title: On pattern classification with weighted dimensions
summary:
Studies on various facets of pattern classification is often imperative while
working with multi-dimensional samples pertaining to diverse application
scenarios. In this notion, weighted dimension-based distance measure has been
one of the vital considerations in pattern analysis as it reflects the degree
of similarity between samples. Though it is often presumed to be settled with
the pervasive use of Euclidean distance, plethora of issues often surface. In
this paper, we present (a) a detail analysis on the impact of distance measure
norms and weights of dimensions along with visualization, (b) a novel weighting
scheme for each dimension, (c) incorporation of this dimensional weighting
schema into a KNN classifier, and (d) pattern classification on a variety of
synthetic as well as realistic datasets with the developed model. It has
performed well across diverse experiments in comparison to the traditional KNN
under the same experimental setups. Specifically, for gene expression datasets,
it yields significant and consistent gain in classification accuracy (around
10%) in all cross-validation experiments with different values of k. As such
datasets contain limited number of samples of high dimensions, meaningful
selection of nearest neighbours is desirable, and this requirement is
reasonably met by regulating the shape and size of the region enclosing the k
number of reference samples with the developed weighting schema and appropriate
norm. It, therefore, stands as an important generalization of KNN classifier
powered by weighted Minkowski distance with the present weighting schema.

title: Why Prototypes Collapse: Diagnosing and Preventing Partial Collapse in Prototypical Self-Supervised Learning
summary:
Prototypical self-supervised learning methods consistently suffer from
partial prototype collapse, where multiple prototypes converge to nearly
identical representations. This undermines their central purpose -- providing
diverse and informative targets to guide encoders toward rich representations
-- and has led practitioners to over-parameterize prototype sets or add ad-hoc
regularizers, which mitigate symptoms rather than address the root cause. We
empirically trace the collapse to the joint optimization of encoders and
prototypes, which encourages a type of shortcut learning: early in training
prototypes drift toward redundant representations that minimize loss without
necessarily enhancing representation diversity. To break the joint
optimization, we introduce a fully decoupled training strategy that learns
prototypes and encoders under separate objectives. Concretely, we model
prototypes as a Gaussian mixture updated with an online EM-style procedure,
independent of the encoder's loss. This simple yet principled decoupling
eliminates prototype collapse without explicit regularization and yields
consistently diverse prototypes and stronger downstream performance.

title: The Verification-Value Paradox: A Normative Critique of Gen AI in Legal Practice
summary:
It is often claimed that machine learning-based generative AI products will
drastically streamline and reduce the cost of legal practice. This enthusiasm
assumes lawyers can effectively manage AI's risks. Cases in Australia and
elsewhere in which lawyers have been reprimanded for submitting inaccurate
AI-generated content to courts suggest this paradigm must be revisited. This
paper argues that a new paradigm is needed to evaluate AI use in practice,
given (a) AI's disconnection from reality and its lack of transparency, and (b)
lawyers' paramount duties like honesty, integrity, and not to mislead the
court. It presents an alternative model of AI use in practice that more
holistically reflects these features (the verification-value paradox). That
paradox suggests increases in efficiency from AI use in legal practice will be
met by a correspondingly greater imperative to manually verify any outputs of
that use, rendering the net value of AI use often negligible to lawyers. The
paper then sets out the paradox's implications for legal practice and legal
education, including for AI use but also the values that the paradox suggests
should undergird legal practice: fidelity to the truth and civic
responsibility.

title: UREM: A High-performance Unified and Resilient Enhancement Method for Multi- and High-Dimensional Indexes
summary:
Numerous multi- or high-dimensional indexes with distinct advantages have
been proposed on various platforms to meet application requirements. To achieve
higher-performance queries, most indexes employ enhancement methods, including
structure-oriented and layout-oriented enhancement methods. Existing
structure-oriented methods tailored to specific indexes work well under static
workloads but lack generality and degrade under dynamic workloads. The
layout-oriented methods exhibit good generality and perform well under dynamic
workloads, but exhibit suboptimal performance under static workloads.
Therefore, it is an open challenge to develop a unified and resilient
enhancement method that can improve query performance for different indexes
adaptively under different scenarios. In this paper, we propose UREM, which is
the first high-performance Unified and Resilient Enhancement Method designed
for both multi- and high-dimensional indexes, capable of adapting to different
scenarios. Specifically, UREM (1) can be uniformly applied with different
indexes on various platforms; (2) enhances the query performance of indexes by
layout optimization under static workloads; (3) enables indexes to stabilize
performance when queries shift through partial layout reorganization. We
evaluate UREM on 20 widely used indexes. Experimental results demonstrate that
UREM improves the query performance of multi- and high-dimensional indexes by
up to 5.73x and 9.18x under static workloads, and by an average of 5.72x and
9.47x under dynamic workloads. Moreover, some traditional indexes enhanced by
UREM even achieve performance comparable to or even surpassing that of recent
advanced indexes.

title: AsyncHZP: Hierarchical ZeRO Parallelism with Asynchronous Scheduling for Scalable LLM Training
summary:
The training efficiency and scalability of language models on massive
clusters currently remain a critical bottleneck. Mainstream approaches like ND
parallelism are often cumbersome and complex, while flexible alternatives such
as the Zero Redundancy Optimizer (ZeRO) are frequently hampered by
communication overhead. In this paper, we propose Asynchronous Hierarchical
Zero Parallelism (AsyncHZP), a novel asynchronous variant of ZeRO designed to
achieve superior performance while maintaining simplicity and memory
efficiency. Unlike traditional ZeRO, which employs over-fine-grained sharding
that can lead to inefficient communication, AsyncHZP adaptively reshards
parameters, gradients, and optimizer states across different replica groups.
This strategy optimizes device memory utilization and significantly reduces
communication overhead. In addition, we also design a multi-stream asynchronous
scheduling method that executes parameter all-gather and gradient
reduce-scatter operations in dedicated background threads, effectively
overlapping communication with computation while incurring negligible memory
fragmentation. Empirical evaluations on both Dense and Mixture-of-Experts (MoE)
models confirm that AsyncHZP maintains robust stability at scale. It
consistently outperforms classic ND parallelism, achieving state-of-the-art
performance without complex strategic tuning, thereby simplifying the path to
efficient large-scale training.

title: SpeechAgent: An End-to-End Mobile Infrastructure for Speech Impairment Assistance
summary:
Speech is essential for human communication, yet millions of people face
impairments such as dysarthria, stuttering, and aphasia conditions that often
lead to social isolation and reduced participation. Despite recent progress in
automatic speech recognition (ASR) and text-to-speech (TTS) technologies,
accessible web and mobile infrastructures for users with impaired speech remain
limited, hindering the practical adoption of these advances in daily
communication. To bridge this gap, we present SpeechAgent, a mobile SpeechAgent
designed to facilitate people with speech impairments in everyday
communication. The system integrates large language model (LLM)- driven
reasoning with advanced speech processing modules, providing adaptive support
tailored to diverse impairment types. To ensure real-world practicality, we
develop a structured deployment pipeline that enables real-time speech
processing on mobile and edge devices, achieving imperceptible latency while
maintaining high accuracy and speech quality. Evaluation on real-world impaired
speech datasets and edge-device latency profiling confirms that SpeechAgent
delivers both effective and user-friendly performance, demonstrating its
feasibility for personalized, day-to-day assistive communication.

title: Interpolatory Approximations of PMU Data: Dimension Reduction and Pilot Selection
summary:
This work investigates the reduction of phasor measurement unit (PMU) data
through low-rank matrix approximations. To reconstruct a PMU data matrix from
fewer measurements, we propose the framework of interpolatory matrix
decompositions (IDs). In contrast to methods relying on principal component
analysis or singular value decomposition, IDs recover the complete data matrix
using only a few of its rows (PMU datastreams) and/or a few of its columns
(snapshots in time). This compression enables the real-time monitoring of power
transmission systems using a limited number of measurements, thereby minimizing
communication bandwidth. The ID perspective gives a rigorous error bound on the
quality of the data compression. We propose selecting rows and columns used in
an ID via the discrete empirical interpolation method (DEIM), a greedy
algorithm that aims to control the error bound. This bound leads to a
computable estimate for the reconstruction error during online operations. A
violation of this estimate suggests a change in the system's operating
conditions, and thus serves as a tool for fault detection. Numerical tests
using synthetic PMU data illustrate DEIM's excellent performance for data
compression, and validate the proposed DEIM-based fault-detection method.

title: Minimizing Residuals in ODE Integration Using Optimal Control
summary:
Given the set of discrete solution points or nodes, called the skeleton,
generated by an ODE solver, we study the problem of fitting a curve passing
through the nodes in the skeleton minimizing a norm of the residual vector of
the ODE. We reformulate this interpolation problem as a multi-stage optimal
control problem and, for the minimization of two different norms, we apply the
associated maximum principle to obtain the necessary conditions of optimality.
We solve the problem analytically for the Dahlquist test problem and a variant
of the leaky bucket problem, in terms of the given skeleton. We also consider
the Van der Pol equation, for which we obtain interpolating curves with minimal
residual norms by numerically solving a direct discretization of the problem
through optimization software. With the skeletons obtained by various ODE
solvers of MATLAB, we make comparisons between the residuals obtained by our
approach and those obtained by the MATLAB function deval.

title: There is No "apple" in Timeseries: Rethinking TSFM through the Lens of Invariance
summary:
Timeseries foundation models (TSFMs) have multiplied, yet lightweight
supervised baselines and even classical models often match them. We argue this
gap stems from the naive importation of NLP or CV pipelines. In language and
vision, large web-scale corpora densely capture human concepts i.e. there are
countless images and text of apples. In contrast, timeseries data is built to
complement the image and text modalities. There are no timeseries dataset that
contains the concept apple. As a result, the scrape-everything-online paradigm
fails for TS. We posit that progress demands a shift from opportunistic
aggregation to principled design: constructing datasets that systematically
span the space of invariance that preserve temporal semantics. To this end, we
suggest that the ontology of timeseries invariances should be built based on
first principles. Only by ensuring representational completeness through
invariance coverage can TSFMs achieve the aligned structure necessary for
generalisation, reasoning, and truly emergent behaviour.

title: Developing a Model-Driven Reengineering Approach for Migrating PL/SQL Triggers to Java: A Practical Experience
summary:
Model-driven software engineering (MDE) techniques are not only useful in
forward engineering scenarios, but can also be successfully applied to evolve
existing systems. RAD (Rapid Application Development) platforms emerged in the
nineties, but the success of modern software technologies motivated that a
large number of enterprises tackled the migration of their RAD applications,
such as Oracle Forms. Our research group has collaborated with a software
company in developing a solution to migrate PL/SQL monolithic code on Forms
triggers and program units to Java code separated in several tiers.
  Our research focused on the model-driven reengineering process applied to
develop the migration tool for the conversion of PL/SQL code to Java. Legacy
code is represented in form of KDM (Knowledge-Discovery Metamodel) models. In
this paper, we propose a software process to implement a model-driven
re-engineering. This process integrates a TDD-like approach to incrementally
develop model transformations with three kinds of validations for the generated
code. The implementation and validation of the re-engineering approach are
explained in detail, as well as the evaluation of some issues related with the
application of MDE.

title: "Learning Together": AI-Mediated Support for Parental Involvement in Everyday Learning
summary:
Family learning takes place in everyday routines where children and
caregivers read, practice, and develop new skills together. Although AI is
increasingly present in learning environments, most systems remain
child-centered and overlook the collaborative, distributed nature of family
education. This paper investigates how AI can mediate family collaboration by
addressing tensions of coordination, uneven workloads, and parental mediation.
From a formative study with families using AI in daily learning, we identified
challenges in responsibility sharing and recognition of contributions. Building
on these insights, we designed FamLearn, an LLM-powered prototype that
distributes tasks, visualizes contributions, and provides individualized
support. A one-week field study with 11 families shows how this prototype can
ease caregiving burdens, foster recognition, and enrich shared learning
experiences. Our findings suggest that LLMs can move beyond the role of tutor
to act as family mediators - balancing responsibilities, scaffolding
intergenerational participation, and strengthening the relational fabric of
family learning.

title: Physics-Guided Fusion for Robust 3D Tracking of Fast Moving Small Objects
summary:
While computer vision has advanced considerably for general object detection
and tracking, the specific problem of fast-moving tiny objects remains
underexplored. This paper addresses the significant challenge of detecting and
tracking rapidly moving small objects using an RGB-D camera. Our novel system
combines deep learning-based detection with physics-based tracking to overcome
the limitations of existing approaches. Our contributions include: (1) a
comprehensive system design for object detection and tracking of fast-moving
small objects in 3D space, (2) an innovative physics-based tracking algorithm
that integrates kinematics motion equations to handle outliers and missed
detections, and (3) an outlier detection and correction module that
significantly improves tracking performance in challenging scenarios such as
occlusions and rapid direction changes. We evaluated our proposed system on a
custom racquetball dataset. Our evaluation shows our system surpassing kalman
filter based trackers with up to 70\% less Average Displacement Error. Our
system has significant applications for improving robot perception on
autonomous platforms and demonstrates the effectiveness of combining
physics-based models with deep learning approaches for real-time 3D detection
and tracking of challenging small objects.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个结合深度学习检测和基于物理跟踪的新系统，用于使用RGB-D相机对快速移动的小物体进行鲁棒3D跟踪。该系统使用运动学方程处理异常值和漏检，在定制的壁球数据集上，其平均位移误差比卡尔曼滤波器减少高达70%。
AI.motivation: 现有的计算机视觉方法在处理快速移动的微小物体的检测和跟踪问题上存在局限性，这个问题尚未得到充分探索。需要一个能够利用RGB-D相机克服这些挑战的新系统。
AI.method: 提出了一种新颖的系统，将基于深度学习的检测与基于物理的跟踪相结合（物理引导融合）。具体贡献包括：1) 针对快速移动小物体3D检测和跟踪的综合系统设计；2) 集成运动学运动方程的创新型基于物理的跟踪算法，用于处理异常值和漏检；3) 一个异常值检测和校正模块，以应对遮挡和快速方向变化等挑战性场景。
AI.result: 在定制的壁球数据集上进行评估。该系统超越了基于卡尔曼滤波的跟踪器，平均位移误差（ADE）减少高达70%。
AI.conclusion: 该系统在提高自主平台上的机器人感知方面具有重要应用，并证明了将基于物理的模型与深度学习方法相结合，用于具有挑战性的小物体实时3D检测和跟踪的有效性。
AI.translation: 尽管计算机视觉在通用物体检测和跟踪方面取得了显著进展，但快速移动微小物体的特定问题仍未得到充分探索。本文解决了使用RGB-D相机检测和跟踪快速移动小物体这一重大挑战。我们的新颖系统结合了基于深度学习的检测和基于物理的跟踪，以克服现有方法的局限性。我们的贡献包括：（1）一个用于3D空间中快速移动小物体检测和跟踪的综合系统设计；（2）一种创新的基于物理的跟踪算法，它集成了运动学运动方程来处理异常值和漏检；（3）一个异常值检测和校正模块，显著提高了在遮挡和快速方向变化等挑战性场景中的跟踪性能。我们在定制的壁球数据集上评估了我们提出的系统。我们的评估显示，我们的系统超越了基于卡尔曼滤波的跟踪器，平均位移误差最多减少70%。我们的系统对于提高自主平台上的机器人感知具有重要应用，并证明了将基于物理的模型与深度学习方法相结合，用于具有挑战性的小物体实时3D检测和跟踪的有效性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种物理引导融合系统，用于使用RGB-D相机对快速移动的小物体进行鲁棒3D跟踪。该系统结合了深度学习检测和创新的基于物理的跟踪算法，后者集成运动学方程以有效处理异常值和漏检。通过异常值检测和校正模块，系统在遮挡和快速方向变化等挑战性场景中表现优异。在定制的壁球数据集上，该系统实现了比基于卡尔曼滤波的跟踪器低70%的平均位移误差，展示了其在机器人感知应用中的潜力。
AI.keywords: 3D跟踪, 快速移动小物体, 物理引导融合, 深度学习, 运动学
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于将传统计算机视觉的深度学习检测能力与基于物理的运动学模型相结合，以解决快速、微小物体跟踪这一特定而困难的问题。这种“物理引导融合”的方法克服了纯数据驱动模型在处理高动态、低数据信噪比情况（如快速运动和遮挡）下的固有弱点。通过明确集成运动学方程来处理异常值和漏检，该系统提高了在机器人感知和自主平台等实时应用中的鲁棒性和精度。使用定制的壁球数据集进行评估是合适的，因为它提供了快速移动小物体的高挑战性场景。

title: A Full Stack Framework for High Performance Quantum-Classical Computing
comments:
9 pages, 8 figures, presented at Cray User Group Meeting 2025, May
  04-09, 2025, New York, NY
summary:
To address the growing needs for scalable High Performance Computing (HPC)
and Quantum Computing (QC) integration, we present our HPC-QC full stack
framework and its hybrid workload development capability with modular
hardware/device-agnostic software integration approach. The latest development
in extensible interfaces for quantum programming, dispatching, and compilation
within existing mature HPC programming environment are demonstrated. Our HPC-QC
full stack enables high-level, portable invocation of quantum kernels from
commercial quantum SDKs within HPC meta-program in compiled languages (C/C++
and Fortran) as well as Python through a quantum programming interface library
extension. An adaptive circuit knitting hypervisor is being developed to
partition large quantum circuits into sub-circuits that fit on smaller noisy
quantum devices and classical simulators. At the lower-level, we leverage Cray
LLVM-based compilation framework to transform and consume LLVM IR and Quantum
IR (QIR) from commercial quantum software frontends in a retargetable fashion
to different hardware architectures. Several hybrid HPC-QC multi-node multi-CPU
and GPU workloads (including solving linear system of equations, quantum
optimization, and simulating quantum phase transitions) have been demonstrated
on HPE EX supercomputers to illustrate functionality and execution viability
for all three components developed so far. This work provides the framework for
a unified quantum-classical programming environment built upon classical HPC
software stack (compilers, libraries, parallel runtime and process scheduling).

AI.title_translation: 用于高性能量子-经典计算的全栈框架
AI.tldr: 我们创建了一个全栈框架，将高性能计算（HPC）和量子计算（QC）集成在一起。它允许HPC程序（如C/C++和Fortran）轻松调用量子内核，使用LLVM和QIR进行编译，并在超级计算机上成功运行了混合量子-经典任务。
AI.motivation: 解决对可扩展高性能计算（HPC）和量子计算（QC）集成日益增长的需求。
AI.method: 提出了一个HPC-QC全栈框架，采用模块化、硬件/设备无关的软件集成方法。通过量子编程接口库扩展，实现从C/C++、Fortran和Python等HPC元程序中可移植地调用量子内核。正在开发自适应电路编织（circuit knitting）监管程序来分割大型量子电路。在底层，利用Cray LLVM编译框架来转换和使用LLVM IR和QIR，实现对不同硬件架构的可重定向。
AI.result: 在HPE EX超级计算机上演示了几种混合HPC-QC多节点多CPU和GPU工作负载（包括求解线性方程组、量子优化和模拟量子相变），以证明该框架所有已开发组件的功能性和执行可行性。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作提供了一个建立在经典HPC软件栈（编译器、库、并行运行时和进程调度）之上的统一量子-经典编程环境框架。
AI.translation: 为了满足对可扩展高性能计算（HPC）和量子计算（QC）集成日益增长的需求，我们提出了我们的HPC-QC全栈框架及其混合工作负载开发能力，该框架采用模块化、硬件/设备无关的软件集成方法。本文展示了在现有成熟HPC编程环境中，用于量子编程、调度和编译的可扩展接口的最新进展。我们的HPC-QC全栈通过量子编程接口库扩展，使得在编译语言（C/C++和Fortran）以及Python中的HPC元程序中，可以进行高层次、可移植地调用商业量子SDK中的量子内核。正在开发一个自适应电路编织（circuit knitting）监管程序，用于将大型量子电路划分为适合较小噪声量子设备和经典模拟器的子电路。在较低层，我们利用Cray基于LLVM的编译框架，以可重定向的方式转换和使用来自商业量子软件前端的LLVM IR和量子IR（QIR），以适应不同的硬件架构。我们已在HPE EX超级计算机上演示了几种混合HPC-QC多节点多CPU和GPU工作负载（包括求解线性方程组、量子优化和模拟量子相变），以说明迄今为止开发的所有三个组件的功能性和执行可行性。这项工作为建立在经典HPC软件栈（编译器、库、并行运行时和进程调度）之上的统一量子-经典编程环境提供了框架。
AI.summary: 为了满足可扩展高性能计算（HPC）与量子计算（QC）集成的需求，本文提出了一个HPC-QC全栈框架。该框架采用模块化、硬件无关的软件集成方法，通过扩展的量子编程接口，支持在HPC元程序中（如C/C++、Fortran和Python）可移植地调用量子内核。底层利用基于LLVM的编译框架处理QIR，实现对不同硬件架构的可重定向。通过在HPE EX超级计算机上演示多种混合工作负载，验证了其功能和执行可行性，为构建统一的量子-经典编程环境奠定了基础。
AI.keywords: 高性能计算 (HPC), 量子计算 (QC), 全栈框架, 混合编程, QIR
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于提出了一个连接成熟高性能计算（HPC）软件栈与新兴量子计算（QC）硬件的全栈框架。它解决了在现实世界的超级计算机环境中扩展和执行混合量子-经典工作负载的关键挑战。通过利用现有的Cray LLVM编译框架来处理量子IR（QIR），该框架实现了对不同硬件架构的可重定向性和兼容性，极大地提高了量子编程的可移植性。这项工作对于推动量子计算在大型科学和工业应用中的实际部署至关重要。

title: SAID: Empowering Large Language Models with Self-Activating Internal Defense
summary:
Large Language Models (LLMs), despite advances in safety alignment, remain
vulnerable to jailbreak attacks designed to circumvent protective mechanisms.
Prevailing defense strategies rely on external interventions, such as input
filtering or output modification, which often lack generalizability and
compromise model utility while incurring significant computational overhead. In
this work, we introduce a new, training-free defense paradigm, Self-Activating
Internal Defense (SAID), which reframes the defense task from external
correction to internal capability activation. SAID uniquely leverages the LLM's
own reasoning abilities to proactively identify and neutralize malicious intent
through a three-stage pipeline: model-native intent distillation to extract
core semantics, optimal safety prefix probing to activate latent safety
awareness, and a conservative aggregation strategy to ensure robust
decision-making. Extensive experiments on five open-source LLMs against six
advanced jailbreak attacks demonstrate that SAID substantially outperforms
state-of-the-art defenses in reducing harmful outputs. Crucially, it achieves
this while preserving model performance on benign tasks and incurring minimal
computational overhead. Our work establishes that activating the intrinsic
safety mechanisms of LLMs is a more robust and scalable path toward building
safer and more reliable aligned AI systems.

AI.title_translation: SAID：以自激活内部防御赋能大型语言模型
AI.tldr: 提出SAID（自激活内部防御），这是一种无需训练的新范式，通过利用LLM自身的推理能力进行三阶段流程（意图提取、安全前缀探测、保守聚合）来主动识别和中和恶意意图，从而有效防御越狱攻击，同时保持模型性能和低计算开销。
AI.motivation: 尽管大型语言模型（LLMs）在安全对齐方面有所进步，但仍容易受到旨在规避保护机制的越狱攻击。现有的防御策略依赖外部干预，这些干预通常缺乏通用性、损害模型效用并产生显著的计算开销。
AI.method: 引入SAID（自激活内部防御），这是一种无需训练的新防御范式，将防御任务从外部校正重构为内部能力激活。SAID独特地利用LLM自身的推理能力，通过一个三阶段流程主动识别和中和恶意意图：1. 模型原生（model-native）意图蒸馏（提取核心语义）；2. 最佳安全前缀探测（激活潜在的安全意识）；3. 保守聚合策略（确保稳健的决策制定）。
AI.result: 在五种开源LLM上针对六种先进的越狱攻击进行的大量实验表明，SAID在减少有害输出方面显著优于最先进的防御方法。更重要的是，它在保持模型在良性任务上的性能的同时，只产生了极小的计算开销。
AI.conclusion: 激活LLM的内在安全机制是构建更安全、更可靠的对齐AI系统的一条更稳健和可扩展的路径。
AI.translation: 尽管大型语言模型（LLMs）在安全对齐方面取得了进步，但它们仍然容易受到旨在规避保护机制的越狱攻击。主流的防御策略依赖于外部干预，例如输入过滤或输出修改，这些方法往往缺乏通用性，损害模型效用，同时产生显著的计算开销。在这项工作中，我们引入了一种新的、无需训练的防御范式——自激活内部防御（SAID），它将防御任务从外部校正重构为内部能力激活。SAID独特地利用LLM自身的推理能力，通过一个三阶段流程主动识别并中和恶意意图：模型原生（model-native）意图蒸馏以提取核心语义、最佳安全前缀探测以激活潜在的安全意识，以及保守聚合策略以确保稳健的决策制定。针对六种先进的越狱攻击，在五种开源LLM上进行的大量实验表明，SAID在减少有害输出方面显著优于最先进的防御方法。至关重要的是，它在保持模型在良性任务上的性能的同时，只产生了极小的计算开销。我们的工作确立了激活LLM的内在安全机制是构建更安全、更可靠的对齐AI系统的一条更稳健和可扩展的路径。
AI.summary: 本文提出了SAID（自激活内部防御），一种无需训练的新型防御范式，旨在解决现有外部防御策略在应对LLM越狱攻击时通用性差、效用受损和计算开销大的问题。SAID通过利用LLM自身的推理能力，设计了一个包含意图蒸馏、安全前缀探测和保守聚合策略的三阶段流程，以实现对恶意意图的主动识别和中和。实验证明，SAID在对抗多种越狱攻击时显著优于现有SOTA防御，同时能保持模型在良性任务上的性能并仅产生极小的计算开销。
AI.keywords: 大型语言模型, 越狱攻击, 内部防御, 安全对齐, 无需训练
AI.comments: SAID的创新点在于将防御焦点从模型外部干预转移到模型内在能力的激活，这是一种范式上的转变。通过利用LLM已有的推理能力进行“自我防御”，它解决了现有外部防御策略（如输入过滤或后处理）在通用性和计算效率上的核心痛点。特别是其“无需训练”的特性，使其具有高度的可扩展性和部署便捷性。这项工作为构建更稳定、更可靠的对齐AI系统提供了一个新的、更具前景的方向。

title: Separating Pseudorandom Generators from Logarithmic Pseudorandom States
summary:
Pseudorandom generators (PRGs) are a foundational primitive in classical
cryptography, underpinning a wide range of constructions. In the quantum
setting, pseudorandom quantum states (PRSs) were proposed as a potentially
weaker assumption that might serve as a substitute for PRGs in cryptographic
applications. Two primary size regimes of PRSs have been studied:
logarithmic-size and linear-size. Interestingly, logarithmic PRSs have led to
powerful cryptographic applications, such as digital signatures and quantum
public-key encryption, that have not been realized from their linear
counterparts. However, PRGs have only been black-box separated from linear
PRSs, leaving open the fundamental question of whether PRGs are also separated
from logarithmic PRSs.
  In this work, we resolve this open problem. We establish a quantum black-box
separation between (quantum-evaluable) PRGs and PRSs of either size regime.
Specifically, we construct a unitary quantum oracle with inverse access
relative to which no black-box construction of PRG from (logarithmic or linear)
PRS exists. As a direct corollary, we obtain separations between PRGs and
several primitives implied by logarithmic PRSs, including digital signatures
and quantum public-key encryption.

AI.title_translation: 将伪随机生成器与对数伪随机状态分离
AI.tldr: 本文解决了伪随机生成器（PRG）是否能从对数伪随机状态（PRS）黑盒分离的开放问题。我们构建了一个具有逆向访问的酉量子谕示，证明了PRG无法通过黑盒方式从对数或线性PRS构造出来，从而实现了它们之间的量子黑盒分离。
AI.motivation: 伪随机生成器（PRGs）是经典密码学的基本原语。在量子设置中，伪随机量子状态（PRSs）被视为潜在的较弱假设替代品。虽然对数尺寸的PRS实现了数字签名和量子公钥加密等强大的密码学应用，但PRGs此前仅被黑盒分离于线性PRS。因此，PRGs是否与对数PRS分离是一个悬而未决的根本性问题。
AI.method: 建立（量子可评估的）PRG与任意尺寸（对数或线性）PRS之间的量子黑盒分离。具体来说，构造一个具有逆向访问的酉量子谕示（unitary quantum oracle with inverse access），相对于该谕示，不存在从PRS黑盒构造PRG的方法。
AI.result: 成功解决了PRG与对数PRS分离的开放问题。证明了相对于所构建的谕示，PRG与对数PRS以及线性PRS之间存在量子黑盒分离。
AI.conclusion: PRG与对数（或线性）PRS之间存在量子黑盒分离。直接推论是，PRG也与对数PRS所蕴含的几个原语（如数字签名和量子公钥加密）分离。
AI.translation: 伪随机生成器（PRGs）是经典密码学的基础原语，支撑着广泛的构造。在量子环境中，伪随机量子状态（PRSs）被提出作为一种可能较弱的假设，可以在密码学应用中替代PRGs。PRSs主要研究了两种尺寸范围：对数尺寸和线性尺寸。有趣的是，对数PRS带来了强大的密码学应用，例如数字签名和量子公钥加密，这些应用尚未通过其线性对应物实现。然而，PRGs此前仅被黑盒分离于线性PRS，这留下了一个基本问题：PRGs是否也与对数PRS分离？在这项工作中，我们解决了这个开放问题。我们建立了（量子可评估的）PRG与任意尺寸范围的PRS之间的量子黑盒分离。具体来说，我们构造了一个具有逆向访问的酉量子谕示，相对于该谕示，不存在从（对数或线性）PRS黑盒构造PRG的方法。作为直接推论，我们获得了PRGs与对数PRS所蕴含的几种原语（包括数字签名和量子公钥加密）之间的分离。
AI.summary: 本文解决了伪随机生成器（PRG）是否能从对数伪随机状态（PRS）黑盒分离的开放问题。研究者通过构造一个具有逆向访问的酉量子谕示，证明了相对于该谕示，不存在通过黑盒方式从对数或线性PRS构造PRG的方法，从而建立了PRG与这两种尺寸PRS之间的量子黑盒分离。这一结果进一步推导了PRG与对数PRS所蕴含的数字签名和量子公钥加密等密码学原语之间的分离。
AI.keywords: 伪随机生成器, 伪随机量子状态, 量子黑盒分离, 对数PRS, 密码学原语
AI.comments: 这项工作解决了量子密码学中的一个重要基础性开放问题，即伪随机生成器（PRG）与对数尺寸伪随机状态（PRS）之间的关系。通过构建一个具有逆向访问的酉量子谕示，作者清晰地界定了这些原语的能力差异，证明了PRG无法通过黑盒方式从PRS构造出来。这一分离结果对于理解和构建基于PRS的量子密码学方案的相对强度和局限性具有重要意义，尤其因为它影响到由对数PRS实现的强大应用（如数字签名和量子公钥加密）。

title: Inverse Image-Based Rendering for Light Field Generation from Single Images
summary:
A concept of light-fields computed from multiple view images on regular grids
has proven its benefit for scene representations, and supported realistic
renderings of novel views and photographic effects such as refocusing and
shallow depth of field. In spite of its effectiveness of light flow
computations, obtaining light fields requires either computational costs or
specialized devices like a bulky camera setup and a specialized microlens
array. In an effort to broaden its benefit and applicability, in this paper, we
propose a novel view synthesis method for light field generation from only
single images, named inverse image-based rendering. Unlike previous attempts to
implicitly rebuild 3D geometry or to explicitly represent objective scenes, our
method reconstructs light flows in a space from image pixels, which behaves in
the opposite way to image-based rendering. To accomplish this, we design a
neural rendering pipeline to render a target ray in an arbitrary viewpoint. Our
neural renderer first stores the light flow of source rays from the input
image, then computes the relationships among them through cross-attention, and
finally predicts the color of the target ray based on these relationships.
After the rendering pipeline generates the first novel view from a single input
image, the generated out-of-view contents are updated to the set of source
rays. This procedure is iteratively performed while ensuring the consistent
generation of occluded contents. We demonstrate that our inverse image-based
rendering works well with various challenging datasets without any retraining
or finetuning after once trained on synthetic dataset, and outperforms relevant
state-of-the-art novel view synthesis methods.

AI.title_translation: 基于单张图像的光场生成的逆向图像渲染
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为“逆向图像渲染”（Inverse Image-Based Rendering, IIBR）的神经渲染方法，仅使用单张图像即可生成光场。该方法通过跨注意力机制重建空间中的光流，并采用迭代更新策略处理遮挡内容，实现了在各种数据集上无需微调即可超越现有先进方法的效果。
AI.motivation: 传统光场生成需要多视角图像、高计算成本或笨重的专业设备（如特殊相机设置或微透镜阵列），限制了光场的应用和普及。
AI.method: 提出逆向图像渲染（IIBR），这是一种从图像像素重建空间光流的神经渲染管线。具体步骤包括：1. 存储输入图像的源射线光流；2. 通过跨注意力计算源射线之间的关系；3. 基于这些关系预测目标射线的颜色。该过程是迭代执行的，新生成的视图内容会被更新到源射线集合中，以确保遮挡内容生成的一致性。
AI.result: 该方法在各种具有挑战性的数据集上表现良好，在合成数据集上训练一次后无需任何再训练或微调。性能优于相关的现有最先进的新颖视图合成方法。
AI.conclusion: 摘要中未提及
AI.translation: 光场是基于规则网格上的多视角图像计算得出的概念，已被证明对场景表示有益，并支持新颖视图的逼真渲染以及重新聚焦和浅景深等摄影效果。尽管光流计算有效，但获取光场需要计算成本或专用设备，如笨重的相机设置和专用微透镜阵列。为了扩大其益处和适用性，本文提出了一种仅从单张图像生成光场的新颖视图合成方法，命名为逆向图像渲染。与以往试图隐式重建三维几何或显式表示客观场景的尝试不同，我们的方法从图像像素重建空间中的光流，其行为与基于图像的渲染方式相反。为实现此目的，我们设计了一个神经渲染管线来渲染任意视点中的目标射线。我们的神经渲染器首先存储来自输入图像的源射线的（光）流，然后通过跨注意力计算它们之间的关系，最后根据这些关系预测目标射线的颜色。在渲染管线从单个输入图像生成第一个新颖视图后，生成的视图外内容会被更新到源射线集合中。该过程是迭代执行的，同时确保遮挡内容生成的一致性。我们证明了我们的逆向图像渲染在合成数据集上训练一次后，无需任何再训练或微调即可在各种具有挑战性的数据集上表现良好，并优于相关的现有最先进的新颖视图合成方法。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为“逆向图像渲染”（IIBR）的新颖视图合成方法，旨在解决传统光场生成需要多视角图像和昂贵设备的限制。IIBR是一种神经渲染管线，通过从单个输入图像的像素重建空间中的光流来生成光场。该方法利用跨注意力机制计算源射线间的关系并预测目标射线颜色，并采用迭代更新策略来确保遮挡内容生成的一致性。实验证明，该方法在仅使用合成数据训练一次后，即可在各种挑战性数据集上表现优异，并超越了现有的先进新颖视图合成技术。
AI.keywords: 光场生成, 单张图像, 逆向图像渲染, 神经渲染, 跨注意力
AI.comments: 创新点在于提出了“逆向图像渲染”（IIBR）的概念，即从像素到光流的空间重建，与传统的基于图像的渲染（IBR）方向相反。技术上，它结合了神经渲染和跨注意力机制，并引入了迭代更新机制来处理关键的遮挡和内容一致性问题。重要性在于它大大降低了光场获取的门槛，使其可以从单张图像生成，从而拓宽了光场技术的应用范围，尤其是在需要轻量级输入或实时应用的场景中。

title: Revisiting Logit Distributions for Reliable Out-of-Distribution Detection
summary:
Out-of-distribution (OOD) detection is critical for ensuring the reliability
of deep learning models in open-world applications. While post-hoc methods are
favored for their efficiency and ease of deployment, existing approaches often
underexploit the rich information embedded in the model's logits space. In this
paper, we propose LogitGap, a novel post-hoc OOD detection method that
explicitly exploits the relationship between the maximum logit and the
remaining logits to enhance the separability between in-distribution (ID) and
OOD samples. To further improve its effectiveness, we refine LogitGap by
focusing on a more compact and informative subset of the logit space.
Specifically, we introduce a training-free strategy that automatically
identifies the most informative logits for scoring. We provide both theoretical
analysis and empirical evidence to validate the effectiveness of our approach.
Extensive experiments on both vision-language and vision-only models
demonstrate that LogitGap consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance
across diverse OOD detection scenarios and benchmarks. Code is available at
https://github.com/GIT-LJc/LogitGap.

AI.title_translation: 重新审视 Logit 分布以实现可靠的分布外检测
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为 LogitGap 的新型后验 OOD 检测方法。它通过利用最大 Logit 与其余 Logit 之间的差距，并采用无训练策略自动选择信息量最大的 Logit 子集，显著提升了分布外检测的性能，并在多种基准上达到了 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 分布外 (OOD) 检测对于确保深度学习模型在开放世界应用中的可靠性至关重要。现有的后验方法通常未充分利用模型 Logit 空间中嵌入的丰富信息。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为 LogitGap 的新型后验 OOD 检测方法。该方法明确利用了最大 Logit 与其余 Logit 之间的关系，以增强 ID 和 OOD 样本之间的可分离性。此外，LogitGap 通过引入一种无训练策略，自动识别信息量最大的 Logit 子集进行评分，从而进一步提高了有效性。
AI.result: 在视觉-语言模型和纯视觉模型上的大量实验表明，LogitGap 在各种 OOD 检测场景和基准上始终达到最先进（SOTA）的性能。
AI.conclusion: LogitGap 通过充分利用 Logit 空间信息，特别是最大 Logit 与其余 Logit 的关系以及自动选择信息子集，有效地提高了 OOD 检测的可靠性和性能。
AI.translation: 分布外 (OOD) 检测对于确保深度学习模型在开放世界应用中的可靠性至关重要。尽管后验方法因其效率和易于部署而受到青睐，但现有方法往往未充分利用模型 Logit 空间中嵌入的丰富信息。在本文中，我们提出了 LogitGap，这是一种新颖的后验 OOD 检测方法，它明确利用了最大 Logit 与其余 Logit 之间的关系，以增强分布内 (ID) 和 OOD 样本之间的可分离性。为了进一步提高其有效性，我们通过关注 Logit 空间中更紧凑和信息量更大的子集来完善 LogitGap。具体来说，我们引入了一种无训练策略，可以自动识别用于评分的最具信息量的 Logit。我们提供了理论分析和经验证据来验证我们方法的有效性。对视觉-语言模型和纯视觉模型进行的大量实验表明，LogitGap 在各种 OOD 检测场景和基准上始终达到最先进的性能。代码可在 https://github.com/GIT-LJc/LogitGap 获取。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 LogitGap，一种新颖的后验 OOD 检测方法，旨在解决现有方法对 Logit 空间信息利用不足的问题。LogitGap 通过显式利用最大 Logit 与剩余 Logit 之间的关系来提高 ID/OOD 样本的可分离性。该方法还引入了一种无训练策略，自动选择最具信息量的 Logit 子集进行评分。理论分析和广泛的实验证明，LogitGap 在视觉-语言和纯视觉模型上的各种 OOD 检测任务中均取得了最先进的性能。
AI.keywords: 分布外检测, Logit 分布, 后验方法, LogitGap, 状态最优性能
AI.comments: 这项工作创新点在于重新审视并充分挖掘了模型 Logit 空间中的信息，特别是最大 Logit 与其他 Logit 的“差距”关系，这是一种轻量级的、后处理（post-hoc）的改进方式。通过引入无训练的 Logit 子集选择策略，该方法在不增加额外训练开销的前提下，增强了 OOD 检测的鲁棒性和信息利用效率。在开放世界应用中，后验方法的效率和 SOTA 性能使其具有重要的实用价值。

title: Design Optimization and Global Impact Assessment of Solar-Thermal Direct Air Carbon Capture
summary:
The dual challenge of decarbonizing the economy and meeting rising global
energy demand underscores the need for scalable and cost-effective carbon
dioxide removal technologies. Direct air capture (DAC) is among the most
promising approaches, but its high energy intensity, particularly the thermal
energy required for sorbent regeneration, remains a critical barrier to cost
reduction and sustainable deployment. This study explores solar-thermal DAC
systems that combine concentrated solar thermal technology with low-cost
sand-based thermal energy storage to meet this demand. We analyze the
techno-economic performance of such systems in both grid-connected and
stand-alone configurations. Results show that solar-thermal DAC can achieve
annual capacity factors exceeding 80% and CO2 removal costs as low as 160-200
USD per ton, making it competitive with leading DAC technologies. The proposed
system operates most efficiently with short-cycle sorbents that align with
solar availability. The stand-alone Solar-DAC systems, which rely solely on
solar energy for both electricity and thermal energy, are particularly
promising in regions with high solar capacity and sandy terrain, exhibiting
minimal ambient sensitivity from temperature and humidity. An optimal 6000
ton/yr modular system design takes <1 km2 land-use requirement and potentially
>26 Gt/year DAC capacity is identified for sandy terrain alone globally. In
areas with sedimentary basins suitable for CO2 storage, solar-powered DAC
offers a lower-cost alternative to geothermal heating, which often faces
geological and economic constraints.

AI.title_translation: 太阳能热驱动直接空气碳捕集的设计优化与全球影响评估
AI.tldr: 本研究提出并分析了一种结合聚光太阳能热技术和低成本沙基储热的太阳能热驱动直接空气碳捕集（DAC）系统。结果显示，该系统成本可低至160-200美元/吨二氧化碳，具有高容量系数和全球超过26 Gt/年的巨大潜力，特别适用于高日照和多沙地区。
AI.motivation: 解决经济脱碳和全球能源需求增长的双重挑战，并克服有前景的直接空气碳捕集（DAC）技术面临的能耗高、特别是吸附剂再生所需热能强度大的关键障碍，以实现可持续部署和成本降低。
AI.method: 探索并分析了太阳能热驱动DAC系统，该系统结合了聚光太阳能热技术和低成本沙基热能存储。研究评估了此类系统在并网和独立配置下的技术经济性能。
AI.result: 1. 太阳能热驱动DAC的年容量系数可超过80%。2. CO2去除成本可低至160-200美元/吨，与领先的DAC技术具有竞争力。3. 系统与符合太阳能可用性的短周期吸附剂配合使用效率最高。4. 独立太阳能DAC系统在温度和湿度方面的环境敏感性极小，在太阳能容量高和多沙地区前景广阔。5. 确定了一个最佳的模块化系统设计（6000吨/年），其占地面积小于1平方公里，并且仅在全球多沙地区潜在DAC容量可超过26 Gt/年。6. 在具有CO2存储盆地的地区，该系统提供了比地热加热更低成本的替代方案。
AI.conclusion: 太阳能热驱动直接空气碳捕集（DAC）系统，特别是独立配置的系统，通过利用低成本沙基储热和高太阳能资源，能够实现具有竞争力的成本（160-200 USD/吨）和高容量系数，为全球大规模、可持续的CO2去除提供了极具前景的解决方案。
AI.translation: 经济脱碳和满足日益增长的全球能源需求带来的双重挑战，凸显了对可扩展且具有成本效益的二氧化碳去除技术的必要性。直接空气碳捕集（DAC）是最有前景的方法之一，但其高能耗，特别是吸附剂再生所需的热能，仍然是降低成本和可持续部署的关键障碍。本研究探索了太阳能热驱动DAC系统，该系统将聚光太阳能热技术与低成本沙基热能存储相结合以满足热能需求。我们分析了此类系统在并网和独立配置下的技术经济性能。结果显示，太阳能热驱动DAC可以实现超过80%的年容量系数，CO2去除成本低至每吨160-200美元，使其与领先的DAC技术具有竞争力。所提出的系统与符合太阳能可用性的短周期吸附剂配合使用效率最高。独立太阳能DAC系统完全依靠太阳能提供电力和热能，在太阳能容量高和多沙的地区尤其有前景，并且对温度和湿度的环境敏感性极小。研究确定了一个最佳的6000吨/年模块化系统设计，其土地使用需求小于1平方公里，并且仅在全球多沙地区潜在的DAC容量可超过26 Gt/年。在适合CO2存储的沉积盆地地区，太阳能驱动的DAC提供了一种比地热加热更低成本的替代方案，后者经常面临地质和经济限制。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种结合聚光太阳能热技术和沙基热能存储的太阳能热驱动直接空气碳捕集（DAC）系统，旨在克服传统DAC的高能耗障碍。通过分析并网和独立配置的技术经济性能，研究发现该系统能够实现超过80%的年容量系数和160-200美元/吨的低成本。独立系统在多沙、高日照地区表现出最小的环境敏感性，并确定了一个最佳模块化设计，预估全球仅在多沙地区就有超过26 Gt/年的巨大潜在碳捕集容量。
AI.keywords: 太阳能热驱动DAC, 沙基热能存储, 成本优化, 全球影响评估, 碳捕集
AI.comments: 这项研究的创新点在于将聚光太阳能热技术和低成本沙基储热相结合，直接解决了DAC技术中成本高昂且难以持续的热能供应问题。通过提出完全依赖太阳能的独立系统配置，该研究不仅提供了成本竞争力强的解决方案，还极大地拓宽了DAC的地理部署范围，尤其是在具有丰富太阳能和沙地资源的地区。全球超过26 Gt/年的潜力评估突显了该技术对气候变化缓解的重大影响，使其成为极具前景的DAC发展方向。

title: Joint Signal Recovery and Uncertainty Quantification via the Residual Prior Transform
summary:
Conventional priors used for signal recovery are often limited by the
assumption that the type of a signal's variability, such as piecewise constant
or linear behavior, is known and fixed. This assumption is problematic for
complex signals that exhibit different behaviors across the domain. The
recently developed {\em residual transform operator} effectively reduces such
variability-dependent error within the LASSO regression framework. Importantly,
it does not require prior information regarding structure of the underlying
signal. This paper reformulates the residual transform operator into a new
prior within a hierarchical Bayesian framework. In so doing, it unlocks two
powerful new capabilities. First, it enables principled uncertainty
quantification, providing robust credible intervals for the recovered signal,
and second, it provides a natural framework for the joint recovery of signals
from multimodal measurements by coherently fusing information from disparate
data sources. Numerical experiments demonstrate that the residual prior yields
high-fidelity signal and image recovery from multimodal data while providing
robust uncertainty quantification.

AI.title_translation: 通过残差先验变换进行联合信号恢复和不确定性量化
AI.tldr: 通过将残差变换构建为新的贝叶斯先验，我们实现了对复杂信号的高保真恢复、稳健的不确定性量化，以及来自多模态数据的联合信息融合，而无需预先知道信号的结构。
AI.motivation: 传统信号恢复中使用的先验受限于对信号变化类型（如分段常数或线性）是已知且固定的假设，这对于在域内表现出不同行为的复杂信号是有问题的。
AI.method: 将残差变换算子重新构建为一个分层贝叶斯框架中的新先验。
AI.result: 实现了稳健的置信区间估计（不确定性量化），并提供了一个自然框架，用于通过相干地融合来自不同数据源的信息来联合恢复来自多模态测量的信号。数值实验证明了高保真恢复和稳健的不确定性量化。
AI.conclusion: 残差先验在从多模态数据进行高保真信号和图像恢复的同时，提供了稳健的不确定性量化。
AI.translation: 传统的信号恢复先验通常受限于信号变化类型（如分段常数或线性行为）是已知且固定的假设。这种假设对于在域内表现出不同行为的复杂信号是有问题的。最近开发的残差变换算子有效地减少了 LASSO 回归框架内的此类变化相关误差。重要的是，它不需要关于底层信号结构的先验信息。本文将残差变换算子重新构建为一个分层贝叶斯框架中的新先验。通过这样做，它解锁了两个强大的新功能。首先，它实现了原则性的不确定性量化，为恢复的信号提供了稳健的置信区间；其次，它为从多模态测量中联合恢复信号提供了一个自然的框架，通过相干地融合来自不同数据源的信息。数值实验证明了残差先验能够从多模态数据中实现高保真信号和图像恢复，同时提供稳健的不确定性量化。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种新的残差先验，它基于残差变换算子，并将其置于分层贝叶斯框架中。这种方法克服了传统先验的局限性，实现了复杂信号的联合恢复和不确定性量化，并能有效融合多模态测量数据。
AI.keywords: 残差先验, 信号恢复, 不确定性量化, 贝叶斯框架, 多模态测量
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于将残差变换算子重新构建为一个分层贝叶斯框架中的新先验，这使得不确定性量化和多模态数据联合恢复成为可能。其重要性在于解决了传统先验对信号变化类型预先设定的局限性。局限性方面，摘要未明确指出。

title: HALOC-AxA: An Area/-Energy-Efficient Approximate Adder for Image Processing Application
summary:
The design of approximate adders has been widely researched to advance
energy-efficient hardware for computation-intensive multimedia applications,
such as image, audio, or video processing. The design of approximate adders has
been widely researched to advance energy-efficient hardware for computation
intensive multimedia applications, such as image/audio/video processing.
Several static and dynamic approximate adders exist in the literature, each of
which endeavors to balance the conflicting demands of high performance,
computational accuracy, and energy efficiency. This work introduces a novel
approximate adder that is more energy- and area-efficient than existing adders,
while achieving improved or comparable accuracy, as demonstrated by simulation
results. The proposed adder's ability to digitally reconstruct high quality
images is further demonstrated by the deployment of the design for an image
processing task.

AI.title_translation: HALOC-AxA：一种用于图像处理应用的面积/能效近似加法器
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为HALOC-AxA的新型近似加法器，它比现有设计具有更高的面积和能效，同时保持了良好的精度，并被证明可用于高质量图像处理。
AI.motivation: 现有研究旨在通过设计近似加法器来推进用于图像、音频、视频处理等计算密集型多媒体应用的能效硬件。目前的近似加法器需要在高性能、计算精度和能效之间进行权衡。本文的动机是设计一种在能效和面积方面更优，同时保持或提高精度的近似加法器。
AI.method: 引入了一种名为HALOC-AxA的新型近似加法器设计。
AI.result: 提出的加法器通过仿真证明比现有加法器更具能效和面积效率，并且实现了改进或相当的精度。通过将其部署到图像处理任务中，证明了其能够数字重建高质量图像。
AI.conclusion: Not mentioned in abstract
AI.translation: 近似加法器的设计已被广泛研究，旨在推动用于图像、音频或视频处理等计算密集型多媒体应用的节能硬件发展。文献中存在多种静态和动态近似加法器，它们都试图平衡高性能、计算精度和能效之间相互冲突的需求。这项工作引入了一种新型近似加法器，通过仿真结果证明，它比现有加法器具有更高的能效和面积效率，同时实现了改进或相当的精度。通过将该设计部署到图像处理任务中，进一步证明了所提出的加法器能够数字重建高质量图像。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了一种名为HALOC-AxA的新型近似加法器，旨在解决计算密集型多媒体应用中能效硬件的设计挑战。该设计在保持或提高计算精度的同时，显著提高了面积效率和能效。通过仿真和在实际图像处理任务中的部署，证明了HALOC-AxA能够数字重建高质量图像，展示了其在能效计算领域的优势。
AI.keywords: 近似加法器, 能效硬件, 图像处理, 面积效率, HALOC-AxA
AI.comments: 这项工作的创新点在于提出了一种新型近似加法器（HALOC-AxA），它有效地解决了近似计算中精度、面积和能效之间的核心矛盾。通过在图像处理应用中进行实际部署验证，论文展示了该设计不仅在理论上提高了硬件效率，而且在实际应用中保持了高质量的输出（数字重建高质量图像），这对于推进边缘计算和移动设备上的多媒体处理具有重要意义。

title: General transformation neural networks: A class of parametrized functions for high-dimensional function approximation
summary:
We propose a novel class of neural network-like parametrized functions, i.e.,
general transformation neural networks (GTNNs), for high-dimensional
approximation. Conventional deep neural networks sometimes perform less
accurately in approximation problems under gradient descent training,
especially when the target function is oscillatory. To improve accuracy, we
generalize the affine transformation of the abstract neuron to more general
functions, which act as complex shape functions and have larger capacities.
Specifically, we introduce two types of GTNNs: the cubic and quadratic
transformation neural networks (CTNNs and QTNNs). We perform approximation
error analysis for CTNNs and QTNNs, presenting their universal approximation
properties for continuous functions and error bounds for smooth functions and
Barron-type functions. Several numerical examples of regression problems and
partial differential equations are presented, demonstrating that CTNNs/QTNNs
have advantages in accuracy and robustness over conventional fully connected
neural networks.

AI.title_translation: 广义变换神经网络：一类用于高维函数逼近的参数化函数
AI.tldr: 提出广义变换神经网络（GTNNs），通过将神经元中的仿射变换推广到更复杂的函数，解决了传统深度神经网络在逼近高维振荡函数时的精度不足问题。理论分析证明了其泛化能力，数值实验显示其在准确性和鲁棒性上优于传统网络。
AI.motivation: 传统深度神经网络（DNNs）在梯度下降训练下的逼近问题中，尤其是在目标函数具有振荡性时，精度较低。为了提高逼近精度，需要一种具有更大容量和更复杂形状函数的参数化函数类。
AI.method: 提出了一种新型的类神经网络参数化函数——广义变换神经网络（GTNNs）。该方法将抽象神经元的仿射变换推广到更一般的函数，使其充当复杂的形状函数并具有更大的容量。具体引入了立方和二次变换神经网络（CTNNs和QTNNs）两种类型。同时对CTNNs和QTNNs进行了逼近误差分析，证明了其对于连续函数的通用逼近性质，并给出了针对光滑函数和Barron型函数的误差界。
AI.result: 通过回归问题和偏微分方程的数值示例表明，CTNNs/QTNNs在准确性和鲁棒性方面优于传统的全连接神经网络。
AI.conclusion: GTNNs（特别是CTNNs/QTNNs）通过推广神经元的变换函数，成功提高了高维函数逼近的准确性和鲁棒性，解决了传统深度神经网络在处理振荡函数时的精度问题。
AI.translation: 我们提出了一类新型的类神经网络参数化函数，即广义变换神经网络（GTNNs），用于高维函数逼近。传统的深度神经网络在梯度下降训练下的逼近问题中，有时表现不佳，尤其当目标函数是振荡的时。为了提高精度，我们将抽象神经元的仿射变换推广到更一般的函数，这些函数充当复杂的形状函数并具有更大的容量。具体来说，我们引入了两种类型的GTNNs：立方和二次变换神经网络（CTNNs和QTNNs）。我们对CTNNs和QTNNs进行了逼近误差分析，提出了它们对连续函数的通用逼近性质以及对光滑函数和Barron型函数的误差界。通过回归问题和偏微分方程的若干数值示例表明，CTNNs/QTNNs在准确性和鲁棒性方面优于传统的全连接神经网络。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种新型的参数化函数类——广义变换神经网络（GTNNs），旨在解决传统深度神经网络在逼近高维振荡函数时精度不足的问题。GTNNs通过将神经元中的仿射变换推广为更一般的、具有更大容量的复杂形状函数来实现精度提升。具体实现包括立方和二次变换神经网络（CTNNs和QTNNs）。研究提供了理论基础，包括通用逼近性质和误差界分析。数值实验（如回归和偏微分方程求解）证明了CTNNs/QTNNs在准确性和鲁棒性方面均优于传统的全连接神经网络。
AI.keywords: 广义变换神经网络, 高维函数逼近, 通用逼近, 误差界
AI.comments: 这项工作提出了一个有前景的架构创新，即GTNNs，通过修改神经元的核心操作（从仿射变换到更一般的函数）来增强网络的表示能力。这种方法直接针对传统DNNs在处理高维、高振荡函数时的已知局限性（即精度不足）。通过提供严谨的理论分析（通用逼近和误差界）以及实际的数值验证（回归和偏微分方程），该研究为高维函数逼近提供了一个理论扎实且性能优越的替代方案。创新点在于对神经元基本结构的泛化，而不是仅仅依赖于网络的深度或宽度。

title: Understanding Mechanistic Role of Structural and Functional Connectivity in Tau Propagation Through Multi-Layer Modeling
summary:
Emerging neuroimaging evidence shows that pathological tau proteins build up
along specific brain networks, suggesting that large-scale network architecture
plays a key role in the progression of Alzheimer's disease (AD). However, how
structural connectivity (SC) and functional connectivity (FC) interact to
influence tau propagation remains unclear. Leveraging an unprecedented volume
of longitudinal neuroimaging data, we examine SC-FC interactions through a
multi-layer graph diffusion model. Beyond showing that connectome architecture
constrains tau spread, our model reveals a regionally asymmetric contribution
of SC and FC. Specifically, FC predominantly drives tau spread in subcortical
areas, the insula, frontal and temporal cortices, whereas SC plays a larger
role in occipital, parietal, and limbic regions. The relative dominance of SC
versus FC shifts over the course of disease, with FC generally prevailing in
early AD and SC becoming primary in later stages. Spatial patterns of SC- and
FC-dominant regions strongly align with the regional expression of
AD-associated genes involved in inflammation, apoptosis, and lysosomal
function, including CHUK (IKK-alpha), TMEM106B, MCL1, NOTCH1, and TH. In
parallel, other non-modifiable risk factors (e.g., APOE genotype, sex) and
biological mechanisms (e.g., amyloid deposition) selectively reshape tau
propagation by shifting dominant routes between anatomical and functional
pathways in a region-specific manner. Findings are validated in an independent
AD cohort.

AI.title_translation: 通过多层建模理解结构和功能连接在Tau蛋白传播中的机制作用
AI.tldr: 该研究使用多层图扩散模型和纵向神经影像数据，揭示了在阿尔茨海默病（AD）中，结构连接（SC）和功能连接（FC）对Tau蛋白传播的贡献存在区域不对称性，并在疾病进程中发生转变（早期FC主导，晚期SC主导）。这种不对称性与AD相关基因的区域表达一致，并且受APOE基因型和淀粉样蛋白沉积等因素的影响。
AI.motivation: 神经影像证据表明病理性的Tau蛋白沿着特定的脑网络积累，暗示大规模网络结构在阿尔茨海默病（AD）进展中起关键作用。然而，结构连接（SC）和功能连接（FC）如何相互作用并影响Tau蛋白传播的机制尚不清楚。
AI.method: 利用大量空前的纵向神经影像数据，通过一个多层图扩散模型来检查结构连接（SC）和功能连接（FC）之间的相互作用。研究结果在一个独立的AD队列中进行了验证。
AI.result: 1. 连接组结构限制了Tau蛋白的扩散。2. SC和FC的贡献存在区域不对称性：FC主要驱动皮层下区域、脑岛、额叶和颞叶皮质的Tau扩散；SC在枕叶、顶叶和边缘区域作用更大。3. 相对主导地位随疾病进程变化：FC在早期AD中普遍占主导，SC在晚期阶段成为主要驱动因素。4. SC和FC主导区域的空间模式与涉及炎症、细胞凋亡和溶酶体功能的AD相关基因（如CHUK、TMEM106B等）的区域表达高度一致。5. 不可改变的风险因素（如APOE基因型、性别）和生物学机制（如淀粉样蛋白沉积）通过区域特异性地改变解剖和功能通路之间的主导路径，选择性地重塑Tau蛋白传播。
AI.conclusion: 通过多层建模，本研究揭示了结构连接和功能连接对Tau蛋白传播的贡献具有区域和时间上的不对称性，并受基因表达和风险因素的调控。这些发现为理解AD进展中的网络机制提供了新的见解。
AI.translation: 新出现的神经影像证据表明，病理性的Tau蛋白沿着特定的脑网络积累，这表明大规模网络结构在阿尔茨海默病（AD）的进展中起着关键作用。然而，结构连接（SC）和功能连接（FC）如何相互作用并影响Tau蛋白传播的机制仍不清楚。我们利用空前大量的纵向神经影像数据，通过一个多层图扩散模型来检查SC-FC的相互作用。除了表明连接组结构限制了Tau蛋白的扩散外，我们的模型还揭示了SC和FC在区域上的不对称贡献。具体来说，FC主要驱动皮层下区域、脑岛、额叶和颞叶皮质的Tau扩散，而SC在枕叶、顶叶和边缘区域发挥更大的作用。SC与FC的相对主导地位在疾病进程中发生转变，FC通常在早期AD中占主导地位，而SC在晚期阶段成为主要因素。SC和FC主导区域的空间模式与涉及炎症、细胞凋亡和溶酶体功能的AD相关基因（包括CHUK (IKK-alpha)、TMEM106B、MCL1、NOTCH1和TH）的区域表达高度一致。同时，其他不可改变的风险因素（例如，APOE基因型、性别）和生物学机制（例如，淀粉样蛋白沉积）通过以区域特异性的方式改变解剖和功能通路之间的主导路径，选择性地重塑Tau蛋白传播。研究结果在一个独立的AD队列中得到了验证。
AI.summary: 本研究利用纵向神经影像数据和多层图扩散模型，探究了结构连接（SC）和功能连接（FC）在阿尔茨海默病（AD）中对Tau蛋白传播的相互作用机制。结果发现，SC和FC的贡献具有区域不对称性，FC主导皮层下和部分皮质区，SC主导后部和边缘区。此外，这种主导地位随疾病进程发生转变（早期FC，晚期SC）。这种模式与AD相关基因的区域表达相符，并受APOE基因型和淀粉样蛋白沉积等风险因素的调控。
AI.keywords: Tau蛋白传播, 结构连接, 功能连接, 多层建模, 阿尔茨海默病
AI.comments: 这项研究的创新点在于首次采用多层图扩散模型来系统地解析结构连接和功能连接在Tau蛋白传播中的动态和区域特异性作用，克服了以往研究仅关注单一连接模式的局限。利用纵向神经影像大数据集进行分析和独立队列验证，增强了结果的可靠性。揭示的SC/FC主导模式与AD相关基因表达和风险因素的关联，为理解AD进展的复杂网络生物学机制提供了关键的机械性见解，可能指导未来基于网络靶点的治疗策略。

title: Dependency-Aware Task Offloading in Multi-UAV Assisted Collaborative Mobile Edge Computing
comments:
Preprint version. Under review for possible publication in IEEE
  Transactions on Vehicular Technology
summary:
This paper proposes a novel multi-unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) assisted
collaborative mobile edge computing (MEC) framework, where the computing tasks
of terminal devices (TDs) can be decomposed into serial or parallel sub-tasks
and offloaded to collaborative UAVs. We first model the dependencies among all
sub-tasks as a directed acyclic graph (DAG) and design a two-timescale frame
structure to decouple the sub-task interdependencies for sub-task scheduling.
Then, a joint sub-task offloading, computational resource allocation, and UAV
trajectories optimization problem is formulated, which aims to minimize the
system cost, i.e., the weighted sum of the task completion delay and the system
energy consumption. To solve this non-convex mixed-integer nonlinear
programming (MINLP) problem, a penalty dual decomposition and successive convex
approximation (PDD-SCA) algorithm is developed. Particularly, the original
MINLP problem is equivalently transferred into a continuous form relying on PDD
theory. By decoupling the resulting problem into three nested subproblems, the
SCA method is further combined to recast the non-convex components and obtain
desirable solutions. Numerical results demonstrate that: 1) Compared to the
benchmark algorithms, the proposed scheme can significantly reduce the system
cost, and thus realize an improved trade-off between task latency and energy
consumption; 2) The proposed algorithm can achieve an efficient workload
balancing for distributed computation across multiple UAVs.

AI.title_translation: 多无人机辅助协作移动边缘计算中的依赖感知任务卸载
AI.tldr: 为解决多UAV协作MEC中的任务卸载和调度问题，本文提出了一种考虑任务依赖性的框架，建模为MINLP问题，并设计了PDD-SCA算法来联合优化卸载、资源和轨迹，以最小化延迟和能耗的加权和，结果表明系统成本显著降低。
AI.motivation: 旨在于多无人机（UAV）辅助协作移动边缘计算（MEC）框架中，解决终端设备（TDs）计算任务的分解、卸载和调度问题，以最小化系统成本（任务完成延迟和系统能耗的加权和）。
AI.method: 首先将子任务依赖性建模为有向无环图（DAG），并设计双时间尺度的帧结构来解耦子任务的相互依赖性。然后，将联合子任务卸载、计算资源分配和UAV轨迹优化问题公式化为一个最小化系统成本的非凸混合整数非线性规划（MINLP）问题。为求解该问题，开发了惩罚对偶分解和连续凸近似（PDD-SCA）算法，通过将MINLP等效转换为连续形式，并将其解耦为三个嵌套子问题，结合SCA方法处理非凸部分。
AI.result: 与基准算法相比，所提出的方案能显著降低系统成本，实现了任务延迟和能耗之间的改进权衡，并且能高效地实现多UAV之间分布式计算的工作负载均衡。
AI.conclusion: 数值结果表明，所提出的方案相比基准算法能显著降低系统成本，实现了任务延迟和能耗之间的改进权衡，并能有效实现多UAV之间分布式计算的工作负载均衡。
AI.translation: 本文提出了一个新颖的多无人机（UAV）辅助协作移动边缘计算（MEC）框架，其中终端设备（TDs）的计算任务可以分解为串行或并行的子任务并卸载到协作无人机上。我们首先将所有子任务之间的依赖关系建模为有向无环图（DAG），并设计了一个双时间尺度的帧结构来解耦子任务的相互依赖性，以进行子任务调度。然后，我们提出了一个联合子任务卸载、计算资源分配和UAV轨迹优化的问题，旨在最小化系统成本，即任务完成延迟和系统能耗的加权和。为求解该非凸混合整数非线性规划（MINLP）问题，我们开发了一种惩罚对偶分解和连续凸近似（PDD-SCA）算法。特别是，原始的MINLP问题依赖于PDD理论被等效地转移到一个连续形式。通过将所得问题解耦为三个嵌套的子问题，进一步结合SCA方法来重构非凸分量并获得期望的解。数值结果表明：1）与基准算法相比，所提出的方案可以显著降低系统成本，从而实现了任务延迟和能耗之间的改进权衡；2）所提出的算法可以实现在多UAV之间分布式计算的高效工作负载均衡。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一个新颖的多UAV协作MEC框架，用于卸载终端设备的计算任务。该框架将任务分解为串/并行子任务，利用有向无环图（DAG）建模依赖性，并采用双时间尺度的帧结构进行调度。研究者将联合卸载、资源分配和UAV轨迹优化问题建模为最小化系统成本的MINLP问题，并开发了惩罚对偶分解和连续凸近似（PDD-SCA）算法来求解，以期在延迟和能耗之间取得优化。
AI.keywords: UAV, 移动边缘计算, 任务卸载, 资源分配, 轨迹优化
AI.comments: 该研究的创新点在于提出了一个考虑任务依赖性的多UAV协作MEC卸载框架，并设计了双时间尺度的帧结构来解耦依赖性，以优化系统成本。其局限性在于模型为非凸MINLP，虽然提出了PDD-SCA算法求解，但实际性能仍需在更复杂的动态场景中验证。

title: Rank-GRPO: Training LLM-based Conversational Recommender Systems with Reinforcement Learning
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) are reshaping the recommender system paradigm by
enabling users to express preferences and receive recommendations through
conversations. Yet, aligning LLMs to the recommendation task remains
challenging: pretrained LLMs often generate out-of-catalog items, violate
required output formats, and their ranking quality degrades sharply toward the
end of the generated list. To this end, we propose ConvRec-R1, a two-stage
framework for end-to-end training of LLM-based conversational recommender
systems. In Stage 1, we construct a behavioral-cloning dataset with a
Remap-Reflect-Adjust pipeline, which produces high-quality, catalog-grounded
demonstrations from powerful blackbox LLMs to warm-start the RL training. In
Stage 2, we propose Rank-GRPO, a principled extension of group relative policy
optimization (GRPO) tailored to tasks with rank-style outputs. Rank-GRPO treats
each rank in the recommendation list as the unit instead of token (too
fine-grained) or sequence (too coarse), redefining rewards to remove non-causal
credit assignment and introducing a rank-level importance ratio based on the
geometric mean of rank-wise token probabilities to stabilize policy updates.
Experiments on the public Reddit-v2 dataset show that ConvRec-R1 converges
faster and achieves higher Recall and NDCG than GRPO-style baselines. Code and
datasets are released at https://github.com/yaochenzhu/Rank-GRPO.

AI.title_translation: Rank-GRPO：使用强化学习训练基于LLM的对话推荐系统
AI.tldr: LLM在对话推荐系统中面临生成目录外项目和排名质量下降等挑战。本文提出ConvRec-R1两阶段框架，包含行为克隆预训练和专门为排序输出设计的Rank-GRPO强化学习算法。实验证明ConvRec-R1比基线收敛更快，并取得了更高的Recall和NDCG。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型（LLM）正在重塑推荐系统范式，但将LLM与推荐任务对齐仍具挑战：预训练的LLM常生成目录外项目、违反所需输出格式，且其生成列表末尾的排名质量急剧下降。
AI.method: 本文提出ConvRec-R1，一个用于LLM对话推荐系统端到端训练的两阶段框架。第一阶段，通过Remap-Reflect-Adjust管道构建行为克隆数据集，从强大的黑盒LLM生成高质量、目录接地的演示数据，用于强化学习训练的预热。第二阶段，提出Rank-GRPO，这是群相对策略优化（GRPO）的原理性扩展，专为排序式输出任务设计。Rank-GRPO将推荐列表中的每个“排名”作为单位（而非token或序列），重新定义奖励以消除非因果信用分配，并引入基于排名级token概率几何平均值的排名级重要性比率以稳定策略更新。
AI.result: 在公共Reddit-v2数据集上的实验表明，ConvRec-R1比GRPO风格的基线收敛更快，并取得了更高的Recall和NDCG。
AI.conclusion: ConvRec-R1框架及其核心的Rank-GRPO算法成功解决了LLM在对话推荐系统中面临的挑战，特别是在排名质量和训练效率方面，显著提升了系统的性能。
AI.translation: 大语言模型（LLM）通过使用户能够通过对话表达偏好并接收推荐，正在重塑推荐系统范式。然而，将LLM与推荐任务对齐仍然具有挑战性：预训练的LLM通常会生成目录外项目，违反所需的输出格式，并且其生成列表末尾的排名质量急剧下降。为此，我们提出了ConvRec-R1，一个用于LLM对话推荐系统端到端训练的两阶段框架。在第一阶段，我们使用Remap-Reflect-Adjust管道构建了一个行为克隆数据集，该管道从强大的黑盒LLM生成高质量、目录接地的演示，以预热强化学习训练。在第二阶段，我们提出了Rank-GRPO，这是群相对策略优化（GRPO）的原理性扩展，专为具有排序式输出的任务量身定制。Rank-GRPO将推荐列表中的每个排名视为单位，而不是token（过于细粒度）或序列（过于粗粒度），重新定义奖励以消除非因果信用分配，并引入基于排名级token概率几何平均值的排名级重要性比率以稳定策略更新。在公共Reddit-v2数据集上的实验表明，ConvRec-R1比GRPO风格的基线收敛更快，并取得了更高的Recall和NDCG。代码和数据集已在https://github.com/yaochenzhu/Rank-GRPO发布。
AI.summary: 本文针对LLM在对话推荐系统中面临的挑战，如生成目录外项目和排名质量下降，提出了一个名为ConvRec-R1的两阶段训练框架。该框架首先通过行为克隆从黑盒LLM生成高质量演示数据进行预训练，随后引入Rank-GRPO强化学习算法。Rank-GRPO是GRPO的扩展，专为排序任务设计，它将推荐列表中的“排名”作为优化单位，通过重新定义奖励和引入排名级重要性比率来稳定策略更新。实验结果表明，ConvRec-R1在收敛速度和推荐质量（Recall和NDCG）上均优于现有基线。
AI.keywords: LLM, 对话推荐系统, 强化学习, Rank-GRPO, 策略优化
AI.comments: Rank-GRPO通过将“排名”而非传统的“token”或“序列”作为强化学习的优化单位，创新性地解决了LLM在推荐系统排序任务中的信用分配难题。这种设计有助于更精确地优化推荐列表的整体质量，并有效稳定策略更新，对于提升LLM在复杂对话推荐场景中的应用潜力具有重要意义。

title: BoundRL: Efficient Structured Text Segmentation through Reinforced Boundary Generation
summary:
As structured texts become increasingly complex across diverse domains --
from technical reports to generative AI prompts -- the need for text
segmentation into semantically meaningful components becomes critical. Such
texts often contain elements beyond plain language, including tables, code
snippets, and placeholders, which conventional sentence- or paragraph-level
segmentation methods cannot handle effectively. To address this challenge, we
propose BoundRL, a novel and efficient approach that jointly performs
token-level text segmentation and label prediction for long structured texts.
Instead of generating complete contents for each segment, it generates only a
sequence of starting tokens and reconstructs the complete contents by locating
these tokens within the original texts, thereby reducing inference costs by
orders of magnitude and minimizing hallucination. To adapt the model for the
output format, BoundRL~performs reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards
(RLVR) with a specifically designed reward that jointly optimizes document
reconstruction fidelity and semantic alignment. To mitigate entropy collapse,
it further constructs intermediate candidates by systematically perturbing a
fraction of generated sequences of segments to create stepping stones toward
higher-quality solutions. To demonstrate BoundRL's effectiveness on
particularly challenging structured texts, we focus evaluation on complex
prompts used for LLM applications. Experiments show that BoundRL enables small
language models (1.7B parameters) to outperform few-shot prompting of much
larger models. Moreover, RLVR with our designed reward yields significant
improvements over supervised fine-tuning, and incorporating intermediate
candidates further improves both performance and generalization.

AI.title_translation: BoundRL：通过强化边界生成实现高效的结构化文本分割
AI.tldr: BoundRL是一种新的、高效的结构化文本分割方法，它使用强化学习（RLVR）来生成边界，而不是完整内容，从而大幅降低了推理成本，并在复杂的LLM提示测试中，使小模型（1.7B）的性能超越了大模型的少样本提示。
AI.motivation: 随着技术报告和生成式AI提示等领域中结构化文本的日益复杂，将文本分割成语义上有意义的组件变得至关重要。传统方法无法有效处理包含表格、代码片段和占位符等非纯文本元素的结构化文本。
AI.method: BoundRL提出了一种新颖高效的方法，通过仅生成起始标记并将其定位回原始文本来重建完整内容，从而实现标记级文本分割和标签预测。它采用带有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR），奖励函数联合优化文档重建保真度和语义对齐。为缓解熵崩溃，它通过系统地扰动生成序列的一部分来构建中间候选。
AI.result: 实验表明，BoundRL能够使参数量为1.7B的小型语言模型在处理复杂提示时，性能超越了参数量大得多的模型的少样本提示。RLVR相较于监督微调有显著提升，引入中间候选进一步提高了性能和泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: BoundRL通过使用带有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）和中间候选机制，有效地实现了对长结构化文本的标记级分割和标签预测，并在LLM复杂提示上展现出优于大型模型少样本提示的性能。
AI.translation: 随着结构化文本在从技术报告到生成式AI提示的各种领域中变得日益复杂，将其分割成语义上有意义的组件的需求变得至关重要。此类文本通常包含纯语言以外的元素，包括表格、代码片段和占位符，这些元素是传统句子或段落级分割方法无法有效处理的。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了BoundRL，这是一种新颖且高效的方法，可对长结构化文本同时执行标记级文本分割和标签预测。它不为每个片段生成完整内容，而是仅生成起始标记的序列，并通过在原始文本中定位这些标记来重建完整内容，从而将推理成本降低了几个数量级并最大限度地减少了幻觉。为使模型适应输出格式，BoundRL执行带有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR），并设计了一个联合优化文档重建保真度和语义对齐的特定奖励。为缓解熵崩溃，它进一步通过系统地扰动生成片段序列的一部分来构建中间候选，为更高质量的解决方案提供垫脚石。为证明BoundRL在特别具有挑战性的结构化文本上的有效性，我们将评估重点放在LLM应用所使用的复杂提示上。实验表明，BoundRL能够使小型语言模型（1.7B参数）的性能超越大型模型的少样本提示。此外，我们设计的奖励下的RLVR相较于监督微调有显著改进，并结合中间候选进一步提高了性能和泛化能力。
AI.summary: BoundRL是一种用于长结构化文本的高效分割方法，它通过仅生成起始标记并利用带有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）来联合优化重建和语义对齐，从而显著降低推理成本并减少幻觉。该方法在复杂的LLM提示上表现出色，使小模型能超越大模型的少样本性能。
AI.keywords: 结构化文本分割, 强化学习, 边界生成, 标记级预测, LLM提示
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于使用强化学习（RLVR）来联合优化文档重建保真度和语义对齐，并引入中间候选来缓解熵崩溃，从而实现了高效的结构化文本分割，尤其是在LLM提示等复杂场景下，甚至能让小模型超越大模型的少样本提示能力。技术的关键在于只生成起始标记而非完整内容，极大地降低了推理成本。

title: Soft Switching Expert Policies for Controlling Systems with Uncertain Parameters
comments: 6 pages, 8 figures. Submitted to an International Conference
summary:
This paper proposes a simulation-based reinforcement learning algorithm for
controlling systems with uncertain and varying system parameters. While
simulators are useful for safely learning control policies for physical
systems, mitigating the reality gap remains a major challenge. To address the
challenge, we propose a two-stage algorithm. In the first stage, multiple
control policies are learned for systems with different parameters in a
simulator. In the second stage, for a real system, the control policies learned
in the first stage are smoothly switched using an online convex optimization
algorithm based on observations. Our proposed algorithm is demonstrated through
numerical experiments.
comment: 6 pages, 8 figures. Submitted to an International Conference

AI.title_translation: 具有不确定参数的系统控制中的软切换专家策略
AI.tldr: 一种两阶段的基于仿真的强化学习算法，通过在仿真器中学习多个专家策略，并使用在线凸优化算法在实际系统中进行平滑切换，以控制具有不确定参数的系统，并缩小仿真与现实之间的差距。
AI.motivation: 提出一种基于仿真的强化学习算法，用于控制具有不确定和变化系统参数的系统。主要动机是解决利用仿真器安全学习物理系统控制策略时，缓解“现实差距”（reality gap）这一重大挑战。
AI.method: 提出一个两阶段的基于仿真的强化学习算法：1. **第一阶段：** 在仿真器中为具有不同参数的系统学习多个控制策略（即专家策略）。2. **第二阶段：** 对于实际系统，基于观测结果，使用在线凸优化算法平滑地切换在第一阶段学习到的控制策略（即软切换）。
AI.result: 所提出的算法通过数值实验得到了证明。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的基于仿真和软切换专家策略的强化学习算法，能够有效地控制具有不确定参数的系统并缓解仿真与现实之间的差距。
AI.translation: 本文提出了一种基于仿真的强化学习算法，用于控制具有不确定和变化系统参数的系统。虽然仿真器有助于安全地学习物理系统的控制策略，但缓解“现实差距”仍然是一个重大挑战。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种两阶段算法。在第一阶段，针对仿真器中具有不同参数的系统学习多个控制策略。在第二阶段，对于一个真实的系统，基于观测结果，使用在线凸优化算法平滑地切换在第一阶段学到的控制策略。我们提出的算法通过数值实验得到了证明。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种用于控制具有不确定参数系统的两阶段、基于仿真的强化学习算法。第一阶段在仿真器中为不同参数系统学习多组控制策略（专家策略）。第二阶段则利用在线凸优化算法，根据实时观测结果，在真实系统中平滑地切换这些专家策略，从而有效缓解了仿真与现实之间的差距。
AI.keywords: 软切换, 专家策略, 不确定参数系统, 强化学习, 在线凸优化
AI.comments: 论文的创新点在于结合了强化学习、多专家策略和在线凸优化技术，专门解决参数不确定系统控制中的“现实差距”问题。通过学习一组专家策略并在运行时进行软切换，该方法比单一鲁棒策略或硬切换策略更具适应性，有望提高控制系统在真实世界中的性能和鲁棒性。

title: Optimal Rounding for Two-Stage Bipartite Matching
summary:
We study two-stage bipartite matching, in which the edges of a bipartite
graph on vertices $(B_1 \cup B_2, I)$ are revealed in two batches. In stage
one, a matching must be selected from among revealed edges $E \subseteq B_1
\times I$. In stage two, edges $E^\theta \subseteq B_2 \times I$ are sampled
from a known distribution, and a second matching must be selected between $B_2$
and unmatched vertices in $I$. The objective is to maximize the total weight of
the combined matching. We design polynomial-time approximations to the optimum
online algorithm, achieving guarantees of $7/8$ for vertex-weighted graphs and
$2\sqrt{2}-2 \approx 0.828$ for edge-weighted graphs under arbitrary
distributions. Both approximation ratios match known upper bounds on the
integrality gap of the natural fractional relaxation, improving upon the
best-known approximation of 0.767 by Feng, Niazadeh, and Saberi for unweighted
graphs whose second batch consists of independently arriving nodes.
  Our results are obtained via an algorithm that rounds a fractional matching
revealed in two stages, aiming to match offline nodes (respectively, edges)
with probability proportional to their fractional weights, up to a
constant-factor loss. We leverage negative association (NA) among offline node
availabilities -- a property induced by dependent rounding -- to derive new
lower bounds on the expected size of the maximum weight matching in random
graphs where one side is realized via NA binary random variables. Moreover, we
extend these results to settings where we have only sample access to the
distribution. In particular, $\text{poly}(n,\epsilon^{-1})$ samples suffice to
obtain an additive loss of $\epsilon$ in the approximation ratio for the
vertex-weighted problem; a similar bound holds for the edge-weighted problem
with an additional (unavoidable) dependence on the scale of edge weights.

AI.title_translation: 两阶段二分匹配中的最优舍入
AI.tldr: 本文研究两阶段二分匹配问题，设计了多项式时间近似算法。对于顶点加权图，近似比达到 $7/8$；对于边加权图，近似比达到 $2\sqrt{2}-2 \approx 0.828$。这些结果通过对分阶段分数匹配进行舍入（基于负关联特性）获得，并匹配了已知的分数松弛的整数间隙上限。
AI.motivation: 目标是设计一种算法，在分两批揭示边的两阶段二分匹配问题中，最大化组合匹配的总权重。
AI.method: 采用了一种算法，该算法对分两阶段揭示的分数匹配进行舍入。它利用了由依赖舍入引起的离线节点可用性之间的负关联（Negative Association, NA）特性。利用NA特性，推导了随机图中最大权重匹配期望大小的新下界。该方法还扩展到仅有分布样本访问权的情况。
AI.result: 设计了多项式时间近似算法，对于顶点加权图，近似保证为 $7/8$；对于边加权图，近似保证为 $2\sqrt{2}-2 \approx 0.828$。这些近似比匹配了自然分数松弛的整数间隙已知上限，并优于先前最佳的 $0.767$ 近似比。在仅有分布样本访问权的情况下，$\text{poly}(n,\epsilon^{-1})$ 样本足以实现近似比的 $\epsilon$ 加性损失。
AI.conclusion: 本文设计的多项式时间近似算法为两阶段二分匹配问题提供了接近最优的性能保证，其近似比（$7/8$ 和 $2\sqrt{2}-2$）达到了分数松弛的整数间隙上限。
AI.translation: 我们研究了两阶段二分匹配问题，其中二分图（顶点集为 $(B_1 \cup B_2, I)$）的边分两批揭示。在第一阶段，必须从揭示的边集 $E \subseteq B_1 \times I$ 中选择一个匹配。在第二阶段，边集 $E^\theta \subseteq B_2 \times I$ 从一个已知分布中采样得到，必须在 $B_2$ 和 $I$ 中未匹配的顶点之间选择第二个匹配。目标是最大化组合匹配的总权重。我们设计了最优在线算法的多项式时间近似算法，在任意分布下，对于顶点加权图实现了 $7/8$ 的保证，对于边加权图实现了 $2\sqrt{2}-2 \approx 0.828$ 的保证。这两个近似比都匹配了自然分数松弛的整数间隙已知上限，并改进了 Feng、Niazadeh 和 Saberi 针对第二批由独立到达节点组成的无权图所获得的最佳已知近似比 $0.767$。我们的结果是通过一种算法获得的，该算法对分两阶段揭示的分数匹配进行舍入，旨在以与其分数权重成比例的概率匹配离线节点（或边），但存在一个常数因子损失。我们利用了离线节点可用性之间的负关联（NA）——一种由依赖舍入引起的特性——来推导随机图中最大权重匹配期望大小的新下界，其中一侧是通过 NA 二进制随机变量实现的。此外，我们将这些结果扩展到仅有分布样本访问权的环境。特别是，对于顶点加权问题，$\text{poly}(n,\epsilon^{-1})$ 样本足以在近似比中获得 $\epsilon$ 的加性损失；对于边加权问题，也有一个类似的上界，但额外（且不可避免地）依赖于边权重的规模。
AI.summary: 本文研究了两阶段二分匹配，目标是最大化分两阶段选择的匹配总权重。作者设计了多项式时间近似算法，在任意分布下，为顶点加权图提供了 $7/8$ 的近似保证，为边加权图提供了 $2\sqrt{2}-2 \approx 0.828$ 的保证。这些结果匹配了分数松弛的整数间隙上限，并通过对分阶段分数匹配进行依赖舍入来实现，该舍入利用了负关联（NA）特性来推导新的匹配下界。研究还扩展到仅有分布样本访问权的环境，并给出了相应的样本复杂度保证。
AI.keywords: 两阶段二分匹配, 最优舍入, 近似算法, 负关联, 整数间隙
AI.comments: 本文在在线算法和近似算法领域取得了重要进展。其创新点在于将依赖舍入技术（特别是利用负关联特性）应用于两阶段匹配问题，成功地将近似比提高到与自然分数松弛的整数间隙上限相匹配的水平。这表明所设计的算法在理论上达到了该问题分数松弛方法所能达到的最佳性能。此外，将结果扩展到仅有样本访问权的环境，增强了算法在实际应用中的鲁棒性和实用性。

title: Are Stereotypes Leading LLMs' Zero-Shot Stance Detection ?
summary:
Large Language Models inherit stereotypes from their pretraining data,
leading to biased behavior toward certain social groups in many Natural
Language Processing tasks, such as hateful speech detection or sentiment
analysis. Surprisingly, the evaluation of this kind of bias in stance detection
methods has been largely overlooked by the community. Stance Detection involves
labeling a statement as being against, in favor, or neutral towards a specific
target and is among the most sensitive NLP tasks, as it often relates to
political leanings. In this paper, we focus on the bias of Large Language
Models when performing stance detection in a zero-shot setting. We
automatically annotate posts in pre-existing stance detection datasets with two
attributes: dialect or vernacular of a specific group and text
complexity/readability, to investigate whether these attributes influence the
model's stance detection decisions. Our results show that LLMs exhibit
significant stereotypes in stance detection tasks, such as incorrectly
associating pro-marijuana views with low text complexity and African American
dialect with opposition to Donald Trump.

AI.title_translation: 刻板印象是否主导了大型语言模型的零样本立场检测？
AI.tldr: 研究发现大型语言模型（LLMs）在零样本立场检测任务中表现出显著的刻板印象，例如将支持大麻的观点与低文本复杂度相关联，或将非裔美国人方言与反对唐纳德·特朗普的立场相关联。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型从预训练数据中继承了刻板印象，导致在许多自然语言处理任务中对特定社会群体产生偏见。立场检测是一种敏感任务（通常涉及政治倾向），但其方法中的偏见评估却在很大程度上被社区忽视了。本文旨在填补这一空白，重点研究LLMs在零样本立场检测中的偏见。
AI.method: 利用现有的立场检测数据集，自动标注帖子中的两个属性：1) 特定群体的方言或白话，以及 2) 文本的复杂性/可读性。然后，研究这些属性是否会影响模型进行立场检测的决策。
AI.result: 结果显示LLMs在立场检测任务中表现出显著的刻板印象。具体例子包括错误地将支持大麻的观点与低文本复杂度相关联，以及将非裔美国人方言与反对唐纳德·特朗普的立场相关联。
AI.conclusion: 未在摘要中提及
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）从其预训练数据中继承了刻板印象，这导致在许多自然语言处理任务（如仇恨言论检测或情感分析）中对某些社会群体产生偏见行为。令人惊讶的是，社区在很大程度上忽略了对立场检测方法中此类偏见的评估。立场检测涉及将一个陈述标记为反对、支持或中立于某一特定目标，是NLP中最敏感的任务之一，因为它通常与政治倾向相关。在本文中，我们关注大型语言模型在执行零样本立场检测时的偏见。我们自动标注了现有立场检测数据集中的帖子，加入了两个属性：特定群体的方言或白话，以及文本复杂性/可读性，以调查这些属性是否会影响模型的立场检测决策。我们的结果表明，LLMs在立场检测任务中表现出显著的刻板印象，例如错误地将支持大麻的观点与低文本复杂度相关联，并将非裔美国人方言与反对唐纳德·特朗普的立场相关联。
AI.summary: 本文研究了大型语言模型（LLMs）在零样本立场检测任务中继承自预训练数据的刻板印象偏见。立场检测作为一项敏感的NLP任务，其偏见研究一直被忽视。研究人员通过自动标注现有数据集中的帖子，加入了群体方言/白话和文本复杂性/可读性这两个属性进行调查。实验结果证实LLMs确实表现出显著的刻板印象，例如将支持大麻的立场与低文本复杂度挂钩，或将非裔美国人方言与反对特定政治人物的立场挂钩。
AI.keywords: 大型语言模型, 刻板印象, 零样本立场检测, 偏见, 方言/白话
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于将刻板印象偏见的研究扩展到了零样本立场检测这一敏感任务中，填补了现有研究的空白。它通过引入方言/白话和文本复杂性这两个新的属性来量化和揭示LLMs的系统性偏见，提供了具体的、令人担忧的实例，强调了部署这些模型时需要对社会公平性进行严格审查。其重要性在于提醒研究人员和开发者，即使在零样本设置下，LLMs的决策也可能受到其训练数据中隐含的社会偏见影响。

title: PartNeXt: A Next-Generation Dataset for Fine-Grained and Hierarchical 3D Part Understanding
comments:
NeurIPS 2025 DB Track. Project page:
  https://authoritywang.github.io/partnext
summary:
Understanding objects at the level of their constituent parts is fundamental
to advancing computer vision, graphics, and robotics. While datasets like
PartNet have driven progress in 3D part understanding, their reliance on
untextured geometries and expert-dependent annotation limits scalability and
usability. We introduce PartNeXt, a next-generation dataset addressing these
gaps with over 23,000 high-quality, textured 3D models annotated with
fine-grained, hierarchical part labels across 50 categories. We benchmark
PartNeXt on two tasks: (1) class-agnostic part segmentation, where
state-of-the-art methods (e.g., PartField, SAMPart3D) struggle with
fine-grained and leaf-level parts, and (2) 3D part-centric question answering,
a new benchmark for 3D-LLMs that reveals significant gaps in open-vocabulary
part grounding. Additionally, training Point-SAM on PartNeXt yields substantial
gains over PartNet, underscoring the dataset's superior quality and diversity.
By combining scalable annotation, texture-aware labels, and multi-task
evaluation, PartNeXt opens new avenues for research in structured 3D
understanding.
