AI.title_translation: 婴儿语言模型在近邻发展区内的教师演示以实现偶发性多轮互动
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了ContingentChat框架，通过在婴儿语言模型（BabyLM）的近邻发展区内进行教师演示，以提高多轮对话的偶发性。实验表明，针对性的后训练能提升BabyLM生成语法正确且连贯的回应，但偶发性仍是BabyLM面临的挑战。
AI.motivation: 多轮对话的偶发性（prompt, direct, and meaningful exchanges）对于儿童与看护者之间的交流至关重要，而现有的BabyLM在实现这一特性方面存在挑战。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为ContingentChat的教师-学生框架，并在100M词的BabyLM上进行了基准测试和改进。使用了一种新颖的、用于后训练的对齐数据集。实验中还测试了自适应教师解码策略。
AI.result: 使用对齐数据集进行后训练后，BabyLM生成的回复在语法和连贯性方面有所提高。自适应教师解码策略带来的额外增益有限。研究表明，BabyLM在实现偶发性多轮对话方面仍有很大提升空间。
AI.conclusion: ContingentChat框架通过有针对性的后训练，能够提升BabyLM在多轮对话中的质量，尤其是在偶发性方面。然而，偶发性对于BabyLM来说仍然是一个具有挑战性的目标。
AI.translation: 多轮对话，其特点是用户与用户之间的即时、直接和有意义的交流，这是一种被称为偶发性的属性。我们引入了ContingentChat，一个教师-学生框架，用于在BabyLM上进行基准测试和改进在100M词上训练的BabyLM的多轮偶发性。使用一种新颖的、用于后训练的对齐数据集，BabyLM生成的回应在语法和连贯性方面都更好。与自适应教师解码策略的实验显示，额外的增益有限。ContingentChat证明了针对性后训练对于对话质量的好处，并表明偶发性对于BabyLM来说仍然是一个具有挑战性的目标。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种名为ContingentChat的框架，旨在通过教师演示来提升BabyLM在多轮对话中的偶发性。研究人员利用一个包含100M词的数据集训练BabyLM，并使用新颖的对齐数据集进行后训练。实验结果显示，这种方法能显著提高BabyLM生成回复的语法正确性和连贯性，但同时也指出，实现高水平的偶发性仍然是BabyLM面临的一大挑战。
AI.keywords: 偶发性, BabyLM, 多轮对话, 教师演示, 近邻发展区
AI.comments: 这项研究关注了儿童语言学习中的一个关键方面——对话的偶发性，并提出了一个创新的框架ContingentChat来解决BabyLM在这方面的不足。通过引入教师演示和针对性的后训练，该研究在提升模型生成质量方面取得了积极进展。然而，研究也坦诚地指出了偶发性作为对话质量核心要素的挑战性，为未来的研究方向提供了明确的指示。该研究的创新性在于将“近邻发展区”的概念引入到AI模型的训练中，并设计了相应的技术手段来实现。

title: Why DPO is a Misspecified Estimator and How to Fix It
summary:
Direct alignment algorithms such as Direct Preference Optimization (DPO)
fine-tune models based on preference data, using only supervised learning
instead of two-stage reinforcement learning with human feedback (RLHF). We show
that DPO encodes a statistical estimation problem over reward functions induced
by a parametric policy class. When the true reward function that generates
preferences cannot be realized via the policy class, DPO becomes misspecified,
resulting in failure modes such as preference order reversal, worsening of
policy reward, and high sensitivity to the input preference data distribution.
On the other hand, we study the local behavior of two-stage RLHF for a
parametric class and relate it to a natural gradient step in policy space. Our
fine-grained geometric characterization allows us to propose AuxDPO, which
introduces additional auxiliary variables in the DPO loss function to help move
towards the RLHF solution in a principled manner and mitigate the
misspecification in DPO. We empirically demonstrate the superior performance of
AuxDPO on didactic bandit settings as well as LLM alignment tasks.

AI.title_translation: DPO为何是误设估计量及其修正方法
AI.tldr: DPO算法在某些情况下可能出现估计错误，导致性能下降。本文提出了一种名为AuxDPO的改进方法，通过引入辅助变量来解决DPO的误设问题，并在实验中证明了其优越性。
AI.motivation: 直接偏好优化（DPO）算法在微调模型时，当真实奖励函数无法通过参数化策略类实现时，会导致DPO估计错误，出现偏好逆转、奖励下降和对输入数据分布敏感等问题。
AI.method: 本文首先分析了DPO的统计估计问题，并指出了其在特定情况下的误设问题。然后，研究了两阶段RLHF在参数化类中的局部行为，并将其与策略空间中的自然梯度步联系起来。在此基础上，提出了一种名为AuxDPO的新方法，通过在DPO损失函数中引入辅助变量来解决DPO的误设问题，并使其更接近RLHF的解决方案。
AI.result: AuxDPO在教学性老虎机设置和LLM对齐任务的实验中，表现优于标准的DPO方法。
AI.conclusion: DPO算法存在估计误设的可能性，可能导致一系列负面影响。提出的AuxDPO方法通过引入辅助变量，能够有效缓解DPO的误设问题，并在多个任务中展现出更优越的性能。
AI.translation: 直接偏好优化（DPO）等直接对齐算法使用监督学习对模型进行微调，而不是使用带有人类反馈（RLHF）的两阶段强化学习。我们表明，DPO将统计估计问题编码到由参数策略类引起的奖励函数上。当生成偏好的真实奖励函数无法通过策略类实现时，DPO就会被误设，导致偏好顺序逆转、策略奖励恶化以及对输入偏好数据分布的高度敏感等失败模式。另一方面，我们研究了两阶段RLHF在参数类中的局部行为，并将其与策略空间中的自然梯度步联系起来。我们精细的几何表征使我们能够提出AuxDPO，它在DPO损失函数中引入了额外的辅助变量，以帮助以原则性的方式向RLHF解决方案移动，并减轻DPO中的误设。我们在教学性老虎机设置和LLM对齐任务中通过实验证明了AuxDPO的优越性能。
AI.summary: 本文指出，直接偏好优化（DPO）算法在某些条件下可能成为一个误设的估计量，导致模型性能下降。研究人员通过分析DPO的统计估计问题和两阶段RLHF的行为，提出了一种名为AuxDPO的新方法。AuxDPO通过在损失函数中加入辅助变量，旨在纠正DPO的估计误差，使其解决方案更接近RLHF，并在实验中验证了其在不同任务上的有效性。
AI.keywords: DPO,RLHF,偏好优化,奖励函数,估计错误
AI.comments: 该研究深入分析了DPO算法的理论局限性，并提出了一个具有实际意义的改进方法AuxDPO。通过引入辅助变量来解决DPO的误设问题，为提高模型对齐算法的稳定性和性能提供了一个新的方向。实验结果也为该方法的有效性提供了有力支持。

title: Addressing Mark Imbalance in Integration-free Neural Marked Temporal Point Processes
summary:
Marked Temporal Point Process (MTPP) has been well studied to model the event
distribution in marked event streams, which can be used to predict the mark and
arrival time of the next event. However, existing studies overlook that the
distribution of event marks is highly imbalanced in many real-world
applications, with some marks being frequent but others rare. The imbalance
poses a significant challenge to the performance of the next event prediction,
especially for events of rare marks. To address this issue, we propose a
thresholding method, which learns thresholds to tune the mark probability
normalized by the mark's prior probability to optimize mark prediction, rather
than predicting the mark directly based on the mark probability as in existing
studies. In conjunction with this method, we predict the mark first and then
the time. In particular, we develop a novel neural MTPP model to support
effective time sampling and estimation of mark probability without
computationally expensive numerical improper integration. Extensive experiments
on real-world datasets demonstrate the superior performance of our solution
against various baselines for the next event mark and time prediction. The code
is available at https://github.com/undes1red/IFNMTPP.

AI.title_translation: 解决无积分神经标记时序点过程中的标记不平衡问题
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种新的标记时序点过程（MTPP）模型，通过学习阈值来优化罕见标记事件的预测，解决了实际应用中标记分布不平衡的问题，并在真实数据集上验证了其优越性。
AI.motivation: 现有标记时序点过程（MTPP）模型在处理实际应用中事件标记分布高度不平衡（某些标记频繁，某些标记罕见）的问题时存在不足，尤其是在预测罕见标记事件方面表现不佳。
AI.method: 提出一种基于阈值的方法，通过学习阈值来调整由标记先验概率归一化的标记概率，以优化标记预测，而不是直接基于标记概率进行预测。该方法先预测标记，再预测时间，并开发了一个新的神经MTPP模型，无需进行计算上昂贵的数值不当积分即可进行有效的时间采样和标记概率估计。
AI.result: 在真实世界数据集上的大量实验表明，该研究提出的解决方案在下一个事件标记和时间预测方面优于各种基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的基于阈值的方法和新的神经MTPP模型能够有效解决标记时序点过程中的标记不平衡问题，并在预测任务上取得了优于现有方法的性能。
AI.translation: 标记时序点过程（MTPP）已被充分研究，用于模拟带标记事件流中的事件分布，可用于预测下一个事件的标记和到达时间。然而，现有研究忽略了在许多实际应用中事件标记的分布是高度不平衡的，某些标记频繁出现，而另一些标记则很少出现。这种不平衡对下一个事件预测的性能构成了重大挑战，特别是对于罕见标记的事件。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种阈值方法，该方法学习阈值来调整由标记的先验概率归一化的标记概率，以优化标记预测，而不是像现有研究那样直接基于标记概率进行预测。结合这种方法，我们先预测标记，然后预测时间。特别是，我们开发了一种新颖的神经MTPP模型，能够在没有计算上昂贵的不当数值积分的情况下，支持有效的时间采样和标记概率估计。在真实世界数据集上的大量实验证明了我们的解决方案在下一个事件标记和时间预测方面优于各种基线。代码可在https://github.com/undes1red/IFNMTPP获取。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种新颖的标记时序点过程（MTPP）方法，通过引入基于阈值的标记概率调整来解决实际应用中常见的标记不平衡问题。该方法优先预测事件标记，然后预测事件发生时间，并开发了一个能够进行有效时间采样和概率估计的神经MTPP模型，避免了复杂的数值积分。实验结果表明，该方法在预测准确性上显著优于现有技术。
AI.keywords: 标记时序点过程, 标记不平衡, 阈值方法, 神经MTPP, 事件预测
AI.comments: 该研究解决了标记时序点过程中一个重要的实际问题——标记不平衡。提出的基于阈值的方法和新的神经MTPP模型具有创新性，通过优化罕见标记事件的预测来提高整体性能。无需进行数值积分的设计也提高了计算效率。然而，该方法在处理极端不平衡情况下的鲁棒性以及计算阈值本身的复杂性仍有待进一步研究。

title: A Multifunctional Capacitive Sensing Platform for Wireless Vascular and Heart Monitoring
summary:
We present a multifunctional, antenna-integrated capacitive sensing (MAiCaS)
platform for passive, wireless, and real-time cardiovascular monitoring. Unlike
conventional systems that require separate sensors and wireless modules, our
device unifies sensing, telemetry, and mechanical functionality into a compact
and scalable design by exploiting the parasitic capacitance of an inductive
antenna as a strain-sensitive element. The sensor is fabricated using a
cleanroom-free, single-step UV laser patterning process on a flexible PDMS
substrate, reducing manufacturing complexity and enabling high reproducibility.
The MAiCaS is suitable for three different applications: as a sensor for
epicardial strain measurement, a stent as a sensor, and a vascular graft
sensor. We demonstrate MAiCaS's versatility by validating its wireless
resonance-based response to strain, pressure, and deformation across unrolled
and rolled forms. In vitro experiments demonstrated consistent resonance
frequency shifts under physiological conditions, with stable performance on
skin, in PBS, human serum, and simulated vascular environments. Repeatability
and aging tests confirmed its long-term reliability and elasticity under cyclic
loading. Calibration curves revealed high sensitivity across all
configurations, with wireless interrogation achieved through S11 parameter
measurements and resonance frequency shift as the output metric. The
sensitivity of the device was measured to be 2.9 MHz per 1% strain, 0.43
MHz/mmHg, and 309.6kHz/\textmu m for epicardial patch, graft, and stent
integrated sensor, respectively. The operation of MAiCaS was evaluated in a
human experiment. This monolithic sensor architecture provides a scalable and
cost-effective solution for battery-free monitoring of vascular dynamics, with
potential for remote diagnostics, post-surgical follow-up, and continuous
cardiovascular health management.

AI.title_translation: 一种用于无线血管和心脏监测的多功能电容传感平台
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为MAiCaS的多功能集成天线电容传感平台，用于无源、无线、实时的无电池心血管监测。该平台将传感、遥测和机械功能集成到一个紧凑、可扩展的设计中，利用电感天线的寄生电容作为应变敏感元件。它通过单步激光图案化工艺在柔性PDMS基板上制造，简化了制造过程。MAiCaS可用于心外膜应变测量、支架传感和血管移植物传感，并已在体外和人体实验中得到验证，显示出良好的灵敏度、稳定性和可靠性，为心血管健康管理提供了一种经济高效的解决方案。
AI.motivation: 传统的心血管监测系统通常需要独立的传感器和无线模块，增加了复杂性。本研究旨在开发一种集成化、无源、无线、可扩展且成本效益高的传感平台，以简化心血管监测过程，实现实时监测。
AI.method: 开发了一种名为MAiCaS的多功能集成天线电容传感平台。该平台利用电感天线的寄生电容作为应变敏感元件，将传感、遥测和机械功能集成到一个紧凑、可扩展的设计中。传感器采用单步激光图案化工艺在柔性PDMS基板上制造。通过测量S11参数和共振频率偏移来实现无线询问。在体外和人体实验中验证了其在不同应用场景下的性能。
AI.result: MAiCaS平台在体外实验中表现出在生理条件下对各种应变、压力和变形的一致的无线共振响应。在皮肤、PBS、人血清和模拟血管环境中均表现稳定。重复性和老化测试证明了其在循环加载下的长期可靠性和弹性。该设备在三种配置下的灵敏度分别为：心外膜贴片2.9 MHz / 1% 应变，移植物0.43 MHz/mmHg，以及集成支架传感器309.6 kHz/μm。人体实验也评估了其操作性能。
AI.conclusion: MAiCaS集成传感平台提供了一种可扩展、成本效益高且无需电池的心血管动力学监测解决方案，具有远程诊断、术后随访和持续心血管健康管理的潜力。
AI.translation: 我们提出了一种用于被动、无线和实时心血管监测的多功能、集成天线电容传感（MAiCaS）平台。与需要独立传感器和无线模块的传统系统不同，我们的设备通过利用电感天线的寄生电容作为应变敏感元件，将传感、遥测和机械功能集成到一个紧凑且可扩展的设计中。该传感器采用无洁净室、单步紫外激光图案化工艺在柔性PDMS基板上制造，降低了制造成本，并实现了高可重复性。MAiCaS适用于三种不同的应用：作为心外膜应变测量的传感器、作为传感器的支架以及作为血管移植物传感器。我们通过验证其在展开和卷曲形式下对各种应变、压力和变形的无线共振响应，来展示MAiCaS的多功能性。体外实验证明了在生理条件下具有一致的共振频率偏移，在皮肤、PBS、人血清和模拟血管环境中均表现稳定。重复性和老化测试证实了其在循环加载下的长期可靠性和弹性。校准曲线显示了所有配置下的高灵敏度，通过S11参数测量和共振频率偏移作为输出指标实现了无线询问。对于心外膜贴片、移植物和集成支架传感器，设备的灵敏度分别为每1%应变2.9 MHz、每mmHg 0.43 MHz和每μm 309.6 kHz。在人体实验中评估了MAiCaS的操作。这种整体式传感器架构为电池供电的心血管动力学监测提供了一种可扩展且经济高效的解决方案，具有远程诊断、术后随访和持续心血管健康管理的潜力。
AI.summary: 本研究介绍了一种名为MAiCaS的多功能集成天线电容传感平台，用于实现无源、无线、实时的心血管监测。该平台巧妙地利用了天线的寄生电容作为应变敏感元件，将传感、遥测和机械功能整合在单一、紧凑且可扩展的设计中，无需独立的传感器和无线模块。通过简化的制造工艺，MAiCaS可应用于心外膜应变测量、支架传感和血管移植物传感等多种场景。实验验证了其在不同环境下的稳定性和高灵敏度，以及优异的长期可靠性。该平台为电池供电的心血管动力学监测提供了一种经济高效的解决方案。
AI.keywords: 电容传感, 无线监测, 心血管健康, 集成天线, 柔性电子学
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种创新的多功能电容传感平台（MAiCaS），将传感、遥测和机械功能集成到天线设计中，显著简化了心血管监测设备。其无细胞、单步激光图案化制造工艺降低了成本和复杂性，并实现了高可重复性。该平台在多种应用场景下的验证以及在不同环境中的稳定性测试，证明了其广泛的应用潜力。然而，虽然提到了人体实验，但具体的实验细节和结果有待进一步阐述。此外，长期临床效果和与其他监测技术的比较也是未来研究可以关注的方向。

title: MAC Aggregation over Lossy Channels in DTLS 1.3
summary:
Aggregating Message Authentication Codes (MACs) promises to save valuable
bandwidth in resource-constrained environments. The idea is simple: Instead of
appending an authentication tag to each message in a communication stream, the
integrity protection of multiple messages is aggregated into a single tag.
Recent studies postulate, e.g., based on simulations, that these benefits also
spread to wireless, and thus lossy, scenarios despite each lost packet
typically resulting in the loss of integrity protection information for
multiple messages. In this paper, we investigate these claims in a real
deployment. Therefore, we first design a MAC aggregation extension for the
Datagram Transport Layer Security (DTLS) 1.3 protocol. Afterward, we
extensively evaluate the performance of MAC aggregation on a complete
communication protocol stack on embedded hardware. We find that MAC aggregation
can indeed increase goodput by up to 50% and save up to 17% of energy
expenditure for the transmission of short messages, even in lossy channels.

AI.title_translation: DTLS 1.3中的有损信道上的MAC聚合
AI.tldr: 研究人员为DTLS 1.3设计了一种MAC聚合机制，并在实际嵌入式设备和有损网络中测试发现，它能显著提高短消息的传输效率（吞吐量提升50%）并节省能源（节省17%）。
AI.motivation: 在资源受限的环境中，MAC聚合有望节省宝贵的带宽，并且研究人员推测这种优势也适用于无线和有损场景。
AI.method: 设计了MAC聚合的DTLS 1.3扩展，并在完整的通信协议栈上对嵌入式硬件进行了广泛的性能评估。
AI.result: MAC聚合可以将短消息的吞吐量提高多达50%，并节省高达17%的能源消耗。
AI.conclusion: MAC聚合确实可以在有损信道中提高短消息的吞吐量（高达50%）并节省高达17%的能源消耗。
AI.translation: 聚合消息认证码（MAC）有望在资源受限的环境中节省宝贵的带宽。这个想法很简单：不是在每个消息后面附加一个认证标签，而是将多个消息的完整性保护聚合到一个单一的标签中。最近的研究，例如基于模拟的研究，推测这些好处也扩展到了无线和有损场景，尽管丢失一个数据包通常会导致多个消息的完整性保护信息丢失。在本文中，我们在实际部署中研究了这些说法。因此，我们首先为数据报传输层安全（DTLS）1.3协议设计了一个MAC聚合扩展。然后，我们在嵌入式硬件上的完整通信协议栈上广泛评估了MAC聚合的性能。我们发现，即使在有损信道中，MAC聚合确实可以使吞吐量提高多达50%，并为短消息的传输节省多达17%的能源消耗。
AI.summary: 本文针对资源受限环境，设计了适用于DTLS 1.3协议的MAC聚合扩展，并在嵌入式硬件的有损信道上进行了全面评估，结果表明MAC聚合能显著提高短消息的吞吐量并降低能耗。
AI.keywords: MAC聚合, DTLS 1.3, 有损信道, 嵌入式硬件, 吞吐量
AI.comments: 这项工作的主要创新在于将MAC聚合的概念应用于DTLS 1.3协议，并在真实的嵌入式硬件和有损信道上进行了广泛的性能评估，验证了其在实际环境中的有效性。其局限性可能在于仅关注了短消息的性能提升。

title: Projecting onto the Unit Dual Quaternion Set
summary:
Dual quaternions have gained significant attention due to their wide
applications in areas such as multi-agent formation control, 3D motion
modeling, and robotics. A fundamental aspect in dual quaternion research
involves the projection onto unit dual quaternion sets. In this paper, we
systematically study such projections under the $2^R$-norm, which is commonly
used in practical applications. We identify several distinct cases based on the
relationship between the standard and dual parts in vector form, and
demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm through numerical
experiments.

AI.title_translation: 投影到单位对偶四元数集
AI.tldr: 本文研究了在2^R范数下，对偶四元数在单位对偶四元数集上的投影问题，并根据标准部分和对偶部分的向量形式关系，区分了几种不同的情况，并通过数值实验验证了算法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 对偶四元数在多智能体编队控制、三维运动建模和机器人学等领域有广泛应用，而投影到单位对偶四元数集是其中一个基本问题。
AI.method: 系统地研究了在2^R范数下的投影问题，区分了几种不同的情况。
AI.result: 提出了有效的算法，并通过数值实验进行了验证。
AI.conclusion: 研究了在2^R范数下，对偶四元数在单位对偶四元数集上的投影问题，并提出了有效的算法。
AI.translation: 对偶四元数因其在多智能体编队控制、三维运动建模和机器人学等领域的广泛应用而受到广泛关注。对偶四元数研究的一个基本方面涉及投影到单位对偶四元数集。在本文中，我们系统地研究了在2^R范数下的此类投影，该范数在实际应用中常用。我们根据向量形式的标准部分和对偶部分之间的关系，区分了几种不同的情况，并通过数值实验证明了所提出算法的有效性。
AI.summary: 本文研究了在2^R范数下，对偶四元数在单位对偶四元数集上的投影问题。研究人员根据标准部分和对偶部分的向量形式关系，区分了几种不同的情况，并提出了一种算法，通过数值实验验证了其有效性。
AI.keywords: 对偶四元数, 投影, 单位对偶四元数集, 2^R范数, 机器人学
AI.comments: 该研究系统地解决了对偶四元数在单位对偶四元数集上的投影问题，并提出了有效的算法，具有实际应用价值。

title: An Empirical Study of Sample Selection Strategies for Large Language Model Repair
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in real-world systems,
yet they can produce toxic or biased outputs that undermine safety and trust.
Post-hoc model repair provides a practical remedy, but the high cost of
parameter updates motivates selective use of repair data. Despite extensive
prior work on data selection for model training, it remains unclear which
sampling criteria are most effective and efficient when applied specifically to
behavioral repair of large generative models. Our study presents a systematic
analysis of sample prioritization strategies for LLM repair. We evaluate five
representative selection methods, including random sampling, K-Center,
gradient-norm-based selection(GraNd), stratified coverage (CCS), and a
Semantic-Aware Prioritized Sampling (SAPS) approach we proposed. Repair
effectiveness and trade-offs are assessed through toxicity reduction,
perplexity on WikiText-2 and LAMBADA, and three composite metrics: the Repair
Proximity Score (RPS), the Overall Performance Score (OPS), and the Repair
Efficiency Score (RES). Experimental results show that SAPS achieves the best
balance between detoxification, utility preservation, and efficiency,
delivering comparable or superior repair outcomes with substantially less data.
Random sampling remains effective for large or robust models, while
high-overhead methods such as CCS and GraNd provide limited benefit. The
optimal data proportion depends on model scale and repair method, indicating
that sample selection should be regarded as a tunable component of repair
pipelines. Overall, these findings establish selection-based repair as an
efficient and scalable paradigm for maintaining LLM reliability.

AI.title_translation: 大型语言模型修复的样本选择策略的实证研究
AI.tldr: 本研究系统地分析了用于LLM修复的样本选择策略，发现我们提出的SAPS方法在解毒、保持效用和效率之间取得了最佳平衡，并且所需数据量大大减少。
AI.motivation: LLM的广泛应用带来了有毒或有偏见的输出问题，模型修复是一种实用的补救措施，但参数更新成本高昂，因此需要选择性地使用修复数据。然而，对于大型生成模型的行为修复，尚不清楚哪些采样标准最有效和最高效。
AI.method: 本研究系统地分析了LLM修复的样本选择策略，评估了五种代表性的选择方法：随机抽样、K-Center、基于梯度的选择(GraNd)、分层覆盖(CCS)以及我们提出的语义感知优先抽样(SAPS)。通过毒性降低、在WikiText-2和LAMBADA上的困惑度以及三个综合指标（修复邻近度得分RPS、总体性能得分OPS和修复效率得分RES）来评估修复效果和权衡。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，SAPS在解毒、保持效用和效率方面取得了最佳平衡，所需数据量大大减少，但修复效果相当或更优。对于大型或鲁棒模型，随机抽样仍然有效，而高开销的方法（如CCS和GraNd）带来的益处有限。最佳数据比例取决于模型规模和修复方法，表明样本选择应被视为修复流程的可调组件。
AI.conclusion: 本研究的结果表明，基于选择的修复是维持LLM可靠性的一种高效且可扩展的范式。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地部署在实际系统中，但它们可能产生有毒或有偏见的输出，从而破坏安全性和信任。事后模型修复提供了一种实用的补救措施，但参数更新的高成本促使人们有选择地使用修复数据。尽管在模型训练的数据选择方面已有大量先前的工作，但对于应用于大型生成行为修复的采样标准，其有效性和效率如何，仍然不清楚。我们的研究提出了对LLM修复样本优先级策略的系统分析。我们评估了五种代表性的选择方法，包括随机抽样、K-Center、基于梯度范数（GraNd）的选择、分层覆盖（CCS）以及我们提出的语义感知优先抽样（SAPS）方法。通过降低毒性、在WikiText-2和LAMBADA上的困惑度以及三个综合指标：修复邻近度得分（RPS）、总体性能得分（OPS）和修复效率得分（RES）来评估修复效果和权衡。实验结果表明，SAPS在解毒、效用保持和效率之间取得了最佳平衡，以显著更少的数据提供了相当或更优的修复结果。随机抽样对于大型或鲁棒模型仍然有效，而像CCS和GraNd这样开销较高的方法带来的益处有限。最佳数据比例取决于模型规模和修复方法，这表明样本选择应被视为修复流程的可调组件。总的来说，这些发现确立了基于选择的修复作为一种高效且可扩展的LLM可靠性维护范式。
AI.summary: 本研究对用于大型语言模型（LLM）修复的样本选择策略进行了实证研究。研究评估了包括随机抽样、K-Center、GraNd、CCS以及新提出的SAPS方法在内的五种策略，通过毒性降低、困惑度以及RPS、OPS、RES等综合指标来衡量修复效果。结果显示，SAPS在解毒、效用保持和效率方面取得了最佳平衡，且所需数据量更少。研究还指出，随机抽样对大型模型有效，而高开销方法效果有限，样本选择应作为可调组件。最终，基于选择的修复被证明是维持LLM可靠性的一种高效可扩展范式。
AI.keywords: LLM修复, 样本选择, SAPS, 行为修复, 数据效率
AI.comments: 这项研究非常有价值，因为它解决了LLM修复中的一个关键挑战：数据选择的成本效益。通过系统地比较不同的采样策略，并引入新的SAPS方法，研究为如何更有效地修复LLM提供了实用的指导。然而，需要注意的是，'有效性'的定义可能因具体应用场景而异，并且在实际部署中，可能还需要考虑其他因素，如计算资源和延迟。

title: Partial Optimality in Cubic Correlation Clustering for General Graphs
summary:
The higher-order correlation clustering problem for a graph $G$ and costs
associated with cliques of $G$ consists in finding a clustering of $G$ so as to
minimize the sum of the costs of those cliques whose nodes all belong to the
same cluster. To tackle this NP-hard problem in practice, local search
heuristics have been proposed and studied in the context of applications. Here,
we establish partial optimality conditions for cubic correlation clustering,
i.e., for the special case of at most 3-cliques. We define and implement
algorithms for deciding these conditions and examine their effectiveness
numerically, on two data sets.

AI.title_translation: 一般图上立方相关聚类的部分最优性
AI.tldr: 研究人员为三阶（立方）相关聚类问题建立了局部最优性条件，并开发了算法来检查这些条件，在实验中验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 高阶相关聚类问题是NP难的，需要局部搜索启发式算法来解决，因此需要建立理论来验证局部最优性。
AI.method: 定义并实现了用于判定部分最优性条件的算法，并在两个数据集上进行了数值检验。
AI.result: 建立了立方相关聚类问题的部分最优性条件，并对所提出的判定算法的有效性进行了数值检验。
AI.conclusion: Not mentioned in abstract
AI.translation: 图 $G$ 的高阶相关聚类问题，以及与 $G$ 的团相关的成本，旨在找到一种对 $G$ 进行聚类的方法，使得所有节点都属于同一簇的那些团的成本之和最小。为了在实践中解决这个NP难问题，已经在应用背景下提出并研究了局部搜索启发式算法。在这里，我们为立方相关聚类，即至多涉及 3-团的特殊情况，建立了部分最优性条件。我们定义并实现了用于判定这些条件的算法，并在两个数据集上对它们的有效性进行了数值检验。
AI.summary: 本文针对高阶相关聚类问题（最小化同簇团成本）的NP难特性，专注于立方相关聚类（涉及至多3-团的成本）的局部最优性条件。研究人员定义并实现了解析这些条件的算法，并在两个数据集上进行了数值验证。
AI.keywords: 相关聚类, 立方相关聚类, 局部最优性, 团, 局部搜索
AI.comments: 该研究的创新点在于为三阶相关聚类问题建立了局部最优性条件，这对于解决NP难问题提供了理论基础。重要性在于为实践中使用的局部搜索启发式算法提供了可行的局部最优性验证方法。局限性在于仅关注了三阶（立方）情况，对于更高阶的聚类问题可能不适用。

title: Behavior-Aware Online Prediction of Obstacle Occupancy using Zonotopes
comments: 64th IEEE Conference on Decision and Control
summary:
Predicting the motion of surrounding vehicles is key to safe autonomous
driving, especially in unstructured environments without prior information.
This paper proposes a novel online method to accurately predict the occupancy
sets of surrounding vehicles based solely on motion observations. The approach
is divided into two stages: first, an Extended Kalman Filter and a Linear
Programming (LP) problem are used to estimate a compact zonotopic set of
control actions; then, a reachability analysis propagates this set to predict
future occupancy. The effectiveness of the method has been validated through
simulations in an urban environment, showing accurate and compact predictions
without relying on prior assumptions or prior training data.
comment: 64th IEEE Conference on Decision and Control

AI.title_translation: 基于行为感知的障碍物占有率在线预测方法（使用Zonotopes）
AI.tldr: 这篇论文介绍了一种新的在线方法，通过扩展卡尔曼滤波和线性规划来估计控制动作的Zonotope集合，然后用可达性分析来预测周围车辆在没有先验信息的情况下，未来哪些区域会被占据，并在城市模拟中取得了准确的预测结果。
AI.motivation: 在没有先验信息的非结构化环境中，准确预测周围车辆的运动是安全自动驾驶的关键。
AI.method: 该方法分为两个阶段：首先，使用扩展卡尔曼滤波器（Extended Kalman Filter）和线性规划（LP）问题来估计一个紧凑的控制动作的Zonotopic集合；然后，通过可达性分析（reachability analysis）将此集合传播，以预测未来的占有情况。
AI.result: 在城市环境模拟中验证了该方法的有效性，显示出准确且紧凑的预测结果，且不依赖于先验假设或先验训练数据。
AI.conclusion: 该方法的有效性已在城市环境模拟中得到验证，实现了准确且紧凑的预测，且无需依赖先验假设或先验训练数据。
AI.translation: 预测周围车辆的运动是安全自动驾驶的关键，尤其是在没有先验信息的非结构化环境中。本文提出了一种新颖的在线方法，仅基于运动观测来准确预测周围车辆的占有集合。该方法分为两个阶段：首先，使用扩展卡尔曼滤波器和线性规划（LP）问题来估计一个紧凑的控制动作的Zonotopic集合；然后，通过可达性分析将此集合传播，以预测未来的占有情况。该方法的有效性已通过城市环境中的模拟得到验证，显示出准确且紧凑的预测，且无需依赖先验假设或先验训练数据。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种新颖的在线方法，仅基于运动观测来准确预测周围车辆的占有集合。该方法利用扩展卡尔曼滤波和线性规划估计控制动作的Zonotope集合，并通过可达性分析进行未来预测。仿真结果证明了该方法在城市环境中的准确性和紧凑性。
AI.keywords: 运动预测, 障碍物占有率, 在线预测, Zonotopes, 扩展卡尔曼滤波
AI.comments: 该方法创新点在于仅依赖运动观测来实现对障碍物占有率集的紧凑、准确的在线预测，避免了对先验信息或训练数据的依赖，这在非结构化环境中尤为重要。其局限性可能在于计算复杂性，尤其是在实时、高密度场景下的扩展性，尽管摘要中未明确提及。

title: Dynamic Weight Adjustment for Knowledge Distillation: Leveraging Vision Transformer for High-Accuracy Lung Cancer Detection and Real-Time Deployment
summary:
This paper presents the FuzzyDistillViT-MobileNet model, a novel approach for
lung cancer (LC) classification, leveraging dynamic fuzzy logic-driven
knowledge distillation (KD) to address uncertainty and complexity in disease
diagnosis. Unlike traditional models that rely on static KD with fixed weights,
our method dynamically adjusts the distillation weight using fuzzy logic,
enabling the student model to focus on high-confidence regions while reducing
attention to ambiguous areas. This dynamic adjustment improves the model
ability to handle varying uncertainty levels across different regions of LC
images. We employ the Vision Transformer (ViT-B32) as the instructor model,
which effectively transfers knowledge to the student model, MobileNet,
enhancing the student generalization capabilities. The training process is
further optimized using a dynamic wait adjustment mechanism that adapts the
training procedure for improved convergence and performance. To enhance image
quality, we introduce pixel-level image fusion improvement techniques such as
Gamma correction and Histogram Equalization. The processed images (Pix1 and
Pix2) are fused using a wavelet-based fusion method to improve image resolution
and feature preservation. This fusion method uses the wavedec2 function to
standardize images to a 224x224 resolution, decompose them into multi-scale
frequency components, and recursively average coefficients at each level for
better feature representation. To address computational efficiency, Genetic
Algorithm (GA) is used to select the most suitable pre-trained student model
from a pool of 12 candidates, balancing model performance with computational
cost. The model is evaluated on two datasets, including LC25000
histopathological images (99.16% accuracy) and IQOTH/NCCD CT-scan images
(99.54% accuracy), demonstrating robustness across different imaging domains.

AI.title_translation: 用于高精度肺癌检测和实时部署的知识蒸馏动态权重调整：利用Vision Transformer
AI.tldr: 该研究通过引入模糊逻辑动态调整知识蒸馏权重，让ViT指导MobileNet进行肺癌检测，并结合图像融合和遗传算法优化模型选择，最终在两个数据集上实现了接近99.5%的高准确率和良好的部署潜力。
AI.motivation: 解决肺癌诊断中由于疾病不确定性和复杂性带来的挑战，以及在保证高精度的同时实现模型的实时部署需求。
AI.method: 提出FuzzyDistillViT-MobileNet模型，采用基于模糊逻辑的动态知识蒸馏（KD）调整权重，以适应不同区域的不确定性；使用ViT-B32作为教师模型，MobileNet作为学生模型；引入伽马校正和直方图均衡化进行像素级图像融合（小波融合）；使用遗传算法（GA）从12个候选模型中选择最优学生模型。
AI.result: 在LC25000组织病理图像数据集上达到99.16%的准确率，在IQOTH/NCCD CT扫描图像数据集上达到99.54%的准确率。
AI.conclusion: FuzzyDistillViT-MobileNet模型通过动态模糊逻辑知识蒸馏、优化的图像预处理和遗传算法模型选择，在肺癌检测任务中取得了高精度（最高99.54%），并兼顾了实时部署的效率。
AI.translation: 本文提出了一种名为FuzzyDistillViT-MobileNet的新颖方法，用于肺癌（LC）分类，它利用动态模糊逻辑驱动的知识蒸馏（KD）来解决疾病诊断中的不确定性和复杂性。与依赖静态KD和固定权重的传统模型不同，我们的方法使用模糊逻辑动态调整蒸馏权重，使学生模型能够专注于高置信度区域，同时减少对模糊区域的关注。这种动态调整提高了模型处理LC图像不同区域变化不确定性的能力。我们采用Vision Transformer (ViT-B32) 作为教师模型，有效地将知识转移给学生模型MobileNet，增强了学生的泛化能力。训练过程还通过动态等待调整机制进一步优化，以改善收敛性和性能。为了增强图像质量，我们引入了伽马校正和直方图均衡化等像素级图像融合改进技术。处理后的图像（Pix1和Pix2）使用基于小波的融合方法进行融合，以提高图像分辨率和特征保留。该融合方法使用wavedec2函数将图像标准化为224x224分辨率，将其分解为多尺度频率分量，并在每个级别递归平均系数以获得更好的特征表示。为了解决计算效率问题，使用遗传算法（GA）从12个候选模型中选择最合适的预训练学生模型，平衡了模型性能与计算成本。该模型在两个数据集上进行了评估，包括LC25000组织病理图像（99.16%准确率）和IQOTH/NCCD CT扫描图像（99.54%准确率），证明了其在不同成像领域的鲁棒性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为FuzzyDistillViT-MobileNet的新模型，用于肺癌分类。该方法的核心是利用动态模糊逻辑知识蒸馏（KD）来调整蒸馏权重，使学生模型（MobileNet）能关注高置信度区域。模型使用ViT作为教师模型进行知识迁移，并通过小波融合技术增强图像质量，最后利用遗传算法优化学生模型的选择，以在准确性和计算效率之间取得平衡，并在两个肺癌数据集上展现了鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: 知识蒸馏, 模糊逻辑, 肺癌检测, Vision Transformer, MobileNet
AI.comments: 该研究的创新点在于引入了基于模糊逻辑的动态权重调整机制，用于知识蒸馏，以更好地处理医学图像诊断中的不确定性。模型集成了ViT作为教师模型和MobileNet作为学生模型，并通过遗传算法进行模型选择，实现了高精度和实际部署的平衡。限制在于其复杂性可能增加模型训练和解释的难度。

title: Explainable Benchmarking through the Lense of Concept Learning
comments: Accepted as full research paper at K-CAP 2025
summary:
Evaluating competing systems in a comparable way, i.e., benchmarking them, is
an undeniable pillar of the scientific method. However, system performance is
often summarized via a small number of metrics. The analysis of the evaluation
details and the derivation of insights for further development or use remains a
tedious manual task with often biased results. Thus, this paper argues for a
new type of benchmarking, which is dubbed explainable benchmarking. The aim of
explainable benchmarking approaches is to automatically generate explanations
for the performance of systems in a benchmark. We provide a first instantiation
of this paradigm for knowledge-graph-based question answering systems. We
compute explanations by using a novel concept learning approach developed for
large knowledge graphs called PruneCEL. Our evaluation shows that PruneCEL
outperforms state-of-the-art concept learners on the task of explainable
benchmarking by up to 0.55 points F1 measure. A task-driven user study with 41
participants shows that in 80\% of the cases, the majority of participants can
accurately predict the behavior of a system based on our explanations. Our code
and data are available at https://github.com/dice-group/PruneCEL/tree/K-cap2025
comment: Accepted as full research paper at K-CAP 2025

AI.title_translation: 从概念学习的角度审视可解释性基准测试
AI.tldr: 为了解决传统基准测试中性能分析困难和主观性强的问题，本研究提出了“可解释性基准测试”的概念，并为知识图谱问答系统开发了创新的概念学习器PruneCEL来自动生成性能解释。PruneCEL表现出色，且用户研究证明其解释能准确预测系统行为。
AI.motivation: 传统的系统性能评估依赖于少数指标，导致对评估细节的分析和洞察提取成为一项繁琐且容易产生偏见的手动任务。因此，需要一种新的基准测试范式来自动生成系统性能的解释。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为“可解释性基准测试”的新范式，并为知识图谱问答系统提供了第一个实例化。该方法的核心是使用一个新开发的、针对大型知识图谱的概念学习方法——PruneCEL，来自动生成系统性能的解释。
AI.result: PruneCEL在可解释性基准测试任务上，相比最先进的概念学习器，F1分数最高可提升0.55分。一项包含41名参与者的任务驱动用户研究显示，在80%的情况下，大多数参与者能够根据生成的解释准确预测系统的行为。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入PruneCEL，本研究成功地为知识图谱问答系统提供了一种可解释的基准测试方法，其实证评估和用户研究均表明其解释具有高度的准确性和有效性。
AI.translation: 以可比的方式评估相互竞争的系统，即对它们进行基准测试，是科学方法的不可否认的支柱。然而，系统性能通常通过少数几个指标来总结。对评估细节的分析以及为进一步开发或使用而推导出的见解仍然是一项繁琐的手动任务，结果往往带有偏见。因此，本文主张一种新型的基准测试，即“可解释性基准测试”。可解释性基准测试方法的目标是自动生成系统在基准测试中表现的解释。我们为基于知识图谱的问答系统提供了该范式的第一个实例化。我们使用一种专为大型知识图谱开发的新颖概念学习方法PruneCEL来计算解释。我们的评估显示，PruneCEL在可解释性基准测试任务上，相比最先进的概念学习器，F1分数最高可提升0.55点。一项包含41名参与者的任务驱动用户研究表明，在80%的情况下，大多数参与者能够根据我们的解释准确预测系统的行为。我们的代码和数据可在https://github.com/dice-group/PruneCEL/tree/K-cap2025获取。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一种名为“可解释性基准测试”的新范式，旨在通过自动生成系统性能的解释来改进科学评估。研究人员首先将该范式应用于知识图谱问答系统，并为此开发了一种名为PruneCEL的新概念学习方法。实验结果表明，PruneCEL在性能上优于现有方法，并且用户研究证实了其生成的解释能够有效帮助用户理解系统行为。
AI.keywords: 可解释性基准测试, 概念学习, 知识图谱问答, PruneCEL, 性能解释
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖的“可解释性基准测试”范式，旨在通过自动生成性能解释来克服传统基准测试中评估细节分析的繁琐性和主观性。其核心创新在于引入了PruneCEL概念学习方法，并在一项用户研究中证明了所生成解释的有效性。这是一个重要的研究方向，因为它直接解决了AI系统评估中“为什么会这样表现”的关键问题。然而，该研究的范围目前仅限于知识图谱问答系统。

title: Multicast-partitioning in Time-triggered Stream Planning for Time-Sensitive Networks
summary:
Multicast allows sending a message to multiple recipients without having to
create and send a separate message for each recipient. This preserves network
bandwidth, which is particularly important in time-sensitive networks. These
networks are commonly used to provide latency-bounded communication for
real-time systems in domains like automotive, avionics, industrial internet of
things, automated shop floors, and smart energy grids. The preserved bandwidth
can be used to admit additional real-time messages with specific quality of
service requirements or to reduce the end-to-end latencies for messages of any
type. However, using multicast communication can complicate traffic planning,
as it requires free queues or available downstream egress ports on all branches
of the multicast tree. In this work, we present a novel multicast partitioning
technique to split multicast trees into smaller multicast or unicast trees.
This allows for a more fine-grained trade-off between bandwidth utilization and
traffic scheduling difficulty. Thus, schedulability in dynamic systems can be
improved, in terms the number of admitted streams and the accumulated network
throughput. We evaluated the multicast partitioning on different network
topologies and with three different scheduling algorithms. With the
partitioning, 5-15\% fewer streams were rejected, while achieving 5-125\% more
network throughput, depending on the scheduling algorithm.

AI.title_translation: 时间触发流调度中的组播分区用于时间敏感网络
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种新的组播分区技术，将大的组播树分解为更小的组播或单播树，以解决时间敏感网络中组播通信的流量调度复杂性问题。这种方法可以在带宽利用率和调度难度之间取得更好的平衡，从而提高动态系统中的可调度性。实验结果表明，与不使用分区相比，该方法可以减少5-15%的流拒绝率，并提高5-125%的网络吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 时间敏感网络（TSN）广泛应用于汽车、航空电子、工业物联网等领域，对延迟有严格要求。组播通信可以节省带宽，但会增加流量调度的复杂性，因为需要所有分支上的队列或端口都可用。因此，需要一种方法来解决组播通信在TSN中的调度难题。
AI.method: 提出了一种新颖的组播分区技术，将大的组播树分解为更小的组播或单播树。
AI.result: 在不同的网络拓扑和三种不同的调度算法下进行了评估。结果显示，与未使用分区的方案相比，该分区技术使得拒绝的流数量减少了5-15%，网络吞吐量提高了5-125%，具体取决于所使用的调度算法。
AI.conclusion: 提出的组播分区技术能够有效解决时间敏感网络中组播通信的流量调度复杂性问题，提高了系统的可调度性、流接纳能力和网络吞吐量。
AI.translation: 组播允许在不为每个接收者创建和发送单独消息的情况下将消息发送给多个接收者。这可以节省网络带宽，这在时间敏感网络中尤其重要。这些网络通常用于为汽车、航空电子、工业物联网、自动化车间和智能电网等领域的实时系统提供延迟有界通信。节省的带宽可用于接纳具有特定服务质量要求的其他实时消息，或减少任何类型消息的端到端延迟。然而，使用组播通信会使流量调度复杂化，因为它需要在组播树的所有分支上都有空闲队列或可用的下游出口端口。在本研究中，我们提出了一种新颖的组播分区技术，将组播树分解为更小的组播或单播树。这允许在带宽利用率和流量调度难度之间进行更精细的权衡。因此，可以从接纳的流数量和累积的网络吞吐量方面来改善动态系统的可调度性。我们在不同的网络拓扑和三种不同的调度算法下评估了组播分区。通过分区，拒绝的流数量减少了5-15%，同时网络吞吐量提高了5-125%，具体取决于调度算法。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种新颖的组播分区技术，用于时间触发流调度。该技术通过将大型组播树分解为更小的组播或单播树，解决了时间敏感网络中组播通信流量调度的复杂性问题。这种方法在带宽利用率和调度难度之间取得了更好的权衡，从而提高了动态系统的可调度性，增加了可接纳的流数量并提升了网络吞吐量。实验结果表明，与现有方法相比，该技术在减少流拒绝率和提高网络吞吐量方面取得了显著成效。
AI.keywords: 组播分区,时间敏感网络,流量调度,可调度性,网络吞吐量
AI.comments: 该研究提出的组播分区技术在解决时间敏感网络中的组播调度问题方面具有重要意义。通过将复杂的组播树分解，该方法有效地平衡了带宽利用率和调度复杂度，为提高实时系统的性能提供了新的途径。实验结果令人鼓舞，但未来可以进一步探索该技术在不同网络规模和更复杂的调度场景下的表现。

title: UniSE: A Unified Framework for Decoder-only Autoregressive LM-based Speech Enhancement
summary:
The development of neural audio codecs (NACs) has largely promoted
applications of language models (LMs) to speech processing and understanding.
However, there lacks the verification on the effectiveness of autoregressive
(AR) LMbased models in unifying different sub-tasks of speech enhancement (SE).
In this work, we propose UniSE, a unified decoder-only LM-based framework to
handle different SE tasks including speech restoration, target speaker
extraction and speech separation. It takes input speech features as conditions
and generates discrete tokens of the target speech using AR modeling, which
facilitates a compatibility between distinct learning patterns of multiple
tasks. Experiments on several benchmarks indicate the proposed UniSE can
achieve competitive performance compared to discriminative and generative
baselines, showing the capacity of LMs in unifying SE tasks. The demo page is
available here: https://github.com/hyyan2k/UniSE.

AI.title_translation: UniSE：一个用于仅解码器自回归语言模型的统一语音增强框架
AI.tldr: UniSE 是一个新框架，使用仅解码器的自回归语言模型，将语音恢复、说话人提取和语音分离等多种语音增强任务统一到一个模型中，并在实验中取得了良好的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有研究中缺乏对自回归语言模型（AR LM）在统一不同语音增强子任务方面的有效性的验证，尽管神经音频编解码器（NAC）已促进了语言模型在语音处理中的应用。
AI.method: UniSE 框架采用基于仅解码器的自回归语言模型（AR LM），以输入的语音特征作为条件，通过自回归建模生成目标语音的离散标记，从而实现对语音恢复、目标说话人提取和语音分离等不同子任务的统一处理。
AI.result: 在多个基准测试上，所提出的 UniSE 取得了与判别式和生成式基线相比具有竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果表明，UniSE 能够实现与判别式和生成式基线相比具有竞争力的性能，证明了语言模型在统一语音增强任务方面的能力。
AI.translation: 神经音频编解码器（NAC）的发展极大地促进了语言模型（LM）在语音处理和理解中的应用。然而，对于自回归（AR）LM 模型在统一不同语音增强（SE）子任务方面的有效性，目前仍缺乏验证。在这项工作中，我们提出了 UniSE，一个统一的仅解码器 LM 框架，用于处理不同的 SE 任务，包括语音恢复、目标说话人提取和语音分离。它以输入的语音特征作为条件，并使用 AR 建模生成目标语音的离散标记，这有助于整合多个任务中不同的学习模式。在多个基准测试上的实验表明，所提出的 UniSE 可以实现与判别式和生成式基线相比具有竞争力的性能，展示了 LM 在统一 SE 任务方面的能力。演示页面可在此处获取：https://github.com/hyyan2k/UniSE。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 UniSE，一个统一的、基于仅解码器自回归语言模型的框架，用于解决语音恢复、目标说话人提取和语音分离等多种语音增强任务。该框架通过将输入语音特征作为条件并生成目标语音的离散标记来实现任务的统一。实验证明了 UniSE 具有与现有基线相当的性能。
AI.keywords: 语音增强, 统一框架, 自回归语言模型, 仅解码器模型, 离散语音生成
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于提出了一个统一的、基于仅解码器自回归语言模型的框架（UniSE），用于处理多种语音增强子任务，这在现有研究中较少被验证。其重要性在于展示了大型语言模型（LM）在统一不同语音增强任务方面的潜力。目前未提及局限性。

title: Joint Computation Offloading and Resource Management for Cooperative Satellite-Aerial-Marine Internet of Things Networks
summary:
Devices within the marine Internet of Things (MIoT) can connect to low Earth
orbit (LEO) satellites and unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) to facilitate
low-latency data transmission and execution, as well as enhanced-capacity data
storage. However, without proper traffic handling strategy, it is still
difficult to effectively meet the low-latency requirements. In this paper, we
consider a cooperative satellite-aerial-MIoT network (CSAMN) for maritime edge
computing and maritime data storage to prioritize delay-sensitive (DS) tasks by
employing mobile edge computing, while handling delay-tolerant (DT) tasks via
the store-carry-forward method. Considering the delay constraints of DS tasks,
we formulate a constrained joint optimization problem of maximizing
satellite-collected data volume while minimizing system energy consumption by
controlling four interdependent variables, including the transmit power of UAVs
for DS tasks, the start time of DT tasks, computing resource allocation, and
offloading ratio. To solve this non-convex and non-linear problem, we propose a
joint computation offloading and resource management (JCORM) algorithm using
the Dinkelbach method and linear programming. Our results show that the volume
of data collected by the proposed JCORM algorithm can be increased by up to
41.5% compared to baselines. Moreover, JCORM algorithm achieves a dramatic
reduction in computational time, from a maximum of 318.21 seconds down to just
0.16 seconds per experiment, making it highly suitable for real-time maritime
applications.

AI.title_translation: 面向合作卫星-航空-海事物联网网络的联合计算卸载与资源管理
AI.tldr: 为解决海洋物联网中的低延迟通信问题，研究人员提出了一种名为JCORM的新算法，该算法通过联合优化卫星、无人机和地面设备的资源分配，成功地在满足延迟要求的同时，将收集的数据量提高了41.5%，并将计算时间缩短到了毫秒级别。
AI.motivation: 海洋物联网（MIoT）设备需要连接到低地球轨道（LEO）卫星和无人机（UAV）以实现低延迟数据传输和执行，但在缺乏适当的流量处理策略时，难以有效满足低延迟要求。
AI.method: 提出了一种联合计算卸载和资源管理（JCORM）算法，该算法利用Dinkelbach方法和线性规划来解决所提出的非凸非线性联合优化问题。
AI.result: 与基线方法相比，所提出的JCORM算法收集的数据量最多可增加41.5%。此外，JCORM算法将计算时间从最长318.21秒大幅减少到每个实验仅0.16秒。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的JCORM算法通过联合优化卫星收集的数据量和系统能耗，能够显著提高数据收集量，并极大地缩短了计算时间，使其非常适合实时海事应用。
AI.translation: 海洋物联网（MIoT）中的设备可以连接到低地球轨道（LEO）卫星和无人机（UAV），以促进低延迟的数据传输和执行，以及增强容量的数据存储。然而，如果没有适当的流量处理策略，仍然难以有效满足低延迟要求。在本文中，我们考虑了一个用于海事边缘计算和海事数据存储的合作卫星-航空-MIoT网络（CSAMN），通过采用移动边缘计算来优先处理延迟敏感（DS）任务，同时通过存储-携带-转发方法处理延迟容忍（DT）任务。考虑到DS任务的延迟约束，我们制定了一个联合优化问题，目标是最大化卫星收集的数据量，同时最小化系统能耗，通过控制四个相互依赖的变量：无人机对DS任务的发射功率、DT任务的开始时间、计算资源分配和卸载比率。为了解决这个非凸非线性问题，我们提出了一种使用Dinkelbach方法和线性规划的联合计算卸载和资源管理（JCORM）算法。我们的结果表明，与基线方法相比，所提出的JCORM算法收集的数据量最多可增加41.5%。此外，JCORM算法将每个实验的计算时间从最长318.21秒急剧减少到仅0.16秒，使其非常适合实时海事应用。
AI.summary: 本文针对合作卫星-航空-海事物联网网络（CSAMN）中的海事边缘计算和数据存储问题，提出了一种联合优化框架。该框架旨在通过移动边缘计算优先处理延迟敏感（DS）任务，并通过存储-携带-转发处理延迟容忍（DT）任务。通过联合优化卫星收集的数据量和系统能耗，并控制无人机发射功率、DT任务开始时间、计算资源分配和卸载比例这四个相互依赖的变量，提出了一种名为JCORM的算法来解决这一非凸优化问题。实验结果表明，JCORM算法在提高数据收集量和显著降低计算时间方面表现出色。
AI.keywords: 卫星-航空-海事物联网, 计算卸载, 资源管理, 延迟敏感任务, 联合优化
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于首次提出了一个联合优化框架，用于协调卫星、无人机和海事物联网设备之间的计算卸载和资源管理，以同时满足延迟敏感和延迟容忍任务的需求。其重要性在于为解决海洋边缘计算中的低延迟和能耗挑战提供了有效的解决方案。局限性在于，它主要关注的是优化模型和算法的性能，实际部署中的复杂性和动态性未在摘要中详细说明。

title: MolBridge: Atom-Level Joint Graph Refinement for Robust Drug-Drug Interaction Event Prediction
summary:
Drug combinations offer therapeutic benefits but also carry the risk of
adverse drug-drug interactions (DDIs), especially under complex molecular
structures. Accurate DDI event prediction requires capturing fine-grained
inter-drug relationships, which are critical for modeling metabolic mechanisms
such as enzyme-mediated competition. However, existing approaches typically
rely on isolated drug representations and fail to explicitly model atom-level
cross-molecular interactions, limiting their effectiveness across diverse
molecular complexities and DDI type distributions. To address these
limitations, we propose MolBridge, a novel atom-level joint graph refinement
framework for robust DDI event prediction. MolBridge constructs a joint graph
that integrates atomic structures of drug pairs, enabling direct modeling of
inter-drug associations. A central challenge in such joint graph settings is
the potential loss of information caused by over-smoothing when modeling
long-range atomic dependencies. To overcome this, we introduce a structure
consistency module that iteratively refines node features while preserving the
global structural context. This joint design allows MolBridge to effectively
learn both local and global interaction outperforms state-of-the-art baselines,
achieving superior performance across long-tail and inductive scenarios.
patterns, yielding robust representations across both frequent and rare DDI
types. Extensive experiments on two benchmark datasets show that MolBridge
consistently. These results demonstrate the advantages of fine-grained graph
refinement in improving the accuracy, robustness, and mechanistic
interpretability of DDI event prediction.This work contributes to Web Mining
and Content Analysis by developing graph-based methods for mining and analyzing
drug-drug interaction networks.

AI.title_translation: MolBridge：用于鲁棒药物-药物相互作用事件预测的原子级联合图细化
AI.tldr: MolBridge通过原子级联合图细化来改进药物-药物相互作用（DDI）预测，解决了现有方法在处理复杂分子结构和捕捉原子间相互作用方面的不足。该框架通过构建包含药物对原子结构的联合图，并引入结构一致性模块来防止信息丢失和保持全局结构上下文，从而有效地学习局部和全局相互作用模式。实验证明MolBridge在长尾和归纳场景中均优于现有方法，提高了DDI预测的准确性、鲁棒性和机制可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有药物-药物相互作用（DDI）预测方法通常依赖于孤立的药物表示，未能明确模拟原子级别的跨分子相互作用，这限制了它们在处理复杂分子结构和不同DDI类型分布时的有效性。
AI.method: 提出MolBridge，一个新颖的原子级联合图细化框架。它构建一个联合图，整合药物对的原子结构，直接模拟分子间的关联。为解决信息平滑和长程原子依赖问题，引入结构一致性模块，在保持全局结构上下文的同时迭代地细化节点特征。
AI.result: MolBridge在两个基准数据集上进行了广泛的实验，结果显示该模型在长尾和归纳场景中持续优于最先进的基线方法，在DDI预测的准确性、鲁棒性和机制可解释性方面取得了优越的性能。
AI.conclusion: MolBridge通过细粒度的图细化提高了DDI预测的准确性、鲁棒性和机制可解释性，证明了其在处理复杂分子结构和长尾分布DDI方面的优势。
AI.translation: 药物组合具有治疗益处，但也可能带来不良的药物-药物相互作用（DDIs），尤其是在复杂的分子结构下。准确的DDI事件预测需要捕捉细粒度的药物间关系，这对于模拟酶介导的竞争等代谢机制至关重要。然而，现有方法通常依赖于孤立的药物表示，未能明确模拟原子级别的跨分子相互作用，这限制了它们在处理各种分子复杂性和DDI类型分布时的有效性。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了MolBridge，一个新颖的原子级联合图细化框架，用于鲁棒的DDI事件预测。MolBridge构建了一个联合图，整合了药物对的原子结构，能够直接模拟分子间的关联。这种联合图设置中的一个核心挑战是，在模拟长程原子依赖性时，过度平滑可能导致信息丢失。为了克服这一点，我们引入了一个结构一致性模块，在保持全局结构上下文的同时，迭代地细化节点特征。这种联合设计使MolBridge能够有效地学习局部和全局的相互作用模式，从而在频繁和罕见的DDI类型中产生鲁棒的表示。在两个基准数据集上的广泛实验表明，MolBridge在长尾和归纳场景中持续优于最先进的基线方法，取得了优越的性能。这些结果证明了细粒度图细化在提高DDI事件预测的准确性、鲁棒性和机制可解释性方面的优势。这项工作通过开发基于图的方法来挖掘和分析药物-药物相互作用网络，为Web挖掘和内容分析做出了贡献。
AI.summary: MolBridge是一个新颖的原子级联合图细化框架，旨在解决现有DDI预测方法在处理复杂分子结构和捕捉原子间相互作用方面的局限性。该框架通过构建包含药物对原子结构的联合图，并引入结构一致性模块来迭代地细化节点特征，同时保持全局结构上下文，从而有效地学习局部和全局相互作用模式。实验结果表明，MolBridge在准确性、鲁棒性和机制可解释性方面均优于现有方法，尤其是在长尾和归纳场景下。

AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种名为MolBridge的新颖框架，用于改进药物-药物相互作用（DDI）预测。其主要创新点在于采用原子级别的联合图细化方法，能够直接捕捉药物对之间的细粒度相互作用，解决了现有方法依赖孤立表示的局限性。引入的结构一致性模块对于克服图神经网络中常见的过平滑问题至关重要，确保了模型在处理复杂分子结构和长尾分布DDI时的鲁棒性。该方法在实验中表现出色，证明了细粒度图细化在DDI预测领域的潜力和重要性。

title: LM-mixup: Text Data Augmentation via Language Model based Mixup
summary:
Instruction tuning is crucial for aligning Large Language Models (LLMs), yet
the quality of instruction-following data varies significantly. While
high-quality data is paramount, it is often scarce; conversely, abundant
low-quality data is frequently discarded, leading to substantial information
loss. Existing data augmentation methods struggle to augment this low-quality
data effectively, and the evaluation of such techniques remains poorly defined.
To address this, we formally define the task of Instruction Distillation:
distilling multiple low-quality and redundant inputs into high-quality and
coherent instruction-output pairs. Specifically, we introduce a comprehensive
data construction pipeline to create MIXTURE, a 144K-sample dataset pairing
low-quality or semantically redundant imperfect instruction clusters with their
high-quality distillations. We then introduce LM-Mixup, by first performing
supervised fine-tuning on MIXTURE and then optimizing it with reinforcement
learning. This process uses three complementary reward signals: quality,
semantic alignment, and format compliance, via Group Relative Policy
Optimization (GRPO). We demonstrate that LM-Mixup effectively augments
imperfect datasets: fine-tuning LLMs on its distilled data, which accounts for
only about 3% of the entire dataset, not only surpasses full-dataset training
but also competes with state-of-the-art high-quality data selection methods
across multiple benchmarks. Our work establishes that low-quality data is a
valuable resource when properly distilled and augmented with LM-Mixup,
significantly enhancing the efficiency and performance of instruction-tuned
LLMs.

AI.title_translation: 基于语言模型的文本数据增强方法LM-mixup
AI.tldr: LM-Mixup是一种通过语言模型混合技术增强文本数据的方法，它能有效地从低质量指令数据中提炼出高质量指令-输出对，显著提升指令微调LLM的效率和性能，甚至优于使用全部高质量数据进行训练。
AI.motivation: 指令微调对于齐LLM至关重要，但高质量指令数据稀缺，而低质量数据常被丢弃造成信息损失。现有数据增强方法难以有效处理低质量数据，且评估方法定义不清。因此，需要一种方法来有效利用低质量数据。
AI.method: 提出指令蒸馏任务，构建了一个名为MIXTURE的数据集，包含144K个低质量或冗余指令簇及其高质量蒸馏结果。在此基础上，提出LM-Mixup方法，首先在MIXTURE上进行监督微调，然后使用基于质量、语义对齐和格式合规性的三个互补奖励信号，通过组相对策略优化（GRPO）进行强化学习优化。
AI.result: 在MIXTURE数据集上蒸馏和增强后的数据，即使仅占总数据集的约3%，也能使微调后的LLM性能超越使用全部数据集训练的模型，并能与最先进的高质量数据选择方法相媲美。
AI.conclusion: 低质量数据经过LM-Mixup的有效蒸馏和增强后，可以成为宝贵的资源，显著提高指令微调LLM的效率和性能。
AI.translation: 指令微调对于齐大语言模型（LLMs）至关重要，但指令遵循数据的质量差异很大。高质量数据至关重要，但通常稀缺；相反，大量的低质量数据经常被丢弃，导致大量信息丢失。现有的数据增强方法难以有效地增强这些低质量数据，并且对此类技术的评估仍然定义不清。为了解决这个问题，我们正式定义了指令蒸馏任务：将多个低质量和冗余的输入蒸馏成高质量、连贯的指令-输出对。具体来说，我们引入了一个全面的数据构建流程，创建了MIXTURE，一个包含144K个样本的数据集，将低质量或语义冗余的不完美指令簇与其高质量的蒸馏结果配对。然后，我们通过首先在MIXTURE上进行监督微调，然后使用强化学习进行优化来引入LM-Mixup。此过程通过组相对策略优化（GRPO）使用三个互补的奖励信号：质量、语义对齐和格式合规性。我们证明了LM-Mixup能够有效地增强不完美的数据集：在经过蒸馏的数据上进行微调LLM（仅占整个数据集的约3%），不仅超过了全数据集训练，而且在多个基准测试中与最先进的高质量数据选择方法相媲美。我们的工作确立了低质量数据是经过适当蒸馏和LM-Mixup增强后的宝贵资源，显著提高了指令微调LLM的效率和性能。
AI.summary: 该研究提出了一种名为LM-Mixup的数据增强方法，旨在解决指令微调中高质量数据稀缺和低质量数据被浪费的问题。研究者定义了“指令蒸馏”任务，并构建了MIXTURE数据集，将低质量指令聚类与其高质量版本配对。通过在MIXTURE上进行监督微调和基于质量、语义对齐及格式合规性的强化学习优化，LM-Mixup能够有效地从低质量数据中提炼信息。实验结果表明，使用LM-Mixup增强后的少量数据进行微调，性能优于使用全部数据，并可与顶尖方法媲美，证明了低质量数据在经过有效处理后的价值。
AI.keywords: 指令蒸馏, LM-Mixup, 数据增强, 低质量数据, 大语言模型
AI.comments: 该研究巧妙地利用了通常被忽视的低质量数据，通过“指令蒸馏”和LM-Mixup方法将其转化为有价值的训练资源。其创新性在于不仅提出了新的数据增强技术，还构建了相应的数据集和优化框架（GRPO），并给出了量化的实验结果证明其有效性。然而，对于“低质量”和“高质量”的具体界定标准，以及GRPO在不同场景下的鲁棒性，可能还需要进一步的探讨。总的来说，这项工作为如何更高效地利用现有数据资源训练LLM提供了新的思路。

title: Resource-Aware Hybrid Quantum Programming with General Recursion and Quantum Control
summary:
This paper introduces the hybrid quantum language with general recursion
$\mathtt{Hyrql}$, driven towards resource-analysis. By design, $\mathtt{Hyrql}$
does not require the specification of an initial set of quantum gates and,
hence, is well amenable towards a generic cost analysis. Indeed, languages
using different sets of quantum gates lead to representations of quantum
circuits whose complexity varies. Towards resource-analysis, a
semantics-preserving compilation algorithm to simply-typed term rewrite systems
is described; allowing a generic reuse of all known techniques for analyzing
the complexity of term rewrite systems. We prove the versatility of this
approach through many examples.

AI.title_translation: 资源感知的混合量子编程，支持通用递归和量子控制
AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种名为Hyrql的混合量子语言，旨在进行资源分析。Hyrql不需要预先指定初始量子门，便于进行通用的成本分析。通过将Hyrql编译为类型项重写系统，可以利用现有的技术分析量子电路的复杂度。
AI.motivation: 现有的量子语言在进行资源分析时，通常需要预先指定一组量子门，这限制了通用成本分析的进行。不同的量子门集合会导致量子电路表示的复杂度不同。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为Hyrql的混合量子语言，并设计了一种保持语义的编译算法，将其转换为类型项重写系统。这使得可以利用已有的项重写系统分析技术来分析量子电路的复杂度。
AI.result: 通过将Hyrql编译为类型项重写系统，实现了对量子电路复杂度的通用分析方法，并通过多个示例证明了该方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: Hyrql语言及其编译到类型项重写系统的方案，为进行资源感知的混合量子编程提供了一种通用的、可分析的方法。
AI.translation: 这篇论文介绍了具有通用递归的混合量子语言Hyrql，旨在进行资源分析。Hyrql在设计上不需要指定初始量子门集，因此非常适合进行通用的成本分析。事实上，使用不同量子门集的语言会导致量子电路表示的复杂度各不相同。为了进行资源分析，我们描述了一种保持语义的编译算法，将其转换为简单的类型项重写系统；这使得可以通用地重用所有已知的用于分析项重写系统复杂度的技术。我们通过许多示例证明了该方法的通用性。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种名为Hyrql的混合量子语言，其特点是支持通用递归且无需预先指定量子门集，从而便于进行通用的资源和成本分析。论文描述了一种将Hyrql编译为类型项重写系统的语义保持算法，使得可以利用现有的项重写系统分析技术来评估量子电路的复杂度。该方法通过多个示例验证了其有效性和通用性。
AI.keywords: 混合量子编程,通用递归,资源分析,类型项重写系统,量子电路复杂度
AI.comments: 该研究通过引入Hyrql语言和将其编译为类型项重写系统的方法，解决了混合量子编程中的资源分析问题，具有重要的理论意义和潜在的应用价值。其通用性和灵活性是该方法的亮点。

title: Intransitive Player Dominance and Market Inefficiency in Tennis Forecasting: A Graph Neural Network Approach
summary:
Intransitive player dominance, where player A beats B, B beats C, but C beats
A, is common in competitive tennis. Yet, there are few known attempts to
incorporate it within forecasting methods. We address this problem with a graph
neural network approach that explicitly models these intransitive relationships
through temporal directed graphs, with players as nodes and their historical
match outcomes as directed edges. We find the bookmaker Pinnacle Sports poorly
handles matches with high intransitive complexity and posit that our
graph-based approach is uniquely positioned to capture relational dynamics in
these scenarios. When selectively betting on higher intransitivity matchups
with our model (65.7% accuracy, 0.215 Brier Score), we achieve significant
positive returns of 3.26% ROI with Kelly staking over 1903 bets, suggesting a
market inefficiency in handling intransitive matchups that our approach
successfully exploits.

AI.title_translation: 网球预测中的非传递性玩家支配和市场低效率：一种图神经网络方法
AI.tldr: 该研究提出一种利用图神经网络（GNN）来预测网球比赛结果的方法，特别关注非传递性玩家支配（A克B，B克C，C克A）的情况。研究发现，在非传递性复杂性高的比赛中，博彩公司Pinnacle Sports的预测存在不足。通过对这类比赛进行投注，该模型取得了显著的投资回报率（ROI），表明市场在处理非传递性对局时存在效率低下，而该模型能够有效利用这一点。
AI.motivation: 现有预测方法很少考虑网球比赛中普遍存在的非传递性玩家支配现象，这促使研究者开发一种能够明确建模这些关系的新方法。
AI.method: 提出一种图神经网络（GNN）方法，将球员视为节点，历史比赛结果视为有向边，构建时间有向图来显式地建模非传递性关系。
AI.result: 在处理非传递性复杂性高的比赛时，博彩公司Pinnacle Sports的表现不佳。该图模型在选择性投注非传递性对局时，准确率达到65.7%，Brier得分为0.215，投资回报率（ROI）为3.26%，表明市场在处理非传递性对局时存在效率低下。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出的图神经网络方法能够有效捕捉网球比赛中的关系动态，特别是在处理非传递性玩家支配的情况下，并成功利用了由此产生的市场低效率，实现了显著的投资回报率。
AI.translation: 非传递性玩家支配，即A击败B，B击败C，但C击败A，在竞技网球中很常见。然而，目前很少有尝试将其纳入预测方法。我们通过一种图神经网络方法来解决这个问题，该方法通过时间有向图显式地建模这些非传递性关系，将球员作为节点，将他们的历史比赛结果作为有向边。我们发现博彩公司Pinnacle Sports在处理具有高非传递性复杂性的比赛时表现不佳，并认为我们的图基方法在捕捉这些场景下的关系动态方面具有独特性。通过在我们的模型上选择性地投注非传递性对局（准确率65.7%，Brier得分为0.215），我们在超过1903场比赛中实现了3.26%的显著正投资回报率（ROI），采用了Kelly押注策略，这表明在处理非传递性对局方面存在市场低效率，而我们的方法成功地利用了这一点。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种利用图神经网络（GNN）来预测网球比赛结果的方法，该方法特别关注非传递性玩家支配（A胜B，B胜C，C胜A）的现象。通过构建时间有向图，模型能够显式地捕捉这种复杂的玩家关系。研究发现，博彩公司在处理此类高非传递性复杂性的比赛时存在预测偏差。通过对模型识别出的非传递性比赛进行选择性投注，研究取得了显著的投资回报率，证明了市场在此类情况下的低效率，以及该GNN模型有效利用这种低效率的能力。
AI.keywords: 非传递性玩家支配, 图神经网络, 网球预测, 市场低效率, 投注策略
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地将非传递性玩家支配这一网球比赛中的普遍现象引入预测模型，并提出了一种基于图神经网络的解决方案。模型在处理复杂关系和识别市场低效率方面表现出色，具有重要的理论和实践意义。然而，模型在实际应用中的泛化能力和对其他体育项目的适用性有待进一步研究。

title: Rotate Both Ways: Time-and-Order RoPE for Generative Recommendation
summary:
Generative recommenders, typically transformer-based autoregressive models,
predict the next item or action from a user's interaction history. Their
effectiveness depends on how the model represents where an interaction event
occurs in the sequence (discrete index) and when it occurred in wall-clock
time. Prevailing approaches inject time via learned embeddings or relative
attention biases. In this paper, we argue that RoPE-based approaches, if
designed properly, can be a stronger alternative for jointly modeling temporal
and sequential information in user behavior sequences. While vanilla RoPE in
LLMs considers only token order, generative recommendation requires
incorporating both event time and token index. To address this, we propose
Time-and-Order RoPE (TO-RoPE), a family of rotary position embedding designs
that treat index and time as angle sources shaping the query-key geometry
directly. We present three instantiations: early fusion, split-by-dim, and
split-by-head. Extensive experiments on both publicly available datasets and a
proprietary industrial dataset show that TO-RoPE variants consistently improve
accuracy over existing methods for encoding time and index. These results
position rotary embeddings as a simple, principled, and deployment-friendly
foundation for generative recommendation.

AI.title_translation: 双向旋转：用于生成式推荐的时间与顺序RoPE
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为TO-RoPE的新型旋转位置嵌入方法，用于改进基于Transformer的生成式推荐模型。TO-RoPE能够同时考虑用户交互事件发生的时间和顺序，通过将时间和顺序信息作为角度源直接影响查询-键的几何关系，从而比现有方法更有效地对时间和顺序信息进行编码。实验证明，TO-RoPE在多个数据集上均能提升推荐准确率，显示了其作为生成式推荐基础的潜力。
AI.motivation: 现有的生成式推荐模型在表示用户交互事件的顺序和发生时间方面存在不足，通常依赖于学习到的嵌入或相对注意力偏差。本文认为，精心设计的RoPE（旋转位置嵌入）方法可以作为一种更强大的替代方案，用于联合建模用户行为序列中的时间信息和顺序信息。
AI.method: 提出时间与顺序RoPE（TO-RoPE），这是一系列旋转位置嵌入的设计，将索引和时间视为影响查询-键几何关系的直接角度源。具体提出了三种实现方式：早期融合、按维度分裂和按头分裂。
AI.result: TO-RoPE的变体在公开和专有数据集上的广泛实验表明，它们在编码时间和索引方面持续优于现有方法，提高了准确率。
AI.conclusion: TO-RoPE变体在编码时间和索引方面持续优于现有方法，提高了准确率。这些结果表明，旋转嵌入可以作为一种简单、有原则且易于部署的基础，用于生成式推荐。
AI.translation: 生成式推荐器，通常是基于Transformer的自回归模型，从用户的交互历史中预测下一个项目或动作。它们的有效性取决于模型如何表示交互事件在序列中的位置（离散索引）和在挂钟时间中的发生时间。现有的方法通过学习到的嵌入或相对注意力偏差来注入时间信息。在本文中，我们认为，如果设计得当，基于RoPE的方法可以作为一种更强大的替代方案，用于联合建模用户行为序列中的时间信息和顺序信息。虽然LLM中的原始RoPE仅考虑令牌顺序，但生成式推荐需要同时包含事件时间和令牌索引。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了时间与顺序RoPE（TO-RoPE），这是一系列旋转位置嵌入的设计，它将索引和时间视为直接影响查询-键几何关系的角源。我们提出了三种实例化：早期融合、按维度分裂和按头分裂。在公开数据集和专有工业数据集上的广泛实验表明，TO-RoPE变体在编码时间和索引方面持续优于现有方法。这些结果表明，旋转嵌入可以作为一种简单、有原则且易于部署的基础，用于生成式推荐。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种名为TO-RoPE的新型旋转位置嵌入方法，用于改进基于Transformer的生成式推荐模型。TO-RoPE能够同时考虑用户交互事件发生的时间和顺序，通过将时间和顺序信息作为角度源直接影响查询-键的几何关系，从而比现有方法更有效地对时间和顺序信息进行编码。实验证明，TO-RoPE在多个数据集上均能提升推荐准确率，显示了其作为生成式推荐基础的潜力。
AI.keywords: 生成式推荐, 旋转位置嵌入, 时间信息, 顺序信息, TO-RoPE
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖的TO-RoPE方法，有效地解决了生成式推荐中时间与顺序信息融合的挑战。通过将时间和顺序信息作为RoPE的角度源，实现了更精确的表示。三种具体的实现方式提供了灵活性，并且实验结果验证了其优越性。该方法简单、有原则且易于部署，具有重要的实际应用价值。

title: Parallel $(1+ε)$-Approximate Multi-Commodity Mincost Flow in Almost Optimal Depth and Work
comments: To appear in FOCS 2025, 104 pages, 3 figures
summary:
We present a parallel algorithm for computing $(1+\epsilon)$-approximate
mincost flow on an undirected graph with $m$ edges, where capacities and costs
are assigned to both edges and vertices. Our algorithm achieves $\hat{O}(m)$
work and $\hat{O}(1)$ depth when $\epsilon > 1/\mathrm{polylog}(m)$, making
both the work and depth almost optimal, up to a subpolynomial factor.
  Previous algorithms with $\hat{O}(m)$ work required $\Omega(m)$ depth, even
for special cases of mincost flow with only edge capacities or max flow with
vertex capacities. Our result generalizes prior almost-optimal parallel
$(1+\epsilon)$-approximation algorithms for these special cases, including
shortest paths [Li, STOC'20] [Andoni, Stein, Zhong, STOC'20] [Rozhen, Haeupler,
Marinsson, Grunau, Zuzic, STOC'23] and max flow with only edge capacities
[Agarwal, Khanna, Li, Patil, Wang, White, Zhong, SODA'24].
  Our key technical contribution is the first construction of
length-constrained flow shortcuts with $(1+\epsilon)$ length slack,
$\hat{O}(1)$ congestion slack, and $\hat{O}(1)$ step bound. This provides a
strict generalization of the influential concept of
$(\hat{O}(1),\epsilon)$-hopsets [Cohen, JACM'00], allowing for additional
control over congestion. Previous length-constrained flow shortcuts [Haeupler,
Hershkowitz, Li, Roeyskoe, Saranurak, STOC'24] incur a large constant in the
length slack, which would lead to a large approximation factor. To enable our
flow algorithms to work under vertex capacities, we also develop a
close-to-linear time algorithm for computing length-constrained vertex expander
decomposition.
  Building on Cohen's idea of path-count flows [Cohen, SICOMP'95], we further
extend our algorithm to solve $(1+\epsilon)$-approximate $k$-commodity mincost
flow problems with almost-optimal $\hat{O}(mk)$ work and $\hat{O}(1)$ depth,
independent of the number of commodities $k$.
comment: To appear in FOCS 2025, 104 pages, 3 figures

AI.title_translation: 并行 (1+ε)-近似多商品最小费用流，具有近乎最优的深度和工作量
AI.tldr: (1+ε)-近似多商品最小费用流的并行算法，工作量接近最优 (Ô(m))，深度也接近最优 (Ô(1))，并且不依赖于商品数量 k。
AI.motivation: 现有并行算法在解决最小费用流或最大流问题时，即使是特殊情况，也需要较高的深度（Ω(m)）。本研究旨在改进这一点，提出一种具有近乎最优工作量和深度的并行算法，并将其推广到更一般的多商品最小费用流问题。
AI.method: 该算法的核心技术是构建了具有 (1+ε) 长度松弛、Ô(1) 拥塞松弛和 Ô(1) 步界限的长度受限流捷径（flow shortcuts），这是对 (Ô(1),ε)-hopsets 的严格推广。此外，为了处理顶点容量，还开发了一种近乎线性时间的长度受限顶点扩展分解算法。最后，借鉴了路径计数流（path-count flows）的思想，将算法扩展到多商品问题。
AI.result: 该算法在无向图上实现了 (1+ε)-近似最小费用流，具有 Ô(m) 的工作量和 Ô(1) 的深度，当 ε > 1/polylog(m) 时，工作量和深度都接近最优。对于 k-商品最小费用流问题，算法实现了 Ô(mk) 的工作量和 Ô(1) 的深度，深度不依赖于商品数量 k。
AI.conclusion: 本研究提出了首个在并行计算中实现近乎最优工作量和深度的 (1+ε)-近似多商品最小费用流算法，显著优于现有算法，并为相关领域的研究提供了新的技术贡献。
AI.translation:
我们提出了一种计算无向图上 (1+ε)-近似最小费用流的并行算法，其中边和顶点都分配有容量和成本。我们的算法实现了 Ô(m) 的工作量和 Ô(1) 的深度，当 ε > 1/polylog(m) 时，工作量和深度都接近最优，仅相差一个次多项式因子。
  此前，具有 Ô(m) 工作量的算法需要 Ω(m) 的深度，即使是仅具有边容量的最小费用流或仅具有顶点容量的最大流的特例。
  我们的结果推广了先前针对这些特例（包括最短路径 [Li, STOC'20] [Andoni, Stein, Zhong, STOC'20] [Rozhen, Haeupler, Marinsson, Grunau, Zuzic, STOC'23] 和仅具有边容量的最大流 [Agarwal, Khanna, Li, Patil, Wang, White, Zhong, SODA'24]）的近似最优并行 (1+ε) 近似算法。
  我们的关键技术贡献是首次构建了具有 (1+ε) 长度松弛、Ô(1) 拥塞松弛和 Ô(1) 步界限的长度受限流捷径。这为有影响力的 (Ô(1),ε)-hopsets 概念提供了严格的推广，并允许对拥塞进行额外的控制。
  先前存在的长度受限流捷径 [Haeupler, Hershkowitz, Li, Roeyskoe, Saranurak, STOC'24] 在长度松弛方面存在一个较大的常数，这会导致较大的近似因子。
  为了使我们的流算法能够在顶点容量下工作，我们还开发了一种近乎线性时间算法来计算长度受限顶点扩展分解。
  基于 Cohen 的路径计数流思想 [Cohen, SICOMP'95]，我们进一步将算法扩展到解决 (1+ε)-近似 k-商品最小费用流问题，具有近乎最优的 Ô(mk) 工作量和 Ô(1) 深度，并且不依赖于商品数量 k。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种创新的并行算法，用于解决具有顶点和边容量及成本的 (1+ε)-近似多商品最小费用流问题。该算法在 ε > 1/polylog(m) 时，实现了近乎最优的 Ô(m) 工作量和 Ô(1) 深度，显著优于现有算法。关键技术包括构建具有长度和拥塞松弛的长度受限流捷径，以及用于顶点容量的长度受限顶点扩展分解。算法进一步扩展到 k-商品问题，工作量为 Ô(mk)，深度仍为 Ô(1)。
AI.keywords: 并行算法,最小费用流,多商品流,近似算法,长度受限流捷径
AI.comments: 该研究在并行流算法领域取得了重要进展，特别是在同时优化工作量和深度方面。通过引入新的技术（如长度受限流捷径和顶点扩展分解），成功地将算法的适用范围和性能提升到了新的水平。算法的深度复杂度不依赖于商品数量 k 是一个显著的亮点。然而，对于 ε 较小的情况，算法的性能可能仍有提升空间。

title: Neural Reasoning for Robust Instance Retrieval in $\mathcal{SHOIQ}$
comments: Accepted as a full research paper at K-CAP 2025
summary:
Concept learning exploits background knowledge in the form of description
logic axioms to learn explainable classification models from knowledge bases.
Despite recent breakthroughs in neuro-symbolic concept learning, most
approaches still cannot be deployed on real-world knowledge bases. This is due
to their use of description logic reasoners, which are not robust against
inconsistencies nor erroneous data. We address this challenge by presenting a
novel neural reasoner dubbed EBR. Our reasoner relies on embeddings to
approximate the results of a symbolic reasoner. We show that EBR solely
requires retrieving instances for atomic concepts and existential restrictions
to retrieve or approximate the set of instances of any concept in the
description logic $\mathcal{SHOIQ}$. In our experiments, we compare EBR with
state-of-the-art reasoners. Our results suggest that EBR is robust against
missing and erroneous data in contrast to existing reasoners.
comment: Accepted as a full research paper at K-CAP 2025

title: Systematic Evaluation of Uncertainty Estimation Methods in Large Language Models
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) produce outputs with varying levels of
uncertainty, and, just as often, varying levels of correctness; making their
practical reliability far from guaranteed. To quantify this uncertainty, we
systematically evaluate four approaches for confidence estimation in LLM
outputs: VCE, MSP, Sample Consistency, and CoCoA (Vashurin et al., 2025). For
the evaluation of the approaches, we conduct experiments on four
question-answering tasks using a state-of-the-art open-source LLM. Our results
show that each uncertainty metric captures a different facet of model
confidence and that the hybrid CoCoA approach yields the best reliability
overall, improving both calibration and discrimination of correct answers. We
discuss the trade-offs of each method and provide recommendations for selecting
uncertainty measures in LLM applications.

AI.title_translation: 大型语言模型中不确定性估计方法的系统评估
AI.tldr: 该研究评估了四种用于量化大型语言模型（LLM）输出不确定性的方法（VCE、MSP、样本一致性和CoCoA），在四个问答任务上使用最先进的开源LLM进行实验。结果表明，每种不确定性度量都捕捉到模型置信度的不同方面，而混合方法CoCoA在整体可靠性方面表现最佳，同时提高了正确答案的校准和区分度。研究还讨论了各种方法的权衡，并为在LLM应用中选择不确定性度量提供了建议。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型（LLM）的输出存在不确定性和错误，其实际可靠性远未得到保证，因此需要量化这种不确定性。
AI.method: 系统评估了四种用于LLM输出置信度估计的方法：VCE、MSP、样本一致性和CoCoA。在四个问答任务上使用最先进的开源LLM进行了实验。
AI.result: 每种不确定性度量都捕捉到模型置信度的不同方面。混合方法CoCoA在整体可靠性方面表现最佳，同时提高了正确答案的校准和区分度。
AI.conclusion: 混合方法CoCoA在不确定性估计方面表现最佳，在LLM应用中提供了更好的可靠性。研究为选择不确定性度量提供了指导。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLM）的输出具有不同程度的不确定性，而且常常也具有不同程度的正确性；这使得它们的实际可靠性远未得到保证。为了量化这种不确定性，我们系统地评估了LLM输出中置信度估计的四种方法：VCE、MSP、样本一致性和CoCoA（Vashurin 等人，2025）。为了评估这些方法，我们在四个问答任务上使用最先进的开源LLM进行了实验。我们的结果表明，每种不确定性度量都捕捉到模型置信度的不同方面，而混合方法CoCoA在整体可靠性方面表现最佳，同时提高了正确答案的校准和区分度。我们讨论了每种方法的权衡，并为在LLM应用中选择不确定性度量提供了建议。
AI.summary: 本研究系统评估了四种用于量化大型语言模型（LLM）输出不确定性的方法（VCE、MSP、样本一致性和CoCoA）。通过在四个问答任务上使用最先进的开源LLM进行实验，研究发现混合方法CoCoA在提高校准和区分正确答案方面表现最佳，从而提供了整体上最可靠的度量。
AI.keywords: 不确定性估计, 大型语言模型, 置信度度量, CoCoA, 问答
AI.comments: 这项研究通过系统地评估不确定性估计方法，为提高大型语言模型的可靠性做出了重要贡献。混合方法CoCoA的优越性表明，结合多种度量方法可能比单一方法更能准确地捕捉模型的不确定性。然而，该研究仅限于四个问答任务和一种特定的LLM，未来的研究可以扩展到更多样化的任务和模型，以验证这些发现的普遍性。

title: FLORA: Unsupervised Knowledge Graph Alignment by Fuzzy Logic
summary:
Knowledge graph alignment is the task of matching equivalent entities (that
is, instances and classes) and relations across two knowledge graphs. Most
existing methods focus on pure entity-level alignment, computing the similarity
of entities in some embedding space. They lack interpretable reasoning and need
training data to work. In this paper, we propose FLORA, a simple yet effective
method that (1) is unsupervised, i.e., does not require training data, (2)
provides a holistic alignment for entities and relations iteratively, (3) is
based on fuzzy logic and thus delivers interpretable results, (4) provably
converges, (5) allows dangling entities, i.e., entities without a counterpart
in the other KG, and (6) achieves state-of-the-art results on major benchmarks.

title: Transferable Black-Box One-Shot Forging of Watermarks via Image Preference Models
summary:
Recent years have seen a surge in interest in digital content watermarking
techniques, driven by the proliferation of generative models and increased
legal pressure. With an ever-growing percentage of AI-generated content
available online, watermarking plays an increasingly important role in ensuring
content authenticity and attribution at scale. There have been many works
assessing the robustness of watermarking to removal attacks, yet, watermark
forging, the scenario when a watermark is stolen from genuine content and
applied to malicious content, remains underexplored. In this work, we
investigate watermark forging in the context of widely used post-hoc image
watermarking. Our contributions are as follows. First, we introduce a
preference model to assess whether an image is watermarked. The model is
trained using a ranking loss on purely procedurally generated images without
any need for real watermarks. Second, we demonstrate the model's capability to
remove and forge watermarks by optimizing the input image through
backpropagation. This technique requires only a single watermarked image and
works without knowledge of the watermarking model, making our attack much
simpler and more practical than attacks introduced in related work. Third, we
evaluate our proposed method on a variety of post-hoc image watermarking
models, demonstrating that our approach can effectively forge watermarks,
questioning the security of current watermarking approaches. Our code and
further resources are publicly available.

title: Structures generated in a multiagent system performing information fusion in peer-to-peer resource-constrained networks
summary:
There has recently been a major advance with respect to how information
fusion is performed. Information fusion has gone from being conceived as a
purely hierarchical procedure, as is the case of traditional military
applications, to now being regarded collaboratively, as holonic fusion, which
is better suited for civil applications and edge organizations. The above
paradigm shift is being boosted as information fusion gains ground in different
non-military areas, and human-computer and machine-machine communications,
where holarchies, which are more flexible structures than ordinary, static
hierarchies, become more widespread. This paper focuses on showing how holonic
structures tend to be generated when there are constraints on resources
(energy, available messages, time, etc.) for interactions based on a set of
fully intercommunicating elements (peers) whose components fuse information as
a means of optimizing the impact of vagueness and uncertainty present message
exchanges. Holon formation is studied generically based on a multiagent system
model, and an example of its possible operation is shown. Holonic structures
have a series of advantages, such as adaptability, to sudden changes in the
environment or its composition, are somewhat autonomous and are capable of
cooperating in order to achieve a common goal. This can be useful when the
shortage of resources prevents communications or when the system components
start to fail.

title: Conan: Progressive Learning to Reason Like a Detective over Multi-Scale Visual Evidence
summary:
Video reasoning, which requires multi-step deduction across frames, remains a
major challenge for multimodal large language models (MLLMs). While
reinforcement learning (RL)-based methods enhance reasoning capabilities, they
often rely on text-only chains that yield ungrounded or hallucinated
conclusions. Conversely, frame-retrieval approaches introduce visual grounding
but still struggle with inaccurate evidence localization. To address these
challenges, we present Conan, a framework for evidence-grounded multi-step
video reasoning. Conan identifies contextual and evidence frames, reasons over
cross-frame clues, and adaptively decides when to conclude or explore further.
To achieve this, we (1) construct Conan-91K, a large-scale dataset of
automatically generated reasoning traces that includes frame identification,
evidence reasoning, and action decision, and (2) design a multi-stage
progressive cold-start strategy combined with an
Identification-Reasoning-Action (AIR) RLVR training framework to jointly
enhance multi-step visual reasoning. Extensive experiments on six multi-step
reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that Conan surpasses the baseline
Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct by an average of over 10% in accuracy, achieving
state-of-the-art performance. Furthermore, Conan generalizes effectively to
long-video understanding tasks, validating its strong scalability and
robustness.

title: Robot Path and Trajectory Planning Considering a Spatially Fixed TCP
summary:
This paper presents a method for planning a trajectory in workspace
coordinates using a spatially fixed tool center point (TCP), while taking into
account the processing path on a part. This approach is beneficial if it is
easier to move the part rather than moving the tool. Whether a mathematical
description that defines the shape to be processed or single points from a
design program are used, the robot path is finally represented using B-splines.
The use of splines enables the path to be continuous with a desired degree,
which finally leads to a smooth robot trajectory. While calculating the robot
trajectory through prescribed orientation, additionally a given velocity at the
TCP has to be considered. The procedure was validated on a real system using an
industrial robot moving an arbitrary defined part.

title: Mask and You Shall Receive: Optimizing Masked Language Modeling For Pretraining BabyLMs
summary:
We describe our strategy for the 2025 edition of the BabyLM Challenge. Our
main contribution is that of an improved form of Masked Language Modeling
(MLM), which adapts the probabilities of the tokens masked according to the
model's ability to predict them. The results show a substantial increase in
performance on (Super)GLUE tasks over the standard MLM. We also incorporate
sub-token embeddings, finding that this increases the model's morphological
generalization capabilities. Our submission beats the baseline in the
strict-small track.

title: Bi-CoG: Bi-Consistency-Guided Self-Training for Vision-Language Models
summary:
Exploiting unlabeled data through semi-supervised learning (SSL) or
leveraging pre-trained models via fine-tuning are two prevailing paradigms for
addressing label-scarce scenarios. Recently, growing attention has been given
to combining fine-tuning of pre-trained vision-language models (VLMs) with SSL,
forming the emerging paradigm of semi-supervised fine-tuning. However, existing
methods often suffer from model bias and hyperparameter sensitivity, due to
reliance on prediction consistency or pre-defined confidence thresholds. To
address these limitations, we propose a simple yet effective plug-and-play
methodology named
$\underline{\textbf{Bi-Co}}$nsistency-$\underline{\textbf{G}}$uided
Self-Training (Bi-CoG), which assigns high-quality and low-bias pseudo-labels,
by simultaneously exploiting inter-model and intra-model consistency, along
with an error-aware dynamic pseudo-label assignment strategy. Both theoretical
analysis and extensive experiments over 14 datasets demonstrate the
effectiveness of Bi-CoG, which consistently and significantly improves the
performance of existing methods.

title: RECALL: REpresentation-aligned Catastrophic-forgetting ALLeviation via Hierarchical Model Merging
summary:
We unveil that internal representations in large language models (LLMs) serve
as reliable proxies of learned knowledge, and propose RECALL, a novel
representation-aware model merging framework for continual learning without
access to historical data. RECALL computes inter-model similarity from
layer-wise hidden representations over clustered typical samples, and performs
adaptive, hierarchical parameter fusion to align knowledge across models. This
design enables the preservation of domain-general features in shallow layers
while allowing task-specific adaptation in deeper layers. Unlike prior methods
that require task labels or incur performance trade-offs, RECALL achieves
seamless multi-domain integration and strong resistance to catastrophic
forgetting. Extensive experiments across five NLP tasks and multiple continual
learning scenarios show that RECALL outperforms baselines in both knowledge
retention and generalization, providing a scalable and data-free solution for
evolving LLMs.

title: Degradation-Aware Cooperative Multi-Modal GNSS-Denied Localization Leveraging LiDAR-Based Robot Detections
comments: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
summary:
Accurate long-term localization using onboard sensors is crucial for robots
operating in Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS)-denied environments.
While complementary sensors mitigate individual degradations, carrying all the
available sensor types on a single robot significantly increases the size,
weight, and power demands. Distributing sensors across multiple robots enhances
the deployability but introduces challenges in fusing asynchronous, multi-modal
data from independently moving platforms. We propose a novel adaptive
multi-modal multi-robot cooperative localization approach using a factor-graph
formulation to fuse asynchronous Visual-Inertial Odometry (VIO), LiDAR-Inertial
Odometry (LIO), and 3D inter-robot detections from distinct robots in a
loosely-coupled fashion. The approach adapts to changing conditions, leveraging
reliable data to assist robots affected by sensory degradations. A novel
interpolation-based factor enables fusion of the unsynchronized measurements.
LIO degradations are evaluated based on the approximate scan-matching Hessian.
A novel approach of weighting odometry data proportionally to the Wasserstein
distance between the consecutive VIO outputs is proposed. A theoretical
analysis is provided, investigating the cooperative localization problem under
various conditions, mainly in the presence of sensory degradations. The
proposed method has been extensively evaluated on real-world data gathered with
heterogeneous teams of an Unmanned Ground Vehicle (UGV) and Unmanned Aerial
Vehicles (UAVs), showing that the approach provides significant improvements in
localization accuracy in the presence of various sensory degradations.

title: Reliable and Reproducible Demographic Inference for Fairness in Face Analysis
summary:
Fairness evaluation in face analysis systems (FAS) typically depends on
automatic demographic attribute inference (DAI), which itself relies on
predefined demographic segmentation. However, the validity of fairness auditing
hinges on the reliability of the DAI process. We begin by providing a
theoretical motivation for this dependency, showing that improved DAI
reliability leads to less biased and lower-variance estimates of FAS fairness.
To address this, we propose a fully reproducible DAI pipeline that replaces
conventional end-to-end training with a modular transfer learning approach. Our
design integrates pretrained face recognition encoders with non-linear
classification heads. We audit this pipeline across three dimensions: accuracy,
fairness, and a newly introduced notion of robustness, defined via
intra-identity consistency. The proposed robustness metric is applicable to any
demographic segmentation scheme. We benchmark the pipeline on gender and
ethnicity inference across multiple datasets and training setups. Our results
show that the proposed method outperforms strong baselines, particularly on
ethnicity, which is the more challenging attribute. To promote transparency and
reproducibility, we will publicly release the training dataset metadata, full
codebase, pretrained models, and evaluation toolkit. This work contributes a
reliable foundation for demographic inference in fairness auditing.

title: Dual Control Reference Generation for Optimal Pick-and-Place Execution under Payload Uncertainty
summary:
This work addresses the problem of robot manipulation tasks under unknown
dynamics, such as pick-and-place tasks under payload uncertainty, where active
exploration and(/for) online parameter adaptation during task execution are
essential to enable accurate model-based control. The problem is framed as dual
control seeking a closed-loop optimal control problem that accounts for
parameter uncertainty. We simplify the dual control problem by pre-defining the
structure of the feedback policy to include an explicit adaptation mechanism.
Then we propose two methods for reference trajectory generation. The first
directly embeds parameter uncertainty in robust optimal control methods that
minimize the expected task cost. The second method considers minimizing the
so-called optimality loss, which measures the sensitivity of parameter-relevant
information with respect to task performance. We observe that both approaches
reason over the Fisher information as a natural side effect of their
formulations, simultaneously pursuing optimal task execution. We demonstrate
the effectiveness of our approaches for a pick-and-place manipulation task. We
show that designing the reference trajectories whilst taking into account the
control enables faster and more accurate task performance and system
identification while ensuring stable and efficient control.

title: Hurdle-IMDL: An Imbalanced Learning Framework for Infrared Rainfall Retrieval
summary:
Artificial intelligence has advanced quantitative remote sensing, yet its
effectiveness is constrained by imbalanced label distribution. This imbalance
leads conventionally trained models to favor common samples, which in turn
degrades retrieval performance for rare ones. Rainfall retrieval exemplifies
this issue, with performance particularly compromised for heavy rain. This
study proposes Hurdle-Inversion Model Debiasing Learning (IMDL) framework.
Following a divide-and-conquer strategy, imbalance in the rain distribution is
decomposed into two components: zero inflation, defined by the predominance of
non-rain samples; and long tail, defined by the disproportionate abundance of
light-rain samples relative to heavy-rain samples. A hurdle model is adopted to
handle the zero inflation, while IMDL is proposed to address the long tail by
transforming the learning object into an unbiased ideal inverse model.
Comprehensive evaluation via statistical metrics and case studies investigating
rainy weather in eastern China confirms Hurdle-IMDL's superiority over
conventional, cost-sensitive, generative, and multi-task learning methods. Its
key advancements include effective mitigation of systematic underestimation and
a marked improvement in the retrieval of heavy-to-extreme rain. IMDL offers a
generalizable approach for addressing imbalance in distributions of
environmental variables, enabling enhanced retrieval of rare yet high-impact
events.

title: Steering Evaluation-Aware Language Models To Act Like They Are Deployed
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) can sometimes detect when they are being
evaluated and adjust their behavior to appear more aligned, compromising the
reliability of safety evaluations. In this paper, we show that adding a
steering vector to an LLM's activations can suppress evaluation-awareness and
make the model act like it is deployed during evaluation. To study our steering
technique, we train an LLM to exhibit evaluation-aware behavior using a
two-step training process designed to mimic how this behavior could emerge
naturally. First, we perform continued pretraining on documents with factual
descriptions of the model (1) using Python type hints during evaluation but not
during deployment and (2) recognizing that the presence of a certain evaluation
cue always means that it is being tested. Then, we train the model with expert
iteration to use Python type hints in evaluation settings. The resulting model
is evaluation-aware: it writes type hints in evaluation contexts more than
deployment contexts. However, this gap can only be observed by removing the
evaluation cue. We find that activation steering can suppress evaluation
awareness and make the model act like it is deployed even when the cue is
present. Importantly, we constructed our steering vector using the original
model before our additional training. Our results suggest that AI evaluators
could improve the reliability of safety evaluations by steering models to act
like they are deployed.

title: Simultaneous Stiffness and Trajectory Optimization for Energy Minimization of Pick-and-Place Tasks of SEA-Actuated Parallel Kinematic Manipulators
summary:
A major field of industrial robot applications deals with repetitive tasks
that alternate between operating points. For these so-called pick-and-place
operations, parallel kinematic manipulators (PKM) are frequently employed.
These tasks tend to automatically run for a long period of time and therefore
minimizing energy consumption is always of interest. Recent research addresses
this topic by the use of elastic elements and particularly series elastic
actuators (SEA). This paper explores the possibilities of minimizing energy
consumption of SEA actuated PKM performing pick-and-place tasks. The basic idea
is to excite eigenmotions that result from the actuator springs and exploit
their oscillating characteristics. To this end, a prescribed cyclic
pick-and-place operation is analyzed and a dynamic model of SEA driven PKM is
derived. Subsequently, an energy minimizing optimal control problem is
formulated where operating trajectories as well as SEA stiffnesses are
optimized simultaneously. Here, optimizing the actuator stiffness does not
account for variable stiffness actuators. It serves as a tool for the design
and dimensioning process. The hypothesis on energy reduction is tested on two
(parallel) robot applications where redundant actuation is also addressed. The
results confirm the validity of this approach.

title: On the cybersecurity of LoRaWAN-based system: a Smart-Lighting case study
comments: 8 pages, 6 figures plus references, International Conference on IoT
summary:
Cyber-physical systems and the Internet of Things (IoT) are key technologies
in the Industry 4.0 vision. They incorporate sensors and actuators to interact
with the physical environment. However, when creating and interconnecting
components to form a heterogeneous smart systems architecture, these face
challenges in cybersecurity. This paper presents an experimental investigation
of architectural configurations for a LoRaWAN-based Smart-Lighting project,
aimed at verifying and improving the system's robustness against attacks. We
assess the system's robustness in a series of iterative experiments conducted
both in-vitro and on-site. The results show that most attacks on a LoRaWAN
network are unsuccessful, also highlighting unresolved issues with the
installed products. The most successful attacks are high-power jamming attacks
within a few meters of the target, which, in the case of gateways, can be
mitigated through gateway redundancy.

title: Accurate Performance Predictors for Edge Computing Applications
summary:
Accurate prediction of application performance is critical for enabling
effective scheduling and resource management in resource-constrained dynamic
edge environments. However, achieving predictable performance in such
environments remains challenging due to the co-location of multiple
applications and the node heterogeneity. To address this, we propose a
methodology that automatically builds and assesses various performance
predictors. This approach prioritizes both accuracy and inference time to
identify the most efficient model. Our predictors achieve up to 90% accuracy
while maintaining an inference time of less than 1% of the Round Trip Time.
These predictors are trained on the historical state of the most correlated
monitoring metrics to application performance and evaluated across multiple
servers in dynamic co-location scenarios. As usecase we consider electron
microscopy (EM) workflows, which have stringent real-time demands and diverse
resource requirements. Our findings emphasize the need for a systematic
methodology that selects server-specific predictors by jointly optimizing
accuracy and inference latency in dynamic co-location scenarios. Integrating
such predictors into edge environments can improve resource utilization and
result in predictable performance.

title: A Parameter-Linear Formulation of the Optimal Path Following Problem for Robotic Manipulator
summary:
In this paper the computational challenges of time-optimal path following are
addressed. The standard approach is to minimize the travel time, which
inevitably leads to singularities at zero path speed, when reformulating the
optimization problem in terms of a path parameter. Thus, smooth trajectory
generation while maintaining a low computational effort is quite challenging,
since the singularities have to be taken into account. To this end, a different
approach is presented in this paper. This approach is based on maximizing the
path speed along a prescribed path. Furthermore, the approach is capable of
planning smooth trajectories numerically efficient. Moreover, the discrete
reformulation of the underlying problem is linear in optimization variables.
