title: Panoptic-CUDAL: Rural Australia Point Cloud Dataset in Rainy Conditions
summary:
Existing autonomous driving datasets are predominantly oriented towards
well-structured urban settings and favourable weather conditions, leaving the
complexities of rural environments and adverse weather conditions largely
unaddressed. Although some datasets encompass variations in weather and
lighting, bad weather scenarios do not appear often. Rainfall can significantly
impair sensor functionality, introducing noise and reflections in LiDAR and
camera data and reducing the system's capabilities for reliable environmental
perception and safe navigation. This paper introduces the Panoptic-CUDAL
dataset, a novel dataset purpose-built for panoptic segmentation in rural areas
subject to rain. By recording high-resolution LiDAR, camera, and pose data,
Panoptic-CUDAL offers a diverse, information-rich dataset in a challenging
scenario. We present the analysis of the recorded data and provide baseline
results for panoptic, semantic segmentation, and 3D occupancy prediction
methods on LiDAR point clouds. The dataset can be found here:
https://robotics.sydney.edu.au/our-research/intelligent-transportation-systems,
https://vision.rwth-aachen.de/panoptic-cudal

title: Streaming Federated Learning with Markovian Data
summary:
Federated learning (FL) is now recognized as a key framework for
communication-efficient collaborative learning. Most theoretical and empirical
studies, however, rely on the assumption that clients have access to
pre-collected data sets, with limited investigation into scenarios where
clients continuously collect data. In many real-world applications,
particularly when data is generated by physical or biological processes, client
data streams are often modeled by non-stationary Markov processes. Unlike
standard i.i.d. sampling, the performance of FL with Markovian data streams
remains poorly understood due to the statistical dependencies between client
samples over time. In this paper, we investigate whether FL can still support
collaborative learning with Markovian data streams. Specifically, we analyze
the performance of Minibatch SGD, Local SGD, and a variant of Local SGD with
momentum. We answer affirmatively under standard assumptions and smooth
non-convex client objectives: the sample complexity is proportional to the
inverse of the number of clients with a communication complexity comparable to
the i.i.d. scenario. However, the sample complexity for Markovian data streams
remains higher than for i.i.d. sampling.

title: Reflex: Faster Secure Collaborative Analytics via Controlled Intermediate Result Size Disclosure
summary:
Secure Multi-Party Computation (MPC) enables collaborative analytics without
exposing private data. However, OLAP queries under MPC remain prohibitively
slow due to oblivious execution and padding of intermediate results with filler
tuples. We present Reflex, the first framework that enables configurable
trimming of intermediate results across different query operators -- joins,
selections, and aggregations -- within full query plans. At its core is the
Resizer operator, which can be inserted between any oblivious operators to
selectively remove filler tuples under MPC using user-defined probabilistic
strategies. To make privacy trade-offs interpretable, we introduce a new metric
that quantifies the number of observations an attacker would need to infer the
true intermediate result sizes. Reflex thus makes the performance-privacy space
of secure analytics navigable, allowing users to balance efficiency and
protection. Experiments show substantial runtime reductions while maintaining
quantifiable privacy guarantees.

title: Exploring the Energy Landscape of RBMs: Reciprocal Space Insights into Bosons, Hierarchical Learning and Symmetry Breaking
summary:
Deep generative models have become ubiquitous due to their ability to learn
and sample from complex distributions. Despite the proliferation of various
frameworks, the relationships among these models remain largely unexplored, a
gap that hinders the development of a unified theory of AI learning. We address
two central challenges: clarifying the connections between different deep
generative models and deepening our understanding of their learning mechanisms.
We focus on Restricted Boltzmann Machines (RBMs), known for their universal
approximation capabilities for discrete distributions. By introducing a
reciprocal space formulation, we reveal a connection between RBMs, diffusion
processes, and coupled Bosons. We show that at initialization, the RBM operates
at a saddle point, where the local curvature is determined by the singular
values, whose distribution follows the Marcenko-Pastur law and exhibits
rotational symmetry. During training, this rotational symmetry is broken due to
hierarchical learning, where different degrees of freedom progressively capture
features at multiple levels of abstraction. This leads to a symmetry breaking
in the energy landscape, reminiscent of Landau theory. This symmetry breaking
in the energy landscape is characterized by the singular values and the weight
matrix eigenvector matrix. We derive the corresponding free energy in a
mean-field approximation. We show that in the limit of infinite size RBM, the
reciprocal variables are Gaussian distributed. Our findings indicate that in
this regime, there will be some modes for which the diffusion process will not
converge to the Boltzmann distribution. To illustrate our results, we trained
replicas of RBMs with different hidden layer sizes using the MNIST dataset. Our
findings bridge the gap between disparate generative frameworks and also shed
light on the processes underpinning learning in generative models.

title: ControlFusion: A Controllable Image Fusion Framework with Language-Vision Degradation Prompts
comments:
Accepted to NeurIPS 2025. The code are available at
  https://github.com/Linfeng-Tang/ControlFusion
summary:
Current image fusion methods struggle to address the composite degradations
encountered in real-world imaging scenarios and lack the flexibility to
accommodate user-specific requirements. In response to these challenges, we
propose a controllable image fusion framework with language-vision prompts,
termed ControlFusion, which adaptively neutralizes composite degradations. On
the one hand, we develop a degraded imaging model that integrates physical
imaging mechanisms, including the Retinex theory and atmospheric scattering
principle, to simulate composite degradations, thereby providing potential for
addressing real-world complex degradations from the data level. On the other
hand, we devise a prompt-modulated restoration and fusion network that
dynamically enhances features with degradation prompts, enabling our method to
accommodate composite degradation of varying levels. Specifically, considering
individual variations in quality perception of users, we incorporate a text
encoder to embed user-specified degradation types and severity levels as
degradation prompts. We also design a spatial-frequency collaborative visual
adapter that autonomously perceives degradations in source images, thus
eliminating the complete dependence on user instructions. Extensive experiments
demonstrate that ControlFusion outperforms SOTA fusion methods in fusion
quality and degradation handling, particularly in countering real-world and
compound degradations with various levels. The source code is publicly
available at https://github.com/Linfeng-Tang/ControlFusion.

title: CTSketch: Compositional Tensor Sketching for Scalable Neurosymbolic Learning
summary:
Many computational tasks benefit from being formulated as the composition of
neural networks followed by a discrete symbolic program. The goal of
neurosymbolic learning is to train the neural networks using end-to-end
input-output labels of the composite. We introduce CTSketch, a novel, scalable
neurosymbolic learning algorithm. CTSketch uses two techniques to improve the
scalability of neurosymbolic inference: decompose the symbolic program into
sub-programs and summarize each sub-program with a sketched tensor. This
strategy allows us to approximate the output distribution of the program with
simple tensor operations over the input distributions and the sketches. We
provide theoretical insight into the maximum approximation error. Furthermore,
we evaluate CTSketch on benchmarks from the neurosymbolic learning literature,
including some designed for evaluating scalability. Our results show that
CTSketch pushes neurosymbolic learning to new scales that were previously
unattainable, with neural predictors obtaining high accuracy on tasks with one
thousand inputs, despite supervision only on the final output.

title: Token embeddings violate the manifold hypothesis
summary:
A full understanding of the behavior of a large language model (LLM) requires
our grasp of its input token space. If this space differs from our assumptions,
our comprehension of and conclusions about the LLM will likely be flawed. We
elucidate the structure of the token embeddings both empirically and
theoretically. We present a novel statistical test assuming that the
neighborhood around each token has a relatively flat and smooth structure as
the null hypothesis. Failing to reject the null is uninformative, but rejecting
it at a specific token $\psi$ implies an irregularity in the token subspace in
a $\psi$-neighborhood, $B(\psi)$. The structure assumed in the null is a
generalization of a manifold with boundary called a \emph{smooth fiber bundle}
(which can be split into two spatial regimes -- small and large radius), so we
denote our new hypothesis test as the ``fiber bundle hypothesis.'' By running
our test over several open-source LLMs, each with unique token embeddings, we
find that the null is frequently rejected, and so the evidence suggests that
the token subspace is not a fiber bundle and hence also not a manifold. As a
consequence of our findings, when an LLM is presented with two semantically
equivalent prompts, if one prompt contains a token implicated by our test, the
response to that prompt will likely exhibit less stability than the other.

title: Integrating Structural and Semantic Signals in Text-Attributed Graphs with BiGTex
summary:
Text-attributed graphs (TAGs) present unique challenges in representation
learning by requiring models to capture both the semantic richness of
node-associated texts and the structural dependencies of the graph. While graph
neural networks (GNNs) excel at modeling topological information, they lack the
capacity to process unstructured text. Conversely, large language models (LLMs)
are proficient in text understanding but are typically unaware of graph
structure. In this work, we propose BiGTex (Bidirectional Graph Text), a novel
architecture that tightly integrates GNNs and LLMs through stacked Graph-Text
Fusion Units. Each unit allows for mutual attention between textual and
structural representations, enabling information to flow in both directions,
text influencing structure and structure guiding textual interpretation. The
proposed architecture is trained using parameter-efficient fine-tuning (LoRA),
keeping the LLM frozen while adapting to task-specific signals. Extensive
experiments on five benchmark datasets demonstrate that BiGTex achieves
state-of-the-art performance in node classification and generalizes effectively
to link prediction. An ablation study further highlights the importance of soft
prompting and bi-directional attention in the model's success.

title: Sign-In to the Lottery: Reparameterizing Sparse Training From Scratch
summary:
The performance gap between training sparse neural networks from scratch
(PaI) and dense-to-sparse training presents a major roadblock for efficient
deep learning. According to the Lottery Ticket Hypothesis, PaI hinges on
finding a problem specific parameter initialization. As we show, to this end,
determining correct parameter signs is sufficient. Yet, they remain elusive to
PaI. To address this issue, we propose Sign-In, which employs a dynamic
reparameterization that provably induces sign flips. Such sign flips are
complementary to the ones that dense-to-sparse training can accomplish,
rendering Sign-In as an orthogonal method. While our experiments and theory
suggest performance improvements of PaI, they also carve out the main open
challenge to close the gap between PaI and dense-to-sparse training.

title: Does Reinforcement Learning Really Incentivize Reasoning Capacity in LLMs Beyond the Base Model?
summary:
Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has recently
demonstrated notable success in enhancing the reasoning performance of large
language models (LLMs), particularly on mathematics and programming tasks.
Similar to how traditional RL helps agents explore and learn new strategies,
RLVR is believed to enable LLMs to continuously self-improve, thus acquiring
novel reasoning abilities beyond those of the corresponding base models. In
this study we critically examine the current state of RLVR by systematically
probing the reasoning capability boundaries of RLVR-trained LLMs across various
model families, RL algorithms, and math, coding, and visual reasoning
benchmarks, using pass@k at large k values as the evaluation metric.
Surprisingly, we find that the current training setup does not elicit
fundamentally new reasoning patterns. While RLVR-trained models outperform
their base models at small k (e.g., k = 1), the base models achieve a higher
pass@k score when k is large. Coverage and perplexity analyses show that the
observed reasoning abilities originate from and are bounded by the base model.
Treating the base model as an upper bound, our quantitative analysis shows that
six popular RLVR algorithms perform similarly and remain far from optimal in
leveraging the potential of the base model. By contrast, we find that
distillation can introduce new reasoning patterns from the teacher and
genuinely expand the model's reasoning capabilities. Overall, our findings
suggest that current RLVR methods have not yet realized the potential of RL to
elicit truly novel reasoning abilities in LLMs. This highlights the need for
improved RL paradigms, such as continual scaling and multi-turn
agent-environment interaction, to unlock this potential.

title: Stop Summation: Min-Form Credit Assignment Is All Process Reward Model Needs for Reasoning
summary:
Process reward models (PRMs) have proven effective for test-time scaling of
Large Language Models (LLMs) on challenging reasoning tasks. However, reward
hacking issues with PRMs limit their successful application in reinforcement
fine-tuning. In this paper, we identify the main cause of PRM-induced reward
hacking: the canonical summation-form credit assignment in reinforcement
learning (RL), which defines the value as cumulative gamma-decayed future
rewards, easily induces LLMs to hack steps with high rewards. To address this,
we propose PURE: Process sUpervised Reinforcement lEarning. The key innovation
of PURE is a min-form credit assignment that formulates the value function as
the minimum of future rewards. This method significantly alleviates reward
hacking by limiting the value function range and distributing advantages more
reasonably. Through extensive experiments on 3 base models, we show that
PRM-based approaches enabling min-form credit assignment achieve comparable
reasoning performance to verifiable reward-based methods within only 30% steps.
In contrast, the canonical sum-form credit assignment collapses training even
at the beginning! Additionally, when we supplement PRM-based fine-tuning with
just 10% verifiable rewards, we further alleviate reward hacking and produce
the best fine-tuned model based on Qwen2.5-Math-7B in our experiments,
achieving 82.5% accuracy on AMC23 and 53.3% average accuracy across 5
benchmarks. Moreover, we summarize the observed reward hacking cases and
analyze the causes of training collapse. We release our code and model weights
at https://github.com/CJReinforce/PURE.

title: Adaptive PCA-Based Outlier Detection for Multi-Feature Time Series in Space Missions
summary:
Analyzing multi-featured time series data is critical for space missions
making efficient event detection, potentially onboard, essential for automatic
analysis. However, limited onboard computational resources and data downlink
constraints necessitate robust methods for identifying regions of interest in
real time. This work presents an adaptive outlier detection algorithm based on
the reconstruction error of Principal Component Analysis (PCA) for feature
reduction, designed explicitly for space mission applications. The algorithm
adapts dynamically to evolving data distributions by using Incremental PCA,
enabling deployment without a predefined model for all possible conditions. A
pre-scaling process normalizes each feature's magnitude while preserving
relative variance within feature types. We demonstrate the algorithm's
effectiveness in detecting space plasma events, such as distinct space
environments, dayside and nightside transients phenomena, and transition layers
through NASA's MMS mission observations. Additionally, we apply the method to
NASA's THEMIS data, successfully identifying a dayside transient using
onboard-available measurements.

title: FreeGraftor: Training-Free Cross-Image Feature Grafting for Subject-Driven Text-to-Image Generation
summary:
Subject-driven image generation aims to synthesize novel scenes that
faithfully preserve subject identity from reference images while adhering to
textual guidance. However, existing methods struggle with a critical trade-off
between fidelity and efficiency. Tuning-based approaches rely on time-consuming
and resource-intensive, subject-specific optimization, while zero-shot methods
often fail to maintain adequate subject consistency. In this work, we propose
FreeGraftor, a training-free framework that addresses these limitations through
cross-image feature grafting. Specifically, FreeGraftor leverages semantic
matching and position-constrained attention fusion to transfer visual details
from reference subjects to the generated images. Additionally, our framework
introduces a novel noise initialization strategy to preserve the geometry
priors of reference subjects, facilitating robust feature matching. Extensive
qualitative and quantitative experiments demonstrate that our method enables
precise subject identity transfer while maintaining text-aligned scene
synthesis. Without requiring model fine-tuning or additional training,
FreeGraftor significantly outperforms existing zero-shot and training-free
approaches in both subject fidelity and text alignment. Furthermore, our
framework can seamlessly extend to multi-subject generation, making it
practical for real-world deployment. Our code is available at
https://github.com/Nihukat/FreeGraftor.

title: Fast-Slow Thinking GRPO for Large Vision-Language Model Reasoning
summary:
When applying reinforcement learning--typically through GRPO--to large
vision-language model reasoning struggles to effectively scale reasoning length
or generates verbose outputs across all tasks with only marginal gains in
accuracy. To address this issue, we present FAST-GRPO, a variant of GRPO that
dynamically adapts reasoning depth based on question characteristics. Through
empirical analysis, we establish the feasibility of fast-slow thinking in LVLMs
by investigating how response length and data distribution affect performance.
Inspired by these observations, we introduce two complementary metrics to
estimate the difficulty of the questions, guiding the model to determine when
fast or slow thinking is more appropriate. Next, we incorporate adaptive
length-based rewards and difficulty-aware KL divergence into the GRPO
algorithm. Experiments across seven reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that FAST
achieves state-of-the-art accuracy with over 10\% relative improvement compared
to the base model, while reducing token usage by 32.7-67.3\% compared to
previous slow-thinking approaches, effectively balancing reasoning length and
accuracy.

title: Evolution of Cooperation in LLM-Agent Societies: A Preliminary Study Using Different Punishment Strategies
comments:
20 pages, 10 figures, Accepted for presentation as a full paper at
  the COINE 2025 workshop at AAMAS 2025
  (https://coin-workshop.github.io/coine-2025-detroit/accepted_for_presentation.html)
summary:
The evolution of cooperation has been extensively studied using abstract
mathematical models and simulations. Recent advances in Large Language Models
(LLMs) and the rise of LLM agents have demonstrated their ability to perform
social reasoning, thus providing an opportunity to test the emergence of norms
in more realistic agent-based simulations with human-like reasoning using
natural language. In this research, we investigate whether the cooperation
dynamics presented in Boyd and Richerson's model persist in a more realistic
simulation of the Diner's Dilemma using LLM agents compared to the abstract
mathematical nature in the work of Boyd and Richerson. Our findings indicate
that agents follow the strategies defined in the Boyd and Richerson model, and
explicit punishment mechanisms drive norm emergence, reinforcing cooperative
behaviour even when the agent strategy configuration varies. Our results
suggest that LLM-based Multi-Agent System simulations, in fact, can replicate
the evolution of cooperation predicted by the traditional mathematical models.
Moreover, our simulations extend beyond the mathematical models by integrating
natural language-driven reasoning and a pairwise imitation method for strategy
adoption, making them a more realistic testbed for cooperative behaviour in
MASs.

AI.title_translation: LLM智能体社会中合作的演化：一项使用不同惩罚策略的初步研究
AI.tldr: 本研究使用LLM智能体对“食客困境”进行了更真实的模拟，以检验Boyd和Richerson模型中合作的演化动态。结果表明，LLM智能体复现了传统模型的预测，并且明确的惩罚机制能够驱动规范的出现和合作行为的增强。
AI.motivation: 传统的合作演化研究依赖于抽象的数学模型。随着LLM智能体的兴起，它们提供了利用类人推理和自然语言进行更现实的智能体模拟的机会，以测试规范的出现。本文旨在研究Boyd和Richerson模型中的合作动态是否在更现实的LLM智能体“食客困境”模拟中持续存在。
AI.method: 使用基于LLM的多智能体系统（MAS）模拟，具体应用“食客困境”模型。该模拟集成了自然语言驱动的推理，并采用了一种用于策略采纳的成对模仿方法（pairwise imitation method）。研究中使用了不同的明确惩罚机制。
AI.result: 研究发现智能体遵循Boyd和Richerson模型中定义的策略。明确的惩罚机制驱动了规范的出现，即使在智能体策略配置变化的情况下，也能强化合作行为。LLM-based MAS模拟能够复制传统数学模型预测的合作演化。
AI.conclusion: LLM驱动的多智能体系统模拟可以成功复制并扩展传统数学模型对合作演化的预测。通过整合自然语言推理和成对模仿，这些模拟提供了一个更现实的合作行为测试平台。
AI.translation: 合作的演化已通过抽象的数学模型和模拟得到了广泛的研究。大型语言模型（LLMs）的最新进展和LLM智能体的兴起展示了它们执行社会推理的能力，从而提供了一个机会，可以使用自然语言在具有类人推理的更现实的基于智能体的模拟中测试规范的出现。在这项研究中，我们调查了与Boyd和Richerson的抽象数学工作相比，在使用LLM智能体进行的更现实的“食客困境”模拟中，Boyd和Richerson模型中提出的合作动态是否依然存在。我们的发现表明，智能体遵循Boyd和Richerson模型中定义的策略，并且明确的惩罚机制驱动了规范的出现，即使在智能体策略配置变化时也能强化合作行为。我们的结果表明，基于LLM的多智能体系统模拟实际上可以复制传统数学模型预测的合作演化。此外，我们的模拟通过整合自然语言驱动的推理和一种用于策略采纳的成对模仿方法，超越了数学模型，使其成为MAS中合作行为的更现实的测试平台。
AI.summary: 本研究利用LLM智能体的社会推理能力，在“食客困境”中建立了一个更现实的多智能体系统模拟，以检验Boyd和Richerson模型中合作演化的动态。研究发现，LLM智能体遵循传统模型策略，并且明确的惩罚机制是驱动规范出现和增强合作的关键因素。结果证实了LLM-based MAS模拟能够复制传统数学模型的预测，并通过引入自然语言推理和成对模仿，提供了一个更先进、更真实的合作行为研究环境。
AI.keywords: 合作演化, LLM智能体, 食客困境, 惩罚策略, 多智能体系统
AI.comments: 这篇初步研究的创新点在于将复杂的社会演化理论（如Boyd和Richerson模型）从抽象的数学领域迁移到了基于大型语言模型（LLM）的更具现实感的模拟环境中。通过利用LLM智能体固有的自然语言推理能力，该工作克服了传统MAS在模拟人类社会行为和规范演化时的局限性。其重要性在于验证了LLM智能体作为社会科学实验台的潜力，证明了这些高级智能体不仅能执行任务，还能在复杂的社会困境中复现和扩展经典的演化动态。研究结果强调了“明确惩罚机制”在LLM社会中驱动合作规范的关键作用，为未来设计更具鲁棒性和可控性的AI社会提供了基础。

title: Don't be lazy: CompleteP enables compute-efficient deep transformers
summary:
We study compute efficiency of LLM training when using different
parameterizations, i.e., rules for adjusting model and optimizer
hyperparameters (HPs) as model size changes. Some parameterizations fail to
transfer optimal base HPs (such as learning rate) across changes in model
depth, requiring practitioners to either re-tune these HPs as they scale up
(expensive), or accept sub-optimal training when re-tuning is prohibitive. Even
when they achieve HP transfer, we develop theory to show parameterizations may
still exist in the lazy learning regime where layers learn only features close
to their linearization, preventing effective use of depth and nonlinearity.
Finally, we identify and adopt the parameterization we call CompleteP that
achieves both depth-wise HP transfer and non-lazy learning in all layers.
CompleteP enables a wider range of model width/depth ratios to remain
compute-efficient, unlocking shapes better suited for different hardware
settings and operational contexts. Moreover, CompleteP enables 12-34% compute
efficiency improvements over the prior state-of-the-art. All experiments were
run on Cerebras CS-3 systems. A minimal implementation is available at
https://github.com/EleutherAI/nanoGPT-mup/tree/completep.

AI.title_translation: 不要偷懒：CompleteP 实现计算高效的深度 Transformer
AI.tldr: 我们引入了 CompleteP，这是一种新的 LLM 参数化方法，它解决了跨深度变化的超参数迁移问题并避免了“惰性学习”机制，从而比现有技术提高了 12-34% 的计算效率。
AI.motivation: 现有的参数化方法在模型深度变化时，难以迁移最优的基础超参数（如学习率），导致昂贵的重新调优或次优的训练。此外，即使实现了超参数迁移，这些方法仍可能处于“惰性学习”状态，无法有效利用深度和非线性。
AI.method: 识别并采用了一种称为 CompleteP 的参数化方法。该方法旨在同时实现深度超参数迁移和所有层中的非惰性学习。
AI.result: CompleteP 使得更广泛的模型宽度/深度比率保持计算高效，适用于不同的硬件和操作环境。它比先前的最先进技术提高了 12-34% 的计算效率。
AI.conclusion: CompleteP 是一种有效的参数化方案，它通过解决超参数迁移和避免惰性学习，显著提升了深度 Transformer 模型的计算效率。
AI.translation: 我们研究了在使用不同参数化（即，随着模型大小变化调整模型和优化器超参数（HPs）的规则）时，LLM 训练的计算效率。一些参数化方法未能跨模型深度变化迁移最优的基础超参数（例如学习率），这要求从业者在扩展时要么重新调整这些超参数（成本高昂），要么在禁止重新调整时接受次优训练。即使它们实现了超参数迁移，我们开发的理论表明，参数化方法仍可能存在于惰性学习机制中，其中层仅学习接近其线性化的特征，从而阻碍了深度的有效利用和非线性。最后，我们识别并采用了我们称之为 CompleteP 的参数化方法，该方法在所有层中实现了深度超参数迁移和非惰性学习。CompleteP 使得更广泛的模型宽度/深度比率保持计算高效，解锁了更适合不同硬件设置和操作环境的模型形状。此外，CompleteP 比先前的最先进技术提高了 12-34% 的计算效率。所有实验均在 Cerebras CS-3 系统上运行。可在 [GitHub 链接] 获取最小实现。
AI.summary: 本文研究了深度 Transformer 模型训练中的计算效率和参数化问题。现有方法在模型深度变化时难以保持超参数最优性，并可能陷入“惰性学习”机制。作者提出并采用了 CompleteP 参数化方法，该方法能同时实现跨深度超参数迁移和非惰性学习。实验证明，CompleteP 能够支持更灵活的模型结构，并在计算效率上比现有最佳方法提升 12% 至 34%。
AI.keywords: CompleteP, 参数化, 计算效率, 惰性学习, 深度 Transformer
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于识别并解决深度缩放中超参数迁移和“惰性学习”这两个关键挑战。通过引入 CompleteP 参数化，论文不仅提供了理论基础来解释为何某些参数化效率低下（即“惰性学习”机制），还提供了一个实用的解决方案来显著提高 LLM 训练的计算效率。12-34% 的性能提升是一个重要的实际贡献，特别是对于需要在大规模硬件上训练和部署深度模型的场景。

title: Towards Machine Learning-based Model Predictive Control for HVAC Control in Multi-Context Buildings at Scale via Ensemble Learning
summary:
The building thermodynamics model, which predicts real-time indoor
temperature changes under potential HVAC (Heating, Ventilation, and Air
Conditioning) control operations, is crucial for optimizing HVAC control in
buildings. While pioneering studies have attempted to develop such models for
various building environments, these models often require extensive data
collection periods and rely heavily on expert knowledge, making the modeling
process inefficient and limiting the reusability of the models. This paper
explores a model ensemble perspective that utilizes existing developed models
as base models to serve a target building environment, thereby providing
accurate predictions while reducing the associated efforts. Given that building
data streams are non-stationary and the number of base models may increase, we
propose a Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning (HRL) approach to dynamically
select and weight the base models. Our approach employs a two-tiered
decision-making process: the high-level focuses on model selection, while the
low-level determines the weights of the selected models. We thoroughly evaluate
the proposed approach through offline experiments and an on-site case study,
and the experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of our method.

AI.title_translation: 基于集成学习的面向多场景建筑规模化暖通空调控制的机器学习模型预测控制研究
AI.tldr: 针对传统建筑热力学模型构建效率低和可重用性差的问题，本文提出了一种基于分层强化学习（HRL）的动态集成学习方法，用于选择和加权现有模型，以实现大规模建筑中暖通空调（HVAC）控制的准确预测。
AI.motivation: 现有的建筑热力学模型需要大量的长时间数据收集并严重依赖专家知识，导致建模过程效率低下，且模型的重用性受到限制。
AI.method: 提出了一种模型集成视角，利用现有已开发的模型作为基模型服务于目标建筑环境。具体采用分层强化学习（HRL）方法来动态选择和加权基模型。该方法采用两层决策过程：高层负责模型选择，低层负责确定所选模型的权重。
AI.result: 通过离线实验和现场案例研究对所提出的方法进行了全面评估，实验结果证明了该集成学习方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的基于HRL的动态模型集成方法能够为目标建筑环境提供准确的预测，同时减少了建模所需的工作量，有效解决了现有模型的效率和重用性问题。
AI.translation: 预测实时室内温度变化以进行潜在暖通空调（HVAC）控制操作的建筑热力学模型，对于优化建筑中的HVAC控制至关重要。虽然开创性的研究已尝试为各种建筑环境开发此类模型，但这些模型通常需要大量的长时间数据收集，并且严重依赖专家知识，这使得建模过程效率低下并限制了模型的可重用性。本文探索了一种模型集成视角，利用现有已开发的模型作为基模型来服务于目标建筑环境，从而在提供准确预测的同时减少相关工作量。鉴于建筑数据流是非平稳的且基模型的数量可能会增加，我们提出了一种分层强化学习（HRL）方法来动态选择和加权基模型。我们的方法采用了两层决策过程：高层侧重于模型选择，而低层确定所选模型的权重。我们通过离线实验和现场案例研究对所提出的方法进行了全面评估，实验结果证明了我们方法的有效性。
AI.summary: 本文旨在解决现有建筑热力学模型在暖通空调控制优化中效率低下和重用性差的问题。研究人员提出了一种模型集成方法，利用分层强化学习（HRL）动态选择和加权现有的基模型。该HRL采用两层决策过程：高层进行模型选择，低层确定权重。通过离线和现场实验验证了该方法能有效提供准确预测并减少建模工作。
AI.keywords: 暖通空调控制, 模型预测控制, 集成学习, 分层强化学习, 建筑热力学
AI.comments: 创新点在于将集成学习和分层强化学习（HRL）应用于非平稳的建筑数据流，以解决现有基于物理或单一机器学习模型的建模效率和泛化性问题。通过动态集成现有模型，该方法显著提高了模型的重用性和适应性，这对于大规模、多场景建筑的实际部署至关重要。

title: Privacy Risks and Preservation Methods in Explainable Artificial Intelligence: A Scoping Review
comments: Accepted in Transactions on Machine Learning Research
summary:
Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) has emerged as a pillar of
Trustworthy AI and aims to bring transparency in complex models that are opaque
by nature. Despite the benefits of incorporating explanations in models, an
urgent need is found in addressing the privacy concerns of providing this
additional information to end users. In this article, we conduct a scoping
review of existing literature to elicit details on the conflict between privacy
and explainability. Using the standard methodology for scoping review, we
extracted 57 articles from 1,943 studies published from January 2019 to
December 2024. The review addresses 3 research questions to present readers
with more understanding of the topic: (1) what are the privacy risks of
releasing explanations in AI systems? (2) what current methods have researchers
employed to achieve privacy preservation in XAI systems? (3) what constitutes a
privacy preserving explanation? Based on the knowledge synthesized from the
selected studies, we categorize the privacy risks and preservation methods in
XAI and propose the characteristics of privacy preserving explanations to aid
researchers and practitioners in understanding the requirements of XAI that is
privacy compliant. Lastly, we identify the challenges in balancing privacy with
other system desiderata and provide recommendations for achieving privacy
preserving XAI. We expect that this review will shed light on the complex
relationship of privacy and explainability, both being the fundamental
principles of Trustworthy AI.
comment: Accepted in Transactions on Machine Learning Research

AI.title_translation: 可解释人工智能中的隐私风险与保护方法：一项范围综述
AI.tldr: 本文对可解释人工智能（XAI）中的隐私风险和保护方法进行了范围综述，旨在解决解释性信息与用户隐私之间的冲突，并提出了隐私保护解释的特征及实现XAI隐私保护的建议。
AI.motivation: 可解释人工智能（XAI）在提供模型透明度方面具有优势，但向终端用户提供额外解释信息时存在隐私担忧，因此迫切需要解决隐私与可解释性之间的冲突。
AI.method: 本文采用标准的范围综述方法，从2019年1月至2024年12月发表的1,943项研究中筛选出57篇文章，以回答关于AI系统中解释信息发布所带来的隐私风险、XAI系统中隐私保护的现有方法以及隐私保护解释的构成等3个研究问题。
AI.result: 基于所选研究的知识综合，本文对XAI中的隐私风险和保护方法进行了分类，并提出了隐私保护解释的特征，以帮助研究人员和实践者理解符合隐私要求的XAI所需条件。此外，还识别了平衡隐私与其他系统期望之间的挑战。
AI.conclusion: 本文识别了平衡隐私与其他系统期望之间的挑战，并为实现隐私保护的XAI提供了建议。期望本次综述能阐明隐私与可解释性之间复杂关系，两者都是可信赖AI的基本原则。
AI.translation: 可解释人工智能（XAI）已成为可信赖AI的支柱，旨在为本质上不透明的复杂模型带来透明度。尽管在模型中纳入解释具有诸多益处，但向终端用户提供这些额外信息所带来的隐私问题亟待解决。本文对现有文献进行了一项范围综述，以揭示隐私与可解释性之间冲突的细节。我们采用范围综述的标准方法，从2019年1月至2024年12月发表的1,943项研究中提取了57篇文章。本次综述旨在通过回答3个研究问题，让读者对该主题有更深入的理解：(1) 在AI系统中发布解释信息存在哪些隐私风险？(2) 研究人员目前采用了哪些方法在XAI系统中实现隐私保护？(3) 什么是隐私保护解释？基于从所选研究中综合得出的知识，我们对XAI中的隐私风险和保护方法进行了分类，并提出了隐私保护解释的特征，以帮助研究人员和实践者理解符合隐私要求的XAI所需条件。最后，我们识别了在平衡隐私与其他系统期望之间的挑战，并为实现隐私保护的XAI提供了建议。我们期望本次综述能阐明隐私与可解释性之间复杂关系，两者都是可信赖AI的基本原则。
AI.summary: 本文对可解释人工智能（XAI）中存在的隐私风险及其保护方法进行了全面的范围综述。研究通过分析57篇文献，旨在解决AI系统解释性与用户隐私之间的冲突。文章分类了XAI中的隐私风险和保护方法，并提出了隐私保护解释的特征，同时识别了在实现隐私保护XAI时面临的挑战，并提供了相关建议，以促进可信赖AI的发展。
AI.keywords: 可解释人工智能, 隐私风险, 隐私保护, 范围综述, 可信赖AI
AI.comments: 这项范围综述及时地关注了可解释人工智能（XAI）中一个日益重要的冲突点：解释性与隐私保护。其创新之处在于系统地梳理了现有文献，并提出了隐私风险分类、保护方法和隐私保护解释的特征。这对于理解XAI在实际部署中面临的挑战及其对可信赖AI原则的影响至关重要。该研究为研究人员和实践者提供了宝贵的指导，以开发出既透明又尊重用户隐私的AI系统，具有重要的理论和实践价值。

title: SetONet: A Set-Based Operator Network for Solving PDEs with Variable-Input Sampling
summary:
Neural operators, particularly the Deep Operator Network (DeepONet), have
shown promise in learning mappings between function spaces for solving
differential equations. However, standard DeepONet requires input functions to
be sampled at fixed locations, limiting its applicability when sensor
configurations vary or inputs exist on irregular grids. We introduce the Set
Operator Network (SetONet), which modifies DeepONet's branch network to process
input functions as unordered sets of location-value pairs. By incorporating
Deep Sets principles, SetONet ensures permutation invariance while maintaining
the same parameter count as the baseline. On classical operator-learning
benchmarks, SetONet achieves parity with DeepONet on fixed layouts while
sustaining accuracy under variable sensor configurations or sensor drop-off -
conditions for which standard DeepONet is not applicable. More significantly,
SetONet natively handles problems where inputs are naturally represented as
unstructured point clouds (such as point sources or density samples) rather
than values on fixed grids, a capability standard DeepONet lacks. On heat
conduction with point sources, advection-diffusion modeling chemical plumes,
and optimal transport between density samples, SetONet learns operators
end-to-end without rasterization or multi-stage pipelines. These problems
feature inputs that are naturally discrete point sets (point sources or density
samples) rather than functions on fixed grids. SetONet is a DeepONet-class
architecture that addresses such problems with a lightweight design,
significantly broadening the applicability of operator learning to problems
with variable, incomplete, or unstructured input data.

AI.title_translation: SetONet：一种基于集合的算子网络，用于解决具有可变输入采样的偏微分方程。
AI.tldr: 传统的DeepONet要求固定采样位置，限制了其在可变或非结构化输入数据上的应用。SetONet通过将输入处理为无序集合（基于Deep Sets原理），实现了排列不变性，并在保持参数量不变的情况下，成功解决了具有可变传感器配置、传感器缺失或非结构化点云输入的PDE问题，显著拓宽了算子学习的应用范围。
AI.motivation: 传统的深度算子网络（如DeepONet）要求输入函数在固定位置采样，这限制了其在传感器配置可变、输入存在于不规则网格上，或输入数据本质上是非结构化点云（如点源或密度样本）时的适用性。
AI.method: 引入Set Operator Network (SetONet)。它通过修改DeepONet的分支网络，利用Deep Sets原理，将输入函数处理为无序的位置-值对集合。这种设计确保了排列不变性，同时保持了与基线DeepONet相同的参数数量。
AI.result: 在经典算子学习基准测试中，SetONet在固定布局上与DeepONet性能相当。SetONet在可变传感器配置或传感器缺失的条件下仍能保持准确性（而标准DeepONet不适用）。更重要的是，SetONet可以本地处理以非结构化点云表示的输入问题（如点源、密度样本），无需光栅化或多阶段流程。
AI.conclusion: SetONet是一种轻量级的DeepONet类架构，它解决了输入数据可变、不完整或非结构化的问题，显著拓宽了算子学习的应用范围。
AI.translation: 神经算子，特别是深度算子网络（DeepONet），在学习用于解决微分方程的函数空间之间的映射方面显示出前景。然而，标准的DeepONet要求输入函数在固定位置采样，这限制了其在传感器配置变化或输入存在于不规则网格上的适用性。我们引入了集合算子网络（SetONet），它修改了DeepONet的分支网络，将输入函数处理为无序的位置-值对集合。通过结合Deep Sets原理，SetONet确保了排列不变性，同时保持了与基线相同的参数数量。在经典的算子学习基准测试中，SetONet在固定布局上与DeepONet达到了同等性能，同时在可变传感器配置或传感器缺失的条件下保持了准确性——这些条件是标准DeepONet不适用的。更重要的是，SetONet原生处理输入自然表示为非结构化点云（如点源或密度样本）而不是固定网格值的问题，这是标准DeepONet所缺乏的能力。在点源热传导、化学羽流的对流-扩散建模以及密度样本之间的最优传输等问题上，SetONet无需光栅化或多阶段流程，即可实现端到端算子学习。SetONet是一种DeepONet类架构，它以轻量级设计解决了这些问题，显著拓宽了算子学习在处理具有可变、不完整或非结构化输入数据的问题上的适用性。
AI.summary: SetONet是一种新型的算子网络，旨在解决传统DeepONet无法处理可变或非结构化输入数据的问题。通过采用Deep Sets原理，SetONet将输入函数视为无序的位置-值对集合，从而实现了排列不变性，并保持了与DeepONet相同的参数量。实验证明，SetONet在固定输入上性能与DeepONet相当，但在可变传感器配置、数据缺失或非结构化点云输入（如点源、密度样本）等场景下表现出显著优势，极大地扩展了算子学习的适用性。
AI.keywords: 算子网络, DeepONet, 集合理论, 排列不变性, 偏微分方程
AI.comments: SetONet的创新性在于将DeepONet的架构与Deep Sets的排列不变性特性相结合，解决了神经算子在实际应用中面临的关键限制——即对固定、规整采样的依赖。这种设计使其能够处理现实世界中常见的非结构化、稀疏或可变配置的数据，例如传感器网络或点云数据。通过保持与DeepONet相似的参数量，SetONet提供了一种轻量级且高效的解决方案，显著拓宽了算子学习在物理建模和微分方程求解中的应用范围，特别是在数据输入格式不固定的场景中具有重要价值。

title: PRUNE: A Patching Based Repair Framework for Certifiable Unlearning of Neural Networks
summary:
It is often desirable to remove (a.k.a. unlearn) a specific part of the
training data from a trained neural network model. A typical application
scenario is to protect the data holder's right to be forgotten, which has been
promoted by many recent regulation rules. Existing unlearning methods involve
training alternative models with remaining data, which may be costly and
challenging to verify from the data holder or a thirdparty auditor's
perspective. In this work, we provide a new angle and propose a novel
unlearning approach by imposing carefully crafted "patch" on the original
neural network to achieve targeted "forgetting" of the requested data to
delete. Specifically, inspired by the research line of neural network repair,
we propose to strategically seek a lightweight minimum "patch" for unlearning a
given data point with certifiable guarantee. Furthermore, to unlearn a
considerable amount of data points (or an entire class), we propose to
iteratively select a small subset of representative data points to unlearn,
which achieves the effect of unlearning the whole set. Extensive experiments on
multiple categorical datasets demonstrates our approach's effectiveness,
achieving measurable unlearning while preserving the model's performance and
being competitive in efficiency and memory consumption compared to various
baseline methods.

AI.title_translation: PRUNE：一种基于补丁的神经网络可认证遗忘修复框架
AI.tldr: PRUNE提出了一种新的神经网络数据遗忘方法，通过在原始网络上应用“补丁”来实现目标数据点的可认证遗忘，并在处理大量数据时采用迭代选择代表性子集的方法，实验证明其在有效性、性能保持、效率和内存方面均表现出色。
AI.motivation: 在训练好的神经网络模型中移除特定训练数据（即遗忘）是常见的需求，尤其是在保护数据持有者的“被遗忘权”方面，这受到许多近期法规的推动。现有的遗忘方法涉及使用剩余数据重新训练替代模型，但这种方法成本高昂且难以从数据持有者或第三方审计师的角度进行验证。
AI.method: 本研究提出了一种新颖的遗忘方法，通过在原始神经网络上施加精心设计的“补丁”，实现对请求删除数据的目标性“遗忘”。具体而言，受神经网络修复研究的启发，该方法旨在战略性地寻找一个轻量级的最小“补丁”，以实现给定数据点的可认证遗忘。此外，为了遗忘大量数据点（或整个类别），该方法建议迭代选择一小部分代表性数据点进行遗忘，从而达到遗忘整个数据集的效果。
AI.result: 在多个分类数据集上进行的广泛实验表明，该方法是有效的，实现了可测量的遗忘，同时保留了模型的性能，并且在效率和内存消耗方面与各种基线方法相比具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: PRUNE通过引入基于补丁的修复框架，为神经网络的可认证遗忘提供了一种有效、高效且可验证的新途径，成功解决了现有方法在成本和验证方面的挑战，并在保持模型性能的同时实现了精确的数据遗忘。
AI.translation: 从训练好的神经网络模型中移除（即遗忘）特定部分的训练数据通常是人们所希望的。一个典型的应用场景是保护数据持有者的被遗忘权，这已受到许多近期监管规则的推动。现有的遗忘方法涉及使用剩余数据训练替代模型，这可能成本高昂，并且从数据持有者或第三方审计师的角度来看难以验证。在这项工作中，我们提供了一个新视角，并提出了一种新颖的遗忘方法，通过在原始神经网络上施加精心设计的“补丁”，实现对请求删除数据的目标性“遗忘”。具体而言，受神经网络修复研究路线的启发，我们提出战略性地寻找一个轻量级的最小“补丁”，以实现给定数据点的可认证遗忘。此外，为了遗忘大量数据点（或整个类别），我们建议迭代选择一小部分代表性数据点进行遗忘，从而达到遗忘整个集合的效果。在多个分类数据集上进行的广泛实验表明，我们的方法是有效的，实现了可测量的遗忘，同时保留了模型的性能，并且在效率和内存消耗方面与各种基线方法相比具有竞争力。
AI.summary: 本论文提出了一种名为PRUNE的新型神经网络遗忘框架，旨在解决现有方法在成本和验证方面的不足。PRUNE的核心思想是借鉴神经网络修复技术，通过在原始模型上应用精心设计的“补丁”，实现对特定训练数据的目标性、可认证遗忘。对于需要遗忘大量数据的情况，PRUNE采用迭代选择代表性数据子集进行遗忘的策略。实验结果表明，该方法在多个分类数据集上表现出良好的有效性，能够在实现数据遗忘的同时，有效保持模型性能，并在效率和内存消耗方面优于现有基线方法。
AI.keywords: 神经网络遗忘, 可认证遗忘, 补丁修复, 数据隐私, 被遗忘权
AI.comments: PRUNE的创新点在于其采用了“补丁”而非重新训练的思路来实现神经网络的遗忘，这提供了一种更轻量级且具有可认证保证的解决方案。这种方法显著降低了遗忘的计算成本和验证难度，尤其是在面对“被遗忘权”等严格监管要求时具有重要意义。通过将神经网络修复技术引入数据遗忘领域，PRUNE为未来研究开辟了新的方向。

title: UMoE: Unifying Attention and FFN with Shared Experts
summary:
Sparse Mixture of Experts (MoE) architectures have emerged as a promising
approach for scaling Transformer models. While initial works primarily
incorporated MoE into feed-forward network (FFN) layers, recent studies have
explored extending the MoE paradigm to attention layers to enhance model
performance. However, existing attention-based MoE layers require specialized
implementations and demonstrate suboptimal performance compared to their
FFN-based counterparts. In this paper, we aim to unify MoE designs in attention
and FFN layers by introducing a novel reformulation of the attention mechanism,
that reveals an underlying FFN-like structure within attention modules. Our
proposed architecture, UMoE, achieves superior performance through
attention-based MoE layers while enabling efficient parameter sharing between
FFN and attention components.

AI.title_translation: UMoE：用共享专家统一注意力机制和前馈网络
AI.tldr: UMoE是一种新的Transformer架构，通过重新设计注意力机制以暴露类FFN结构，从而统一了注意力层和FFN层中的MoE实现，实现了卓越的性能和高效的参数共享。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于注意力的稀疏专家混合（MoE）层与基于前馈网络（FFN）的对应层相比，性能不佳且需要专门的实现。本文旨在统一注意力层和FFN层中的MoE设计。
AI.method: 引入了一种新的注意力机制重构方法，该方法揭示了注意力模块中潜在的类FFN结构。这使得MoE的设计能够在注意力层和FFN层中得到统一，并实现高效的参数共享。
AI.result: 所提出的架构UMoE通过基于注意力的MoE层实现了卓越的性能，并能够在FFN和注意力组件之间实现高效的参数共享。
AI.conclusion: 摘要中未提及
AI.translation: 稀疏专家混合（MoE）架构已成为扩展Transformer模型的一种有前景的方法。虽然最初的工作主要将MoE纳入前馈网络（FFN）层，但最近的研究探索了将MoE范式扩展到注意力层以增强模型性能。然而，现有的基于注意力的MoE层需要专门的实现，并且与基于FFN的对应层相比，性能表现不佳。在本文中，我们旨在通过引入一种新颖的注意力机制重构方法来统一注意力层和FFN层中的MoE设计，该方法揭示了注意力模块中潜在的类FFN结构。我们提出的架构UMoE通过基于注意力的MoE层实现了卓越的性能，同时实现了FFN和注意力组件之间的高效参数共享。
AI.summary: UMoE提出了一种新的Transformer架构，旨在解决现有基于注意力的MoE层性能不佳和实现复杂的问题。通过对注意力机制进行新颖的重构，揭示其潜在的类FFN结构，UMoE成功地统一了注意力层和FFN层中的MoE设计。该架构通过基于注意力的MoE层实现了卓越的性能，并促进了FFN和注意力组件之间高效的参数共享。
AI.keywords: 稀疏专家混合, Transformer, 统一注意力机制和FFN, 参数共享, UMoE
AI.comments: 本文解决了扩展MoE模型的关键挑战：与应用于FFN层相比，将MoE应用于注意力层时，实现不一致且性能不佳。其创新之处在于对注意力机制进行了概念上的重新构建，以揭示类FFN结构，从而实现统一和专家共享，这有望带来性能提升和实现效率（参数共享）。

title: S-DAT: A Multilingual, GenAI-Driven Framework for Automated Divergent Thinking Assessment
summary:
This paper introduces S-DAT (Synthetic-Divergent Association Task), a
scalable, multilingual framework for automated assessment of divergent thinking
(DT) -a core component of human creativity. Traditional creativity assessments
are often labor-intensive, language-specific, and reliant on subjective human
ratings, limiting their scalability and cross-cultural applicability. In
contrast, S-DAT leverages large language models and advanced multilingual
embeddings to compute semantic distance -- a language-agnostic proxy for DT. We
evaluate S-DAT across eleven diverse languages, including English, Spanish,
German, Russian, Hindi, and Japanese (Kanji, Hiragana, Katakana), demonstrating
robust and consistent scoring across linguistic contexts. Unlike prior DAT
approaches, the S-DAT shows convergent validity with other DT measures and
correct discriminant validity with convergent thinking. This cross-linguistic
flexibility allows for more inclusive, global-scale creativity research,
addressing key limitations of earlier approaches. S-DAT provides a powerful
tool for fairer, more comprehensive evaluation of cognitive flexibility in
diverse populations and can be freely assessed online:
https://sdat.iol.zib.de/.

AI.title_translation: S-DAT：一个多语言、GenAI驱动的自动化发散性思维评估框架
AI.tldr: S-DAT是一个利用大型语言模型和多语言嵌入来自动化评估发散性思维的框架，它支持多种语言，并解决了传统评估的局限性。
AI.motivation: 传统的创造力评估通常劳动密集、语言特定且依赖主观人工评分，限制了其可扩展性和跨文化适用性。
AI.method: S-DAT利用大型语言模型和先进的多语言嵌入来计算语义距离，将其作为发散性思维的语言无关代理。
AI.result: S-DAT在包括英语、西班牙语、德语、俄语、印地语和日语（汉字、平假名、片假名）在内的十一种不同语言中表现出稳健且一致的评分。与之前的DAT方法不同，S-DAT显示出与其他发散性思维测量方法的收敛效度以及与收敛性思维的正确判别效度。
AI.conclusion: S-DAT为在不同人群中更公平、更全面地评估认知灵活性提供了一个强大的工具，并促进了更具包容性、全球范围的创造力研究。
AI.translation: 本文介绍了S-DAT（合成发散联想任务），一个可扩展、多语言的自动化发散性思维（DT）评估框架——发散性思维是人类创造力的核心组成部分。传统的创造力评估通常劳动密集、语言特定且依赖主观人工评分，限制了其可扩展性和跨文化适用性。相比之下，S-DAT利用大型语言模型和先进的多语言嵌入来计算语义距离——这是一种与语言无关的发散性思维代理。我们在包括英语、西班牙语、德语、俄语、印地语和日语（汉字、平假名、片假名）在内的十一种不同语言中评估了S-DAT，展示了在不同语言环境中稳健且一致的评分。与之前的DAT方法不同，S-DAT显示出与其他DT测量方法的收敛效度以及与收敛性思维的正确判别效度。这种跨语言的灵活性使得更具包容性、全球范围的创造力研究成为可能，解决了早期方法的主要局限性。S-DAT为在不同人群中更公平、更全面地评估认知灵活性提供了一个强大的工具，并且可以在线免费访问：https://sdat.iol.zib.de/。
AI.summary: S-DAT是一个可扩展、多语言的自动化发散性思维评估框架，旨在解决传统评估方法的局限性。它利用大型语言模型和多语言嵌入计算语义距离，作为发散性思维的语言无关代理。该框架已在十一种不同语言中进行了评估，并展示了稳健一致的评分以及良好的收敛和判别效度。S-DAT的出现使得更具包容性和全球规模的创造力研究成为可能。
AI.keywords: 发散性思维, 创造力评估, 大型语言模型, 多语言, 语义距离
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于利用生成式AI和多语言嵌入来实现自动化、语言无关的发散性思维评估，克服了传统方法在可扩展性和跨文化适用性方面的局限性。其在多种语言环境下的验证是一大亮点，有望推动全球范围内更公平、更全面的创造力研究。

title: Fair Clustering via Alignment
summary:
Algorithmic fairness in clustering aims to balance the proportions of
instances assigned to each cluster with respect to a given sensitive attribute.
While recently developed fair clustering algorithms optimize clustering
objectives under specific fairness constraints, their inherent complexity or
approximation often results in suboptimal clustering utility or numerical
instability in practice. To resolve these limitations, we propose a new fair
clustering algorithm based on a novel decomposition of the fair $K$-means
clustering objective function. The proposed algorithm, called Fair Clustering
via Alignment (FCA), operates by alternately (i) finding a joint probability
distribution to align the data from different protected groups, and (ii)
optimizing cluster centers in the aligned space. A key advantage of FCA is that
it theoretically guarantees approximately optimal clustering utility for any
given fairness level without complex constraints, thereby enabling high-utility
fair clustering in practice. Experiments show that FCA outperforms existing
methods by (i) attaining a superior trade-off between fairness level and
clustering utility, and (ii) achieving near-perfect fairness without numerical
instability.

AI.title_translation: 通过对齐实现的公平聚类
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为FCA的新公平聚类算法，通过分解目标函数并交替对齐数据和优化中心，解决了现有方法的复杂性和次优性问题，实现了高实用性且具有良好公平性-效用权衡的聚类。
AI.motivation: 最近开发的公平聚类算法在优化聚类目标时受限于特定的公平约束，但其固有的复杂性或近似性通常导致聚类效用不理想或在实践中出现数值不稳定。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于公平K-均值聚类目标函数新分解的算法，称为通过对齐的公平聚类（FCA）。该算法通过交替执行两个步骤操作：（i）寻找一个联合概率分布来对齐来自不同保护组的数据；（ii）在对齐的空间中优化聚类中心。
AI.result: 实验表明，FCA通过（i）在公平水平和聚类效用之间实现了更优的权衡，以及（ii）在没有数值不稳定的情况下实现了近乎完美的公平性，从而优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: FCA算法在理论上保证了给定任何公平水平下的近似最优聚类效用，从而在实践中实现了高实用性的公平聚类。实验证明，FCA在公平水平与聚类效用之间取得了优于现有方法的权衡，并实现了接近完美的公平性而没有数值不稳定性。
AI.translation: 算法公平性在聚类中旨在平衡相对于给定敏感属性分配给每个簇的实例比例。虽然最近开发的公平聚类算法在特定公平约束下优化聚类目标，但它们固有的复杂性或近似性通常导致在实践中聚类效用不理想或数值不稳定。为解决这些局限性，我们提出了一种基于公平K-均值聚类目标函数新颖分解的新型公平聚类算法。该算法，称为通过对齐的公平聚类（FCA），通过交替执行（i）寻找一个联合概率分布来对齐来自不同保护组的数据，和（ii）在对齐空间中优化聚类中心来操作。FCA的一个关键优势在于，它理论上保证了对于任何给定的公平水平都能实现近似最优的聚类效用，从而在实践中实现了高实用性的公平聚类。实验表明，FCA通过（i）在公平水平和聚类效用之间实现了更优的权衡，以及（ii）在没有数值不稳定的情况下实现了近乎完美的公平性，从而优于现有方法。
AI.summary: 本文针对现有公平聚类算法的复杂性和次优性问题，提出了一种名为FCA的新算法。FCA通过对公平K-均值目标函数进行新颖的分解，交替执行数据对齐和聚类中心优化。该方法理论上保证了在任何公平水平下都能实现近似最优的聚类效用，并在实验中证明了其在公平性与效用之间的权衡优于现有方法。
AI.keywords: 公平聚类, K-均值, 目标函数分解, 概率分布对齐, 聚类效用
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种名为FCA的新算法，通过解耦公平K-均值目标函数来解决现有公平聚类算法的复杂性和次优性问题。其创新点在于通过对齐不同保护组数据来保证近似最优的聚类效用，并在实验中展示了优越的公平性-效用权衡。

title: Selfish, Local and Online Scheduling via Vector Fitting
summary:
We provide a dual fitting technique on a semidefinite program yielding simple
proofs of tight bounds for the robust price of anarchy of several congestion
and scheduling games under the sum of weighted completion times objective. The
same approach also allows to bound the approximation ratio of local search
algorithms and the competitive ratio of online algorithms for the scheduling
problem $R || \sum w_j C_j$. All of our results are obtained through a simple
unified dual fitting argument on the same semidefinite programming relaxation,
which can essentially be obtained through the first round of the Lasserre/Sum
of Squares hierarchy.
  As our main application, we show that the known coordination ratio bounds of
respectively $4, (3 + \sqrt{5})/2 \approx 2.618,$ and $32/15 \approx 2.133$ for
the scheduling game $R || \sum w_j C_j$ under the coordination mechanisms
Smith's Rule, Proportional Sharing and Rand (STOC 2011) can be extended to
congestion games and obtained through this approach. For the natural
restriction where the weight of each player is proportional to its processing
time on every resource, we show that the last bound can be improved from 2.133
to 2. This improvement can also be made for general instances when considering
the price of anarchy of the game, rather than the coordination ratio. As a
further application of this technique, we show that it recovers the tight bound
of $(3 + \sqrt{5})/2$ for the price of anarchy of weighted affine congestion
games and the Kawaguchi-Kyan bound of $(1+ \sqrt{2})/2$ for the pure price of
anarchy of $P || \sum w_j C_j$. Moreover, this approach can analyze a simple
local search algorithm for $R || \sum w_j C_j$, the best currently known
combinatorial approximation algorithm for this problem achieving an
approximation ratio of $(5 + \sqrt{5})/4 + \varepsilon$ and an online greedy
algorithm which is $4$-competitive.

AI.title_translation: 自私、局部和在线调度通过向量拟合
AI.tldr: 一种基于半定规划松弛的统一对偶拟合方法，为各种调度和拥塞博弈（$R || \sum w_j C_j$）的“无政府代价”提供了简单的证明和紧密界限，并分析了相关局部和在线算法的近似/竞争比率。
AI.motivation: 寻找简单且统一的方法，为在加权完成时间总和目标下的调度和拥塞博弈的鲁棒无政府代价（robust price of anarchy）提供紧密界限，并分析相关局部搜索和在线算法的性能和竞争比率。
AI.method: 采用基于半定规划（SDP）松弛的统一对偶拟合技术（dual fitting technique）。该SDP松弛可以从Lasserre/平方和（Sum of Squares）层级的首轮获得。
AI.result: 1) 证明了调度博弈 $R || \sum w_j C_j$ 的已知协调比率界限（4, $\approx 2.618$, $\approx 2.133$）可以扩展到拥塞博弈。2) 在权重与处理时间成比例的限制下，将最后一个界限从2.133改进到2；该改进对于一般实例的无政府代价也成立。3) 恢复了加权仿射拥塞博弈的紧密界限 $(3 + \sqrt{5})/2$ 和 $P || \sum w_j C_j$ 的Kawaguchi-Kyan界限 $(1+ \sqrt{2})/2$。4) 分析了 $R || \sum w_j C_j$ 的局部搜索算法（近似比为 $(5 + \sqrt{5})/4 + \varepsilon$）和在线贪婪算法（4-竞争比）。
AI.conclusion: 提出的统一对偶拟合方法是分析自私、局部和在线调度与拥塞博弈的有力工具，它能通过单一的半定规划松弛提供紧密界限，并统一和改进多种已知结果。
AI.translation: 我们提供了一种对偶拟合技术，应用于一个半定规划（SDP）松弛，为在加权完成时间总和目标下的几种拥塞和调度博弈的鲁棒无政府代价（robust price of anarchy）提供了简单且紧密的界限证明。同样的方法也允许我们约束调度问题 $R || \sum w_j C_j$ 的局部搜索算法的近似比和在线算法的竞争比。我们所有的结果都是通过对同一半定规划松弛（该松弛基本上可以通过Lasserre/平方和层级的首轮获得）进行简单的统一对偶拟合论证而获得的。作为我们的主要应用，我们表明，对于协调机制Smith's Rule、Proportional Sharing和Rand（STOC 2011）下的调度博弈 $R || \sum w_j C_j$，已知的协调比率界限分别为 $4, (3 + \sqrt{5})/2 \approx 2.618,$ 和 $32/15 \approx 2.133$，这些界限可以通过这种方法扩展到拥塞博弈并获得。对于一种自然的限制，即每个参与者的权重与其在每个资源上的处理时间成比例，我们证明最后一个界限可以从2.133提高到2。当考虑博弈的无政府代价而非协调比率时，这种改进也可以推广到一般实例。作为该技术的进一步应用，我们证明它可以恢复加权仿射拥塞博弈的无政府代价的紧密界限 $(3 + \sqrt{5})/2$，以及 $P || \sum w_j C_j$ 的纯无政府代价的Kawaguchi-Kyan界限 $(1+ \sqrt{2})/2$。此外，该方法可以分析 $R || \sum w_j C_j$ 的一个简单局部搜索算法（目前已知该问题的最佳组合近似算法，近似比为 $(5 + \sqrt{5})/4 + \varepsilon$）和一个4-竞争的在线贪婪算法。
AI.summary: 一种应用于半定规划（SDP）松弛的统一对偶拟合方法，为拥塞和调度博弈（$R || \sum w_j C_j$）中的鲁棒无政府代价提供了简单且紧密的界限。该技术将已知的协调比率界限扩展到拥塞博弈，并在特定条件下将界限从2.133改进到2。此外，该方法还成功分析了 $R || \sum w_j C_j$ 问题的最佳已知组合局部搜索算法的近似比以及在线贪婪算法的竞争比，并恢复了其他相关博弈的紧密界限。
AI.keywords: 对偶拟合, 半定规划, 无政府代价, 调度博弈, 在线算法
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于证明技术的“统一性”和“简洁性”。通过将对偶拟合技术应用于单一的半定规划（SDP）松弛（源自Lasserre层级结构的第一轮），作者为一系列相关的调度和拥塞博弈（包括自私、局部和在线设置）提供了紧密的鲁棒无政府代价（PoA）界限和近似比率。这种方法不仅统一了许多先前分散的结果，还为分析组合优化博弈中的均衡和近似算法性能提供了一个强大且通用的框架。

title: Superposition Yields Robust Neural Scaling
summary:
The success of today's large language models (LLMs) depends on the
observation that larger models perform better. However, the origin of this
neural scaling law, that loss decreases as a power law with model size, remains
unclear. We propose that representation superposition, meaning that LLMs
represent more features than they have dimensions, can be a key contributor to
loss and cause neural scaling. Based on Anthropic's toy model, we use weight
decay to control the degree of superposition, allowing us to systematically
study how loss scales with model size. When superposition is weak, the loss
follows a power law only if data feature frequencies are power-law distributed.
In contrast, under strong superposition, the loss generically scales inversely
with model dimension across a broad class of frequency distributions, due to
geometric overlaps between representation vectors. We confirmed that
open-sourced LLMs operate in the strong superposition regime and have loss
scaling like one over the model dimension, and that the Chinchilla scaling laws
are also consistent with this behavior. Our results identify representation
superposition as a central driver of neural scaling laws, providing insights
into questions like when neural scaling laws can be improved and when they will
break down.

AI.title_translation: 叠加产生稳健的神经缩放
AI.tldr: 研究表明，大型语言模型中“表示叠加”现象是导致其性能随模型尺寸增大而提升（即神经网络缩放定律）的主要原因，强叠加使得损失与模型维度成反比关系，这与现有LLMs的性能趋势一致。
AI.motivation: 当今大型语言模型（LLMs）的成功依赖于模型越大性能越好的观察，但损失随模型尺寸呈幂律下降的神经网络缩放定律的起源仍然不清楚。
AI.method: 基于Anthropic的玩具模型，使用权重衰减来控制表示叠加的程度，从而系统地研究损失如何随模型尺寸缩放。研究还通过分析开源LLMs来确认其实际工作状态。
AI.result: 当叠加较弱时，只有当数据特征频率呈幂律分布时，损失才遵循幂律。在强叠加下，由于表示向量之间的几何重叠，损失在广泛的频率分布下普遍与模型维度成反比缩放。研究证实开源LLMs处于强叠加状态，且损失按模型维度的倒数缩放，Chinchilla缩放定律也与此行为一致。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果表明，表示叠加是神经网络缩放定律的一个核心驱动因素，为理解何时可以改进以及何时会失效等问题提供了见解。
AI.translation: 当今大型语言模型（LLMs）的成功依赖于模型越大性能越好的观察。然而，损失随模型尺寸呈幂律下降的这种神经网络缩放定律的起源仍然不清楚。我们提出，表示叠加，意味着LLMs表示的特征多于其维度，可以成为损失和导致神经缩放的关键贡献因素。基于Anthropic的玩具模型，我们使用权重衰减来控制叠加的程度，从而系统地研究损失如何随模型尺寸缩放。当叠加较弱时，只有当数据特征频率呈幂律分布时，损失才遵循幂律。相反，在强叠加下，由于表示向量之间的几何重叠，损失在广泛的频率分布下普遍与模型维度成反比缩放。我们证实开源LLMs工作在强叠加状态，且损失按模型维度倒数缩放，Chinchilla缩放定律也与此行为一致。我们的结果将表示叠加确定为神经网络缩放定律的一个核心驱动力，为“何时可以改进神经网络缩放定律”以及“何时它们会失效”等问题提供了见解。
AI.summary: 本文提出表示叠加（LLMs表示的特征多于其维度）是导致神经网络缩放定律（损失随模型尺寸呈幂律下降）的关键因素。通过在玩具模型中控制叠加程度，研究发现强叠加使得损失普遍与模型维度成反比缩放，与开源LLMs的实际观测结果和Chinchilla缩放定律一致，从而将表示叠加确立为神经网络缩放的核心驱动力。
AI.keywords: 表示叠加, 神经网络缩放, 大型语言模型, 损失函数, 模型尺寸
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一个关于神经网络缩放定律起源的新颖解释，即表示叠加。它通过控制叠加程度来系统地研究损失与模型大小的关系，并确认了现有大型语言模型处于强叠加状态，这为理解和改进缩放定律提供了理论基础。然而，该研究主要基于玩具模型进行推导，其实际应用的普适性仍需进一步验证。

title: Learning Dense Hand Contact Estimation from Imbalanced Data
comments: Accepted at NeurIPS 2025. Project page: http://haco-release.github.io
summary:
Hands are essential to human interaction, and exploring contact between hands
and the world can promote comprehensive understanding of their function.
Recently, there have been growing number of hand interaction datasets that
cover interaction with object, other hand, scene, and body. Despite the
significance of the task and increasing high-quality data, how to effectively
learn dense hand contact estimation remains largely underexplored. There are
two major challenges for learning dense hand contact estimation. First, there
exists class imbalance issue from hand contact datasets where majority of
regions are not in contact. Second, hand contact datasets contain spatial
imbalance issue with most of hand contact exhibited in finger tips, resulting
in challenges for generalization towards contacts in other hand regions. To
tackle these issues, we present a framework that learns dense HAnd COntact
estimation (HACO) from imbalanced data. To resolve the class imbalance issue,
we introduce balanced contact sampling, which builds and samples from multiple
sampling groups that fairly represent diverse contact statistics for both
contact and non-contact vertices. Moreover, to address the spatial imbalance
issue, we propose vertex-level class-balanced (VCB) loss, which incorporates
spatially varying contact distribution by separately reweighting loss
contribution of each vertex based on its contact frequency across dataset. As a
result, we effectively learn to predict dense hand contact estimation with
large-scale hand contact data without suffering from class and spatial
imbalance issue. The codes are available at
https://github.com/dqj5182/HACO_RELEASE.
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2025. Project page: http://haco-release.github.io

AI.title_translation: 从不平衡数据中学习密集手部接触估计
AI.tldr: 手部接触估计很难，因为数据不平衡（很多地方没接触，接触点都在指尖）。作者提出了 HACO 框架，用“平衡采样”解决类别不平衡，用“VCB 损失”解决空间不平衡，最终实现了更好的密集接触估计。
AI.motivation: 尽管手部接触估计任务重要且高质量数据不断增加，但有效学习密集手部接触估计仍然是一个未被充分探索的领域。主要挑战在于手部接触数据集中存在的类别不平衡（大部分区域不接触）和空间不平衡（大部分接触集中在指尖）。
AI.method: 该框架（HACO）通过两种主要方法解决不平衡问题：1. 类别不平衡问题通过“平衡接触采样”解决，该方法构建并从多个采样组中采样，以公平地代表接触和非接触顶点的多样化接触统计数据。2. 空间不平衡问题通过“顶点级类别平衡（VCB）损失”解决，该损失根据数据集中每个顶点的接触频率，单独重新加权其损失贡献，从而结合了空间变化的接触分布。
AI.result: 他们有效地学习了预测密集手部接触估计，而没有受到类别不平衡和空间不平衡问题的困扰，可以在大规模手部接触数据上实现。
AI.conclusion: 他们成功地提出了一个名为 HACO 的框架，该框架通过平衡接触采样和顶点级类别平衡损失，有效地解决了大规模手部接触数据中存在的类别不平衡和空间不平衡问题，从而实现了密集手部接触估计的学习。
AI.translation: 手是人类互动的基础，探索手与世界之间的接触可以促进对它们功能的全面理解。最近，涵盖与物体、另一只手、场景和身体互动的“手部交互数据集”的数量不断增加。尽管这项任务很重要，高质量数据也越来越多，但如何有效地学习密集手部接触估计仍然在很大程度上未被充分探索。学习密集手部接触估计存在两个主要挑战。首先，手部接触数据集中存在类别不平衡问题，其中大多数区域没有接触。其次，手部接触数据集存在空间不平衡问题，大多数手部接触集中在指尖，这对泛化到手部其他区域的接触带来了挑战。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一个从不平衡数据中学习密集手部接触估计（HACO）的框架。为解决类别不平衡问题，我们引入了平衡接触采样，该采样方法构建并从多个采样组中进行采样，这些采样组公平地代表了接触和非接触顶点的多样化接触统计数据。此外，为解决空间不平衡问题，我们提出了顶点级类别平衡（VCB）损失，它通过根据数据集中每个顶点的接触频率单独重新加权其损失贡献，结合了空间变化的接触分布。因此，我们有效地学习了利用大规模手部接触数据进行密集手部接触估计的预测，而不会受到类别和空间不平衡问题的困扰。代码可在 https://github.com/dqj5182/HACO_RELEASE 获取。
AI.summary: 本文针对手部接触估计任务中存在的数据类别不平衡和空间不平衡两大挑战，提出了 HACO 框架。为解决类别不平衡，引入了平衡接触采样；为解决空间不平衡，设计了顶点级类别平衡（VCB）损失。这些方法使模型能够从大规模数据中学习，成功实现密集的、不受不平衡问题影响的手部接触估计。
AI.keywords: 手部接触估计, 类别不平衡, 空间不平衡, 平衡接触采样, 顶点级类别平衡损失
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了两种专门针对手部接触估计中存在的类别不平衡和空间不平衡问题的解决方案：平衡接触采样和顶点级类别平衡损失。这些方法使得模型能够更有效地从大规模数据中学习，克服了现有数据集的固有缺陷。方法的有效性是其重要性所在。局限性在于，摘要中并未提及模型在特定复杂场景或不同手部模型上的泛化能力评估。

title: Prot2Text-V2: Protein Function Prediction with Multimodal Contrastive Alignment
summary:
Predicting protein function from sequence is a central challenge in
computational biology. While existing methods rely heavily on structured
ontologies or similarity-based techniques, they often lack the flexibility to
express structure-free functional descriptions and novel biological functions.
In this work, we introduce Prot2Text-V2, a novel multimodal sequence-to-text
model that generates free-form natural language descriptions of protein
function directly from amino acid sequences. Our method combines a protein
language model as a sequence encoder (ESM-3B) and a decoder-only language model
(LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct) through a lightweight nonlinear modality projector. A
key innovation is our Hybrid Sequence-level Contrastive Alignment Learning
(H-SCALE), which improves cross-modal learning by matching mean- and std-pooled
protein embeddings with text representations via contrastive loss. After the
alignment phase, we apply instruction-based fine-tuning using LoRA on the
decoder to teach the model how to generate accurate protein function
descriptions conditioned on the protein sequence. We train Prot2Text-V2 on
about 250K curated entries from SwissProt and evaluate it under low-homology
conditions, where test sequences have low similarity with training samples.
Prot2Text-V2 consistently outperforms traditional and LLM-based baselines
across various metrics.

AI.title_translation: Prot2Text-V2：基于多模态对比对齐的蛋白质功能预测
AI.tldr: 提出Prot2Text-V2，一个使用ESM-3B和LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct构建的多模态序列到文本模型。它利用混合序列级对比对齐学习（H-SCALE）来生成自由形式的蛋白质功能自然语言描述，并在低同源性条件下优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有的蛋白质功能预测方法严重依赖结构化本体或基于相似性的技术，缺乏表达无结构功能描述和新颖生物学功能的灵活性。
AI.method: 引入Prot2Text-V2，一个多模态序列到文本模型。它结合了蛋白质语言模型（ESM-3B）作为编码器和仅解码器语言模型（LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct），通过一个轻量级非线性模态投影仪连接。关键创新是混合序列级对比对齐学习（H-SCALE），它通过对比损失将均值池化和标准差池化的蛋白质嵌入与文本表示进行匹配，以改进跨模态学习。之后，使用LoRA进行基于指令的微调以生成功能描述。模型在约25万个SwissProt条目上训练，并在低同源性条件下评估。
AI.result: Prot2Text-V2在各种指标上持续优于传统和基于LLM的基线方法，特别是在测试序列与训练样本相似度较低的低同源性条件下表现出色。
AI.conclusion: Prot2Text-V2成功解决了现有方法在表达无结构和新颖功能描述方面的局限性，通过多模态对比对齐和指令微调，在低同源性条件下实现了超越传统和基于LLM基线的卓越性能。
AI.translation: 从序列预测蛋白质功能是计算生物学中的核心挑战。虽然现有方法严重依赖结构化本体或基于相似性的技术，但它们往往缺乏表达无结构功能描述和新颖生物学功能的灵活性。在这项工作中，我们引入了Prot2Text-V2，这是一种新颖的多模态序列到文本模型，它直接从氨基酸序列生成蛋白质功能的自由形式自然语言描述。我们的方法结合了蛋白质语言模型（ESM-3B）作为序列编码器和一个仅解码器语言模型（LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct），通过一个轻量级的非线性模态投影仪连接。一个关键创新是我们的混合序列级对比对齐学习（H-SCALE），它通过对比损失将均值池化和标准差池化的蛋白质嵌入与文本表示进行匹配，从而改进跨模态学习。在对齐阶段之后，我们使用LoRA对解码器进行基于指令的微调，以教会模型如何根据蛋白质序列生成准确的蛋白质功能描述。我们在大约25万个来自SwissProt的精选条目上训练Prot2Text-V2，并在低同源性条件下进行评估，即测试序列与训练样本相似度较低。Prot2Text-V2在各种指标上持续优于传统和基于LLM的基线。
AI.summary: Prot2Text-V2是一种新型多模态序列到文本模型，旨在通过直接生成自由形式的自然语言描述来解决传统蛋白质功能预测方法缺乏灵活性的问题。该模型结合了ESM-3B编码器和LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct解码器，并引入了混合序列级对比对齐学习（H-SCALE）来优化跨模态特征匹配。通过在低同源性数据集上的严格评估，Prot2Text-V2的表现优于传统和基于大型语言模型的基线方法。
AI.keywords: 蛋白质功能预测, 多模态对比对齐, 序列到文本, Prot2Text-V2, H-SCALE
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于将蛋白质功能预测从传统的本体分类或相似性方法，提升到生成自由形式的自然语言描述，极大地提高了表达新颖和复杂生物学功能的能力。通过结合先进的蛋白质PLM（ESM-3B）和LLM（LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct），并引入混合序列级对比对齐学习（H-SCALE）机制，有效地解决了跨模态学习的挑战。特别是在低同源性条件下的评估，强调了模型在泛化和处理新颖序列方面的鲁棒性。这种序列到文本的范式是计算生物学领域的一个重要进展。

title: XtraGPT: Context-Aware and Controllable Academic Paper Revision
comments:
Preprint. The model report is available at
  https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.11336v1
summary:
Despite the growing adoption of large language models (LLMs) in academic
workflows, their capabilities remain limited to support high-quality scientific
writing. Most existing systems are designed for general-purpose scientific text
generation and fail to meet the sophisticated demands of research communication
beyond surface-level polishing, such as conceptual coherence across sections.
Furthermore, academic writing is inherently iterative and revision-driven, a
process not well supported by direct prompting-based paradigms. To address
these scenarios, we propose a human-AI collaboration framework for academic
paper revision centered on criteria-guided intent alignment and context-aware
modeling. To validate the framework, we curate a dataset of 7,000 research
papers from top-tier venues annotated with 140,000 instruction-response pairs
that reflect realistic, section-level scientific revisions. We instantiate the
framework in XtraGPT, the first suite of open-source LLMs (1.5B to 14B
parameters) for context-aware, instruction-guided writing assistance. Extensive
experiments validate that XtraGPT significantly outperforms same-scale
baselines and approaches the quality of proprietary systems. Both automated
preference assessments and human evaluations confirm the effectiveness of
XtraGPT in improving scientific drafts.
comment:
Preprint. The model report is available at
  https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.11336v1

AI.title_translation: XtraGPT：上下文感知和可控的学术论文修订
AI.tldr: 提出XtraGPT，这是一个基于人类-AI协作框架和上下文感知建模的开源LLM套件（1.5B至14B），用于指导学术论文修订。它通过一个包含14万指令-响应对的大型数据集进行训练，在实验中显著优于基线模型，并被人类评估证实能有效改进科学草稿。
AI.motivation: 现有的LLMs主要用于通用科学文本生成，难以满足高质量科学写作的复杂需求（如跨章节的概念一致性），且对学术写作中固有的迭代和修订驱动过程支持不足。
AI.method: 提出一个以标准指导的意图对齐和上下文感知建模为核心的人类-AI协作框架。通过整理一个包含7,000篇论文和140,000个反映现实、章节级科学修订的指令-响应对的数据集来验证该框架。将该框架实例化为XtraGPT，这是一个开源LLM套件（1.5B到14B参数）。
AI.result: XtraGPT显著优于同等规模的基线模型，并接近专有系统的质量。自动偏好评估和人工评估均证实了XtraGPT在改进科学草稿方面的有效性。
AI.conclusion: XtraGPT是一个有效的、上下文感知的、指令引导的写作辅助工具，能够显著改进科学草稿，解决了现有通用LLMs在复杂学术修订中的局限性。
AI.translation: 尽管大型语言模型（LLMs）在学术工作流程中的应用日益广泛，但其支持高质量科学写作的能力仍然有限。大多数现有系统是为通用科学文本生成而设计的，未能满足超出表面润色的研究交流的复杂需求，例如跨章节的概念连贯性。此外，学术写作本质上是迭代和修订驱动的，而直接基于提示的范式对此过程支持不佳。为解决这些问题，我们提出了一个以标准指导的意图对齐和上下文感知建模为核心的学术论文修订的人类-AI协作框架。为了验证该框架，我们整理了一个来自顶级会议的7,000篇研究论文数据集，并用140,000个反映现实、章节级科学修订的指令-响应对进行了标注。我们将该框架实例化为XtraGPT，这是第一个用于上下文感知、指令引导写作辅助的开源LLM套件（1.5B至14B参数）。广泛的实验验证了XtraGPT显著优于同等规模的基线模型，并接近专有系统的质量。自动偏好评估和人工评估均证实了XtraGPT在改进科学草稿方面的有效性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了XtraGPT，一个用于上下文感知和可控学术论文修订的开源LLM套件。针对现有LLMs在处理复杂、迭代的学术写作需求（如跨章节连贯性）时的不足，研究者设计了一个基于标准指导的意图对齐和上下文感知建模的人类-AI协作框架。该框架通过一个包含14万条章节级修订指令-响应对的大型数据集进行训练。实验结果表明，XtraGPT显著优于同规模基线模型，并获得了接近专有系统的性能，其有效性得到了人工评估的证实。
AI.keywords: 学术论文修订, 上下文感知, 大型语言模型 (LLMs), 人类-AI协作, 开源
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于提出了一个专门针对学术论文“修订”过程的框架，而不是仅仅关注“生成”。通过引入“上下文感知建模”和“标准指导的意图对齐”，XtraGPT解决了现有通用LLMs在处理跨章节概念连贯性和迭代修订中的关键局限性。此外，发布了一个大规模的、章节级修订数据集（14万对），以及一系列开源模型（1.5B至14B），这对于推动该领域的研究和实际应用具有重要价值。

title: Reinforcing Multi-Turn Reasoning in LLM Agents via Turn-Level Reward Design
summary:
This paper investigates Reinforcement Learning (RL) approaches to enhance the
reasoning capabilities of Large Language Model (LLM) agents in long-horizon,
multi-turn scenarios. Although RL algorithms such as Group Relative Policy
Optimization (GRPO) and Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) have been widely
applied to train multi-turn LLM agents, they typically rely only on sparse
outcome rewards and lack dense intermediate signals across multiple decision
steps, limiting their performance on complex reasoning tasks. To bridge this
gap, we present the first systematic study of \textit{turn-level reward design}
for multi-turn RL algorithms and agent applications. By integrating turn-level
rewards, we extend GRPO and PPO to their respective multi-turn variants,
enabling fine-grained credit assignment. We conduct case studies on multi-turn
reasoning-augmented search agents, where we carefully design two types of
turn-level rewards: verifiable and LLM-as-judge. Our experiments on multi-turn
search tasks demonstrate that incorporating well-designed turn-level rewards
enables RL algorithms to significantly outperform baseline methods with
trajectory-level rewards. Both training and validation reward curves illustrate
that our method achieves \textit{greater stability}, \textit{faster
convergence}, and \textit{higher accuracy}. Numerical results across diverse
question-answering datasets further show that our approach consistently
delivers highest answer correctness and 100\% format correctness.

AI.title_translation: 通过回合级奖励设计强化LLM智能体中的多轮推理
AI.tldr: 针对多轮推理任务中LLM智能体所面临的稀疏奖励问题，本文提出了回合级奖励设计，并将其应用于GRPO和PPO，实现了更稳定、收敛更快、准确率更高的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 现有的强化学习算法（如GRPO和PPO）在训练多轮LLM智能体时，通常仅依赖稀疏的最终结果奖励，缺乏跨多个决策步骤的密集中间信号，限制了它们在复杂推理任务中的表现。
AI.method: 首次系统性地研究了“回合级奖励设计”用于多轮强化学习算法。通过集成回合级奖励，将GRPO和PPO扩展到其多轮变体，以实现细粒度的信用分配。设计了两种回合级奖励：可验证的（verifiable）和以LLM作为评判者（LLM-as-judge），并将其应用于多轮推理增强型搜索智能体。
AI.result: 纳入回合级奖励的RL算法显著优于仅使用轨迹级奖励的基线方法。训练和验证奖励曲线显示出更高的稳定性、更快的收敛速度和更高的准确性。在不同的问答数据集上，该方法始终提供最高的答案正确性和100%的格式正确性。
AI.conclusion: 设计良好的回合级奖励对于增强多轮强化学习算法和提升LLM智能体在复杂、长周期推理任务中的性能至关重要。
AI.translation: 本文研究了强化学习（RL）方法，以增强大型语言模型（LLM）智能体在长周期、多轮场景中的推理能力。尽管诸如群组相对策略优化（GRPO）和近端策略优化（PPO）等RL算法已被广泛应用于训练多轮LLM智能体，但它们通常仅依赖稀疏的结果奖励，缺乏跨多个决策步骤的密集中间信号，限制了它们在复杂推理任务中的性能。为了弥补这一差距，我们首次系统性地研究了用于多轮RL算法和智能体应用的“回合级奖励设计”。通过整合回合级奖励，我们将GRPO和PPO扩展到各自的多轮变体，从而实现了细粒度的信用分配。我们在多轮推理增强型搜索智能体上进行了案例研究，并精心设计了两种类型的回合级奖励：可验证的（verifiable）和以LLM作为评判者（LLM-as-judge）。我们在多轮搜索任务上的实验证明，结合精心设计的回合级奖励，使RL算法能够显著优于使用轨迹级奖励的基线方法。训练和验证奖励曲线均表明，我们的方法实现了更高的稳定性、更快的收敛速度和更高的准确性。跨不同问答数据集的数值结果进一步显示，我们的方法始终提供最高的答案正确性和100%的格式正确性。
AI.summary: 本文旨在通过强化学习增强LLM智能体在多轮推理任务中的表现。针对现有方法仅依赖稀疏结果奖励的局限性，作者首次提出了系统性的“回合级奖励设计”。通过将回合级奖励集成到GRPO和PPO中，实现了细粒度的信用分配。实验证明，这种设计（包括可验证和LLM-as-judge两种类型）显著提高了RL算法的性能，带来了更高的稳定性、更快的收敛速度、更高的答案正确性，并在多轮搜索和问答任务中实现了100%的格式正确性。
AI.keywords: 回合级奖励设计, 多轮推理, LLM智能体, 强化学习, 信用分配
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于将强化学习中的奖励设计从传统的稀疏、轨迹级奖励，系统性地提升到了密集的、回合级奖励，以解决LLM智能体在复杂多轮推理中的信用分配难题。这种方法论上的转变对于提升长周期决策链中的RL性能具有重要意义，尤其是在需要中间反馈的复杂推理任务中。设计两种奖励类型（可验证和LLM-as-judge）体现了对不同反馈机制的探索，其中后者代表了利用LLM自身能力进行自我评估的趋势。

title: Improving Energy Natural Gradient Descent through Woodbury, Momentum, and Randomization
summary:
Natural gradient methods significantly accelerate the training of
Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs), but are often prohibitively costly.
We introduce a suite of techniques to improve the accuracy and efficiency of
energy natural gradient descent (ENGD) for PINNs. First, we leverage the
Woodbury formula to dramatically reduce the computational complexity of ENGD.
Second, we adapt the Subsampled Projected-Increment Natural Gradient Descent
algorithm from the variational Monte Carlo literature to accelerate the
convergence. Third, we explore the use of randomized algorithms to further
reduce the computational cost in the case of large batch sizes. We find that
randomization accelerates progress in the early stages of training for
low-dimensional problems, and we identify key barriers to attaining
acceleration in other scenarios. Our numerical experiments demonstrate that our
methods outperform previous approaches, achieving the same $L^2$ error as the
original ENGD up to $75\times$ faster.

AI.title_translation: 通过Woodbury、动量和随机化改进能量自然梯度下降
AI.tldr: 为解决PINN训练中昂贵的能量自然梯度下降（ENGD）问题，本文结合使用Woodbury公式降本、动量加速、以及随机化探索，最终实现了高达75倍的训练速度提升，同时保持了相同的精度。
AI.motivation: 自然梯度方法能显著加速物理信息神经网络（PINNs）的训练，但其成本通常高得令人望而却步。
AI.method: 引入Woodbury公式以降低计算复杂度；借鉴变分蒙特卡洛文献中的子采样投影增量自然梯度下降算法以加速收敛；探索使用随机化算法以进一步降低大批量计算成本。
AI.result: 随机化算法在低维问题的早期训练阶段加速了进展，并且论文确定了在其他情况下实现加速的关键障碍。数值实验验证了所提方法在效率上的显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 数值实验表明，所提出的方法优于先前的方法，在达到与原始ENGD相同的$L^2$误差时，速度可提高75倍。
AI.translation: 自然梯度方法显著加速了物理信息神经网络（PINNs）的训练，但通常成本高得令人望而却步。我们引入了一套技术来提高能量自然梯度下降（ENGD）在PINNs中的准确性和效率。首先，我们利用Woodbury公式，显著降低了ENGD的计算复杂度。其次，我们从变分蒙特卡洛文献中借鉴了子采样投影增量自然梯度下降（Subsampled Projected-Increment Natural Gradient Descent）算法，以加速收敛。第三，我们探索使用随机化算法来进一步降低大批量情况下的计算成本。我们发现随机化加速了低维问题的早期训练进展，并确定了在其他情况下实现加速的关键障碍。我们的数值实验表明，我们的方法优于先前的方法，在达到与原始ENGD相同的$L^2$误差时，速度可提高75倍。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一套改进能量自然梯度下降（ENGD）用于物理信息神经网络（PINNs）的准确性和效率的技术。主要方法包括利用Woodbury公式降低计算复杂度、采用动量算法加速收敛，以及探索随机化以减少大批量计算成本。实验结果显示，新方法在达到相同精度的情况下，速度可比原始ENGD快75倍。
AI.keywords: 能量自然梯度下降, 物理信息神经网络, Woodbury公式, 动量, 随机化
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于将Woodbury公式、动量技术和随机化算法引入到能量自然梯度下降（ENGD）中，以解决其计算成本高昂的问题。其重要性在于显著提升了PINNs训练的效率和准确性。限制方面，论文指出随机化在某些场景下加速存在关键障碍。

title: Embedding principle of homogeneous neural network for classification problem
summary:
In this paper, we study the Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) points of the associated
maximum-margin problem in homogeneous neural networks, including
fully-connected and convolutional neural networks. In particular, We
investigates the relationship between such KKT points across networks of
different widths generated. We introduce and formalize the \textbf{KKT point
embedding principle}, establishing that KKT points of a homogeneous network's
max-margin problem ($P_{\Phi}$) can be embedded into the KKT points of a larger
network's problem ($P_{\tilde{\Phi}}$) via specific linear isometric
transformations. We rigorously prove this principle holds for neuron splitting
in fully-connected networks and channel splitting in convolutional neural
networks. Furthermore, we connect this static embedding to the dynamics of
gradient flow training with smooth losses. We demonstrate that trajectories
initiated from appropriately mapped points remain mapped throughout training
and that the resulting $\omega$-limit sets of directions are correspondingly
mapped, thereby preserving the alignment with KKT directions dynamically when
directional convergence occurs. We conduct several experiments to justify that
trajectories are preserved. Our findings offer insights into the effects of
network width, parameter redundancy, and the structural connections between
solutions found via optimization in homogeneous networks of varying sizes.

AI.title_translation: 分类问题的同质神经网络的嵌入原理
AI.tldr: 论文提出了KKT点嵌入原理，证明了较小同质网络的最大间隔解（KKT点）可以通过线性变换嵌入到较大网络中，并展示了这种关系在梯度下降训练动力学中也保持不变，揭示了网络宽度与解结构之间的联系。
AI.motivation: 研究同质神经网络（全连接和卷积网络）相关最大间隔问题的KKT点，并探讨不同宽度网络中KKT点之间的关系。
AI.method: 研究了同质神经网络（包括全连接和卷积网络）相关最大间隔问题的Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT)点，并引入和形式化了KKT点嵌入原理，通过特定的线性等距变换将较小网络的KKT点嵌入到较大网络的KKT点中。此外，将静态嵌入与平滑损失的梯度流训练动力学联系起来。
AI.result: 证明了同质网络最大间隔问题的KKT点可以通过特定的线性等距变换嵌入到更大网络的KKT点中。证明了该原理适用于神经元分裂和通道分裂。证明了梯度流训练中，从适当映射的点开始的轨迹在训练过程中保持映射，并且方向的$\omega$-极限集也相应地被映射，从而在方向收敛发生时动态地保持与KKT方向的一致性。实验证明了轨迹的保持性。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果为理解网络宽度、参数冗余以及不同尺寸同质网络中通过优化找到的解之间的结构联系提供了见解。
AI.translation: 在本文中，我们研究了同质神经网络（包括全连接和卷积神经网络）中相关最大间隔问题的Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT)点。特别是，我们研究了由不同宽度生成的网络之间的此类KKT点之间的关系。我们引入并形式化了\textbf{KKT点嵌入原理}，确立了同质网络的max-margin问题（$P_{\Phi}$）的KKT点可以通过特定的线性等距变换嵌入到更大网络的（$P_{\tilde{\Phi}}$）的KKT点中。我们严格证明了该原理适用于全连接网络中的神经元分裂和卷积神经网络中的通道分裂。此外，我们将这种静态嵌入与具有平滑损失的梯度流训练的动力学联系起来。我们证明了从适当映射的点开始的轨迹在整个训练过程中保持映射，并且方向的$\omega$-极限集相应地被映射，从而在发生方向收敛时动态地保持与KKT方向的一致性。我们进行了几项实验来证明轨迹的保持性。我们的发现为网络宽度、参数冗余以及不同尺寸同质网络中通过优化找到的解之间的结构联系提供了见解。
AI.summary: 本文研究了同质神经网络（全连接和卷积网络）最大间隔问题的KKT点，并提出了“KKT点嵌入原理”。该原理表明，较小网络的KKT点可以通过线性等距变换嵌入到较大网络的KKT点中，并严格证明了该原理在神经元/通道分裂下的有效性。此外，研究将此静态嵌入与梯度流训练动态联系起来，表明训练轨迹和收敛方向在不同宽度网络间保持映射关系。
AI.keywords: KKT点,同质神经网络,最大间隔问题,嵌入原理,梯度流
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于正式提出了“KKT点嵌入原理”，并证明了它在全连接和卷积网络中通过神经元/通道分裂的有效性。其重要性在于揭示了不同宽度网络解之间的结构联系，并将其与梯度流训练动力学联系起来。局限性在于主要关注最大间隔问题及其KKT点，可能没有完全涵盖所有类型的损失函数或优化动态。

title: Rebalancing Contrastive Alignment with Bottlenecked Semantic Increments in Text-Video Retrieval
summary:
Recent progress in text-video retrieval has been largely driven by
contrastive learning. However, existing methods often overlook the effect of
the modality gap, which causes anchor representations to undergo in-place
optimization (i.e., optimization tension) that limits their alignment capacity.
Moreover, noisy hard negatives further distort the semantics of anchors. To
address these issues, we propose GARE, a Gap-Aware Retrieval framework that
introduces a learnable, pair-specific increment $\Delta_{ij}$ between text
$t_i$ and video $v_j$, redistributing gradients to relieve optimization tension
and absorb noise. We derive $\Delta_{ij}$ via a multivariate first-order Taylor
expansion of the InfoNCE loss under a trust-region constraint, showing that it
guides updates along locally consistent descent directions. A lightweight
neural module conditioned on the semantic gap couples increments across batches
for structure-aware correction. Furthermore, we regularize $\Delta$ through a
variational information bottleneck with relaxed compression, enhancing
stability and semantic consistency. Experiments on four benchmarks demonstrate
that GARE consistently improves alignment accuracy and robustness, validating
the effectiveness of gap-aware tension mitigation. Code is available at
https://github.com/musicman217/GARE-text-video-retrieval.

AI.title_translation: 使用瓶颈语义增量在文本-视频检索中重新平衡对比对齐
AI.tldr: 针对文本-视频检索中对比学习的模态间隙和优化张力问题，我们提出了 GARE 框架，通过引入一个基于泰勒展开导出的可学习语义增量 ($\Delta_{ij}$) 来重新平衡对齐。GARE 在四个基准测试中提高了精度和鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有的文本-视频检索方法忽略了模态间隙，导致锚点表示经历“优化张力”（就地优化），从而限制了对齐能力。此外，嘈杂的难负样本进一步扭曲了锚点的语义。
AI.method: 提出 GARE（间隙感知检索框架）。引入了一个可学习的、特定于对的增量 $\Delta_{ij}$ 来重新分配梯度，以缓解优化张力并吸收噪声。$\Delta_{ij}$ 是通过 InfoNCE 损失在信任域约束下的多元一阶泰勒展开导出的。使用一个轻量级的神经模块，根据语义间隙对增量进行跨批次耦合。通过具有松弛压缩的变分信息瓶颈来规范化 $\Delta$。
AI.result: 在四个基准测试中，GARE 持续提高了对齐精度和鲁棒性，验证了间隙感知张力缓解的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 间隙感知张力缓解的有效性得到了验证，GARE 框架成功提高了对齐精度和鲁棒性。
AI.translation: 近期文本-视频检索的进展主要由对比学习驱动。然而，现有方法通常忽略了模态间隙的影响，这会导致锚点表示经历就地优化（即优化张力），从而限制了它们的对齐能力。此外，嘈杂的难负样本进一步扭曲了锚点的语义。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了 GARE，一个间隙感知检索框架，它在文本 $t_i$ 和视频 $v_j$ 之间引入了一个可学习的、特定于对的增量 $\Delta_{ij}$，通过重新分配梯度来缓解优化张力并吸收噪声。我们在信任域约束下，通过 InfoNCE 损失的多元一阶泰勒展开推导出 $\Delta_{ij}$，表明它沿着局部一致的下降方向指导更新。一个根据语义间隙调节的轻量级神经模块将增量跨批次耦合起来，实现结构感知的校正。此外，我们通过具有松弛压缩的变分信息瓶颈来规范化 $\Delta$，增强了稳定性和语义一致性。在四个基准测试上的实验证明，GARE 持续提高了对齐精度和鲁棒性，验证了间隙感知张力缓解的有效性。代码可在 https://github.com/musicman217/GARE-text-video-retrieval 获取。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 GARE（间隙感知检索框架），用于缓解对比学习在文本-视频检索中存在的模态间隙和优化张力问题。GARE 引入了一个可学习的、特定于对的语义增量 ($\Delta_{ij}$)，该增量通过 InfoNCE 损失的泰勒展开导出，用于重新分配梯度和吸收噪声。$\Delta_{ij}$ 通过变分信息瓶颈进行规范化，并由一个间隙条件的模块进行跨批次耦合。在四个基准上的实验证明 GARE 显著提高了对齐精度和鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: 文本-视频检索, 对比对齐, 模态间隙, 语义增量, InfoNCE
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于明确解决了对比学习中由模态间隙引起的“优化张力”问题。其核心方法是引入一个通过 InfoNCE 损失在信任域约束下进行一阶泰勒展开导出的可学习、特定于对的语义增量 ($\Delta_{ij}$)，用于重新分配梯度和吸收噪声，这在理论上具有坚实的基础且方法新颖。通过变分信息瓶颈对增量进行规范化，进一步增强了稳定性和语义一致性。这是对鲁棒多模态对齐的重要贡献。

title: CALM-PDE: Continuous and Adaptive Convolutions for Latent Space Modeling of Time-dependent PDEs
comments:
Accepted for publication at the 39th Conference on Neural Information
  Processing Systems (NeurIPS) 2025, San Diego, California, USA
summary:
Solving time-dependent Partial Differential Equations (PDEs) using a densely
discretized spatial domain is a fundamental problem in various scientific and
engineering disciplines, including modeling climate phenomena and fluid
dynamics. However, performing these computations directly in the physical space
often incurs significant computational costs. To address this issue, several
neural surrogate models have been developed that operate in a compressed latent
space to solve the PDE. While these approaches reduce computational complexity,
they often use Transformer-based attention mechanisms to handle irregularly
sampled domains, resulting in increased memory consumption. In contrast,
convolutional neural networks allow memory-efficient encoding and decoding but
are limited to regular discretizations. Motivated by these considerations, we
propose CALM-PDE, a model class that efficiently solves arbitrarily discretized
PDEs in a compressed latent space. We introduce a novel continuous
convolution-based encoder-decoder architecture that uses an
epsilon-neighborhood-constrained kernel and learns to apply the convolution
operator to adaptive and optimized query points. We demonstrate the
effectiveness of CALM-PDE on a diverse set of PDEs with both regularly and
irregularly sampled spatial domains. CALM-PDE is competitive with or
outperforms existing baseline methods while offering significant improvements
in memory and inference time efficiency compared to Transformer-based methods.
comment:
Accepted for publication at the 39th Conference on Neural Information
  Processing Systems (NeurIPS) 2025, San Diego, California, USA

AI.title_translation: CALM-PDE：用于时变偏微分方程潜空间建模的连续自适应卷积
AI.tldr: CALM-PDE使用连续自适应卷积，高效地在潜空间中求解时变偏微分方程（PDEs），能处理不规则域，并且比基于Transformer的模型在内存和推理时间上更高效。
AI.motivation: 解决使用密集离散化空间域求解时变偏微分方程（PDEs）所导致的高昂计算成本问题。现有的潜空间神经替代模型（如基于Transformer的方法）虽然降低了计算复杂度，但内存消耗大；标准卷积神经网络（CNNs）内存高效但局限于规则离散化。目标是高效求解任意离散化的PDEs。
AI.method: 提出了CALM-PDE模型，采用新型的基于连续卷积的编码器-解码器架构。该架构使用一个受epsilon邻域约束的核，并学习将卷积算子应用于自适应和优化的查询点。
AI.result: 在具有规则和不规则采样空间域的多种PDEs上证明了CALM-PDE的有效性。性能上与现有基线方法相当或优于它们，并且在内存和推理时间效率上比基于Transformer的方法有显著提高。
AI.conclusion: CALM-PDE是一种高效且有效的模型，能够在压缩的潜空间中解决任意离散化的时变偏微分方程（PDEs），并在内存和推理时间效率方面显著优于基于Transformer的方法。
AI.translation: 使用密集离散化的空间域求解时变偏微分方程（PDEs）是包括气候现象建模和流体动力学在内的各种科学和工程学科中的一个基本问题。然而，直接在物理空间中执行这些计算通常会产生显著的计算成本。为了解决这个问题，已经开发了几种在压缩潜空间中运行的神经替代模型来求解PDE。尽管这些方法降低了计算复杂度，但它们通常使用基于Transformer的注意力机制来处理不规则采样的域，从而导致内存消耗增加。相比之下，卷积神经网络允许内存高效的编码和解码，但受限于规则离散化。基于这些考虑，我们提出了CALM-PDE，这是一个模型类别，可以高效地在压缩潜空间中求解任意离散化的PDE。我们引入了一种新颖的基于连续卷积的编码器-解码器架构，该架构使用一个受epsilon邻域约束的核，并学习将卷积算子应用于自适应和优化的查询点。我们在具有规则和不规则采样空间域的多种PDEs上证明了CALM-PDE的有效性。与现有基线方法相比，CALM-PDE具有竞争性或超越它们的性能，同时在内存和推理时间效率方面比基于Transformer的方法有显著改进。
AI.summary: CALM-PDE是一种新型的基于连续自适应卷积的神经替代模型，旨在高效解决时变偏微分方程（PDEs）的计算问题。它通过在压缩的潜空间中操作，并引入一种使用epsilon-邻域约束核的连续卷积编码器-解码器架构，成功地处理了任意离散化的空间域。实验证明，CALM-PDE在保持竞争性或更优性能的同时，显著提高了内存和推理时间的效率，克服了基于Transformer方法的局限性。
AI.keywords: 连续自适应卷积, 潜空间建模, 时变偏微分方程, 神经替代模型, 不规则采样
AI.comments: 创新性地提出了基于连续自适应卷积的架构（CALM-PDE），成功地将卷积神经网络固有的内存效率与处理不规则离散化域的能力相结合。这克服了传统CNN仅限于规则网格的局限性，同时也解决了基于Transformer的神经替代模型在处理不规则数据时内存消耗过大的问题。该方法为科学和工程领域中时变偏微分方程（PDEs）的高效潜空间建模提供了一个有前景且计算资源友好的替代方案。

title: One-Step Offline Distillation of Diffusion-based Models via Koopman Modeling
summary:
Diffusion-based generative models have demonstrated exceptional performance,
yet their iterative sampling procedures remain computationally expensive. A
prominent strategy to mitigate this cost is distillation, with offline
distillation offering particular advantages in terms of efficiency, modularity,
and flexibility. In this work, we identify two key observations that motivate a
principled distillation framework: (1) while diffusion models have been viewed
through the lens of dynamical systems theory, powerful and underexplored tools
can be further leveraged; and (2) diffusion models inherently impose
structured, semantically coherent trajectories in latent space. Building on
these observations, we introduce the Koopman Distillation Model (KDM), a novel
offline distillation approach grounded in Koopman theory - a classical
framework for representing nonlinear dynamics linearly in a transformed space.
KDM encodes noisy inputs into an embedded space where a learned linear operator
propagates them forward, followed by a decoder that reconstructs clean samples.
This enables single-step generation while preserving semantic fidelity. We
provide theoretical justification for our approach: (1) under mild assumptions,
the learned diffusion dynamics admit a finite-dimensional Koopman
representation; and (2) proximity in the Koopman latent space correlates with
semantic similarity in the generated outputs, allowing for effective trajectory
alignment. KDM achieves highly competitive performance across standard offline
distillation benchmarks.

AI.title_translation: 基于 Koopman 建模的扩散模型一步离线蒸馏
AI.tldr: 针对扩散模型采样慢的问题，本文提出了 Koopman 蒸馏模型（KDM），它利用 Koopman 理论将非线性扩散动力学转化为线性表示，实现一步（单步）离线蒸馏，同时保持生成质量。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型的迭代采样过程计算成本高昂。作者观察到：1) 扩散模型可以利用更强大的、未充分探索的动力系统工具（如 Koopman 理论）；2) 扩散模型内在的在潜在空间中施加了结构化、语义一致的轨迹。这些观察促使建立一个有原则的蒸馏框架，实现高效的单步生成。
AI.method: 提出了 Koopman 蒸馏模型（KDM），这是一种基于 Koopman 理论的离线蒸馏方法。Koopman 理论的特点是在变换空间中线性表示非线性动力学。KDM 的机制是将带噪声的输入编码到一个嵌入空间，其中一个学习到的线性算子（Koopman 算子）负责将其向前传播，随后一个解码器重建干净的样本。
AI.result: KDM 实现了单步生成，同时保持了语义保真度。该方法提供了理论依据，证明学习到的扩散动力学允许有限维 Koopman 表示，且 Koopman 潜在空间中的接近度与语义相似性相关联。KDM 在标准离线蒸馏基准上取得了极具竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: KDM 通过利用 Koopman 理论对扩散模型的非线性动力学进行线性表示和轨迹对齐，成功实现了扩散模型的一步离线蒸馏，有效解决了计算成本高昂的问题，并取得了优异的性能。
AI.translation: 基于扩散的生成模型已展示出卓越的性能，但其迭代采样过程的计算成本仍然很高。蒸馏是减轻此成本的一种突出策略，其中离线蒸馏在效率、模块性和灵活性方面具有独特的优势。在这项工作中，我们确定了两个关键观察结果，它们激励了一个有原则的蒸馏框架：（1）虽然扩散模型已被视为动力系统理论的视角，但可以进一步利用强大且未充分探索的工具；（2）扩散模型内在的在潜在空间中施加了结构化、语义一致的轨迹。基于这些观察，我们引入了 Koopman 蒸馏模型（KDM），这是一种新颖的离线蒸馏方法，其基础是 Koopman 理论——一个用于在变换空间中线性表示非线性动力学的经典框架。KDM 将带噪声的输入编码到一个嵌入空间，其中一个学习到的线性算子将其向前传播，随后一个解码器重建干净的样本。这使得单步生成成为可能，同时保持了语义保真度。我们为我们的方法提供了理论依据：（1）在温和假设下，学习到的扩散动力学允许有限维的 Koopman 表示；（2）Koopman 潜在空间中的接近度与生成输出中的语义相似性相关联，从而实现有效的轨迹对齐。KDM 在标准离线蒸馏基准上取得了极具竞争力的性能。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为 Koopman 蒸馏模型（KDM）的新型离线蒸馏方法，旨在解决基于扩散模型的迭代采样计算成本高昂的问题。KDM 利用 Koopman 理论将扩散模型的非线性动力学映射到线性嵌入空间，通过一个学习到的线性算子实现一步式的轨迹传播和样本生成。该方法不仅提供了理论上的证明，而且实现了单步生成，同时在标准离线蒸馏基准上取得了极具竞争力的性能。
AI.keywords: 扩散模型, 离线蒸馏, Koopman 理论, 单步生成, 动力系统
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于将经典的 Koopman 理论引入到现代深度生成模型（扩散模型）的蒸馏领域。通过将复杂的非线性扩散过程转化为嵌入空间中的简单线性传播，该方法巧妙地解决了传统扩散模型采样速度慢的瓶颈。这种“一步离线蒸馏”的设计极大地提高了效率、模块性和灵活性。理论证明增强了方法的可靠性，特别是关于 Koopman 潜在空间中的语义保持特性，这是实现高质量单步生成的关键。

title: CLEVER: A Curated Benchmark for Formally Verified Code Generation
summary:
