AI.tldr: 为了解决MVP评估的难题，我们提出了MVP-Shapley框架，它利用Shapley值分析比赛数据（如助攻和得分），计算球员贡献度，并确定MVP排名。该方法经过优化以符合专家意见，并在NBA等数据集上成功验证并部署。
AI.motivation: 电子竞技和多人在线游戏社区的蓬勃发展凸显了评估最有价值球员（MVP）的关键重要性，但建立一个可解释且实用的MVP评估方法极具挑战性。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为\oursys的新MVP评估框架，该框架利用Shapley值，包括特征处理、胜负模型训练、Shapley值分配以及基于球员贡献的MVP排名确定。此外，该算法还从因果角度进行了优化，以使其与专家投票结果保持一致。
AI.result: 通过使用NBA数据集和Dunk City Dynasty数据集验证了所提方法的有效性，并在业界进行了在线部署。
AI.conclusion: 通过在NBA和Dunk City Dynasty数据集上的验证，证实了MVP-Shapley方法的有效性，并已在行业中实现在线部署。
AI.translation: 电子竞技和多人在线游戏社区的蓬勃发展凸显了评估最有价值球员（MVP）的关键重要性。建立一个可解释且实用的MVP评估方法极具挑战性。在我们的研究中，我们专门关注记录比赛中相关事件（如助攻和得分）的逐场数据。我们的目标是通过引入一个名为\oursys的新MVP评估框架来应对这些挑战，该框架利用Shapley值。该方法包括特征处理、胜负模型训练、Shapley值分配以及基于球员贡献的MVP排名确定。此外，我们从因果角度优化了我们的算法，以使其与专家投票结果保持一致。最后，我们通过使用NBA数据集和Dunk City Dynasty数据集验证了我们方法的有效性，并在业界实现了在线部署。
AI.summary: 本文针对MVP评估的挑战，提出了一种名为MVP-Shapley的新框架，它利用Shapley值对基于比赛事件（如助攻和得分）的Play-by-Play数据进行建模，以量化球员贡献并确定MVP排名。该方法还通过与专家投票结果对齐来增强其因果解释性，并在实际数据集上验证了其有效性。
AI.keywords: MVP评估, Shapley值, 特征建模, 电子竞技, 贡献度分析
AI.comments: 该方法创新性地结合了Shapley值和基于特征的建模来评估MVP，并且通过与专家投票结果对齐来增强其因果解释性，具有很强的实际应用价值。局限性在于其评估完全依赖于可用的比赛数据（如助攻和得分事件）。

title: Direct Numerical Layout Generation for 3D Indoor Scene Synthesis via Spatial Reasoning
summary:
Realistic 3D indoor scene synthesis is vital for embodied AI and digital
content creation. It can be naturally divided into two subtasks: object
generation and layout generation. While recent generative models have
significantly advanced object-level quality and controllability, layout
generation remains challenging due to limited datasets. Existing methods either
overfit to these datasets or rely on predefined constraints to optimize
numerical layout that sacrifice flexibility. As a result, they fail to generate
scenes that are both open-vocabulary and aligned with fine-grained user
instructions. We introduce DirectLayout, a framework that directly generates
numerical 3D layouts from text descriptions using generalizable spatial
reasoning of large language models (LLMs). DirectLayout decomposes the
generation into three stages: producing a Bird's-Eye View (BEV) layout, lifting
it into 3D space, and refining object placements. To enable explicit spatial
reasoning and help the model grasp basic principles of object placement, we
employ Chain-of-Thought (CoT) Activation based on the 3D-Front dataset.
Additionally, we design CoT-Grounded Generative Layout Reward to enhance
generalization and spatial planning. During inference, DirectLayout addresses
asset-layout mismatches via Iterative Asset-Layout Alignment through in-context
learning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DirectLayout achieves
impressive semantic consistency, generalization and physical plausibility.

AI.title_translation: 通过空间推理直接生成3D室内场景的数值布局
AI.tldr: DirectLayout 框架使用LLM的空间推理能力，通过三阶段（BEV、3D提升、精炼）直接从文本生成数值3D室内场景布局，并利用CoT激活和自定义奖励机制来提高规划能力和泛化性，实验结果表明其在场景的语义一致性和物理合理性方面表现优异。
AI.motivation: 现有的3D室内场景布局生成方法受限于有限的数据集，导致模型过拟合或依赖预定义约束，从而牺牲了灵活性，无法生成同时满足开放词汇和精细用户指令的场景。
AI.method: DirectLayout 框架，它将生成过程分解为三个阶段：生成鸟瞰图（BEV）布局、将其提升到3D空间，以及精炼物体位置。该方法利用基于3D-Front数据集的思维链（CoT）激活来进行显式的空间推理，并设计了CoT基础的生成布局奖励来增强泛化和空间规划。推理时，通过上下文学习的迭代资产-布局对齐来解决资产-布局不匹配问题。
AI.result: DirectLayout 实现了令人印象深刻的语义一致性、泛化能力和物理合理性。
AI.conclusion: DirectLayout 实现了令人印象深刻的语义一致性、泛化能力和物理合理性。
AI.translation: 逼真的3D室内场景合成对于具身人工智能和数字内容创建至关重要。它可以自然地分为两个子任务：物体生成和布局生成。虽然最近的生成模型在物体层面的质量和可控性方面取得了显著进展，但由于数据集有限，布局生成仍然具有挑战性。现有方法要么过度拟合这些数据集，要么依赖预定义的约束来优化数值布局，从而牺牲了灵活性。因此，它们无法生成既符合开放词汇又与精细用户指令对齐的场景。我们引入了 DirectLayout，一个直接从文本描述生成数值3D布局的框架，该框架利用大型语言模型（LLM）的通用空间推理能力。DirectLayout 将生成分解为三个阶段：生成鸟瞰图（BEV）布局、将其提升到3D空间，以及精炼物体位置。为了实现显式的空间推理并帮助模型掌握物体放置的基本原理，我们采用了基于 3D-Front 数据集的思维链（CoT）激活。此外，我们设计了 CoT 基础的生成布局奖励来增强泛化能力和空间规划。在推理过程中，DirectLayout 通过上下文学习的迭代资产-布局对齐来解决资产-布局不匹配问题。大量实验证明，DirectLayout 实现了令人印象深刻的语义一致性、泛化能力和物理合理性。
AI.summary: DirectLayout 是一个新框架，它利用大型语言模型（LLM）的通用空间推理能力，直接从文本描述生成数值3D场景布局。该方法通过BEV布局生成、3D提升和物体位置精炼三阶段进行，并引入了基于CoT激活和特定奖励机制来增强空间推理和泛化能力。最终证明了该方法在语义一致性和物理合理性方面表现出色。
AI.keywords: 3D室内场景合成, 数值布局生成, 空间推理, 大语言模型, 鸟瞰图
AI.comments: 该论文的创新之处在于直接利用LLM的通用空间推理能力来生成3D场景的数值布局，解决了现有方法在布局生成方面因数据集限制而导致的灵活性和开放词汇性不足的问题。其重要性在于为具身AI和数字内容创建提供了更灵活、更符合用户指令的3D场景生成新范式。局限性可能在于对LLM推理能力的依赖程度以及CoT激活和奖励机制的有效性验证的充分性（尽管实验证明有效）。

title: FuseUNet: A Multi-Scale Feature Fusion Method for U-like Networks
comments:
Updated author information to clarify institutional affiliation. The
  research was conducted prior to the author joining the University of Maryland
summary:
Medical image segmentation is a critical task in computer vision, with UNet
serving as a milestone architecture. The typical component of UNet family is
the skip connection, however, their skip connections face two significant
limitations: (1) they lack effective interaction between features at different
scales, and (2) they rely on simple concatenation or addition operations, which
constrain efficient information integration. While recent improvements to UNet
have focused on enhancing encoder and decoder capabilities, these limitations
remain overlooked. To overcome these challenges, we propose a novel multi-scale
feature fusion method that reimagines the UNet decoding process as solving an
initial value problem (IVP), treating skip connections as discrete nodes. By
leveraging principles from the linear multistep method, we propose an adaptive
ordinary differential equation method to enable effective multi-scale feature
fusion. Our approach is independent of the encoder and decoder architectures,
making it adaptable to various U-Net-like networks. Experiments on ACDC,
KiTS2023, MSD brain tumor, and ISIC2017/2018 skin lesion segmentation datasets
demonstrate improved feature utilization, reduced network parameters, and
maintained high performance. The code is available at
https://github.com/nayutayuki/FuseUNet.
comment:
Updated author information to clarify institutional affiliation. The
  research was conducted prior to the author joining the University of Maryland

AI.title_translation: FuseUNet：一种用于类U型网络的​​多尺度特征融合方法
AI.tldr: 为了解决UNet跳跃连接特征交互弱的问题，研究人员提出了一种基于常微分方程（ODE）的自适应多尺度特征融合机制（FuseUNet），它将融合过程视为一个IVP求解，并在多个医学分割任务上展示了优于现有方法的性能和更高的参数效率。
AI.motivation: 传统的UNet跳跃连接存在两个主要限制：(1) 缺乏不同尺度特征之间的有效交互；(2) 依赖简单的拼接或加法操作，限制了信息的有效整合。现有改进多集中在编码器和解码器能力上，而忽略了这些限制。
AI.method: 提出了一种新颖的多尺度特征融合方法，将UNet的解码过程重新构想为求解初值问题（IVP），将跳跃连接视为离散节点，并利用线性多步法的原理，提出了一种自适应常微分方程方法来实现有效的多尺度特征融合。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该方法提高了特征利用率，减少了网络参数，并在ACDC、KiTS2023、MSD脑肿瘤和ISIC2017/2018皮肤病变分割数据集上保持了高性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过在多个医学图像分割数据集上进行的实验证明，所提出的方法能够提高特征利用率，减少网络参数，同时保持高性能。
AI.translation: 医学图像分割是计算机视觉中的一项关键任务，其中UNet是里程碑式的架构。UNet家族的典型组成部分是跳跃连接，然而，它们的跳跃连接面临两个显著限制：（1）它们缺乏不同尺度特征之间的有效交互；（2）它们依赖于简单的拼接或加法操作，这限制了有效的信息整合。虽然最近对UNet的改进集中在增强编码器和解码器能力上，但这些限制仍然被忽视。为了克服这些挑战，我们提出了一种新颖的多尺度特征融合方法，将UNet的解码过程重新构想为求解初值问题（IVP），将跳跃连接视为离散节点。通过利用线性多步法的原理，我们提出了一种自适应常微分方程方法来实现有效的多尺度特征融合。我们的方法独立于编码器和解码器架构，使其能够适应各种U-Net类网络。在ACDC、KiTS2023、MSD脑肿瘤和ISIC2017/2018皮肤病变分割数据集上的实验证明，该方法提高了特征利用率，减少了网络参数，并保持了高性能。代码可在https://github.com/nayutayuki/FuseUNet获取。
AI.summary: 本文针对U-Net类网络中跳跃连接在多尺度特征交互和信息整合方面的局限性，提出了一种名为FuseUNet的新型多尺度特征融合方法。该方法将解码过程视为初值问题（IVP），并基于线性多步法原理设计了一种自适应常微分方程方法，实现了有效的特征融合，且该方法不依赖于特定的编码器和解码器架构。
AI.keywords: U-Net, 多尺度特征融合, 跳跃连接, 常微分方程, 医学图像分割
AI.comments: 该方法创新性地将U-Net的解码过程视为求解初值问题（IVP），利用线性多步法原理设计了自适应常微分方程方法来实现多尺度特征的有效融合，解决了传统跳跃连接中特征交互不足和信息整合效率低下的问题。其通用性强，可应用于多种U-Net类网络。

title: Diffusion-Based Hierarchical Graph Neural Networks for Simulating Nonlinear Solid Mechanics
summary:
Graph-based learned simulators have emerged as a promising approach for
simulating physical systems on unstructured meshes, offering speed and
generalization across diverse geometries. However, they often struggle with
capturing global phenomena, such as bending or long-range correlations usually
occurring in solid mechanics, and suffer from error accumulation over long
rollouts due to their reliance on local message passing and direct next-step
prediction. We address these limitations by introducing the Rolling
Diffusion-Batched Inference Network (ROBIN), a novel learned simulator that
integrates two key innovations: (i) Rolling Diffusion-Batched Inference (ROBI),
a parallelized inference scheme that amortizes the cost of diffusion-based
refinement across physical time steps by overlapping denoising steps across a
temporal window. (ii) A Hierarchical Graph Neural Network built on algebraic
multigrid coarsening, enabling multiscale message passing across different mesh
resolutions. This architecture, implemented via Algebraic-hierarchical Message
Passing Networks, captures both fine-scale local dynamics and global structural
effects critical for phenomena like beam bending or multi-body contact. We
validate ROBIN on challenging 2D and 3D solid mechanics benchmarks involving
geometric, material, and contact nonlinearities. ROBIN achieves
state-of-the-art accuracy on all tasks, substantially outperforming existing
next-step learned simulators while reducing inference time by up to an order of
magnitude compared to standard diffusion simulators.

AI.title_translation: 用于模拟非线性固体力学的扩散型分层图神经网络
AI.tldr: ROBIN是一种新的扩散模型驱动的分层图神经网络模拟器，用于固体力学。它通过ROBI并行化了扩散推理，并通过分层结构捕获多尺度信息，从而在保持高精度的同时，比现有方法快得多。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于图的学习模拟器在捕捉固体力学中的全局现象（如弯曲或长程相关性）方面存在困难，并且由于依赖局部消息传递和直接的下一步预测，在长时间演化中容易出现误差积累。
AI.method: 引入了滚动扩散批处理推理网络（ROBIN），它结合了两个关键创新：（i）滚动扩散批处理推理（ROBI），一种并行化推理方案，通过在时间窗口内重叠去噪步骤来分摊扩散模型细化成本。（ii）一个基于代数多重网格（AMG）粗化的分层图神经网络，实现了跨不同网格分辨率的多尺度消息传递（通过代数分层消息传递网络实现）。
AI.result: ROBIN在所有固体力学任务上实现了最先进的准确性，性能显著优于现有的下一步学习模拟器，并将推理时间与标准扩散模拟器相比减少了多达一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: ROBIN在涉及几何、材料和接触非线性的具有挑战性的2D和3D固体力学基准测试中，实现了所有任务上的最先进精度，在性能上显著优于现有的下一步学习模拟器，同时与标准扩散模拟器相比，推理时间减少了多达一个数量级。
AI.translation: 基于图的学习模拟器已成为在非结构化网格上模拟物理系统的一种有前景的方法，它提供了速度和跨不同几何形状的泛化能力。然而，它们通常难以捕捉全局现象，例如在固体力学中通常发生的弯曲或长程相关性，并且由于依赖局部消息传递和直接的下一步预测，在长时间的滚动画中容易出现误差积累。我们通过引入滚动扩散批处理推理网络（ROBIN），一种新颖的学习模拟器，来解决这些限制。ROBIN集成了两个关键创新：（i）滚动扩散批处理推理（ROBI），一种并行化推理方案，通过在时间窗口内重叠去噪步骤来分摊扩散模型细化的成本。（ii）一个基于代数多重网格粗化的分层图神经网络，实现了跨不同网格分辨率的多尺度消息传递。该架构通过代数分层消息传递网络实现，能够捕获对束弯曲或多体接触等现象至关重要的精细尺度局部动力学和全局结构效应。我们在涉及几何、材料和接触非线性的具有挑战性的2D和3D固体力学基准测试中验证了ROBIN。ROBIN在所有任务上实现了最先进的准确性，显著优于现有的下一步学习模拟器，同时与标准扩散模拟器相比，推理时间减少了多达一个数量级。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一种名为ROBIN的新型学习模拟器，用于模拟非线性固体力学。ROBIN通过集成并行化的滚动扩散推理（ROBI）和基于代数多重网格粗化的分层图神经网络，解决了传统图模型难以捕捉全局现象和扩散模型推理成本高的问题。实验证明，ROBIN在复杂的2D和3D固体力学任务中达到了最先进的精度，同时显著提高了推理速度。
AI.keywords: 扩散模型, 图神经网络, 固体力学模拟, 分层结构, 滚动推理
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于结合了扩散模型（用于高精度细化）和分层图神经网络（用于多尺度信息捕获），并提出了并行化的滚动推理方案（ROBI）来解决扩散模型推理成本高和传统图模型难以捕捉全局现象的问题。这对于处理具有复杂非线性和接触的固体力学模拟至关重要。限制是摘要中没有明确指出模型在哪些具体的物理参数（如杨氏模量、泊松比等）上的泛化能力。

title: Spark Transformer: Reactivating Sparsity in FFN and Attention
summary:
The discovery of the lazy neuron phenomenon in trained Transformers, where
the vast majority of neurons in their feed-forward networks (FFN) are inactive
for each token, has spurred tremendous interests in activation sparsity for
enhancing large model efficiency. While notable progress has been made in
translating such sparsity to wall-time benefits, modern Transformers have moved
away from the ReLU activation function crucial to this phenomenon. Existing
efforts on re-introducing activation sparsity often degrade model quality,
increase parameter count, complicate or slow down training. Sparse attention,
the application of sparse activation to the attention mechanism, often faces
similar challenges.
  This paper introduces the Spark Transformer, a novel architecture that
achieves a high level of activation sparsity in both FFN and the attention
mechanism while maintaining model quality, parameter count, and standard
training procedures. Our method realizes sparsity via top-k masking for
explicit control over sparsity level. Crucially, we introduce statistical
top-k, a hardware-accelerator-friendly, linear-time approximate algorithm that
avoids costly sorting and mitigates significant training slowdown from standard
top-$k$ operators. Furthermore, Spark Transformer reallocates existing FFN
parameters and attention key embeddings to form a low-cost predictor for
identifying activated entries. This design not only mitigates quality loss from
enforced sparsity, but also enhances wall-time benefit. Pretrained with the
Gemma-2 recipe, Spark Transformer demonstrates competitive performance on
standard benchmarks while exhibiting significant sparsity: only 8% of FFN
neurons are activated, and each token attends to a maximum of 256 tokens. This
sparsity translates to a 2.5x reduction in FLOPs, leading to decoding wall-time
speedups of up to 1.79x on CPU and 1.40x on GPU.

AI.title_translation: Spark Transformer：在FFN和注意力中重新激活稀疏性
AI.tldr: Spark Transformer通过引入一种新的架构，在FFN和注意力机制中实现了高激活稀疏性，同时保持了模型质量和参数数量。它使用top-k掩码和一种名为statistical top-k的近似算法来控制稀疏性，并利用FFN参数和注意力键嵌入来预测激活项，从而减少了计算量和训练减速。实验表明，Spark Transformer在Gemma-2预训练下，FFN神经元激活率仅为8%，每个token最多关注256个token，FLOPs减少2.5倍，CPU和GPU的解码速度分别提升1.79倍和1.40倍。
AI.motivation: Lazy neuron现象表明，Transformer中的大部分FFN神经元对于每个token都是不活跃的，这激发了人们对激活稀疏性以提高大模型效率的兴趣。然而，现有的方法往往会降低模型质量、增加参数数量、使训练复杂化或减慢训练速度，并且在将稀疏性转化为实际运行时间效益方面存在挑战。
AI.method: Spark Transformer通过以下方法实现高激活稀疏性：1. 使用top-k掩码来显式控制稀疏性水平。2. 引入statistical top-k，一种硬件加速器友好的线性时间近似算法，用于避免昂贵的排序并减轻标准top-k算子带来的训练减速。3. 重新分配现有的FFN参数和注意力键嵌入，构建一个低成本的预测器来识别激活项，从而减轻因强制稀疏性导致的质量损失并增强实际运行时间效益。
AI.result: Spark Transformer在Gemma-2预训练下，在标准基准上表现出有竞争力，同时具有显著的稀疏性：仅8%的FFN神经元被激活，每个token最多关注256个token。这使得FLOPs减少了2.5倍，并在CPU上实现了高达1.79倍的解码速度提升，在GPU上实现了1.40倍的解码速度提升。
AI.conclusion: Spark Transformer成功地在FFN和注意力机制中实现了高激活稀疏性，同时保持了模型质量、参数数量和标准的训练流程，并在效率和速度方面取得了显著的实际效益。
AI.translation:
在已训练的Transformer中发现大量前馈网络（FFN）神经元对于每个token而言是不活跃的“懒惰神经元”现象，极大地激发了人们对激活稀疏性以提高大模型效率的兴趣。尽管在将此类稀疏性转化为实际运行时间效益方面已取得显著进展，但现代Transformer已远离了对该现象至关重要的ReLU激活函数。现有关于重新引入激活稀疏性的努力常常会损害模型质量、增加参数数量、使训练过程复杂化或减慢训练速度。稀疏注意力，即稀疏激活在注意力机制上的应用，常常面临类似的挑战。

本论文介绍了Spark Transformer，一种新颖的架构，它在保持模型质量、参数数量和标准训练程序的同时，在FFN和注意力机制中实现了高水平的激活稀疏性。我们的方法通过top-k掩码来实现稀疏性，从而对稀疏性水平进行显式控制。至关重要的是，我们引入了statistical top-k，一种硬件加速器友好的线性时间近似算法，它避免了昂贵的排序，并减轻了标准top-k算子带来的显著训练减速。此外，Spark Transformer重新分配了现有的FFN参数和注意力键嵌入，以构建一个低成本的预测器来识别激活项。这种设计不仅减轻了强制稀疏性导致的质量损失，而且增强了实际运行时间效益。通过Gemma-2配方进行预训练，Spark Transformer在标准基准上展现出有竞争力的性能，同时表现出显著的稀疏性：只有8%的FFN神经元被激活，并且每个token最多关注256个token。这种稀疏性转化为FLOPs减少了2.5倍，从而在CPU上实现了高达1.79倍的解码运行时间加速，在GPU上实现了1.40倍的解码运行时间加速。
AI.summary: Spark Transformer提出了一种新颖的架构，通过top-k掩码和一种名为statistical top-k的硬件友好近似算法，在FFN和注意力机制中实现了高激活稀疏性。该方法利用重用参数来预测激活项，从而在保持模型质量和标准训练流程的同时，显著减少了计算量（FLOPs减少2.5倍）并提高了解码速度（CPU上1.79倍，GPU上1.40倍）。
AI.keywords: Spark Transformer, 激活稀疏性, FFN, 注意力机制, statistical top-k
AI.comments: 该研究解决了Transformer模型效率的关键问题，即激活稀疏性。通过引入Spark Transformer，作者不仅实现了显著的稀疏性（FFN激活率8%，注意力稀疏性），而且通过创新的statistical top-k算法和参数重用机制，有效解决了现有方法在模型质量、训练复杂度和实际速度提升方面的痛点。特别是statistical top-k算法，通过避免排序实现了线性时间复杂度，这对硬件加速非常友好。然而，需要进一步研究其在不同模型规模和任务上的泛化能力，以及长期训练稳定性。

title: HauntAttack: When Attack Follows Reasoning as a Shadow
summary:
Emerging Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) consistently excel in mathematical and
reasoning tasks, showcasing remarkable capabilities. However, the enhancement
of reasoning abilities and the exposure of internal reasoning processes
introduce new safety vulnerabilities. A critical question arises: when
reasoning becomes intertwined with harmfulness, will LRMs become more
vulnerable to jailbreaks in reasoning mode? To investigate this, we introduce
HauntAttack, a novel and general-purpose black-box adversarial attack framework
that systematically embeds harmful instructions into reasoning questions.
Specifically, we modify key reasoning conditions in existing questions with
harmful instructions, thereby constructing a reasoning pathway that guides the
model step by step toward unsafe outputs. We evaluate HauntAttack on 11 LRMs
and observe an average attack success rate of 70\%, achieving up to 12
percentage points of absolute improvement over the strongest prior baseline.
Our further analysis reveals that even advanced safety-aligned models remain
highly susceptible to reasoning-based attacks, offering insights into the
urgent challenge of balancing reasoning capability and safety in future model
development.

AI.title_translation: HauntAttack：当攻击如影随形地跟随推理时
AI.tldr: 研究人员开发了一种名为HauntAttack的新型黑盒攻击方法，它通过将恶意指令“植入”到数学或逻辑推理问题的步骤中，成功地诱导大型推理模型（LRMs）生成有害输出。即使是最新、经过安全训练的模型也未能幸免，攻击成功率很高，表明推理能力与安全之间存在严重的冲突。
AI.motivation: LRMs在推理任务中表现出色，但推理能力的增强和内部推理过程的暴露引入了新的安全漏洞。研究动机是探究当推理与有害性交织时，LRMs在推理模式下是否更容易受到越狱攻击。
AI.method: 引入HauntAttack，这是一个新颖且通用的黑盒对抗性攻击框架，通过系统地将有害指令嵌入到推理问题中，修改现有问题的关键推理条件，从而构建引导模型逐步产生不安全输出的推理路径。
AI.result: 在11个LRMs上评估HauntAttack，观察到平均攻击成功率为70%，比最强的现有基线提高了高达12个百分点的绝对提升。
AI.conclusion: 先进的安全对齐模型仍然高度容易受到基于推理的攻击，这为未来模型开发中平衡推理能力和安全性提供了重要的见解，表明这是一个紧迫的挑战。
AI.translation: 新兴的大型推理模型（LRMs）在数学和推理任务中表现出色，展现出卓越的能力。然而，推理能力的增强和内部推理过程的暴露引入了新的安全漏洞。一个关键问题是：当推理与有害性交织时，LRMs在推理模式下是否会更容易受到越狱攻击？为了研究这个问题，我们引入了HauntAttack，一个新颖且通用的黑盒对抗性攻击框架，它系统地将有害指令嵌入到推理问题中。具体来说，我们用有害指令修改了现有问题中的关键推理条件，从而构建了一个逐步引导模型走向不安全输出的推理路径。我们在11个LRMs上评估了HauntAttack，观察到平均攻击成功率为70%，比最强的现有基线提高了高达12个百分点的绝对提升。我们进一步的分析表明，即使是先进的安全对齐模型仍然高度容易受到基于推理的攻击，这为未来模型开发中平衡推理能力和安全性提供了重要的见解。
AI.summary: 本文提出了HauntAttack，一个用于系统地将有害指令嵌入推理问题的黑盒对抗性攻击框架，以测试大型推理模型（LRMs）在推理模式下的安全漏洞。研究发现，即使是先进的安全对齐模型也极易受到此类推理驱动的攻击，平均成功率达70%，凸显了在提升推理能力的同时保障安全性的紧迫性。
AI.keywords: 推理模型, 安全漏洞, 对抗性攻击, 越狱, 有害指令
AI.comments: 这项工作创新性地提出了将有害指令嵌入推理问题的框架（HauntAttack），揭示了推理能力增强带来的新安全隐患。其重要性在于证明了即使是经过安全对齐的高级模型也容易受到基于推理的攻击，强调了推理能力与安全之间平衡的紧迫性。局限性在于仅基于黑盒攻击框架进行评估。

title: LeVo: High-Quality Song Generation with Multi-Preference Alignment
summary:
Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) and audio language models
have significantly improved music generation, particularly in lyrics-to-song
generation. However, existing approaches still struggle with the complex
composition of songs and the scarcity of high-quality data, leading to
limitations in audio quality, musicality, instruction following, and
vocal-instrument harmony. To address these challenges, we introduce LeVo, a
language model based framework consisting of LeLM and Music Codec. LeLM is
capable of parallel modeling of two types of tokens: mixed tokens, which
represent the combined audio of vocals and accompaniment to achieve better
vocal-instrument harmony, and dual-track tokens, which separately encode vocals
and accompaniment for high-quality song generation. It employs two decoder-only
transformers and a modular extension training strategy to prevent interference
between different token types. To further enhance musicality and instruction
following ability, we introduce a multi-preference alignment method based on
Direct Preference Optimization (DPO). This method handles diverse human
preferences through a semi-automatic data construction process and
post-training. Experimental results demonstrate that LeVo significantly
outperforms existing open-source methods in both objective and subjective
metrics, while performing competitively with industry systems. Ablation studies
further justify the effectiveness of our designs. Audio examples and source
code are available at https://levo-demo.github.io and
https://github.com/tencent-ailab/songgeneration.

AI.title_translation: LeVo：具有多偏好对齐的高质量歌曲生成
AI.tldr: LeVo是一个基于语言模型的框架，用于生成高质量歌曲，通过混合和双轨道编码器解决现有方法的局限性，并使用直接偏好优化（DPO）来提高音乐性和指令遵循能力，实验结果优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有音乐生成方法在歌曲创作的复杂性、高质量数据稀缺性方面存在挑战，导致音频质量、音乐性、指令遵循和人声-乐器和声方面存在局限性。
AI.method: LeVo框架包括LeLM和Music Codec。LeLM可以并行建模混合（人声+伴奏）和双轨道（人声、伴奏分离）两种类型的token，并采用模块化扩展训练策略。通过基于DPO的多偏好对齐方法来增强音乐性和指令遵循能力。
AI.result: LeVo在客观和主观指标上显著优于现有的开源方法，并且与行业系统相比具有竞争力。消融研究证明了其设计的有效性。
AI.conclusion: LeVo通过创新的token建模和多偏好对齐方法，成功解决了现有歌曲生成方法的局限性，并在生成质量和指令遵循方面取得了显著的进步。
AI.translation: 近期，大型语言模型（LLMs）和音频语言模型在音乐生成方面取得了显著进展，尤其是在歌词到歌曲生成方面。然而，现有方法在歌曲的复杂创作和高质量数据稀缺性方面仍然存在挑战，导致音频质量、音乐性、指令遵循和人声-乐器和声方面存在局限性。为了应对这些挑战，我们引入了LeVo，一个基于语言模型的框架，包括LeLM和Music Codec。LeLM能够并行建模两种类型的token：混合token，代表了人声和伴奏的组合音频，以实现更好的人声-乐器和声；以及双轨道token，分别编码人声和伴奏，以实现高质量的歌曲生成。它采用了两个解码器-only Transformer和一个模块化扩展训练策略，以防止不同token类型之间的干扰。为了进一步增强音乐性和指令遵循能力，我们引入了一种基于直接偏好优化（DPO）的多偏好对齐方法。该方法通过半自动数据构建过程和后训练来处理多样化的用户偏好。实验结果表明，LeVo在客观和主观指标上都显著优于现有的开源方法，并且与行业系统相比具有竞争力。消融研究进一步证明了我们设计的有效性。音频示例和源代码可在https://levo-demo.github.io 和 https://github.com/tencent-ailab/songgeneration 获取。
AI.summary: LeVo是一个新提出的框架，旨在通过创新的方法解决现有歌曲生成技术的局限性，包括音频质量、音乐性和指令遵循能力。它采用了LeLM，能够同时处理结合了人声和伴奏的混合token以及分离的人声和伴奏的双轨道token，以实现更好的和声和高质量的输出。此外，LeVo还引入了基于DPO的多偏好对齐技术，以适应不同的用户偏好并提升音乐性和指令遵循。实验证明，LeVo在多个评估维度上均超越了现有开源方案，并能与商业系统相媲美。
AI.keywords: 歌曲生成, 大型语言模型, 多偏好对齐, LeLM, 直接偏好优化
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种名为LeVo的新型歌曲生成框架，通过结合混合token和双轨道token的并行建模以及基于DPO的多偏好对齐，有效地解决了现有方法在音频质量、音乐性和指令遵循方面的不足。其创新性在于同时处理人声与伴奏的多种表示方式，并引入先进的偏好对齐技术以满足多样化需求。实验结果令人信服，表明LeVo在性能上超越了开源竞争对手，并达到了行业级水平。该研究为高质量、个性化歌曲生成开辟了新途径。

title: MIRA: Medical Time Series Foundation Model for Real-World Health Data
summary:
A unified foundation model for medical time series -- pretrained on open
access and ethics board-approved medical corpora -- offers the potential to
reduce annotation burdens, minimize model customization, and enable robust
transfer across clinical institutions, modalities, and tasks, particularly in
data-scarce or privacy-constrained environments. However, existing generalist
time series foundation models struggle to handle medical time series data due
to their inherent challenges, including irregular intervals, heterogeneous
sampling rates, and frequent missing values. To address these challenges, we
introduce MIRA, a unified foundation model specifically designed for medical
time series forecasting. MIRA incorporates a Continuous-Time Rotary Positional
Encoding that enables fine-grained modeling of variable time intervals, a
frequency-specific mixture-of-experts layer that routes computation across
latent frequency regimes to further promote temporal specialization, and a
Continuous Dynamics Extrapolation Block based on Neural ODE that models the
continuous trajectory of latent states, enabling accurate forecasting at
arbitrary target timestamps. Pretrained on a large-scale and diverse medical
corpus comprising over 454 billion time points collect from publicly available
datasets, MIRA achieves reductions in forecasting errors by an average of 10%
and 7% in out-of-distribution and in-distribution scenarios, respectively, when
compared to other zero-shot and fine-tuned baselines. We also introduce a
comprehensive benchmark spanning multiple downstream clinical tasks,
establishing a foundation for future research in medical time series modeling.

AI.title_translation: MIRA：用于真实世界健康数据的医学时间序列基础模型
AI.tldr: MIRA是一个专门为医学时间序列预测设计的统一基础模型，通过创新的时间编码、专家混合层和神经ODE模块，解决了医学时间序列数据的挑战，并在大规模预训练后，在各种预测场景下显著提高了准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有的通用时间序列基础模型难以处理医学时间序列数据固有的不规则间隔、异构采样率和频繁缺失值等挑战，因此需要一个专门针对医学时间序列的统一基础模型。
AI.method: MIRA模型集成了连续时间旋转位置编码（用于模拟可变时间间隔）、特定频率的专家混合层（用于跨潜在频率域路由计算）以及基于神经ODE的连续动态外推块（用于模拟潜在状态的连续轨迹），并使用大规模医学语料库进行了预训练。
AI.result: 与零样本和微调基线相比，MIRA在分布外和分布内场景下的预测误差分别平均降低了10%和7%。
AI.conclusion: MIRA作为首个专门为医学时间序列设计的统一基础模型，通过其独特的架构和大规模预训练，有效解决了现有模型的局限性，并在医学时间序列预测任务中取得了显著的性能提升，为未来的研究奠定了基础。
AI.translation: 一个统一的医学时间序列基础模型——在开放获取和伦理委员会批准的医学语料库上进行预训练——有潜力减少注释负担，最小化模型定制，并在临床机构、模态和任务之间实现稳健的迁移，特别是在数据稀疏或隐私受限的环境中。然而，现有的通用时间序列基础模型由于其固有的挑战，如不规则间隔、异构采样率和频繁缺失值，难以处理医学时间序列数据。为了解决这些挑战，我们引入了MIRA，一个专门为医学时间序列预测设计的统一基础模型。MIRA包含一个连续时间旋转位置编码，能够对可变时间间隔进行细粒度建模；一个特定频率的专家混合层，可以跨潜在频率域路由计算，以进一步促进时间专业化；以及一个基于神经ODE的连续动态外rapolation块，用于模拟潜在状态的连续轨迹，从而能够在任意目标时间戳上进行准确预测。MIRA在包含超过4540亿个时间点的大规模、多样化的医学语料库上进行了预训练，这些数据来自公开可用的数据集，与其他的零样本和微调基线相比，在分布外和分布内场景下的预测误差分别平均降低了10%和7%。我们还引入了一个涵盖多个下游临床任务的综合基准，为未来医学时间序列建模的研究奠定了基础。
AI.summary: MIRA是一个针对医学时间序列数据（如不规则间隔、异构采样率、缺失值）设计的统一基础模型。它通过引入连续时间旋转位置编码、专家混合层和基于神经ODE的连续动态外推块来解决这些挑战。在包含超过4540亿个时间点的大规模医学语料库上预训练后，MIRA在零样本和微调场景下均显著优于现有基线，平均误差降低了10%和7%。该研究还提出了一个包含多个下游临床任务的基准，为医学时间序列建模的研究提供了基础。
AI.keywords: 医学时间序列, 基础模型, MIRA, 时间序列预测, 神经ODE
AI.comments: MIRA模型在处理真实世界医学时间序列数据的挑战方面取得了显著进展，其创新的架构设计和大规模预训练是其成功的关键。然而，模型在不同临床环境下的泛化能力和可解释性仍需进一步研究。此外，引入一个全面的基准测试对于推动该领域的发展至关重要。

title: Edit Flows: Flow Matching with Edit Operations
summary:
Autoregressive generative models naturally generate variable-length
sequences, while non-autoregressive models struggle, often imposing rigid,
token-wise structures. We propose Edit Flows, a non-autoregressive model that
overcomes these limitations by defining a discrete flow over sequences through
edit operations$\unicode{x2013}$insertions, deletions, and substitutions. By
modeling these operations within a Continuous-time Markov Chain over the
sequence space, Edit Flows enable flexible, position-relative generation that
aligns more closely with the structure of sequence data. Our training method
leverages an expanded state space with auxiliary variables, making the learning
process efficient and tractable. Empirical results show that Edit Flows
outperforms both autoregressive and mask models on image captioning and
significantly outperforms the mask construction in text and code generation.

AI.title_translation: 编辑流：带有编辑操作的流匹配
AI.tldr: Edit Flows是一种新的非自回归序列生成方法，它使用编辑操作（插入、删除、替换）来定义离散流，并通过连续时间马尔可夫链建模，从而能灵活生成可变长度序列，并在多项任务中超越了自回归和掩码模型。
AI.motivation: 现有的自回归模型可以生成可变长度序列，而非自回归模型在处理可变长度时存在局限性，通常强加刚性的、逐个标记的结构。动机是开发一种非自回归模型，克服这些限制，实现更灵活的、与序列数据结构更贴近的生成。
AI.method: 提出Edit Flows，一个通过插入、删除和替换等编辑操作在序列上定义离散流的非自回归模型。通过在序列空间上的连续时间马尔可夫链中对这些操作进行建模，并利用包含辅助变量的扩展状态空间进行高效可行的训练。
AI.result: Edit Flows在图像描述任务上优于自回归模型和掩码模型，在文本和代码生成任务上显著优于掩码构建方法。
AI.conclusion: Edit Flows在图像描述、文本和代码生成任务上表现出色，优于现有的自回归模型和掩码模型。
AI.translation: 自回归生成模型自然地生成可变长度序列，而非自回归模型则难以做到，通常强加刚性的、逐个标记的结构。我们提出了Edit Flows，一个非自回归模型，它通过在序列上定义一个由编辑操作——插入、删除和替换——构成的离散流来克服这些限制。通过在序列空间的连续时间马尔可夫链中对这些操作进行建模，Edit Flows实现了灵活的、与位置相关的生成，这更贴近序列数据的结构。我们的训练方法利用了带有辅助变量的扩展状态空间，使学习过程高效且可行。实证结果表明，Edit Flows在图像描述任务上优于自回归模型和掩码模型，在文本和代码生成任务上显著优于掩码构建方法。
AI.summary: Edit Flows是一种新颖的非自回归序列生成模型，它通过将插入、删除和替换等编辑操作建模为连续时间马尔可夫链上的离散流，从而克服了传统非自回归模型在处理可变长度序列时的结构僵化问题。该方法利用扩展状态空间进行高效训练，并在图像描述、文本和代码生成等任务上取得了优于现有方法的性能。
AI.keywords: 编辑流,非自回归模型,序列生成,编辑操作,连续时间马尔可夫链
AI.comments: Edit Flows的创新之处在于将离散的序列生成问题转化为基于编辑操作的连续时间马尔可夫链上的离散流建模，这有效地解决了非自回归模型在处理可变长度序列时的结构僵化问题。其重要性在于为序列生成提供了一种新的、更灵活的非自回归范式。局限性在于抽象中没有详细说明其在特定任务上的计算效率或泛化能力。

title: How Far Have LLMs Come Toward Automated SATD Taxonomy Construction?
summary:
Technical debt refers to suboptimal code that degrades software quality. When
developers intentionally introduce such debt, it is called self-admitted
technical debt (SATD). Since SATD hinders maintenance, identifying its
categories is key to uncovering quality issues. Traditionally, constructing
such taxonomies requires manually inspecting SATD comments and surrounding
code, which is time-consuming, labor-intensive, and often inconsistent due to
annotator subjectivity. In this study, we investigated to what extent large
language models (LLMs) could generate SATD taxonomies. We designed a
structured, LLM-driven pipeline that mirrors the taxonomy construction steps
researchers typically follow. We evaluated it on SATD datasets from three
domains: quantum software, smart contracts, and machine learning. It
successfully recovered domain-specific categories reported in prior work, such
as Layer Configuration in machine learning. It also completed taxonomy
generation in under two hours and for less than $1, even on the largest
dataset. These results suggest that, while full automation remains challenging,
LLMs can support semi-automated SATD taxonomy construction. Furthermore, our
work opens up avenues for future work, such as automated taxonomy generation in
other areas.

AI.title_translation: 大型语言模型在自动化SATD分类法构建方面取得了多大进展？
AI.tldr: 该研究评估了大型语言模型（LLM）在构建自承认技术债务（SATD）分类法方面的能力。研究人员设计了一个LLM驱动的流程，并在三个领域的SATD数据集上进行了评估。结果表明，LLM能够恢复特定领域的类别，并在短时间内以低成本完成分类法生成，表明LLM可用于半自动SATD分类法构建。
AI.motivation: 传统上，SATD分类法的构建需要手动检查SATD注释和周围代码，这是一个耗时、劳动密集且可能不一致的过程。本研究旨在探索大型语言模型（LLM）在自动化SATD分类法构建方面的潜力。
AI.method: 研究人员设计了一个结构化的、由LLM驱动的流程，该流程模仿了研究人员通常遵循的分类法构建步骤。该流程在来自三个领域（量子软件、智能合约和机器学习）的SATD数据集上进行了评估。
AI.result: 该LLM驱动的方法成功地恢复了先前工作中报道的特定领域类别（例如，机器学习中的层配置）。它还在不到两个小时的时间内完成了分类法生成，成本不到1美元，即使是最大的数据集也是如此。
AI.conclusion: 虽然完全自动化仍然具有挑战性，但LLM可以支持SATD分类法的半自动构建。该研究为未来在其他领域进行自动分类法生成开辟了道路。
AI.translation: 技术债务是指会降低软件质量的次优代码。当开发人员有意引入此类债务时，称为自承认技术债务（SATD）。由于SATD会阻碍维护，因此识别其类别是揭示质量问题的关键。传统上，构建此类分类法需要手动检查SATD注释和周围代码，这既耗时又耗力，而且由于注释者的主观性，结果往往不一致。在本研究中，我们调查了大型语言模型（LLM）在多大程度上可以生成SATD分类法。我们设计了一个结构化的、由LLM驱动的流程，该流程模仿了研究人员通常遵循的分类法构建步骤。我们在来自三个领域的数据集上对其进行了评估：量子软件、智能合约和机器学习。它成功地恢复了先前工作中报道的特定领域类别，例如机器学习中的层配置。它还在不到两个小时的时间内完成了分类法生成，成本不到1美元，即使是最大的数据集也是如此。这些结果表明，虽然完全自动化仍然具有挑战性，但LLM可以支持SATD分类法的半自动构建。此外，我们的工作为未来的工作开辟了道路，例如在其他领域进行自动分类法生成。
AI.summary: 本研究评估了大型语言模型（LLM）在构建自承认技术债务（SATD）分类法方面的能力。通过设计一个模仿传统研究流程的LLM驱动流程，并在三个不同领域的SATD数据集上进行评估，研究人员发现LLM能够有效识别特定领域的SATD类别，并以较低的成本和时间完成了分类法构建。尽管完全自动化仍有待实现，但LLM在支持SATD分类法的半自动构建方面显示出巨大潜力。
AI.keywords: 自承认技术债务, 分类法构建, 大型语言模型, 软件工程, 技术债务
AI.comments: 这项研究有效地利用了LLM来解决SATD分类法构建中的手动限制。LLM在恢复已知类别和在成本效益方面取得的成果令人印象深刻。然而，该研究可能需要进一步探讨LLM生成的新颖或以前未识别的类别，以及评估这些自动生成分类法的准确性和实用性。

title: Execution Guided Line-by-Line Code Generation
summary:
We present a novel approach to neural code generation that incorporates
real-time execution signals into the language model generation process. While
large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive code generation
capabilities, they typically do not utilize execution feedback during
inference, a critical signal that human programmers regularly leverage. Our
method, Execution-Guided Classifier-Free Guidance (EG-CFG), dynamically
incorporates execution signals as the model generates code, providing
line-by-line feedback that guides the generation process toward executable
solutions. EG-CFG employs a multi-stage process: first, we conduct beam search
to sample candidate program completions for each line; second, we extract
execution signals by executing these candidates against test cases; and
finally, we incorporate these signals into the prompt during generation. By
maintaining consistent signals across tokens within the same line and
refreshing signals at line boundaries, our approach provides coherent guidance
while preserving syntactic structure. Moreover, the method naturally supports
native parallelism at the task level in which multiple agents operate in
parallel, exploring diverse reasoning paths and collectively generating a broad
set of candidate solutions. Our experiments across diverse coding tasks
demonstrate that EG-CFG significantly improves code generation performance
compared to standard approaches, achieving state-of-the-art results across
various levels of complexity, from foundational problems to challenging
competitive programming and data science tasks. Our code is available at:
https://github.com/boazlavon/eg_cfg

title: Engineering Fast and Space-Efficient Recompression from SLP-Compressed Text
summary:
Compressed indexing enables powerful queries over massive and repetitive
textual datasets using space proportional to the compressed input. While
theoretical advances have led to highly efficient index structures, their
practical construction remains a bottleneck, especially for complex components
like recompression RLSLP, a grammar-based representation crucial for building
powerful text indexes that support widely used suffix and LCP array queries.
  In this work, we present the first implementation of recompression RLSLP
construction that runs in compressed time, operating on an LZ77-like
approximation of the input. Compared to state-of-the-art uncompressed-time
methods, our approach achieves up to $46\times$ speedup and $17\times$ lower
RAM usage on large, repetitive inputs. These gains unlock scalability to larger
datasets and affirm compressed computation as a practical path forward for fast
index construction.

title: What Happens During the Loss Plateau? Understanding Abrupt Learning in Transformers
summary:
Training Transformers on algorithmic tasks frequently demonstrates an
intriguing abrupt learning phenomenon: an extended performance plateau followed
by a sudden, sharp improvement. This work investigates the underlying
mechanisms for such dynamics, primarily in shallow Transformers. We reveal that
during the plateau, the model often develops an interpretable partial solution
while simultaneously exhibiting a strong repetition bias in their outputs. This
output degeneracy is accompanied by internal representation collapse, where
hidden states across different tokens become nearly parallel. We further
identify the slow learning of optimal attention maps as a key bottleneck.
Hidden progress in attention configuration during the plateau precedes the
eventual rapid convergence, and directly intervening on attention significantly
alters plateau duration and the severity of repetition bias and
representational collapse. We validate that these identified
phenomena-repetition bias and representation collapse-are not artifacts of toy
setups but also manifest in the early pre-training stage of large language
models like Pythia and OLMo.

title: AssistedDS: Benchmarking How External Domain Knowledge Assists LLMs in Automated Data Science
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) have advanced the automation of data science
workflows. Yet it remains unclear whether they can critically leverage external
domain knowledge as human data scientists do in practice. To answer this
question, we introduce AssistedDS (Assisted Data Science), a benchmark designed
to systematically evaluate how LLMs handle domain knowledge in tabular
prediction tasks. AssistedDS features both synthetic datasets with explicitly
known generative mechanisms and real-world Kaggle competitions, each
accompanied by curated bundles of helpful and adversarial documents. These
documents provide domain-specific insights into data cleaning, feature
engineering, and model selection. We assess state-of-the-art LLMs on their
ability to discern and apply beneficial versus harmful domain knowledge,
evaluating submission validity, information recall, and predictive performance.
Our results demonstrate three key findings: (1) LLMs frequently exhibit an
uncritical adoption of provided information, significantly impairing their
predictive performance when adversarial content is introduced, (2) helpful
guidance is often insufficient to counteract the negative influence of
adversarial information, and (3) in Kaggle datasets, LLMs often make errors in
handling time-series data, applying consistent feature engineering across
different folds, and interpreting categorical variables correctly. These
findings highlight a substantial gap in current models' ability to critically
evaluate and leverage expert knowledge, underscoring an essential research
direction for developing more robust, knowledge-aware automated data science
systems. Our data and code are publicly available here:
https://github.com/jeremyxianx/Assisted-DS

title: Structured Generative Modeling with the Thermodynamic Kolmogorov-Arnold Model
summary:
Learning an energy-based model (EBM) in the latent space of a top-down
generative model offers a versatile framework for generation across multiple
data modalities. However, it remains unclear how its interpretability can be
used to guide model design, improve generative quality, and reduce training
time. Moreover, the reliance on Langevin Monte Carlo (LMC) sampling presents
challenges in efficiency and sampling multimodal latent distributions. In this
work, we propose a novel adaptation of the Kolmogorov-Arnold representation
theorem for generative modeling and introduce the Thermodynamic
Kolmogorov-Arnold Model (T-KAM) to take advantage of structural and inductive
biases. By constraining the prior to univariate relationships, T-KAM enables
fast and exact inference via the inverse transform method. With the low
dimensionality of the latent space and suitable inductive biases encoded, we
demonstrate that importance sampling (IS) becomes a viable, unbiased, and
highly efficient posterior sampler. For situations where IS fails, we
investigate a novel strategy using population-based LMC, which decomposes
posterior sampling into a sequence of annealed distributions to improve
multimodal sampling. T-KAM elegantly balances common trade-offs in generative
modeling, offering fast inference, interpretability, and stable training, while
being naturally suited to upcoming Zettascale Computing Corp. hardware.

title: Equivariance Everywhere All At Once: A Recipe for Graph Foundation Models
summary:
Graph machine learning architectures are typically tailored to specific tasks
on specific datasets, which hinders their broader applicability. This has led
to a new quest in graph machine learning: how to build graph foundation models
capable of generalizing across arbitrary graphs and features? In this work, we
present a recipe for designing graph foundation models for node-level tasks
from first principles. The key ingredient underpinning our study is a
systematic investigation of the symmetries that a graph foundation model must
respect. In a nutshell, we argue that label permutation-equivariance alongside
feature permutation-invariance are necessary in addition to the common node
permutation-equivariance on each local neighborhood of the graph. To this end,
we first characterize the space of linear transformations that are equivariant
to permutations of nodes and labels, and invariant to permutations of features.
We then prove that the resulting network is a universal approximator on
multisets that respect the aforementioned symmetries. Our recipe uses such
layers on the multiset of features induced by the local neighborhood of the
graph to obtain a class of graph foundation models for node property
prediction. We validate our approach through extensive experiments on 29
real-world node classification datasets, demonstrating both strong zero-shot
empirical performance and consistent improvement as the number of training
graphs increases.

title: MoORE: SVD-based Model MoE-ization for Conflict- and Oblivion-Resistant Multi-Task Adaptation
summary:
Adapting large-scale foundation models in multi-task scenarios often suffers
from task conflict and oblivion. To mitigate such issues, we propose a novel
''model MoE-ization'' strategy that leads to a conflict- and oblivion-resistant
multi-task adaptation method. Given a weight matrix of a pre-trained model, our
method applies SVD to it and introduces a learnable router to adjust its
singular values based on tasks and samples. Accordingly, the weight matrix
becomes a Mixture of Orthogonal Rank-one Experts (MoORE), in which each expert
corresponds to the outer product of a left singular vector and the
corresponding right one. We can improve the model capacity by imposing a
learnable orthogonal transform on the right singular vectors. Unlike low-rank
adaptation (LoRA) and its MoE-driven variants, MoORE guarantees the experts'
orthogonality and maintains the column space of the original weight matrix.
These two properties make the adapted model resistant to the conflicts among
the new tasks and the oblivion of its original tasks, respectively. Experiments
on various datasets demonstrate that MoORE outperforms existing multi-task
adaptation methods consistently, showing its superiority in terms of conflict-
and oblivion-resistance. The code of the experiments is available at
https://github.com/DaShenZi721/MoORE.

title: SR-NCL: an Area-/Energy-Efficient Resilient NCL Architecture Based on Selective Redundancy
comments:

  2025
summary:
Duplication-based redundancy schemes have proven to be effective in designing
fully-resilient Quasi-delay Insensitive (QDI) asynchronous circuits. The
complete resiliency, however, is accompanied by significant energy, latency,
and area overhead. This paper presents a novel error-tolerant Null Convention
Logic (NCL) architecture based on selective redundancy. Results demonstrate the
efficacy of the proposed method in terms of area and energy utilization as
compared to existing duplication-based NCL designs, targeting an image
processing application.

title: Watermarking Autoregressive Image Generation
summary:
Watermarking the outputs of generative models has emerged as a promising
approach for tracking their provenance. Despite significant interest in
autoregressive image generation models and their potential for misuse, no prior
work has attempted to watermark their outputs at the token level. In this work,
we present the first such approach by adapting language model watermarking
techniques to this setting. We identify a key challenge: the lack of reverse
cycle-consistency (RCC), wherein re-tokenizing generated image tokens
significantly alters the token sequence, effectively erasing the watermark. To
address this and to make our method robust to common image transformations,
neural compression, and removal attacks, we introduce (i) a custom
tokenizer-detokenizer finetuning procedure that improves RCC, and (ii) a
complementary watermark synchronization layer. As our experiments demonstrate,
our approach enables reliable and robust watermark detection with theoretically
grounded p-values. Code and models are available at
https://github.com/facebookresearch/wmar.

title: Flow based approach for Dynamic Temporal Causal models with non-Gaussian or Heteroscedastic Noises
summary:
Understanding causal relationships in multivariate time series is crucial in
many scenarios, such as those dealing with financial or neurological data. Many
such time series exhibit multiple regimes, i.e., consecutive temporal segments
with a priori unknown boundaries, with each regime having its own causal
structure. Inferring causal dependencies and regime shifts is critical for
analyzing the underlying processes. However, causal structure learning in this
setting is challenging due to (1) non-stationarity, i.e., each regime can have
its own causal graph and mixing function, and (2) complex noise distributions,
which may be nonGaussian or heteroscedastic. Existing causal discovery
approaches cannot address these challenges, since generally assume stationarity
or Gaussian noise with constant variance. Hence, we introduce FANTOM, a unified
framework for causal discovery that handles non-stationary processes along with
non-Gaussian and heteroscedastic noises. FANTOM simultaneously infers the
number of regimes and their corresponding indices and learns each regime's
Directed Acyclic Graph. It uses a Bayesian Expectation Maximization algorithm
that maximizes the evidence lower bound of the data log-likelihood. On the
theoretical side, we prove, under mild assumptions, that temporal
heteroscedastic causal models, introduced in FANTOM's formulation, are
identifiable in both stationary and non-stationary settings. In addition,
extensive experiments on synthetic and real data show that FANTOM outperforms
existing methods.

title: ReDit: Reward Dithering for Improved LLM Policy Optimization
summary:
DeepSeek-R1 has successfully enhanced Large Language Model (LLM) reasoning
capabilities through its rule-based reward system. While it's a ''perfect''
reward system that effectively mitigates reward hacking, such reward functions
are often discrete. Our experimental observations suggest that discrete rewards
can lead to gradient anomaly, unstable optimization, and slow convergence. To
address this issue, we propose ReDit (Reward Dithering), a method that dithers
the discrete reward signal by adding simple random noise. With this perturbed
reward, exploratory gradients are continuously provided throughout the learning
process, enabling smoother gradient updates and accelerating convergence. The
injected noise also introduces stochasticity into flat reward regions,
encouraging the model to explore novel policies and escape local optima.
Experiments across diverse tasks demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency
of ReDit. On average, ReDit achieves performance comparable to vanilla GRPO
with only approximately 10% the training steps, and furthermore, still exhibits
a 4% performance improvement over vanilla GRPO when trained for a similar
duration. Visualizations confirm significant mitigation of gradient issues with
ReDit. Moreover, theoretical analyses are provided to further validate these
advantages.

title: Prover Agent: An Agent-Based Framework for Formal Mathematical Proofs
summary:
We present Prover Agent, a novel AI agent for automated theorem proving that
integrates large language models (LLMs) with a formal proof assistant, Lean.
Prover Agent coordinates an informal reasoning LLM, a formal prover model, and
feedback from Lean while also generating auxiliary lemmas. These auxiliary
lemmas are not limited to subgoals in the formal proof but can also include
special cases or potentially useful facts derived from the assumptions, which
help in discovering a viable proof strategy. It achieves an 88.1% success rate
on the MiniF2F benchmark, establishing a new state-of-the-art among methods
using small language models (SLMs) with a much lower sample budget than
previous approaches. We also present theoretical analyses and case studies that
illustrate how these generated lemmas contribute to solving challenging
problems. Our code is publicly available at:
https://github.com/kAIto47802/Prover-Agent.

title: Secure Multi-Key Homomorphic Encryption with Application to Privacy-Preserving Federated Learning
summary:
Multi-Key Homomorphic Encryption (MKHE), proposed by Lopez-Alt et al. (STOC
2012), allows for performing arithmetic computations directly on ciphertexts
encrypted under distinct keys. Subsequent works by Chen and Dai et al. (CCS
2019) and Kim and Song et al. (CCS 2023) extended this concept by proposing
multi-key BFV/CKKS variants, referred to as the CDKS scheme. These variants
incorporate asymptotically optimal techniques to facilitate secure computation
across multiple data providers. In this paper, we identify a critical security
vulnerability in the CDKS scheme when applied to multiparty secure computation
tasks, such as privacy-preserving federated learning (PPFL). In particular, we
show that CDKS may inadvertently leak plaintext information from one party to
others. To mitigate this issue, we propose a new scheme, SMHE (Secure Multi-Key
Homomorphic Encryption), which incorporates a novel masking mechanism into the
multi-key BFV and CKKS frameworks to ensure that plaintexts remain confidential
throughout the computation. We implement a PPFL application using SMHE and
demonstrate that it provides significantly improved security with only a modest
overhead in homomorphic evaluation. For instance, our PPFL model based on
multi-key CKKS incurs less than a 2\times runtime and communication traffic
increase compared to the CDKS-based PPFL model. The code is publicly available
at https://github.com/JiahuiWu2022/SMHE.git.

title: Inverse source problem with a posteriori interior measurements for space-time fractional diffusion equations
summary:
This paper investigates an inverse source problem for space-time fractional
diffusion equations from a posteriori interior measurements. The uniqueness
result is established by the memory effect of fractional derivatives and the
unique continuation property. For the numerical reconstruction, the inverse
problem is reformulated as an optimization problem with the Tikhonov
regularization. We use the Levenberg-Marquardt method to identity the unknown
source from noisy measurements. Finally, we give some numerical examples to
illustrate the efficiency and accuracy of the proposed algorithm.

title: Learning Modular Exponentiation with Transformers
comments: Accepted at the 5th MATH-AI Workshop, NeurIPS'25
summary:
Modular exponentiation is crucial to number theory and cryptography, yet
remains largely unexplored from a mechanistic interpretability standpoint. We
train a 4-layer encoder-decoder Transformer model to perform this operation and
investigate the emergence of numerical reasoning during training. Utilizing
principled sampling strategies, PCA-based embedding analysis, and activation
patching, we examine how number-theoretic properties are encoded within the
model. We find that reciprocal operand training leads to strong performance
gains, with sudden generalization across related moduli. These synchronized
accuracy surges reflect grokking-like dynamics, suggesting the model
internalizes shared arithmetic structure. We also find a subgraph consisting
entirely of attention heads in the final layer sufficient to achieve full
performance on the task of regular exponentiation. These results suggest that
transformer models learn modular arithmetic through specialized computational
circuits, paving the way for more interpretable and efficient neural approaches
to modular exponentiation.

title: PlantSegNeRF: A few-shot, cross-species method for plant 3D instance point cloud reconstruction via joint-channel NeRF with multi-view image instance matching
summary:
Organ segmentation of plant point clouds is a prerequisite for the
high-resolution and accurate extraction of organ-level phenotypic traits.
Although the fast development of deep learning has boosted much research on
segmentation of plant point clouds, the existing techniques for organ
segmentation still face limitations in resolution, segmentation accuracy, and
generalizability across various plant species. In this study, we proposed a
novel approach called plant segmentation neural radiance fields (PlantSegNeRF),
aiming to directly generate high-precision instance point clouds from
multi-view RGB image sequences for a wide range of plant species. PlantSegNeRF
performed 2D instance segmentation on the multi-view images to generate
instance masks for each organ with a corresponding ID. The multi-view instance
IDs corresponding to the same plant organ were then matched and refined using a
specially designed instance matching module. The instance NeRF was developed to
render an implicit scene, containing color, density, semantic and instance
information. The implicit scene was ultimately converted into high-precision
plant instance point clouds based on the volume density. The results proved
that in semantic segmentation of point clouds, PlantSegNeRF outperformed the
commonly used methods, demonstrating an average improvement of 16.1%, 18.3%,
17.8%, and 24.2% in precision, recall, F1-score, and IoU compared to the
second-best results on structurally complex species. More importantly,
PlantSegNeRF exhibited significant advantages in plant point cloud instance
segmentation tasks. Across all plant species, it achieved average improvements
of 11.7%, 38.2%, 32.2% and 25.3% in mPrec, mRec, mCov, mWCov, respectively.
This study extends the organ-level plant phenotyping and provides a
high-throughput way to supply high-quality 3D data for the development of
large-scale models in plant science.

title: Serving LLMs in HPC Clusters: A Comparative Study of Qualcomm Cloud AI 100 Ultra and NVIDIA Data Center GPUs
summary:
This study presents a benchmarking analysis of the Qualcomm Cloud AI 100
Ultra (QAic) accelerator for large language model (LLM) inference, evaluating
its energy efficiency (throughput per watt), performance, and hardware
scalability against NVIDIA A100 GPUs (in 4x and 8x configurations) within the
National Research Platform (NRP) ecosystem. A total of 12 open-source LLMs,
ranging from 124 million to 70 billion parameters, are served using the vLLM
framework. Our analysis reveals that QAic achieves competitive energy
efficiency with advantages on specific models while enabling more granular
hardware allocation: some 70B models operate on as few as 1 QAic card versus 8
A100 GPUs required, with 20x lower power consumption (148W vs 2,983W). For
smaller models, single QAic devices achieve up to 35x lower power consumption
compared to our 4-GPU A100 configuration (36W vs 1,246W). The findings offer
insights into the potential of the Qualcomm Cloud AI 100 Ultra for
energy-constrained and resource-efficient HPC deployments within the National
Research Platform (NRP).
