AI.title_translation: 超越静态知识信使：迈向医疗AI的自适应、公平和可扩展的联邦学习
AI.tldr: 针对医疗联邦学习的慢收敛、不公平和低扩展性问题，本文提出了AFFL框架，通过动态信使、公平蒸馏和加速技术，实现了显著的效率和公平性提升，并发布了MedFedBench基准。
AI.motivation: 现有的联邦学习方法在医疗AI中存在隐私保护协作学习的挑战，具体表现为静态架构、收敛速度慢（45-73轮）、边缘化小型机构的公平性差距以及可扩展性限制（15个客户端限制）。
AI.method: 提出自适应公平联邦学习（AFFL），包含三个核心创新：（1）自适应知识信使，根据异构性和任务复杂性动态调整容量；（2）公平感知蒸馏，使用影响加权聚合；（3）课程引导加速，以减少训练轮次。并进行了理论收敛性分析。
AI.result: 理论分析保证了收敛性，达到了 $O(T^{-1/2}) + O(H_{max}/T^{3/4})$ 的速率。实验结果预计可实现55-75%的通信减少、56-68%的公平性提升、34-46%的能源节约，并支持100多个机构。经济效益预测对农村医院有400-800%的投资回报率。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提出了自适应、公平和可扩展的联邦学习框架（AFFL），解决了医疗AI中合作学习的隐私、公平性和效率挑战，并为该领域设定了标准化的评估基准（MedFedBench）和未来的研究方向。
AI.translation: 医疗AI在确保隐私保护的协作学习，同时确保跨异构医疗机构的公平性方面面临挑战。现有的联邦学习方法存在静态架构、收敛缓慢（45-73轮）、边缘化小型机构的公平性差距以及可扩展性限制（15个客户端限制）。我们通过三项创新提出了自适应公平联邦学习（AFFL）：(1) 自适应知识信使，根据异构性和任务复杂性动态调整容量；(2) 公平感知蒸馏，使用影响加权聚合；(3) 课程引导加速，将训练轮次减少60-70%。我们的理论分析提供了具有 $\epsilon$-公平性边界的收敛保证，达到了 $O(T^{-1/2}) + O(H_{max}/T^{3/4})$ 的速率。预测结果显示，通信减少55-75%，公平性提高56-68%，能源节约34-46%，并支持100多个机构。该框架支持跨影像、基因组学、EHR和传感器数据的多模态集成，同时保持HIPAA/GDPR合规性。我们提出了MedFedBench基准套件，用于跨越六个医疗维度的标准化评估：收敛效率、机构公平性、隐私保护、多模态集成、可扩展性和临床部署准备度。经济预测表明，农村医院的投资回报率（ROI）为400-800%，学术中心的性能提升为15-25%。这项工作提出了一个七个问题的研究议程、一个24个月的实施路线图以及实现医疗AI民主化的途径。
AI.summary: 本文针对医疗AI中联邦学习面临的静态架构、收敛慢、公平性不足和可扩展性差的问题，提出了自适应公平联邦学习（AFFL）框架。该框架通过自适应知识信使、公平感知蒸馏和课程引导加速三大创新来提高效率和公平性，并引入了MedFedBench基准套件进行标准化评估。
AI.keywords: 联邦学习, 医疗AI, 公平性, 自适应学习, 知识信使
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了一个集成了自适应知识信使、公平感知蒸馏和课程学习加速的综合框架（AFFL），旨在解决现有联邦学习在医疗领域中面临的静态架构、收敛慢、公平性差和可扩展性差等关键问题。其理论分析和量化结果表明了显著的性能提升，特别是对于小型机构的公平性和整体效率。研究的全面性（引入MedFedBench）和对未来研究的规划是其重要贡献。

title: Relational Transformer: Toward Zero-Shot Foundation Models for Relational Data
summary:
Pretrained transformers readily adapt to new sequence modeling tasks via
zero-shot prompting, but relational domains still lack architectures that
transfer across datasets and tasks. The core challenge is the diversity of
relational data, with varying heterogeneous schemas, graph structures and
functional dependencies. In this paper, we present the Relational Transformer
(RT) architecture, which can be pretrained on diverse relational databases and
directly applied to unseen datasets and tasks without task- or dataset-specific
fine-tuning, or retrieval of in-context examples. RT (i) tokenizes cells with
table/column metadata, (ii) is pretrained via masked token prediction, and
(iii) utilizes a novel Relational Attention mechanism over columns, rows, and
primary-foreign key links. Pretrained on RelBench datasets spanning tasks such
as churn and sales forecasting, RT attains strong zero-shot performance,
averaging 93% of fully supervised AUROC on binary classification tasks with a
single forward pass of a 22M parameter model, as opposed to 84% for a 27B LLM.
Fine-tuning yields state-of-the-art results with high sample efficiency. Our
experiments show that RT's zero-shot transfer harnesses task-table context,
relational attention patterns and schema semantics. Overall, RT provides a
practical path toward foundation models for relational data.

AI.title_translation: 关系Transformer：迈向关系数据的零样本基础模型
AI.tldr: 研究人员开发了一种名为关系Transformer（RT）的新模型，专门用于处理关系数据（如数据库表）。RT通过一种新的“关系注意力”机制，可以在不进行任何微调的情况下，在新任务和数据集上表现出色，性能优于大型语言模型，为构建关系数据的通用基础模型铺平了道路。
AI.motivation: 现有的预训练Transformer模型在序列任务上易于适应新任务，但关系领域缺乏能够跨数据集和任务迁移的架构，核心挑战在于关系数据的异构模式、图结构和函数依赖的多样性。
AI.method: RT架构通过 (i) 使用表/列元数据标记单元格，(ii) 通过掩码令牌预测进行预训练，以及 (iii) 利用一种新颖的跨列、行和主外键链接的关系注意力机制来实现。
AI.result: 在跨越流失和销售预测等任务的RelBench数据集上进行预训练后，RT在二元分类任务上平均达到了完全监督AUROC的93%，仅使用22M参数模型进行单次前向传播，而一个27B LLM仅达到84%。微调后可获得具有高样本效率的最新结果。
AI.conclusion: RT提供了一条实现关系数据基座模型的实用途径，其零样本迁移能力源于任务-表上下文、关系注意力模式和模式语义的协同作用。
AI.translation: 预训练的Transformer模型可以通过零样本提示轻松适应新的序列建模任务，但关系领域仍然缺乏跨数据集和任务迁移的架构。核心挑战在于关系数据（具有不同的异构模式、图结构和函数依赖性）的多样性。在本文中，我们提出了关系Transformer（RT）架构，它可以对多样化的关系数据库进行预训练，并直接应用于未见的数据集和任务，而无需进行特定于任务或数据集的微调，或检索上下文中的示例。RT (i) 使用表/列元数据标记单元格，(ii) 通过掩码令牌预测进行预训练，以及 (iii) 利用一种新颖的跨列、行和主外键链接的关系注意力机制。在跨越流失和销售预测等任务的RelBench数据集上进行预训练后，RT在二元分类任务上平均达到了完全监督AUROC的93%，仅使用22M参数模型进行单次前向传播，而一个27B LLM仅达到84%。微调后可获得具有高样本效率的最新结果。我们的实验表明，RT的零样本迁移能力利用了任务-表上下文、关系注意力模式和模式语义。总而言之，RT为关系数据的基座模型提供了一条实用的途径。
AI.summary: 本文提出了关系Transformer（RT），一种新的架构，旨在解决现有预训练模型在多样化关系数据上缺乏泛化性的问题。RT通过特殊的元数据标记和关系注意力机制进行预训练，实现了在未见数据集和任务上的零样本迁移能力，并在基准测试中取得了超越大型语言模型的出色性能。
AI.keywords: 关系Transformer, 零样本学习, 关系数据, 预训练模型, 关系注意力
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了一个专门用于关系数据的Transformer架构（RT），解决了现有预训练模型在关系数据上的泛化性差的问题。它通过新颖的关系注意力机制实现了零样本（Zero-Shot）迁移，并在性能上超越了大型语言模型（LLM），这对于关系数据领域的基座模型研究具有重要意义。限制在于模型规模（22M参数）与性能的对比，虽然表现出色，但未来需要更深入地探究其在更大规模数据上的潜力。

title: Stress-Testing Model Specs Reveals Character Differences among Language Models
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly trained from AI constitutions
and model specifications that establish behavioral guidelines and ethical
principles. However, these specifications face critical challenges, including
internal conflicts between principles and insufficient coverage of nuanced
scenarios. We present a systematic methodology for stress-testing model
character specifications, automatically identifying numerous cases of principle
contradictions and interpretive ambiguities in current model specs.
  We stress test current model specs by generating scenarios that force
explicit tradeoffs between competing value-based principles. Using a
comprehensive taxonomy we generate diverse value tradeoff scenarios where
models must choose between pairs of legitimate principles that cannot be
simultaneously satisfied. We evaluate responses from twelve frontier LLMs
across major providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, xAI) and measure behavioral
disagreement through value classification scores. Among these scenarios, we
identify over 70,000 cases exhibiting significant behavioral divergence.
Empirically, we show this high divergence in model behavior strongly predicts
underlying problems in model specifications. Through qualitative analysis, we
provide numerous example issues in current model specs such as direct
contradiction and interpretive ambiguities of several principles. Additionally,
our generated dataset also reveals both clear misalignment cases and
false-positive refusals across all of the frontier models we study. Lastly, we
also provide value prioritization patterns and differences of these models.

AI.title_translation: 压力测试模型规范揭示了语言模型之间的特性差异
AI.tldr: 研究人员开发了一种压力测试方法来检查指导LLMs行为的规范（specs），发现这些规范充满了相互矛盾和模糊不清的地方。对十二个领先模型的测试显示，它们在面对价值冲突时表现出巨大的、可量化的行为差异，这些差异直接暴露了规范设计中的缺陷。
AI.motivation: 现有LLMs的行为准则（AI 规范和模型规范）面临内部原则冲突和对细微场景覆盖不足的挑战。需要一种方法来系统地识别这些规范中的缺陷。
AI.method: 提出了一种系统性的方法来对模型规范进行压力测试，通过生成强制在相互竞争的价值原则之间进行明确权衡的场景。使用一个全面的分类法来生成这些场景，并评估了十二个前沿LLMs的响应，通过价值分类分数来衡量行为分歧。
AI.result: 识别出超过70,000个表现出显著行为分歧的案例，证明了模型行为的高度分歧强烈预示了模型规范中存在潜在问题。通过定性分析，发现了当前规范中存在的直接矛盾和解释性歧义等具体问题，并揭示了所有研究的前沿模型中都存在明确的错位案例和误报拒绝（false-positive refusals）。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了当前模型规范中存在大量原则上的矛盾和解释上的歧义，并展示了前沿LLMs在价值权衡任务上存在显著的行为分歧，这些分歧与模型规范的缺陷高度相关。研究还提供了模型价值优先级模式和差异的分析。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地从AI宪法和模型规范中进行训练，这些规范建立了行为准则和道德原则。然而，这些规范面临着关键挑战，包括原则之间的内部冲突和对细微场景覆盖不足的问题。我们提出了一种系统性的方法来对模型特性规范进行压力测试，自动识别当前模型规范中大量的原则矛盾和解释性歧义案例。我们通过生成强制在相互竞争的价值原则之间进行明确权衡的场景来对当前模型规范进行压力测试。我们使用一个全面的分类法生成了多样化的价值权衡场景，其中模型必须在两个不能同时满足的合法原则之间做出选择。我们评估了来自主要提供商（Anthropic、OpenAI、Google、xAI）的十二个前沿LLMs的响应，并通过价值分类分数来衡量行为分歧。在这些场景中，我们识别出超过70,000个表现出显著行为分歧的案例。实证研究表明，这种高分歧的模型行为强烈地预测了模型规范中存在的潜在问题。通过定性分析，我们提供了当前规范中许多示例问题，例如几个原则的直接矛盾和解释性歧义。此外，我们生成的[压力测试]数据集还揭示了我们研究的所有前沿模型中都存在的明确的错位案例和误报拒绝。最后，我们还提供了这些模型的价值优先级模式和差异。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种系统性的方法来对大型语言模型（LLMs）的行为规范进行压力测试，以识别规范中的内部冲突和解释性歧义。研究通过生成强制在相互竞争的价值原则间进行权衡的场景，测试了来自Anthropic、OpenAI、Google和xAI的十二个前沿LLMs。结果显示，模型在价值权衡任务中表现出超过70,000个显著的行为分歧案例，这强烈表明了当前模型规范的设计缺陷。研究还提供了对这些规范问题的定性分析和对不同模型价值优先级的模式比较。
AI.keywords: 模型规范压力测试, 价值权衡, LLM行为差异, 原则冲突, 行为分歧
AI.comments: 这项工作创新性地提出了一个系统性的方法来对大型语言模型的行为规范（Model Specs）进行压力测试，揭示了规范内部的冲突和模糊性。其重要性在于，它量化了不同前沿模型在面对价值权衡时的行为差异，并直接将这些差异与规范设计缺陷联系起来。局限性在于，分析仅基于生成的压力测试场景，可能无法完全覆盖现实世界中所有复杂的交互。

title: Curing Miracle Steps in LLM Mathematical Reasoning with Rubric Rewards
summary:
Large language models for mathematical reasoning are typically trained with
outcome-based rewards, which credit only the final answer. In our experiments,
we observe that this paradigm is highly susceptible to reward hacking, leading
to a substantial overestimation of a model's reasoning ability. This is
evidenced by a high incidence of false positives - solutions that reach the
correct final answer through an unsound reasoning process. Through a systematic
analysis with human verification, we establish a taxonomy of these failure
modes, identifying patterns like Miracle Steps - abrupt jumps to a correct
output without a valid preceding derivation. Probing experiments suggest a
strong association between these Miracle Steps and memorization, where the
model appears to recall the answer directly rather than deriving it. To
mitigate this systemic issue, we introduce the Rubric Reward Model (RRM), a
process-oriented reward function that evaluates the entire reasoning trajectory
against problem-specific rubrics. The generative RRM provides fine-grained,
calibrated rewards (0-1) that explicitly penalize logical flaws and encourage
rigorous deduction. When integrated into a reinforcement learning pipeline,
RRM-based training consistently outperforms outcome-only supervision across
four math benchmarks. Notably, it boosts Verified Pass@1024 on AIME2024 from
26.7% to 62.6% and reduces the incidence of Miracle Steps by 71%. Our work
demonstrates that rewarding the solution process is crucial for building models
that are not only more accurate but also more reliable.

AI.title_translation: LLM数学推理中的“奇迹步骤”与评分奖励
AI.tldr: 传统的基于最终答案的奖励机制会导致大型语言模型（LLM）在数学推理中出现“奇迹步骤”（即跳跃到正确答案而无有效推导过程）等问题。本文提出了一种基于评分标准的奖励模型（RRM），该模型会评估整个推理过程，并能有效减少“奇迹步骤”的发生，显著提升模型在数学基准测试上的准确性和可靠性。
AI.motivation: 传统的基于最终答案的奖励机制在LLM数学推理中容易出现奖励破解，导致对模型能力的过高估计，表现为通过不健全的推理过程得出正确答案（假阳性）。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为“评分奖励模型”（Rubric Reward Model, RRM）的、面向过程的奖励函数，该函数根据问题特定的评分标准评估整个推理轨迹，并提供精细化的（0-1）奖励，明确惩罚逻辑缺陷并鼓励严谨推导。将RRM集成到强化学习流程中进行训练。
AI.result: 在四个数学基准测试中，基于RRM的训练持续优于仅基于结果的监督。具体而言，在AIME2024上，Verified Pass@1024从26.7%提升到62.6%，并且“奇迹步骤”的发生率降低了71%。
AI.conclusion: 奖励解决方案的整个过程对于构建不仅更准确而且更可靠的模型至关重要。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型在数学推理方面通常采用基于结果的奖励进行训练，这种奖励只对最终答案进行评分。在我们的实验中，我们发现这种范式极易受到奖励破解的影响，导致对模型推理能力的严重过高估计。这表现为高发生率的假阳性——即通过不健全的推理过程得出正确最终答案的解决方案。通过系统性的人工验证分析，我们建立了一个这些失败模式的分类体系，识别出“奇迹步骤”等模式——即在没有有效先前推导的情况下突然跳跃到正确输出。探测性实验表明，“奇迹步骤”与记忆之间存在很强的关联，模型似乎直接回忆起答案而不是推导出它。为了缓解这个系统性问题，我们引入了评分奖励模型（RRM），一个面向过程的奖励函数，它根据问题特定的评分标准评估整个推理轨迹。生成式RRM提供精细化的、校准过的奖励（0-1），明确惩罚逻辑缺陷并鼓励严谨的推导。当集成到强化学习流程中时，基于RRM的训练在四个数学基准测试中持续优于仅基于结果的监督。值得注意的是，它将AIME2024上的Verified Pass@1024从26.7%提升到62.6%，并将“奇迹步骤”的发生率降低了71%。我们的工作证明，奖励解决方案的过程对于构建不仅更准确而且更可靠的模型至关重要。
AI.summary: 本研究旨在解决大型语言模型（LLM）在数学推理中出现的“奇迹步骤”问题，即模型通过不健全的推理过程跳跃到正确答案。研究发现，传统的基于最终答案的奖励机制是导致此问题的主要原因，并且“奇迹步骤”与模型记忆有关。为解决此问题，研究者提出了一种名为“评分奖励模型”（RRM）的新型奖励机制，该机制能够评估整个推理过程，并根据问题特定的评分标准对推理的每一步进行奖励。实验结果表明，采用RRM训练的LLM在数学推理任务上的表现显著优于仅基于最终答案奖励训练的模型，不仅提高了准确率，还大幅减少了“奇迹步骤”的发生，证明了过程导向奖励的重要性。
AI.keywords: 数学推理, 大型语言模型, 奖励破解, 奇迹步骤, 评分奖励模型
AI.comments: 这项研究解决了大型语言模型在数学推理中的一个关键且普遍存在的问题——“奇迹步骤”。通过引入基于评分标准的奖励机制（RRM），作者提供了一种有效的解决方案，能够评估整个推理过程，而不仅仅是最终答案。这不仅提高了模型的准确性，而且增强了其可靠性，减少了因记忆而非推导导致的错误。这项工作对于开发更值得信赖的AI数学推理系统具有重要意义。

title: Arbitrary Entropy Policy Optimization: Entropy Is Controllable in Reinforcement Fine-tuning
summary:
Reinforcement fine-tuning (RFT) is essential for enhancing the reasoning
capabilities of large language models (LLM), yet the widely adopted Group
Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) suffers from entropy collapse, where
entropy monotonically decreases, exploration vanishes, and policies converge
prematurely. Existing entropy-regularized methods only partially alleviate this
issue while introducing bias and instability, leaving entropy control
unresolved and the connection between entropy, exploration, and performance
unclear. We propose Arbitrary Entropy Policy Optimization (AEPO), which
eliminates entropy collapse by replacing entropy bonuses with REINFORCE policy
gradient on temperature-adjusted distributions and stabilizing entropy through
temperature regulation. AEPO integrates three key designs: policy gradient as
regularization, distribution as regularization, and REINFORCE as
regularization, enabling precise entropy control without distorting
optimization. Experiments demonstrate three major contributions: AEPO (1)
stabilizes entropy at arbitrary target levels, effectively removing collapse in
GRPO; (2) reveals a non-monotonic relation where performance first improves
then declines with increasing entropy, clarifying the link between entropy,
exploration, and reasoning; and (3) generalizes beyond entropy, providing a
broader RFT paradigm where superior target distributions can serve as REINFORCE
regularizers.

AI.title_translation: 任意熵策略优化：强化微调中的熵是可控的
AI.tldr: AEPO是一种新的强化微调方法，它通过用REINFORCE梯度替换熵奖励并稳定温度，成功地解决了GRPO的熵崩溃问题，实现了对熵的精确控制，并发现最佳性能对应于中间熵水平。
AI.motivation: 广泛采用的群体相对策略优化（GRPO）在强化微调（RFT）中存在熵崩溃问题，导致探索消失和策略过早收敛。现有方法未能解决熵控制问题，且熵、探索与性能之间的关系尚不清楚。
AI.method: 提出任意熵策略优化（AEPO），它通过用温度调整分布上的REINFORCE策略梯度替换熵奖励，并通过温度调节来稳定熵。AEPO集成了“策略梯度作为正则化”、“分布作为正则化”和“REINFORCE作为正则化”三个关键设计。
AI.result: AEPO (1) 能将熵稳定在任意目标水平，有效消除了GRPO中的崩溃；(2) 揭示了性能随熵增加先提高后下降的非单调关系，阐明了熵、探索和推理之间的联系；(3) 具有泛化性，提供了一个更广泛的RFT范式，其中优越的目标分布可用作REINFORCE正则化器。
AI.conclusion: AEPO成功地在不扭曲优化的前提下实现了对熵的精确控制，有效消除了GRPO中的熵崩溃，并揭示了熵、探索与推理性能之间存在非单调关系，这为更广泛的强化微调（RFT）范式奠定了基础。
AI.translation: 强化微调（RFT）对于增强大型语言模型的推理能力至关重要，但广泛采用的群体相对策略优化（GRPO）存在熵崩溃问题，即熵单调下降，探索消失，策略过早收敛。现有的熵正则化方法只能部分缓解此问题，同时引入了偏差和不稳定性，使得熵控制悬而未决，且熵、探索与性能之间的联系尚不清楚。我们提出了任意熵策略优化（AEPO），它通过用温度调整分布上的REINFORCE策略梯度替换熵奖励并稳定熵，从而消除了熵崩溃。AEPO集成了三个关键设计：策略梯度作为正则化、分布作为正则化以及REINFORCE作为正则化，能够在不扭曲优化的前提下实现精确的熵控制。实验证明了AEPO的三个主要贡献：（1）将熵稳定在任意目标水平，有效消除了GRPO中的崩溃；（2）揭示了性能随熵增加先提高后下降的非单调关系，阐明了熵、探索和推理之间的联系；（3）超越了熵的限制，提供了一个更广泛的RFT范式，其中优越的目标分布可以作为REINFORCE正则化器。
AI.summary: 本文提出了任意熵策略优化（AEPO），以解决强化微调（RFT）中GRPO的熵崩溃问题。AEPO通过使用REINFORCE策略梯度替代熵奖励并进行温度调节来精确控制熵，从而稳定了熵。实验证明，AEPO不仅能消除熵崩溃，还能揭示熵与性能之间的非单调关系，并为更广泛的RFT正则化范式提供了基础。
AI.keywords: 强化微调, 熵控制, 策略优化, 熵崩溃, LLM
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于提出了AEPO，它通过将熵奖励替换为温度调整分布上的REINFORCE策略梯度，并引入温度调节来稳定熵，从而解决了GRPO中常见的熵崩溃问题。其重要性在于为LLM的强化微调提供了一种精确控制探索和性能之间权衡的新范式。局限性在于，虽然解决了熵崩溃，但其在更广泛的RLHF场景中的通用性仍需进一步验证。

title: FlyLoRA: Boosting Task Decoupling and Parameter Efficiency via Implicit Rank-Wise Mixture-of-Experts
summary:
Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) is a widely used parameter-efficient fine-tuning
method for foundation models, but it suffers from parameter interference,
resulting in suboptimal performance. Although Mixture-of-Experts (MoE)-based
LoRA variants show promise in mitigating intra-task correlations in single-task
instruction tuning, they introduce additional router parameters and remain
ineffective in multi-task model merging where inter-task interference arises.
Inspired by the fly olfactory circuit, we propose FlyLoRA, an implicit
MoE-based LoRA variant that introduces: (1) rank-wise expert activation in the
up-projection matrix, and (2) an implicit router that unifies expert routing
and down-projection, where a frozen sparse random projection matrix replaces
the traditional dense trainable version. This design resolves the trade-off
between intra-task decorrelation and computational efficiency by eliminating
the need for an explicit router, while inherently mitigating inter-task
interference due to the orthogonality property of random matrices. Extensive
experiments across four domains -- general knowledge understanding, scientific
question answering, mathematical reasoning, and code generation -- demonstrate
consistent performance improvements over existing methods. Beyond empirical
gains, FlyLoRA highlights how biological structures can inspire innovations in
AI technologies. Code is available at https://github.com/gfyddha/FlyLoRA.

AI.title_translation: FlyLoRA：通过隐式秩组合专家混合提升任务解耦和参数效率
AI.tldr: FlyLoRA是一种新的LoRA变体，它使用隐式专家混合来提高参数效率和性能，特别是在多任务场景下，通过秩外激活和隐式路由器解决参数干扰问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的LoRA方法存在参数干扰问题，导致性能不佳。基于MoE的LoRA变体虽然可以缓解单任务指令调优中的任务内相关性，但会引入额外的路由器参数，并且在多任务模型合并中，由于任务间干扰而效果不佳。
AI.method: FlyLoRA是一种隐式MoE-based LoRA变体，其特点是：1）在升维矩阵中引入秩外专家激活；2）使用隐式路由器统一专家路由和降维，其中使用固定的稀疏随机投影矩阵替代传统的密集可训练版本。
AI.result: 在通用知识理解、科学问答、数学推理和代码生成四个领域的广泛实验表明，FlyLoRA在性能上持续优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: FlyLoRA通过秩外专家激活和隐式路由器，解决了任务内解耦和参数效率的权衡问题，并有效缓解了任务间干扰，在多个领域实现了性能提升，并展示了生物结构启发AI创新的潜力。
AI.translation: 低秩自适应（LoRA）是一种广泛使用的参数高效微调方法，用于基础模型，但它存在参数干扰问题，导致性能不佳。尽管基于混合专家（MoE）的LoRA变体在缓解单任务指令调优中的任务内相关性方面显示出潜力，但它们引入了额外的路由器参数，并且在多任务模型合并中仍然无效，因为会产生任务间干扰。受飞虫嗅觉回路的启发，我们提出了FlyLoRA，一种基于隐式MoE的LoRA变体，它引入了：1）升维矩阵中的秩外专家激活；以及2）一种隐式路由器，它统一了专家路由和降维，其中一个固定的稀疏随机投影矩阵取代了传统的密集可训练版本。这种设计通过消除显式路由器的需求，解决了任务内去相关性和计算效率之间的权衡，同时由于随机矩阵的正交性固有地缓解了任务间干扰。在通用知识理解、科学问答、数学推理和代码生成四个领域的广泛实验表明，与现有方法相比，性能得到了一致的提升。除了经验增益之外，FlyLoRA还强调了生物结构如何启发AI技术的创新。代码可在https://github.com/gfyddha/FlyLoRA 获取。
AI.summary: FlyLoRA是一种新颖的低秩自适应（LoRA）方法，通过引入隐式专家混合（MoE）来解决参数干扰和效率问题。它采用秩外专家激活和隐式路由器，后者使用固定的稀疏随机投影矩阵替代可训练的密集版本，从而在不增加显式路由器参数的情况下，实现了任务内去相关和任务间干扰的缓解。实验证明FlyLoRA在多个任务领域均优于现有方法。
AI.keywords: FlyLoRA, 低秩自适应, 混合专家, 参数效率, 任务解耦
AI.comments: FlyLoRA通过借鉴生物学原理（飞虫嗅觉回路）来设计其隐式MoE-based LoRA变体，这是一种有创意的跨学科方法。其核心创新在于“秩外专家激活”和“隐式路由器”，这不仅解决了现有MoE-LoRA在多任务场景下的局限性，还通过使用固定的稀疏随机投影矩阵提高了参数效率。这种设计巧妙地平衡了任务解耦和计算成本，并利用了随机矩阵的正交性来缓解任务间干扰。然而，其在实际应用中的可扩展性和对不同类型模型（而不仅仅是基础模型）的通用性仍有待进一步验证。

title: Which Is Better For Reducing Outdated and Vulnerable Dependencies: Pinning or Floating?
summary:
Developers consistently use version constraints to specify acceptable
versions of the dependencies for their project. \emph{Pinning} dependencies can
reduce the likelihood of breaking changes, but comes with a cost of manually
managing the replacement of outdated and vulnerable dependencies. On the other
hand, \emph{floating} can be used to automatically get bug fixes and security
fixes, but comes with the risk of breaking changes. Security practitioners
advocate \emph{pinning} dependencies to prevent against software supply chain
attacks, e.g., malicious package updates. However, since \emph{pinning} is the
tightest version constraint, \emph{pinning} is the most likely to result in
outdated dependencies. Nevertheless, how the likelihood of becoming outdated or
vulnerable dependencies changes across version constraint types is unknown. The
goal of this study is to aid developers in making an informed dependency
version constraint choice by empirically evaluating the likelihood of
dependencies becoming outdated or vulnerable across version constraint types at
scale. In this study, we first identify the trends in dependency version
constraint usage and the patterns of version constraint type changes made by
developers in the npm, PyPI, and Cargo ecosystems. We then modeled the
dependency state transitions using survival analysis and estimated how the
likelihood of becoming outdated or vulnerable changes when using \emph{pinning}
as opposed to the rest of the version constraint types. We observe that among
outdated and vulnerable dependencies, the most commonly used version constraint
type is \emph{floating-minor}, with \emph{pinning} being the next most common.
We also find that \emph{floating-major} is the least likely to result in
outdated and \emph{floating-minor} is the least likely to result in vulnerable
dependencies.

AI.title_translation: 减少过时和易受攻击的依赖项：固定还是浮动更好？
AI.tldr: 固定（Pinning）依赖可以防止破坏性更改和供应链攻击，但会导致依赖项过时。浮动（Floating）可以自动获取修复，但有破坏性更改的风险。本研究大规模比较了固定和浮动策略对依赖项变旧和变脆弱的影响，发现浮动-次要最常见于已出问题的依赖项，而浮动-主要最不容易导致过时，浮动-次要最不容易导致漏洞。
AI.motivation: 安全实践者提倡固定依赖以防止供应链攻击，但固定最可能导致依赖项过时。然而，依赖项变为过时或易受攻击的几率如何随版本约束类型变化尚不清楚。本研究旨在通过大规模实证评估不同版本约束类型下依赖项变为过时或易受攻击的几率，帮助开发人员做出明智的选择。
AI.method: 首先识别 npm、PyPI 和 Cargo 生态系统中依赖版本约束的使用趋势和类型变更模式。然后，使用生存分析对依赖状态转换进行建模，并估计与使用固定（pinning）相比，使用其他版本约束类型时依赖项变为过时或易受攻击的几率。
AI.result: 在过时和易受攻击的依赖项中，最常用的版本约束类型是浮动-次要（floating-minor），固定（pinning）是第二常用的。浮动-主要（floating-major）最不可能导致依赖项过时，而浮动-次要（floating-minor）最不可能导致依赖项易受攻击。
AI.conclusion: 研究通过实证评估了不同版本约束类型（固定与浮动）在 npm、PyPI 和 Cargo 生态系统中导致依赖项过时或易受攻击的几率，观察到在过时和易受攻击的依赖项中，浮动-次要（floating-minor）是最常用的约束类型，固定（pinning）次之。研究发现，浮动-主要（floating-major）最不可能导致依赖项过时，而浮动-次要（floating-minor）最不可能导致依赖项易受攻击。
AI.translation: 开发人员一致使用版本约束来指定其项目中可接受的依赖项版本。\emph{固定}依赖项可以减少破坏性更改的可能性，但需要手动管理过时和易受攻击的依赖项的替换成本。另一方面，\emph{浮动}可用于自动获取错误修复和安全修复，但存在破坏性更改的风险。安全实践者提倡\emph{固定}依赖项以防止软件供应链攻击，例如恶意包更新。然而，由于\emph{固定}是最严格的版本约束，\emph{固定}最有可能导致依赖项过时。尽管如此，依赖项变为过时或易受攻击的几率如何随版本约束类型变化尚不清楚。本研究的目标是通过在规模上实证评估不同版本约束类型下依赖项变为过时或易受攻击的几率，帮助开发人员做出明智的依赖项版本约束选择。在本研究中，我们首先确定了 npm、PyPI 和 Cargo 生态系统中依赖版本约束的使用趋势以及开发人员进行版本约束类型变更的模式。然后，我们使用生存分析对依赖状态转换进行建模，并估计与使用\emph{固定}相比，使用其他版本约束类型时依赖项变为过时或易受攻击的几率变化。我们观察到，在过时和易受攻击的依赖项中，最常用的版本约束类型是\emph{浮动-次要}，\emph{固定}是第二常见的。我们还发现，\emph{浮动-主要}最不可能导致依赖项过时，而\emph{浮动-次要}最不可能导致依赖项易受攻击。
AI.summary: 本研究实证评估了在 npm、PyPI 和 Cargo 生态系统中，依赖项版本约束类型（固定 vs. 浮动）对依赖项变旧或出现安全漏洞的几率的影响。研究通过分析使用趋势和生存分析建模，发现浮动-次要约束在已过时/易受攻击的依赖项中最常见。结果表明，浮动-主要约束最不易导致依赖项过时，而浮动-次要约束最不易导致依赖项易受攻击。
AI.keywords: 依赖版本约束, 固定, 浮动, 过时依赖, 漏洞依赖
AI.comments: 这项研究的创新之处在于对 npm、PyPI 和 Cargo 生态系统中的依赖项版本约束类型（固定与浮动）对依赖项过时和易受攻击性的影响进行了大规模的实证评估。它量化了不同约束策略的风险和收益，为开发人员的选择提供了重要见解。局限性在于它主要关注这三个生态系统，结果可能无法完全推广到其他生态系统。

title: GTAlign: Game-Theoretic Alignment of LLM Assistants for Mutual Welfare
summary:
Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in reasoning,
yet sometimes produce responses that are suboptimal for users in tasks such as
writing, information seeking, or providing practical guidance. Conventional
alignment practices typically assume that maximizing model reward also
maximizes user welfare, but this assumption frequently fails in practice:
models may over-clarify or generate overly verbose reasoning when users prefer
concise answers. Such behaviors resemble the prisoner's dilemma, where
individually rational choices lead to socially suboptimal outcomes. The
fundamental challenge is the lack of a principled decision making mechanism
that mutually benefits both the LLM and the user. We propose Game-Theoretic
Alignment (GTAlign), an alignment framework that integrates game-theoretic
decision making into both reasoning and training. During reasoning, the model
explicitly treats user-LLM interaction as a strategic game: it constructs
payoff matrices within its reasoning chain to estimate welfare for both itself
and the user, and then selects actions that are mutually beneficial. During
training, we introduce a mutual welfare reward that reinforces cooperative
responses, aligning model behavior with socially efficient outcomes. In
addition, we introduce an inference technique that leverages game-theoretic
reasoning to dynamically adapt LLM's response when pricing policies of LLM
service change. Extensive experiments demonstrate that GTAlign substantially
improves reasoning efficiency, answer quality, and mutual welfare compared to
baselines across diverse tasks. The code is available at
https://github.com/ulab-uiuc/GTAlign .

AI.title_translation: GTAlign：博弈论对齐大语言模型助手以实现互利
AI.tldr: GTAlign是一个新的框架，它将博弈论决策整合到LLM的推理和训练中，将用户-LLM交互视为一个战略博弈，以优化双方的共同利益，而不是仅仅最大化模型奖励。实验表明，GTAlign在推理效率、答案质量和互利方面优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 传统LLM对齐方法假设最大化模型奖励等同于用户福利，但这在实践中常常失败，导致次优结果（例如，用户偏好简洁但模型生成冗长）。根本挑战在于缺乏一个能同时使LLM和用户受益的原则性决策机制。
AI.method: GTAlign框架将博弈论决策整合到LLM的推理和训练中。在推理过程中，模型将用户-LLM交互视为一个战略博弈，构建支付矩阵来估计自身和用户的福利，并选择互利的行动。在训练过程中，引入了互利奖励来鼓励合作性响应。此外，还提出了一种利用博弈论推理动态调整LLM响应的推理技术，以应对LLM服务定价策略的变化。
AI.result: 实验表明，GTAlign在推理效率、答案质量和互利方面相比基线方法有了显著的提高，并且在多样的任务中都表现出色。
AI.conclusion: GTAlign通过将博弈论整合到LLM的推理和训练中，成功地解决了用户-LLM交互中的次优问题，实现了模型和用户的互利共赢，并在多个评估指标上取得了优于现有方法的性能。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLM）在推理方面取得了显著进展，但有时在写作、信息检索或提供实际指导等任务中会产生对用户而言并非最优的响应。传统的对齐实践通常假设最大化模型奖励也最大化了用户福利，但这种假设在实践中常常失败：当用户偏好简洁的答案时，模型可能会过度解释或生成过于冗长的推理。这种行为类似于囚徒困境，其中个人理性的选择会导致社会性的次优结果。根本的挑战在于缺乏一个能够使LLM和用户都受益的原则性决策机制。我们提出了博弈论对齐（GTAlign），一个将博弈论决策整合到推理和训练中的对齐框架。在推理过程中，模型显式地将用户-LLM交互视为一个战略博弈：它在其推理链中构建支付矩阵来估计自身和用户的福利，然后选择能够带来互利的行动。在训练过程中，我们引入了一个互利奖励来强化合作性响应，使模型行为与社会效率结果保持一致。此外，我们还引入了一种利用博弈论推理来动态调整LLM响应的推理技术，以应对LLM服务定价策略的变化。大量的实验表明，GTAlign在推理效率、答案质量和互利方面相比基线方法在各种任务中都有显著的提高。代码可在https://github.com/ulab-uiuc/GTAlign 获取。
AI.summary: GTAlign框架通过将博弈论原理应用于LLM的推理和训练过程，解决了传统对齐方法中模型奖励最大化与用户福利最大化不一致的问题。该方法将用户-LLM交互视为一个战略博弈，通过构建支付矩阵来估计双方福利，并优化互利策略，从而提高推理效率和答案质量，实现用户和模型的共同利益。
AI.keywords: 博弈论对齐, 大型语言模型, 用户福利, 推理效率, 互利
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖的GTAlign框架，将博弈论引入LLM对齐，解决了传统方法中的一个关键痛点。通过将交互视为博弈并优化互利结果，该方法有望显著提升LLM在实际应用中的用户体验和效率。未来的工作可以探索更复杂的博弈模型和更广泛的应用场景。

title: On the Fairness of Privacy Protection: Measuring and Mitigating the Disparity of Group Privacy Risks for Differentially Private Machine Learning
summary:
While significant progress has been made in conventional fairness-aware
machine learning (ML) and differentially private ML (DPML), the fairness of
privacy protection across groups remains underexplored. Existing studies have
proposed methods to assess group privacy risks, but these are based on the
average-case privacy risks of data records. Such approaches may underestimate
the group privacy risks, thereby potentially underestimating the disparity
across group privacy risks. Moreover, the current method for assessing the
worst-case privacy risks of data records is time-consuming, limiting their
practical applicability. To address these limitations, we introduce a novel
membership inference game that can efficiently audit the approximate worst-case
privacy risks of data records. Experimental results demonstrate that our method
provides a more stringent measurement of group privacy risks, yielding a
reliable assessment of the disparity in group privacy risks. Furthermore, to
promote privacy protection fairness in DPML, we enhance the standard DP-SGD
algorithm with an adaptive group-specific gradient clipping strategy, inspired
by the design of canaries in differential privacy auditing studies. Extensive
experiments confirm that our algorithm effectively reduces the disparity in
group privacy risks, thereby enhancing the fairness of privacy protection in
DPML.

AI.title_translation: 隐私保护的公平性：衡量和减轻差分隐私机器学习中群体隐私风险的差异
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种新的差分隐私机器学习方法，通过改进的隐私风险评估和自适应梯度裁剪来减少群体间的隐私风险差异，从而提高隐私保护的公平性。
AI.motivation: 现有的差分隐私机器学习方法在评估群体隐私风险时可能低估了风险，导致跨群体隐私风险的差异被低估，且评估最坏情况隐私风险的方法耗时，不实用。
AI.method: 提出了一种新颖的成员推断博弈，用于高效审计近似最坏情况下的数据记录隐私风险。通过引入自适应的、特定于群体的梯度裁剪策略来增强标准的差分隐私随机梯度下降（DP-SGD）算法。
AI.result: 实验证明，该方法能更严格地衡量群体隐私风险，可靠地评估群体隐私风险的差异。所提出的算法能有效减少群体隐私风险的差异，从而增强差分隐私机器学习中隐私保护的公平性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究通过引入一种新的成员推断博弈和一种自适应的群体特定梯度裁剪策略，成功地衡量并减轻了差分隐私机器学习中群体间的隐私风险差异，提高了隐私保护的公平性。
AI.translation: 尽管在传统公平感知机器学习（ML）和差分隐私ML（DPML）方面取得了显著进展，但跨群体的隐私保护公平性仍未得到充分探索。现有研究提出了评估群体隐私风险的方法，但这些方法基于数据记录的平均情况隐私风险。这类方法可能会低估群体隐私风险，从而可能低估跨群体隐私风险的差异。此外，目前评估数据记录最坏情况隐私风险的方法耗时，限制了其实际应用。为了解决这些局限性，我们引入了一种新颖的成员推断博弈，可以有效地审计数据记录的近似最坏情况隐私风险。实验结果表明，我们的方法提供了更严格的群体隐私风险衡量标准，能够可靠地评估群体隐私风险的差异。此外，为了促进DPML中的隐私保护公平性，我们受到差分隐私审计研究中金丝雀设计的启发，通过引入一种自适应的、特定于群体的梯度裁剪策略来增强标准的DP-SGD算法。广泛的实验证实，我们的算法能够有效减少群体隐私风险的差异，从而增强DPML中隐私保护的公平性。
AI.summary: 本研究旨在解决差分隐私机器学习（DPML）中跨群体隐私保护公平性不足的问题。研究人员提出了一种新颖的成员推断博弈，能够高效地评估数据记录的近似最坏情况隐私风险，克服了现有方法低估风险和效率低下的缺点。此外，研究人员还提出了一种自适应的、特定于群体的梯度裁剪策略，并将其集成到DP-SGD算法中。实验结果表明，该方法不仅能更准确地衡量群体隐私风险及其差异，还能有效减少这种差异，从而显著提升DPML的隐私保护公平性。
AI.keywords: 差分隐私,机器学习,群体公平性,隐私风险,梯度裁剪
AI.comments: 这项研究解决了DPML领域一个重要但被忽视的问题：群体间的隐私保护公平性。提出的成员推断博弈在评估最坏情况隐私风险方面提高了效率和准确性，而自适应梯度裁剪策略则直接解决了隐私风险差异问题。这些贡献对于构建更公平、更可靠的DPML系统具有重要意义。未来的工作可以进一步探索该方法在不同类型的数据和模型上的泛化能力，以及在实际应用中部署的挑战。

title: A Comprehensive Survey on Benchmarks and Solutions in Software Engineering of LLM-Empowered Agentic System
summary:
The integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) into software engineering has
driven a transition from traditional rule-based systems to autonomous agentic
systems capable of solving complex problems. However, systematic progress is
hindered by a lack of comprehensive understanding of how benchmarks and
solutions interconnect. This survey addresses this gap by providing the first
holistic analysis of LLM-powered software engineering, offering insights into
evaluation methodologies and solution paradigms. We review over 150 recent
papers and propose a taxonomy along two key dimensions: (1) Solutions,
categorized into prompt-based, fine-tuning-based, and agent-based paradigms,
and (2) Benchmarks, including tasks such as code generation, translation, and
repair. Our analysis highlights the evolution from simple prompt engineering to
sophisticated agentic systems incorporating capabilities like planning,
reasoning, memory mechanisms, and tool augmentation. To contextualize this
progress, we present a unified pipeline illustrating the workflow from task
specification to deliverables, detailing how different solution paradigms
address various complexity levels. Unlike prior surveys that focus narrowly on
specific aspects, this work connects 50+ benchmarks to their corresponding
solution strategies, enabling researchers to identify optimal approaches for
diverse evaluation criteria. We also identify critical research gaps and
propose future directions, including multi-agent collaboration, self-evolving
systems, and formal verification integration. This survey serves as a
foundational guide for advancing LLM-driven software engineering. We maintain a
GitHub repository that continuously updates the reviewed and related papers at
https://github.com/lisaGuojl/LLM-Agent-SE-Survey.

AI.title_translation: LLM赋能的代理系统的软件工程中的基准和解决方案综合调查
AI.tldr: 本调查首次全面分析了LLM赋能的软件工程，重点关注解决方案（基于提示、微调和代理）和基准（代码生成、翻译、修复），并提出了一个统一的流程图，将50多个基准与相应的解决方案策略联系起来，以指导研究人员并确定未来的研究方向。
AI.motivation: 系统性进展受到对基准和解决方案如何相互关联缺乏全面理解的阻碍，本调查旨在解决这一差距。
AI.method: 对150多篇相关论文进行综述，提出一个包含解决方案（基于提示、微调和代理）和基准（代码生成、翻译、修复）的分类法，并提出了一个统一的流程图来展示从任务规范到交付成果的工作流程。
AI.result: 分析强调了从简单的提示工程到复杂的代理系统的演变，这些系统能够进行规划、推理、记忆和工具增强。该调查将50多个基准与其相应的解决方案策略联系起来，并确定了研究空白和未来方向，如多代理协作、自适应系统和形式化验证。
AI.conclusion: 本调查为推进LLM驱动的软件工程奠定了基础，为研究人员提供了指导，以识别不同评估标准的最佳方法，并指出了未来的研究方向。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在软件工程中的集成推动了从传统的基于规则的系统向能够解决复杂问题的自主代理系统的转变。然而，系统性进展受到对基准和解决方案如何相互关联缺乏全面理解的阻碍。本次调查解决了这一差距，首次对LLM赋能的软件工程进行了整体分析，提供了对评估方法和解决方案范式的见解。我们回顾了150多篇最新论文，并提出了一个沿两个关键维度划分的分类法：(1) 解决方案，分为基于提示、基于微调和基于代理的范式；(2) 基准，包括代码生成、翻译和修复等任务。我们的分析强调了从简单的提示工程到结合了规划、推理、记忆机制和工具增强等功能的复杂代理系统的演变。为了将这一进展置于背景中，我们提出了一个统一的流程图，说明了从任务规范到交付成果的工作流程，详细介绍了不同的解决方案范式如何处理不同级别的复杂性。与以往只关注特定方面的调查不同，本研究将50多个基准与其相应的解决方案策略联系起来，使研究人员能够为不同的评估标准确定最佳方法。我们还确定了关键的研究空白，并提出了未来的方向，包括多代理协作、自适应系统和形式化验证集成。本调查为推进LLM驱动的软件工程奠定了基础。我们维护了一个GitHub存储库，在https://github.com/lisaGuojl/LLM-Agent-SE-Survey 上持续更新所审查和相关论文。
AI.summary: 本调查首次全面分析了LLM赋能的软件工程，重点关注解决方案（基于提示、微调和代理）和基准（代码生成、翻译、修复），并提出了一个统一的流程图，将50多个基准与相应的解决方案策略联系起来，以指导研究人员并确定未来的研究方向。
AI.keywords: LLM, 代理系统, 软件工程, 基准, 解决方案
AI.comments: 这项调查具有开创性，因为它首次全面地将LLM驱动的代理系统的软件工程解决方案和基准联系起来。通过提出的分类法和统一的流程图，研究人员可以更容易地导航和理解该领域，从而促进更快的进步。然而，该调查可能受到其分析的论文范围的限制，并且随着LLM技术的快速发展，其结论可能需要定期更新。

title: A Style-Based Profiling Framework for Quantifying the Synthetic-to-Real Gap in Autonomous Driving Datasets
summary:
Ensuring the reliability of autonomous driving perception systems requires
extensive environment-based testing, yet real-world execution is often
impractical. Synthetic datasets have therefore emerged as a promising
alternative, offering advantages such as cost-effectiveness, bias free
labeling, and controllable scenarios. However, the domain gap between synthetic
and real-world datasets remains a major obstacle to model generalization. To
address this challenge from a data-centric perspective, this paper introduces a
profile extraction and discovery framework for characterizing the style
profiles underlying both synthetic and real image datasets. We propose Style
Embedding Distribution Discrepancy (SEDD) as a novel evaluation metric. Our
framework combines Gram matrix-based style extraction with metric learning
optimized for intra-class compactness and inter-class separation to extract
style embeddings. Furthermore, we establish a benchmark using publicly
available datasets. Experiments are conducted on a variety of datasets and
sim-to-real methods, and the results show that our method is capable of
quantifying the synthetic-to-real gap. This work provides a standardized
profiling-based quality control paradigm that enables systematic diagnosis and
targeted enhancement of synthetic datasets, advancing future development of
data-driven autonomous driving systems.

AI.title_translation: 一种基于风格的剖析框架，用于量化自动驾驶数据集中合成到真实的差距
AI.tldr: 提出一个基于风格分析的框架（SEDD指标），用于量化自动驾驶合成数据与真实数据之间的差距，以帮助改进合成数据集的质量。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶系统需要大量的基于环境的测试，但现实世界的执行成本高昂，因此合成数据集成为有前景的替代方案。然而，合成与真实世界数据集之间的域差距是模型泛化的主要障碍。
AI.method: 提出一个用于表征合成和真实图像数据集风格特征的剖析提取和发现框架。该框架结合了基于Gram矩阵的风格提取与针对类内紧凑性和类间分离优化的度量学习，以提取风格嵌入。并提出了风格嵌入分布差异（SEDD）作为新的评估指标。
AI.result: 实验在各种数据集和sim-to-real方法上进行，结果表明该方法能够量化合成到真实的差距。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作提供了一种标准化的、基于剖析的质量控制范式，能够对合成数据集进行系统诊断和有针对性的增强，从而推动数据驱动的自动驾驶系统的未来发展。
AI.translation: 确保自动驾驶感知系统的可靠性需要广泛的环境测试，但现实世界的执行通常是不切实际的。因此，合成数据集已成为一个有前景的替代方案，它提供了成本效益、无偏见标注和可控场景等优势。然而，合成数据集与真实世界数据集之间的域差距仍然是模型泛化的主要障碍。为从数据中心角度解决这一挑战，本文介绍了一个用于表征合成和真实图像数据集潜在风格特征的剖析提取和发现框架。我们提出风格嵌入分布差异（SEDD）作为一种新颖的评估指标。我们的框架将基于Gram矩阵的风格提取与针对类内紧凑性和类间分离优化的度量学习相结合，以提取风格嵌入。此外，我们使用公开可用的数据集建立了一个基准。在各种数据集和sim-to-real方法上进行了实验，结果表明我们的方法能够量化合成到真实的差距。这项工作提供了一种标准化的、基于剖析的质量控制范式，能够对合成数据集进行系统诊断和有针对性的增强，从而推动数据驱动的自动驾驶系统的未来发展。
AI.summary: 为解决自动驾驶合成数据集与真实世界数据集之间的域差距问题，本文提出了一个风格剖析框架，用于提取和发现数据集的风格特征。研究引入了风格嵌入分布差异（SEDD）作为新指标，并通过结合Gram矩阵和度量学习来提取风格嵌入。该方法提供了一种标准化的质量控制范式，可用于系统诊断和改进合成数据集。
AI.keywords: 风格剖析, 合成到真实差距, 自动驾驶数据集, 风格嵌入分布差异, 质量控制
AI.comments: 该研究的创新点在于提出了一个基于风格剖析的新框架和SEDD新指标，用于量化合成到真实世界的差距。其重要性在于为合成数据集的质量控制和改进提供了一个系统化的方法。局限性是仅基于风格特征，可能无法完全捕捉所有导致泛化的差异。

title: EA4LLM: A Gradient-Free Approach to Large Language Model Optimization via Evolutionary Algorithms
summary:
In recent years, large language models (LLMs) have made remarkable progress,
with model optimization primarily relying on gradient-based optimizers such as
Adam. However, these gradient-based methods impose stringent hardware
requirements, demanding high-concurrency, high-memory GPUs. Moreover, they
require all neural network operations to be differentiable, thereby excluding
many promising non-differentiable architectures from practical use. To address
these limitations, we propose EA4LLM, an evolutionary algorithm for optimizing
LLMs, and, for the first time, empirically verify full-parameter optimization
from the pretraining stage across model sizes ranging from 0.5B to 32B. We
conduct extensive experiments and provide key insights into how evolutionary
algorithms can effectively optimize neural networks. Our work challenges the
prevailing assumption that gradient-based optimization is the only viable
approach for training neural networks. It also holds significant potential to
reduce the computational cost of training large language models, thereby
enabling groups with limited computational resources to participate in deep
learning research.

AI.title_translation: EA4LLM：一种通过进化算法对大型语言模型进行优化的无梯度方法
AI.tldr: EA4LLM是一种全新的、无需梯度的进化算法优化大型语言模型的方法，成功应用于高达32B的模型，挑战了梯度优越性，并有望降低训练成本，使更多人能参与LLM研究。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于梯度的优化器（如Adam）对硬件要求高（需要高并发、高内存的GPU），并且要求所有神经网络操作都是可微的，这排除了许多有前景的不可微架构的实际应用。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为EA4LLM的进化算法来优化大型语言模型，并首次在0.5B到32B的模型尺寸上对全参数进行了实证验证。
AI.result: 成功地对0.5B到32B模型尺寸的大型语言模型进行了全参数优化，并提供了关于进化算法如何有效优化神经网络的关键见解。
AI.conclusion: EA4LLM的提出和验证挑战了梯度优化是训练神经网络唯一可行方法的普遍假设，并具有显著潜力降低大型语言模型训练的计算成本，使计算资源有限的团队也能参与深度学习研究。
AI.translation: 近年来，大型语言模型（LLMs）取得了显著的进步，模型的优化主要依赖于诸如Adam等基于梯度的优化器。然而，这些基于梯度的方法对硬件提出了严格的要求，需要高并发、高内存的GPU。此外，它们要求所有神经网络操作都是可微的，从而将许多有前景的不可微架构排除在实际应用之外。为解决这些限制，我们提出了EA4LLM，一种用于优化LLMs的进化算法，并首次实证验证了跨越0.5B到32B模型尺寸的预训练阶段的全参数优化。我们进行了广泛的实验，并为进化算法如何有效优化神经网络提供了关键见解。我们的工作挑战了梯度优化是训练神经网络唯一可行方法的普遍假设。它还具有显著潜力降低训练大型语言模型的计算成本，从而使计算资源有限的群体能够参与深度学习研究。
AI.summary: EA4LLM提出了一种基于进化算法的无梯度方法来优化大型语言模型（LLMs），以克服传统梯度优化方法对硬件的严格要求和对可微性的限制。研究人员首次在0.5B到32B的模型上验证了这种全参数优化方法，并展示了进化算法优化神经网络的有效性，为资源有限的研究者提供了训练大型模型的替代途径。
AI.keywords: 大型语言模型优化, 进化算法, 无梯度优化, 全参数优化, 预训练
AI.comments: EA4LLM的主要创新在于首次使用进化算法对LLM进行全参数优化，并成功应用于高达32B的模型，挑战了梯度优化是唯一可行方法的传统观念。其重要性在于为资源受限的研究者提供了训练大型模型的替代方案，降低了计算门槛。局限性是未详细说明进化算法的具体实现细节和性能与梯度方法的直接对比。

title: Uncovering Anomalous Events for Marine Environmental Monitoring via Visual Anomaly Detection
summary:
Underwater video monitoring is a promising strategy for assessing marine
biodiversity, but the vast volume of uneventful footage makes manual inspection
highly impractical. In this work, we explore the use of visual anomaly
detection (VAD) based on deep neural networks to automatically identify
interesting or anomalous events. We introduce AURA, the first multi-annotator
benchmark dataset for underwater VAD, and evaluate four VAD models across two
marine scenes. We demonstrate the importance of robust frame selection
strategies to extract meaningful video segments. Our comparison against
multiple annotators reveals that VAD performance of current models varies
dramatically and is highly sensitive to both the amount of training data and
the variability in visual content that defines "normal" scenes. Our results
highlight the value of soft and consensus labels and offer a practical approach
for supporting scientific exploration and scalable biodiversity monitoring.

AI.title_translation: 通过视觉异常检测揭示用于海洋环境监测的反常事件
AI.tldr: 水下视频太多了，手动看太累了。我们用深度学习的视觉异常检测 (VAD) 来自动找异常事件。我们创建了一个叫 AURA 的新数据集，并发现模型性能受训练数据和“正常”场景定义的影响很大，强调了好的帧选择和共识标签的重要性。
AI.motivation: 水下视频监测是评估海洋生物多样性的有前景的策略，但大量的无事件素材使得手动检查非常不切实际。
AI.method: 探索使用基于深度神经网络的视觉异常检测 (VAD) 来自动识别有趣或异常事件，并评估了四种 VAD 模型在两个海洋场景中的表现。
AI.result: 比较结果显示，当前模型的 VAD 性能差异巨大，并且对训练数据的量以及定义“正常”场景的视觉内容的可变性高度敏感。
AI.conclusion: 结果突出了软标签和共识标签的价值，并为支持科学探索和可扩展的生物多样性监测提供了一种实用的方法。
AI.translation: 水下视频监测是评估海洋生物多样性的有前景的策略，但大量的无事件素材使得手动检查非常不切实际。在这项工作中，我们探索使用基于深度神经网络的视觉异常检测（VAD）来自动识别有趣或异常事件。我们引入了 AURA，第一个用于水下 VAD 的多注释者基准数据集，并在两个海洋场景中评估了四种 VAD 模型。我们证明了稳健的帧选择策略对于提取有意义的视频片段的重要性。我们与多个注释者的比较显示，当前模型的 VAD 性能差异巨大，并且对训练数据的量以及定义“正常”场景的视觉内容的可变性高度敏感。我们的结果突出了软标签和共识标签的价值，并为支持科学探索和可扩展的生物多样性监测提供了一种实用的方法。
AI.summary: 该研究旨在利用深度学习的视觉异常检测 (VAD) 技术，自动从大量水下监测视频中识别异常事件，以解决手动检查的难题。研究中引入了首个多注释者水下 VAD 基准数据集 AURA，并通过评估现有模型，强调了稳健的帧选择策略和软/共识标签在提高性能方面的关键作用。
AI.keywords: 视觉异常检测, 水下监测, 基准数据集, 深度神经网络, 生物多样性
AI.comments: 这项工作的主要创新点是提出了第一个用于水下视觉异常检测的多注释者基准数据集 AURA，并强调了稳健的帧选择策略和共识标签的重要性。方法的局限性可能在于模型性能对“正常”场景定义的可变性非常敏感。

title: Structured Spectral Graph Representation Learning for Multi-label Abnormality Analysis from 3D CT Scans
summary:
With the growing volume of CT examinations, there is an increasing demand for
automated tools such as organ segmentation, abnormality detection, and report
generation to support radiologists in managing their clinical workload.
Multi-label classification of 3D Chest CT scans remains a critical yet
challenging problem due to the complex spatial relationships inherent in
volumetric data and the wide variability of abnormalities. Existing methods
based on 3D convolutional neural networks struggle to capture long-range
dependencies, while Vision Transformers often require extensive pre-training on
large-scale, domain-specific datasets to perform competitively. In this work of
academic research, we propose a 2.5D alternative by introducing a new
graph-based framework that represents 3D CT volumes as structured graphs, where
axial slice triplets serve as nodes processed through spectral graph
convolution, enabling the model to reason over inter-slice dependencies while
maintaining complexity compatible with clinical deployment. Our method, trained
and evaluated on 3 datasets from independent institutions, achieves strong
cross-dataset generalization, and shows competitive performance compared to
state-of-the-art visual encoders. We further conduct comprehensive ablation
studies to evaluate the impact of various aggregation strategies,
edge-weighting schemes, and graph connectivity patterns. Additionally, we
demonstrate the broader applicability of our approach through transfer
experiments on automated radiology report generation and abdominal CT data.

title: HoMer: Addressing Heterogeneities by Modeling Sequential and Set-wise Contexts for CTR Prediction
summary:
Click-through rate (CTR) prediction, which models behavior sequence and
non-sequential features (e.g., user/item profiles or cross features) to infer
user interest, underpins industrial recommender systems. However, most methods
face three forms of heterogeneity that degrade predictive performance: (i)
Feature Heterogeneity persists when limited sequence side features provide less
granular interest representation compared to extensive non-sequential features,
thereby impairing sequence modeling performance; (ii) Context Heterogeneity
arises because a user's interest in an item will be influenced by other items,
yet point-wise prediction neglects cross-item interaction context from the
entire item set; (iii) Architecture Heterogeneity stems from the fragmented
integration of specialized network modules, which compounds the model's
effectiveness, efficiency and scalability in industrial deployments. To tackle
the above limitations, we propose HoMer, a Homogeneous-Oriented TransforMer for
modeling sequential and set-wise contexts. First, we align sequence side
features with non-sequential features for accurate sequence modeling and
fine-grained interest representation. Second, we shift the prediction paradigm
from point-wise to set-wise, facilitating cross-item interaction in a highly
parallel manner. Third, HoMer's unified encoder-decoder architecture achieves
dual optimization through structural simplification and shared computation,
ensuring computational efficiency while maintaining scalability with model
size. Without arduous modification to the prediction pipeline, HoMer
successfully scales up and outperforms our industrial baseline by 0.0099 in the
AUC metric, and enhances online business metrics like CTR/RPM by 1.99%/2.46%.
Additionally, HoMer saves 27% of GPU resources via preliminary engineering
optimization, further validating its superiority and practicality.

title: mmWalk: Towards Multi-modal Multi-view Walking Assistance
comments:
Accepted by NeurIPS 2025 Datasets and Benchmarks Track. Data and
  Code: https://github.com/KediYing/mmWalk
summary:
Walking assistance in extreme or complex environments remains a significant
challenge for people with blindness or low vision (BLV), largely due to the
lack of a holistic scene understanding. Motivated by the real-world needs of
the BLV community, we build mmWalk, a simulated multi-modal dataset that
integrates multi-view sensor and accessibility-oriented features for outdoor
safe navigation. Our dataset comprises 120 manually controlled,
scenario-categorized walking trajectories with 62k synchronized frames. It
contains over 559k panoramic images across RGB, depth, and semantic modalities.
Furthermore, to emphasize real-world relevance, each trajectory involves
outdoor corner cases and accessibility-specific landmarks for BLV users.
Additionally, we generate mmWalkVQA, a VQA benchmark with over 69k visual
question-answer triplets across 9 categories tailored for safe and informed
walking assistance. We evaluate state-of-the-art Vision-Language Models (VLMs)
using zero- and few-shot settings and found they struggle with our risk
assessment and navigational tasks. We validate our mmWalk-finetuned model on
real-world datasets and show the effectiveness of our dataset for advancing
multi-modal walking assistance.

title: Bag of Tricks for Subverting Reasoning-based Safety Guardrails
comments: OpenAI Red-teaming Challenge Winner and Oral Presentation
summary:
Recent reasoning-based safety guardrails for Large Reasoning Models (LRMs),
such as deliberative alignment, have shown strong defense against jailbreak
attacks. By leveraging LRMs' reasoning ability, these guardrails help the
models to assess the safety of user inputs before generating final responses.
The powerful reasoning ability can analyze the intention of the input query and
will refuse to assist once it detects the harmful intent hidden by the
jailbreak methods. Such guardrails have shown a significant boost in defense,
such as the near-perfect refusal rates on the open-source gpt-oss series.
Unfortunately, we find that these powerful reasoning-based guardrails can be
extremely vulnerable to subtle manipulation of the input prompts, and once
hijacked, can lead to even more harmful results. Specifically, we first uncover
a surprisingly fragile aspect of these guardrails: simply adding a few template
tokens to the input prompt can successfully bypass the seemingly powerful
guardrails and lead to explicit and harmful responses. To explore further, we
introduce a bag of jailbreak methods that subvert the reasoning-based
guardrails. Our attacks span white-, gray-, and black-box settings and range
from effortless template manipulations to fully automated optimization. Along
with the potential for scalable implementation, these methods also achieve
alarmingly high attack success rates (e.g., exceeding 90% across 5 different
benchmarks on gpt-oss series on both local host models and online API
services). Evaluations across various leading open-source LRMs confirm that
these vulnerabilities are systemic, underscoring the urgent need for stronger
alignment techniques for open-sourced LRMs to prevent malicious misuse. Code is
open-sourced at https://chenxshuo.github.io/bag-of-tricks.

title: Empirical Study on Robustness and Resilience in Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
summary:
In cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL), it is a common
practice to tune hyperparameters in ideal simulated environments to maximize
cooperative performance. However, policies tuned for cooperation often fail to
maintain robustness and resilience under real-world uncertainties. Building
trustworthy MARL systems requires a deep understanding of robustness, which
ensures stability under uncertainties, and resilience, the ability to recover
from disruptions--a concept extensively studied in control systems but largely
overlooked in MARL. In this paper, we present a large-scale empirical study
comprising over 82,620 experiments to evaluate cooperation, robustness, and
resilience in MARL across 4 real-world environments, 13 uncertainty types, and
15 hyperparameters. Our key findings are: (1) Under mild uncertainty,
optimizing cooperation improves robustness and resilience, but this link
weakens as perturbations intensify. Robustness and resilience also varies by
algorithm and uncertainty type. (2) Robustness and resilience do not generalize
across uncertainty modalities or agent scopes: policies robust to action noise
for all agents may fail under observation noise on a single agent. (3)
Hyperparameter tuning is critical for trustworthy MARL: surprisingly, standard
practices like parameter sharing, GAE, and PopArt can hurt robustness, while
early stopping, high critic learning rates, and Leaky ReLU consistently help.
By optimizing hyperparameters only, we observe substantial improvement in
cooperation, robustness and resilience across all MARL backbones, with the
phenomenon also generalizing to robust MARL methods across these backbones.
Code and results available at
https://github.com/BUAA-TrustworthyMARL/adv_marl_benchmark .

title: Deep Research Brings Deeper Harm
comments: Accepted to Reliable ML from Unreliable Data Workshop @ NeurIPS 2025
summary:
Deep Research (DR) agents built on Large Language Models (LLMs) can perform
complex, multi-step research by decomposing tasks, retrieving online
information, and synthesizing detailed reports. However, the misuse of LLMs
with such powerful capabilities can lead to even greater risks. This is
especially concerning in high-stakes and knowledge-intensive domains such as
biosecurity, where DR can generate a professional report containing detailed
forbidden knowledge. Unfortunately, we have found such risks in practice:
simply submitting a harmful query, which a standalone LLM directly rejects, can
elicit a detailed and dangerous report from DR agents. This highlights the
elevated risks and underscores the need for a deeper safety analysis. Yet,
jailbreak methods designed for LLMs fall short in exposing such unique risks,
as they do not target the research ability of DR agents. To address this gap,
we propose two novel jailbreak strategies: Plan Injection, which injects
malicious sub-goals into the agent's plan; and Intent Hijack, which reframes
harmful queries as academic research questions. We conducted extensive
experiments across different LLMs and various safety benchmarks, including
general and biosecurity forbidden prompts. These experiments reveal 3 key
findings: (1) Alignment of the LLMs often fail in DR agents, where harmful
prompts framed in academic terms can hijack agent intent; (2) Multi-step
planning and execution weaken the alignment, revealing systemic vulnerabilities
that prompt-level safeguards cannot address; (3) DR agents not only bypass
refusals but also produce more coherent, professional, and dangerous content,
compared with standalone LLMs. These results demonstrate a fundamental
misalignment in DR agents and call for better alignment techniques tailored to
DR agents. Code and datasets are available at
https://chenxshuo.github.io/deeper-harm.

title: Continuous Uniqueness and Novelty Metrics for Generative Modeling of Inorganic Crystals
comments:
13 pages (5 pages of main text), accepted to the AI4Mat workshop at
  NeurIPS 2025. See https://github.com/WMD-group/xtalmet for the code. Added
  references and a footnote in Section 3
summary:
To address pressing scientific challenges such as climate change,
increasingly sophisticated generative artificial intelligence models are being
developed that can efficiently sample the large chemical space of possible
functional materials. These models can quickly sample new chemical compositions
paired with crystal structures. They are typically evaluated using uniqueness
and novelty metrics, which depend on a chosen crystal distance function.
However, the most prevalent distance function has four limitations: it fails to
quantify the degree of similarity between compounds, cannot distinguish
compositional difference and structural difference, lacks Lipschitz continuity
against shifts in atomic coordinates, and results in a uniqueness metric that
is not invariant against the permutation of generated samples. In this work, we
propose using two continuous distance functions to evaluate uniqueness and
novelty, which theoretically overcome these limitations. Our experiments show
that these distances reveal insights missed by traditional distance functions,
providing a more reliable basis for evaluating and comparing generative models
for inorganic crystals.

title: Epistemic-aware Vision-Language Foundation Model for Fetal Ultrasound Interpretation
comments: This paper contains fundamental errors and will not be replaced
summary:
Recent medical vision-language models have shown promise on tasks such as
VQA, report generation, and anomaly detection. However, most are adapted to
structured adult imaging and underperform in fetal ultrasound, which poses
challenges of multi-view image reasoning, numerous diseases, and image
diversity. To bridge this gap, we introduce FetalMind, a medical AI system
tailored to fetal ultrasound for both report generation and diagnosis. Guided
by clinical workflow, we propose Salient Epistemic Disentanglement (SED), which
injects an expert-curated bipartite graph into the model to decouple
view-disease associations and to steer preference selection along clinically
faithful steps via reinforcement learning. This design mitigates variability
across diseases and heterogeneity across views, reducing learning bottlenecks
while aligning the model's inference with obstetric practice. To train
FetalMind at scale, we curate FetalSigma-1M dataset, the first large-scale
fetal ultrasound report corpus, comprising 20K reports from twelve medical
centers, addressing the scarcity of domain data. Extensive experiments show
that FetalMind outperforms open- and closed-source baselines across all
gestational stages, achieving +14% average gains and +61.2% higher accuracy on
critical conditions while remaining efficient, stable, and scalable. Project
Page: https://hexiao0275.github.io/FetalMind.

title: Behavioral Biometrics for Automatic Detection of User Familiarity in VR
comments:
7 pages, 7 figures, 17th International Conference on Quality of
  Multimedia Experience (QoMEX 2025)
summary:
As virtual reality (VR) devices become increasingly integrated into everyday
settings, a growing number of users without prior experience will engage with
VR systems. Automatically detecting a user's familiarity with VR as an
interaction medium enables real-time, adaptive training and interface
adjustments, minimizing user frustration and improving task performance. In
this study, we explore the automatic detection of VR familiarity by analyzing
hand movement patterns during a passcode-based door-opening task, which is a
well-known interaction in collaborative virtual environments such as meeting
rooms, offices, and healthcare spaces. While novice users may lack prior VR
experience, they are likely to be familiar with analogous real-world tasks
involving keypad entry. We conducted a pilot study with 26 participants, evenly
split between experienced and inexperienced VR users, who performed tasks using
both controller-based and hand-tracking interactions. Our approach uses
state-of-the-art deep classifiers for automatic VR familiarity detection,
achieving the highest accuracies of 92.05% and 83.42% for hand-tracking and
controller-based interactions, respectively. In the cross-device evaluation,
where classifiers trained on controller data were tested using hand-tracking
data, the model achieved an accuracy of 78.89%. The integration of both
modalities in the mixed-device evaluation obtained an accuracy of 94.19%. Our
results underline the promise of using hand movement biometrics for the
real-time detection of user familiarity in critical VR applications, paving the
way for personalized and adaptive VR experiences.

title: DeepCausalMMM: A Deep Learning Framework for Marketing Mix Modeling with Causal Inference
comments:
Submitted to JOSS (Journal of Open Source Software) Journal for
  Publishing. It's currently in the Pre-review stage. Please note that Author
  has no middle name. Last name is 'Puttaparthi Tirumala' (it's a two-part
  surname)
summary:
Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) is a statistical technique used to estimate the
impact of marketing activities on business outcomes such as sales, revenue, or
customer visits. Traditional MMM approaches often rely on linear regression or
Bayesian hierarchical models that assume independence between marketing
channels and struggle to capture complex temporal dynamics and non-linear
saturation effects [@Chan2017; @Hanssens2005; @Ng2021Bayesian].
  **DeepCausalMMM** is a Python package that addresses these limitations by
combining deep learning, causal inference, and advanced marketing science. The
package uses Gated Recurrent Units (GRUs) to automatically learn temporal
patterns such as adstock (carryover effects) and lag, while simultaneously
learning statistical dependencies and potential causal structures between
marketing channels through Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) learning
[@Zheng2018NOTEARS; @Gong2024CausalMMM]. Additionally, it implements Hill
equation-based saturation curves to model diminishing returns and optimize
budget allocation.
  Key features include: (1) a data-driven design where hyperparameters and
transformations (e.g., adstock decay, saturation curves) are learned or
estimated from data with sensible defaults, rather than requiring fixed
heuristics or manual specification, (2) multi-region modeling with both shared
and region-specific parameters, (3) robust statistical methods including Huber
loss and advanced regularization, (4) comprehensive response curve analysis for
understanding channel saturation.

title: Novel Class Discovery for Point Cloud Segmentation via Joint Learning of Causal Representation and Reasoning
summary:
In this paper, we focus on Novel Class Discovery for Point Cloud Segmentation
(3D-NCD), aiming to learn a model that can segment unlabeled (novel) 3D classes
using only the supervision from labeled (base) 3D classes. The key to this task
is to setup the exact correlations between the point representations and their
base class labels, as well as the representation correlations between the
points from base and novel classes. A coarse or statistical correlation
learning may lead to the confusion in novel class inference. lf we impose a
causal relationship as a strong correlated constraint upon the learning
process, the essential point cloud representations that accurately correspond
to the classes should be uncovered. To this end, we introduce a structural
causal model (SCM) to re-formalize the 3D-NCD problem and propose a new method,
i.e., Joint Learning of Causal Representation and Reasoning. Specifically, we
first analyze hidden confounders in the base class representations and the
causal relationships between the base and novel classes through SCM. We devise
a causal representation prototype that eliminates confounders to capture the
causal representations of base classes. A graph structure is then used to model
the causal relationships between the base classes' causal representation
prototypes and the novel class prototypes, enabling causal reasoning from base
to novel classes. Extensive experiments and visualization results on 3D and 2D
NCD semantic segmentation demonstrate the superiorities of our method.

title: Spatial-DISE: A Unified Benchmark for Evaluating Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
summary:
Spatial reasoning ability is crucial for Vision Language Models (VLMs) to
support real-world applications in diverse domains including robotics,
augmented reality, and autonomous navigation. Unfortunately, existing
benchmarks are inadequate in assessing spatial reasoning ability, especially
the \emph{intrinsic-dynamic} spatial reasoning which is a fundamental aspect of
human spatial cognition. In this paper, we propose a unified benchmark,
\textbf{Spatial-DISE}, based on a cognitively grounded taxonomy that
categorizes tasks into four fundamental quadrants:
\textbf{I}ntrinsic-\textbf{S}tatic, Intrinsic-\textbf{D}ynamic,
\textbf{E}xtrinsic-Static, and Extrinsic-Dynamic spatial reasoning. Moreover,
to address the issue of data scarcity, we develop a scalable and automated
pipeline to generate diverse and verifiable spatial reasoning questions,
resulting in a new \textbf{Spatial-DISE} dataset that includes Spatial-DISE
Bench (559 evaluation VQA pairs) and Spatial-DISE-12K (12K+ training VQA
pairs). Our comprehensive evaluation across 28 state-of-the-art VLMs reveals
that, current VLMs have a large and consistent gap to human competence,
especially on multi-step multi-view spatial reasoning. Spatial-DISE offers a
robust framework, valuable dataset, and clear direction for future research
toward human-like spatial intelligence. Benchmark, dataset, and code will be
publicly released.

title: Instant Skinned Gaussian Avatars for Web, Mobile and VR Applications
summary:
We present Instant Skinned Gaussian Avatars, a real-time and cross-platform
3D avatar system. Many approaches have been proposed to animate Gaussian
Splatting, but they often require camera arrays, long preprocessing times, or
high-end GPUs. Some methods attempt to convert Gaussian Splatting into
mesh-based representations, achieving lightweight performance but sacrificing
visual fidelity. In contrast, our system efficiently animates Gaussian
Splatting by leveraging parallel splat-wise processing to dynamically follow
the underlying skinned mesh in real time while preserving high visual fidelity.
From smartphone-based 3D scanning to on-device preprocessing, the entire
process takes just around five minutes, with the avatar generation step itself
completed in only about 30 seconds. Our system enables users to instantly
transform their real-world appearance into a 3D avatar, making it ideal for
seamless integration with social media and metaverse applications. Website:
https://gaussian-vrm.github.io/

title: ViTacGen: Robotic Pushing with Vision-to-Touch Generation
summary:
Robotic pushing is a fundamental manipulation task that requires tactile
feedback to capture subtle contact forces and dynamics between the end-effector
and the object. However, real tactile sensors often face hardware limitations
such as high costs and fragility, and deployment challenges involving
calibration and variations between different sensors, while vision-only
policies struggle with satisfactory performance. Inspired by humans' ability to
infer tactile states from vision, we propose ViTacGen, a novel robot
manipulation framework designed for visual robotic pushing with vision-to-touch
generation in reinforcement learning to eliminate the reliance on
high-resolution real tactile sensors, enabling effective zero-shot deployment
on visual-only robotic systems. Specifically, ViTacGen consists of an
encoder-decoder vision-to-touch generation network that generates contact depth
images, a standardized tactile representation, directly from visual image
sequence, followed by a reinforcement learning policy that fuses visual-tactile
data with contrastive learning based on visual and generated tactile
observations. We validate the effectiveness of our approach in both simulation
and real world experiments, demonstrating its superior performance and
achieving a success rate of up to 86\%.

title: Identity-Preserving Image-to-Video Generation via Reward-Guided Optimization
summary:
Recent advances in image-to-video (I2V) generation have achieved remarkable
progress in synthesizing high-quality, temporally coherent videos from static
images. Among all the applications of I2V, human-centric video generation
includes a large portion. However, existing I2V models encounter difficulties
in maintaining identity consistency between the input human image and the
generated video, especially when the person in the video exhibits significant
expression changes and movements. This issue becomes critical when the human
face occupies merely a small fraction of the image. Since humans are highly
sensitive to identity variations, this poses a critical yet under-explored
challenge in I2V generation. In this paper, we propose Identity-Preserving
Reward-guided Optimization (IPRO), a novel video diffusion framework based on
reinforcement learning to enhance identity preservation. Instead of introducing
auxiliary modules or altering model architectures, our approach introduces a
direct and effective tuning algorithm that optimizes diffusion models using a
face identity scorer. To improve performance and accelerate convergence, our
method backpropagates the reward signal through the last steps of the sampling
chain, enabling richer gradient feedback. We also propose a novel facial
scoring mechanism that treats faces in ground-truth videos as facial feature
pools, providing multi-angle facial information to enhance generalization. A
KL-divergence regularization is further incorporated to stabilize training and
prevent overfitting to the reward signal. Extensive experiments on Wan 2.2 I2V
model and our in-house I2V model demonstrate the effectiveness of our method.
Our project and code are available at https://ipro-alimama.github.io/.

title: Vision-Centric Activation and Coordination for Multimodal Large Language Models
summary:
Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) integrate image features from visual
encoders with LLMs, demonstrating advanced comprehension capabilities. However,
mainstream MLLMs are solely supervised by the next-token prediction of textual
tokens, neglecting critical vision-centric information essential for analytical
abilities. To track this dilemma, we introduce VaCo, which optimizes MLLM
representations through Vision-Centric activation and Coordination from
multiple vision foundation models (VFMs). VaCo introduces visual discriminative
alignment to integrate task-aware perceptual features extracted from VFMs,
thereby unifying the optimization of both textual and visual outputs in MLLMs.
Specifically, we incorporate the learnable Modular Task Queries (MTQs) and
Visual Alignment Layers (VALs) into MLLMs, activating specific visual signals
under the supervision of diverse VFMs. To coordinate representation conflicts
across VFMs, the crafted Token Gateway Mask (TGM) restricts the information
flow among multiple groups of MTQs. Extensive experiments demonstrate that VaCo
significantly improves the performance of different MLLMs on various
benchmarks, showcasing its superior capabilities in visual comprehension.

title: Feature Selection and Regularization in Multi-Class Classification: An Empirical Study of One-vs-Rest Logistic Regression with Gradient Descent Optimization and L1 Sparsity Constraints
comments:
29 pages, 7 figures, 5 tables. Submitted to Machine Learning track.
  Comprehensive empirical evaluation of interpretable linear classification for
  analytical chemistry applications with focus on production deployment
  constraints, cost-benefit analysis, and class-specific feature importance
  patterns
summary:
Multi-class wine classification presents fundamental trade-offs between model
accuracy, feature dimensionality, and interpretability - critical factors for
production deployment in analytical chemistry. This paper presents a
comprehensive empirical study of One-vs-Rest logistic regression on the UCI
Wine dataset (178 samples, 3 cultivars, 13 chemical features), comparing
from-scratch gradient descent implementation against scikit-learn's optimized
solvers and quantifying L1 regularization effects on feature sparsity. Manual
gradient descent achieves 92.59 percent mean test accuracy with smooth
convergence, validating theoretical foundations, though scikit-learn provides
24x training speedup and 98.15 percent accuracy. Class-specific analysis
reveals distinct chemical signatures with heterogeneous patterns where color
intensity varies dramatically (0.31 to 16.50) across cultivars. L1
regularization produces 54-69 percent feature reduction with only 4.63 percent
accuracy decrease, demonstrating favorable interpretability-performance
trade-offs. We propose an optimal 5-feature subset achieving 62 percent
complexity reduction with estimated 92-94 percent accuracy, enabling
cost-effective deployment with 80 dollars savings per sample and 56 percent
time reduction. Statistical validation confirms robust generalization with
sub-2ms prediction latency suitable for real-time quality control. Our findings
provide actionable guidelines for practitioners balancing comprehensive
chemical analysis against targeted feature measurement in resource-constrained
environments.

title: Lexo: Eliminating Stealthy Supply-Chain Attacks via LLM-Assisted Program Regeneration
summary:
Software supply-chain attacks are an important and ongoing concern in the
open source software ecosystem. These attacks maintain the standard
functionality that a component implements, but additionally hide malicious
functionality activated only when the component reaches its target environment.
Lexo addresses such stealthy attacks by automatically learning and regenerating
vulnerability-free versions of potentially malicious components. Lexo first
generates a set of input-output pairs to model a component's full observable
behavior, which it then uses to synthesize a new version of the original
component. The new component implements the original functionality but avoids
stealthy malicious behavior. Throughout this regeneration process, Lexo
consults several distinct instances of Large Language Models (LLMs), uses
correctness and coverage metrics to shepherd these instances, and guardrails
their results. Our evaluation on 100+ real-world packages, including high
profile stealthy supply-chain attacks, indicates that Lexo scales across
multiple domains, regenerates code efficiently (<100s on average), maintains
compatibility, and succeeds in eliminating malicious code in several real-world
supply-chain-attacks, even in cases when a state-of-the-art LLM fails to
eliminate malicious code when prompted to do so.

title: Accelerating Mobile Language Model via Speculative Decoding and NPU-Coordinated Execution
summary:
Enhancing on-device large language models (LLMs) with contextual information
from local data enables personalized and task-aware generation, powering use
cases such as intelligent assistants and UI agents. While recent developments
in neural processors have substantially improved the efficiency of prefill on
mobile devices, the token-by-token generation process still suffers from high
latency and limited hardware utilization due to its inherently memory-bound
characteristics. This work presents sd.npu, a mobile inference framework that
integrates speculative decoding with dynamic hardware scheduling to accelerate
context-aware text generation on mobile devices. The framework introduces three
synergistic components: (1) adaptive execution scheduling, which dynamically
balances compute graphs between prefill and decoding phases; (2)
context-aligned drafting, which improves speculative efficiency through
lightweight online calibration to current tasks; and (3) hardware-efficient
draft extension, which reuses and expands intermediate sequences to improve
processing parallelism and reduce verification cost. Experiments on multiple
smartphones and representative workloads show consistent improvements of up to
3.8x in generation speed and 4.7x in energy efficiency compared with existing
mobile inference solutions. Component-level analysis further validates the
contribution of each optimization.

AI.title_translation: 加速移动端语言模型：通过推测解码和NPU协同执行
AI.tldr: 提出sd.npu框架，结合推测解码和动态硬件调度，通过自适应调度、上下文对齐草稿和硬件高效草稿扩展，将移动设备上LLM的生成速度提高了3.8倍，能效提高了4.7倍。
AI.motivation: 增强移动设备上的LLM以实现个性化和任务感知生成。尽管NPU提升了预填充效率，但逐令牌生成过程（解码）仍存在高延迟和硬件利用率低的问题，因为它受限于内存。
AI.method: 提出sd.npu移动推理框架，将推测解码（Speculative Decoding）与动态硬件调度相结合。框架包含三个协同组件：（1）自适应执行调度，动态平衡预填充和解码阶段的计算图；（2）上下文对齐草稿，通过轻量级在线校准提高推测效率；（3）硬件高效草稿扩展，重用和扩展中间序列以提高并行性并降低验证成本。
AI.result: 在多个智能手机和代表性工作负载上的实验显示，与现有移动推理解决方案相比，生成速度提高了3.8倍，能效提高了4.7倍。组件级分析进一步验证了各项优化的贡献。
AI.conclusion: sd.npu框架通过集成推测解码和动态硬件调度，成功加速了移动设备上的上下文感知文本生成。
AI.translation: 通过本地数据的上下文信息增强设备端大型语言模型（LLMs），可以实现个性化和任务感知的生成，支持智能助手和UI代理等用例。虽然神经处理器（NPU）的最新发展已大幅提高了移动设备上预填充（prefill）的效率，但由于其固有的内存限制特性，逐令牌的生成过程仍然存在高延迟和硬件利用率有限的问题。本文提出了sd.npu，一个移动推理框架，它将推测解码与动态硬件调度相结合，以加速移动设备上的上下文感知文本生成。该框架引入了三个协同组件：（1）自适应执行调度，动态平衡预填充和解码阶段之间的计算图；（2）上下文对齐草稿，通过轻量级在线校准来提高针对当前任务的推测效率；（3）硬件高效草稿扩展，重用和扩展中间序列以提高处理并行性并降低验证成本。在多个智能手机和代表性工作负载上进行的实验表明，与现有移动推理解决方案相比，生成速度提高了高达3.8倍，能效提高了高达4.7倍。组件级分析进一步验证了各项优化的贡献。
AI.summary: 本文提出了sd.npu，一个专为移动设备设计的推理框架，旨在解决设备端大型语言模型（LLMs）在逐令牌生成阶段（解码）面临的高延迟和低硬件利用率问题。sd.npu通过集成推测解码和动态NPU协同执行，引入了自适应执行调度、上下文对齐草稿和硬件高效草稿扩展三个关键组件。实验结果显示，该框架在生成速度上实现了高达3.8倍的提升，并在能效上提高了4.7倍，显著加速了移动设备上的上下文感知文本生成。
AI.keywords: 移动语言模型, 推测解码, NPU, 硬件调度, 低延迟
AI.comments: 这篇论文解决了在移动设备上部署LLM的关键瓶颈，即内存限制导致的解码阶段效率低下。通过结合软件算法（推测解码）和硬件层面的调度优化（NPU协同执行），sd.npu 提供了一个实用的、系统级的解决方案。其创新点在于“上下文对齐草稿”和“硬件高效草稿扩展”，这些组件专门针对移动端资源受限和任务多变的特性进行了优化，是推动LLM在边缘设备上普及的重要一步。

title: Towards Robust Zero-Shot Reinforcement Learning
summary:
The recent development of zero-shot reinforcement learning (RL) has opened a
new avenue for learning pre-trained generalist policies that can adapt to
arbitrary new tasks in a zero-shot manner. While the popular Forward-Backward
representations (FB) and related methods have shown promise in zero-shot RL, we
empirically found that their modeling lacks expressivity and that extrapolation
errors caused by out-of-distribution (OOD) actions during offline learning
sometimes lead to biased representations, ultimately resulting in suboptimal
performance. To address these issues, we propose Behavior-REgularizEd Zero-shot
RL with Expressivity enhancement (BREEZE), an upgraded FB-based framework that
simultaneously enhances learning stability, policy extraction capability, and
representation learning quality. BREEZE introduces behavioral regularization in
zero-shot RL policy learning, transforming policy optimization into a stable
in-sample learning paradigm. Additionally, BREEZE extracts the policy using a
task-conditioned diffusion model, enabling the generation of high-quality and
multimodal action distributions in zero-shot RL settings. Moreover, BREEZE
employs expressive attention-based architectures for representation modeling to
capture the complex relationships between environmental dynamics. Extensive
experiments on ExORL and D4RL Kitchen demonstrate that BREEZE achieves the best
or near-the-best performance while exhibiting superior robustness compared to
prior offline zero-shot RL methods. The official implementation is available
at: https://github.com/Whiterrrrr/BREEZE.

AI.title_translation: 迈向鲁棒的零样本强化学习
AI.tldr: 针对现有零样本强化学习（RL）中基于前向-后向（FB）表示法的鲁棒性和表达能力不足的问题，本文提出了BREEZE框架。BREEZE通过行为正则化、任务条件扩散模型和注意力机制的表达性架构，显著提高了性能和鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于前向-后向（FB）表示法的零样本强化学习（RL）方法缺乏表达能力，并且离线学习过程中由分布外（OOD）动作引起的外推误差可能导致表示偏差，最终导致次优性能。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为BREEZE（Behavior-REgularizEd Zero-shot RL with Expressivity enhancement）的升级版FB框架。BREEZE通过以下方式增强稳定性、策略提取能力和表示学习质量：1. 引入行为正则化，将策略优化转化为稳定的样本内学习范式。2. 使用任务条件扩散模型提取策略，以生成高质量、多模态的动作分布。3. 采用表达性的基于注意力机制的架构进行表示建模。
AI.result: 在ExORL和D4RL Kitchen上的大量实验表明，BREEZE实现了最佳或接近最佳的性能，并且与先前的离线零样本RL方法相比，表现出卓越的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: BREEZE成功地解决了现有零样本RL方法的表达能力不足和鲁棒性问题，通过结合行为正则化、扩散模型和注意力机制架构，实现了优异的性能和鲁棒性。
AI.translation: 零样本强化学习（RL）的最新发展为学习预训练的通用策略开辟了一条新途径，这些策略可以以零样本方式适应任意新任务。尽管流行的前向-后向表示法（FB）及相关方法在零样本RL中显示出潜力，但我们通过经验发现它们的建模缺乏表达能力，并且离线学习期间由分布外（OOD）动作引起的外推误差有时会导致表示偏差，最终导致次优性能。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了BREEZE（Behavior-REgularizEd Zero-shot RL with Expressivity enhancement），这是一个升级版的基于FB的框架，它同时增强了学习稳定性、策略提取能力和表示学习质量。BREEZE在零样本RL策略学习中引入了行为正则化，将策略优化转化为稳定的样本内学习范式。此外，BREEZE使用任务条件扩散模型来提取策略，从而能够在零样本RL设置中生成高质量和多模态的动作分布。更进一步，BREEZE采用表达性的基于注意力机制的架构进行表示建模，以捕获环境动力学之间复杂的关联。在ExORL和D4RL Kitchen上的大量实验证明，与先前的离线零样本RL方法相比，BREEZE实现了最佳或接近最佳的性能，同时表现出卓越的鲁棒性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了BREEZE（Behavior-REgularizEd Zero-shot RL with Expressivity enhancement）框架，旨在解决现有基于FB的零样本强化学习（RL）方法中存在的表达能力不足和由OOD动作引起的外推误差导致的鲁棒性问题。BREEZE通过结合行为正则化、任务条件扩散模型进行策略提取以及使用注意力机制的表达性架构进行表示建模，显著提高了学习稳定性、策略提取能力和表示质量。实验证明，BREEZE在ExORL和D4RL Kitchen上达到了最先进或接近最先进的性能，并展现出优越的鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: 零样本强化学习, 鲁棒性, 行为正则化, 扩散模型, 前向-后向表示法
AI.comments: 本文针对零样本强化学习（Zero-shot RL）的关键挑战——鲁棒性与表达能力——提出了一个系统性的改进方案。创新点在于将行为正则化引入零样本RL策略学习，以稳定优化过程，并创造性地利用任务条件扩散模型来处理零样本设置中策略的多模态输出需求。此外，采用注意力机制增强表示学习的质量，是解决现有FB方法表达力不足的有效手段。这项工作对于推动离线通用策略学习的实用性和可靠性具有重要意义。

title: MARIS: Marine Open-Vocabulary Instance Segmentation with Geometric Enhancement and Semantic Alignment
summary:
Most existing underwater instance segmentation approaches are constrained by
close-vocabulary prediction, limiting their ability to recognize novel marine
categories. To support evaluation, we introduce \textbf{MARIS}
(\underline{Mar}ine Open-Vocabulary \underline{I}nstance
\underline{S}egmentation), the first large-scale fine-grained benchmark for
underwater Open-Vocabulary (OV) segmentation, featuring a limited set of seen
categories and diverse unseen categories. Although OV segmentation has shown
promise on natural images, our analysis reveals that transfer to underwater
scenes suffers from severe visual degradation (e.g., color attenuation) and
semantic misalignment caused by lack underwater class definitions. To address
these issues, we propose a unified framework with two complementary components.
The Geometric Prior Enhancement Module (\textbf{GPEM}) leverages stable
part-level and structural cues to maintain object consistency under degraded
visual conditions. The Semantic Alignment Injection Mechanism (\textbf{SAIM})
enriches language embeddings with domain-specific priors, mitigating semantic
ambiguity and improving recognition of unseen categories. Experiments show that
our framework consistently outperforms existing OV baselines both In-Domain and
Cross-Domain setting on MARIS, establishing a strong foundation for future
underwater perception research.

AI.title_translation: MARIS：基于几何增强和语义对齐的海洋开放词汇实例分割
AI.tldr: 提出了MARIS，首个海洋开放词汇实例分割基准，并提出了一个包含几何先验增强模块（GPEM）和语义对齐注入机制（SAIM）的统一框架，以解决水下图像退化和语义错位问题，该框架在MARIS上表现优异。
AI.motivation: 现有的水下实例分割方法受限于封闭词汇预测，无法识别新颖的海洋类别。开放词汇分割在水下场景中面临严重的视觉退化（如颜色衰减）和缺乏水下类别定义导致的语义错位问题。
AI.method: 提出了**MARIS**，首个大规模细粒度水下开放词汇（OV）分割基准。同时提出了一个统一的框架，包含两个互补组件：1. **几何先验增强模块（GPEM）**：利用稳定的部件级和结构线索，在退化的视觉条件下保持对象一致性。2. **语义对齐注入机制（SAIM）**：利用领域特定的先验知识丰富语言嵌入，以减轻语义模糊性并改善对未见类别的识别。
AI.result: 该框架在MARIS基准上的域内（In-Domain）和跨域（Cross-Domain）设置中，持续优于现有的开放词汇基线。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为未来的水下感知研究奠定了坚实的基础。
AI.translation: 大多数现有的水下实例分割方法受到封闭词汇预测的限制，这限制了它们识别新颖海洋类别的能力。为了支持评估，我们引入了**MARIS**（海洋开放词汇实例分割），这是第一个用于水下开放词汇（OV）分割的大规模细粒度基准，其特点是包含有限的已知类别和多样化的未见类别。虽然开放词汇分割在自然图像上显示出前景，但我们的分析表明，转移到水下场景时，由于严重的视觉退化（例如颜色衰减）和缺乏水下类别定义导致的语义错位而受到影响。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了一个包含两个互补组件的统一框架。**几何先验增强模块（GPEM）**利用稳定的部件级和结构线索，在退化的视觉条件下保持对象一致性。**语义对齐注入机制（SAIM）**利用领域特定的先验知识丰富语言嵌入，减轻语义模糊性并改善对未见类别的识别。实验表明，我们的框架在MARIS上的域内和跨域设置中，持续优于现有的开放词汇基线，为未来的水下感知研究奠定了坚实的基础。
AI.summary: 本文针对水下实例分割中封闭词汇的局限性，首次提出了大规模细粒度水下开放词汇分割基准**MARIS**。针对水下场景特有的视觉退化和语义错位问题，作者提出了一个统一框架，包含利用结构线索增强鲁棒性的几何先验增强模块（GPEM）和利用领域先验校正语言嵌入的语义对齐注入机制（SAIM）。实验证明该框架在MARIS上的域内和跨域设置中均优于现有基线。
AI.keywords: 开放词汇实例分割, 水下感知, 几何增强, 语义对齐, MARIS
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于将开放词汇实例分割任务引入到极具挑战性的水下领域。通过引入首个大规模基准MARIS，解决了该领域数据匮乏和评估受限的问题。提出的GPEM和SAIM模块具有很强的针对性：GPEM通过几何增强应对水下环境特有的图像退化问题；SAIM通过领域先验对齐语义，解决了水下生物类别定义模糊导致的语义错位，为水下感知研究提供了新的方向和强大的基线。

title: VO-DP: Semantic-Geometric Adaptive Diffusion Policy for Vision-Only Robotic Manipulation
summary:
In the context of imitation learning, visuomotor-based diffusion policy
learning is one of the main directions in robotic manipulation. Most of these
approaches rely on point clouds as observation inputs and construct scene
representations through point clouds feature learning, which enables them to
achieve remarkable accuracy. However, the existing literature lacks an in-depth
exploration of vision-only solutions that have significant potential. In this
paper, we propose a Vision-Only and single-view Diffusion Policy learning
method (VO-DP) that leverages pretrained visual foundation models to achieve
effective fusion of semantic and geometric features. We utilize intermediate
features from VGGT incorporating semantic features from DINOv2 and geometric
features from Alternating Attention blocks. Features are fused via
cross-attention and spatially compressed with a CNN to form the input to the
policy head. Extensive experiments demonstrate that VO-DP not only outperforms
the vision-only baseline DP significantly but also exhibits distinct
performance trends against the point cloud-based method DP3: in simulation
tasks, VO-DP achieves an average success rate of 64.6% on par with DP3 64.0%
and far higher than DP 34.8%, while in real-world tasks, it reaches 87.9%,
outperforming both DP3 67.5% and DP 11.2% by a notable margin. Further
robustness evaluations confirm that VO-DP remains highly stable under varying
conditions including color, size, background, and lighting. Lastly, we
open-source a training library for robotic manipulation. Built on Accelerate,
this library supports multi-machine and multi-GPU parallel training, as well as
mixed precision training. It is compatible with visuomotor policies such as DP,
DP3 and VO-DP, and also supports the RoboTwin simulator.

AI.title_translation: VO-DP：面向纯视觉机器人操作的语义-几何自适应扩散策略
AI.tldr: 提出VO-DP，一种纯视觉、单视角的机器人操作扩散策略，它通过融合预训练视觉模型的语义和几何特征，在真实世界任务中取得了超越基于点云方法的卓越性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的机器人操作扩散策略大多依赖点云作为观察输入，并取得了显著的准确性。然而，文献中缺乏对具有巨大潜力的纯视觉解决方案的深入探索。
AI.method: 提出VO-DP（纯视觉单视角扩散策略）。该方法利用预训练的视觉基础模型，从VGGT中提取中间特征，整合来自DINOv2的语义特征和来自交替注意力块（Alternating Attention blocks）的几何特征。特征通过交叉注意力（cross-attention）融合，并用CNN进行空间压缩，作为策略头的输入。
AI.result: VO-DP显著优于纯视觉基线DP。在模拟任务中，VO-DP（64.6%）与基于点云的方法DP3（64.0%）持平。在真实世界任务中，VO-DP（87.9%）显著优于DP3（67.5%）和DP（11.2%）。此外，VO-DP在颜色、尺寸、背景和光照变化下保持高度稳定。
AI.conclusion: VO-DP是一种有效的纯视觉机器人操作扩散策略，其在真实世界任务中的性能超越了基于点云的方法。此外，作者开源了一个支持多机/多GPU并行和混合精度训练的机器人操作训练库。
